?","sql":"SELECT a.\"aid\", a.\"name\", COUNT(w.\"pid\") AS \"nombre\" FROM \"author\" a LEFT JOIN \"writes\" w ON w.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" GROUP BY a.\"aid\", a.\"name\";"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont écrit plus de trois publications ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"aid\", a.\"name\", COUNT(w.\"pid\") AS \"nombre\" FROM \"author\" a JOIN \"writes\" w ON w.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" GROUP BY a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" HAVING COUNT(w.\"pid\") > 3;"},{"question":"Quels titres ont plusieurs auteurs ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"pid\", p.\"title\", COUNT(w.\"aid\") AS \"nombre_auteurs\" FROM \"publication\" p JOIN \"writes\" w ON w.\"pid\" = p.\"pid\" GROUP BY p.\"pid\", p.\"title\" HAVING COUNT(w.\"aid\") > 1;"},{"question":"Quelles publications n'ont aucun auteur associé ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"pid\", p.\"title\" FROM o.\"oid\", o.\"name\" FROM \"organization\" o LEFT JOIN \"author\" a ON a.\"oid\" = o.\"oid\" WHERE a.\"aid\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien d'auteurs compte chaque organisation ?","sql":"SELECT o.\"oid\", o.\"name\", COUNT(a.\"aid\") AS \"nombre_auteurs\" FROM \"organization\" o LEFT JOIN \"author\" a ON a.\"oid\" = o.\"oid\" GROUP BY o.\"oid\", o.\"name\";"},{"question":"Quels domaines sont d.\"name\" HAVING COUNT(da.\"aid\") >= 5;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs appartiennent au domaine nommé « AI » ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" FROM \"author\" a JOIN \"domain_author\" da ON da.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" JOIN \"domain\" d ON d.\"did\" = da.\"did\" WHERE d.\"name\" = 'AI';"},{"question":"Quels domaines sont associés à des conférences ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.\"did\", ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.\"did\", d.\"name\" FROM \"domain\" d JOIN \"domain_journal\" dj ON dj.\"did\" = d.\"did\";"},{"question":"Combien de revues chaque domaine possède-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"name\", COUNT(dj.\"jid\") AS \"nombre_revues\" FROM \"domain\" d LEFT JOIN \"domain_journal\" dj ON dj.\"did\" = d.\"did\" GROUP BY d.\"did\", d.\"name\";"},{"question":"Quels domaines sont associés à des mots-clés ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.\"did\", d.\"name\" FROM \"domain\" d JOIN \"domain_keyword\" dk ON dk.\"did\" = d.\"did\";"},{"question":"Quels mots-clés sont liés au domaine 2 ?","sql":"SELECT k.\"kid\", k.\"keyword\" FROM \"keyword\" k JOIN \"domain_keyword\" dk ON dk.\"kid\" = k.\"kid\" WHERE dk.\"did\" = 2;"},{"question":"Combien de mots-clés sont associés à chaque domaine ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"name\", COUNT(dk.\"kid\") AS \"nombre_mots_cles\" FROM \"domain\" d LEFT JOIN \"domain_keyword\" dk ON dk.\"did\" = d.\"did\" GROUP BY d.\"did\", d.\"name\";"},{"question":"Quels domaines contiennent des publications ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.\"did\", d.\"name\" FROM \"domain\" d JOIN \"domain_publication\" dp ON dp.\"did\" = d.\"did\";"},{"question":"Combien de publications chaque domaine regroupe-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"name\", COUNT(dp.\"pid\") AS \"nombre_publications\" FROM \"domain\" d LEFT JOIN \"domain_publication\" dp ON dp.\"did\" = d.\"did\" GROUP BY d.\"did\", d.\"name\";"},{"question":"Quels domaines regroupent plus de dix publications ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"did\", d.\"name\" FROM \"domain\" d JOIN \"domain_publication\" dp ON dp.\"did\" = d.\"did\" GROUP BY d.\"did\", d.\"name\" HAVING COUNT(dp.\"pid\") > 10;"},{"question":"Quels mots-clés sont utilisés par des publications ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT k.\"kid\", k.\"keyword\" FROM \"keyword\" k JOIN \"publication_keyword\" pk ON pk.\"kid\" = k.\"kid\";"},{"question":"Combien de publications utilisent chaque mot-clé ?","sql":"SELECT k.\"keyword\", COUNT(pk.\"pid\") AS \"nombre_publications\" FROM \"keyword\" k LEFT JOIN \"publication_keyword\" pk ON pk.\"kid\" = k.\"kid\" GROUP BY k.\"kid\", k.\"keyword\";"},{"question":"Quels mots-clés apparaissent dans au moins trois publications ?","sql":"SELECT k.\"kid\", k.\"keyword\" FROM \"keyword\" k JOIN \"publication_keyword\" pk ON pk.\"kid\" = k.\"kid\" GROUP BY k.\"kid\", k.\"keyword\" HAVING COUNT(pk.\"pid\") >= 3;"},{"question":"Quels titres utilisent le mot-clé « database » ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"pid\", p.\"title\" FROM \"publication\" p JOIN \"publication_keyword\" pk ON pk.\"pid\" = p.\"pid\" JOIN \"keyword\" k ON k.\"kid\" = pk.\"kid\" WHERE k.\"keyword\" = 'database';"},{"question":"Quels mots-clés ne sont associés à aucune publication ?","sql":"SELECT k.\"kid\", k.\"keyword\" FROM \"keyword\" k LEFT JOIN \"publication_keyword\" pk ON pk.\"kid\" = k.\"kid\" WHERE pk.\"pid\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles publications ont au moins un mot-clé ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.\"pid\", p.\"title\" FROM \"publication\" p JOIN \"publication_keyword\" pk ON pk.\"pid\" = p.\"pid\";"},{"question":"Quelles publications n'ont aucun mot-clé ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"pid\", p.\"title\" FROM \"publication\" p LEFT JOIN \"publication_keyword\" pk ON pk.\"pid\" = p.\"pid\" WHERE pk.\"kid\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de mots-clés par publication ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(\"nombre\") FROM (SELECT \"pid\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre\" FROM \"publication_keyword\" GROUP BY \"pid\");"},{"question":"Quelles publications citent d'autres publications ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.\"pid\", p.\"title\" FROM \"publication\" p JOIN \"cite\" c ON c.\"citing\" = p.\"pid\";"},{"question":"Quelles publications sont citées au moins une fois ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.\"pid\", p.\"title\" FROM \"publication\" p JOIN \"cite\" c ON c.\"cited\" = p.\"pid\";"},{"question":"Quelles publications ne citent aucune autre publication ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"pid\", p.\"title\" FROM \"publication\" p LEFT JOIN \"cite\" c ON c.\"citing\" = p.\"pid\" WHERE c.\"cited\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles publications ne sont jamais citées ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"pid\", p.\"title\" FROM \"publication\" p LEFT JOIN \"cite\" c ON c.\"cited\" = p.\"pid\" WHERE c.\"citing\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien de fois chaque publication est-elle citée dans la table des citations ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"pid\", p.\"title\", COUNT(c.\"citing\") AS \"nombre\" FROM \"publication\" p LEFT JOIN \"cite\" c ON c.\"cited\" = p.\"pid\" GROUP BY p.\"pid\", p.\"title\";"},{"question":"Quelles publications reçoivent plus de deux citations explicites ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"pid\", p.\"title\", COUNT(c.\"citing\") AS \"nombre\" FROM \"publication\" p JOIN \"cite\" c ON c.\"cited\" = p.\"pid\" GROUP BY p.\"pid\", p.\"title\" HAVING COUNT(c.\"citing\") > 2;"},{"question":"Quels couples de publications sont reliés par une citation ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"citing\", c.\"cited\" FROM \"cite\" c;"},{"question":"Quels titres citent le titre « Introduction » ?","sql":"SELECT p1.\"title\" AS \"citant\", p2.\"title\" AS \"citee\" FROM \"cite\" c JOIN \"publication\" p1 ON p1.\"pid\" = c.\"citing\" JOIN \"publication\" p2 ON p2.\"pid\" = c.\"cited\" WHERE p2.\"title\" = 'Introduction';"},{"question":"Quelles publications ont un nombre de citations supérieur à la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT \"pid\", \"title\", \"citation_num\" FROM \"publication\" WHERE \"citation_num\" > (SELECT AVG(\"citation_num\") FROM \"publication\");"},{"question":"Quelles publications ont plus de références que la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT \"pid\", \"title\", \"reference_num\" FROM \"publication\" WHERE \"reference_num\" > (SELECT AVG(\"reference_num\") FROM \"publication\");"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont écrit une publication très citée ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" FROM \"author\" a JOIN \"writes\" w ON w.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" JOIN \"publication\" p ON p.\"pid\" = w.\"pid\" WHERE p.\"citation_num\" > (SELECT AVG(\"citation_num\") FROM \"publication\");"},{"question":"Quelles publications appartiennent à la fois au domaine 1 et au domaine 2 ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"pid\", p.\"title\" FROM \"publication\" p JOIN \"domain_publication\" d1 ON d1.\"pid\" = p.\"pid\" JOIN \"domain_publication\" d2 ON d2.\"pid\" = p.\"pid\" WHERE d1.\"did\" = 1 AND d2.\"did\" = 2;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs appartiennent au domaine 1 ou au domaine 2 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" FROM \"author\" a JOIN \"domain_author\" da ON da.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" WHERE da.\"did\" IN (1, 2);"},{"question":"Quels auteurs appartiennent au domaine 1 mais pas au domaine 2 ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" FROM \"author\" a JOIN \"domain_author\" da ON da.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" WHERE da.\"did\" = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"domain_author\" db WHERE db.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" AND db.\"did\" = 2);"},{"question":"Quels domaines ont à la fois des auteurs et des publications ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"did\", d.\"name\" FROM \"domain\" d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"domain_author\" da WHERE da.\"did\" = d.\"did\") AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"domain_publication\" dp WHERE dp.\"did\" = d.\"did\");"},{"question":"Quels domaines ont des publications mais aucun auteur ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"did\", d.\"name\" FROM \"domain\" d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"domain_publication\" dp WHERE dp.\"did\" = d.\"did\") AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"domain_author\" da WHERE da.\"did\" = d.\"did\");"},{"question":"Quels identifiants apparaissent à la fois comme auteur et organisation ?","sql":"SELECT \"aid\" AS \"identifiant\" FROM \"author\" INTERSECT SELECT \"oid\" FROM \"organization\";"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de domaines sont associés à des auteurs ou à des revues ?","sql":"SELECT \"did\" FROM \"domain_author\" UNION SELECT \"did\" FROM \"domain_journal\";"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de publications ont un mot-clé mais aucun domaine ?","sql":"SELECT \"pid\" FROM \"publication_keyword\" EXCEPT SELECT \"pid\" FROM \"domain_publication\";"},{"question":"Quels noms sont communs aux auteurs et aux organisations ?","sql":"SELECT \"name\" FROM \"author\" INTERSECT SELECT \"name\" FROM \"organization\";"},{"question":"Quelles publications sont dans une revue ou une conférence ?","sql":"SELECT \"pid\", \"title\" FROM \"publication\" WHERE \"jid\" IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT \"pid\", \"title\" FROM \"publication\" WHERE \"cid\" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles publications sont dans une revue mais pas dans une conférence ?","sql":"SELECT \"pid\", \"title\" FROM \"publication\" WHERE \"jid\" IS NOT NULL EXCEPT SELECT \"pid\", \"title\" FROM \"publication\" WHERE \"cid\" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont le plus grand nombre de publications ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"aid\", a.\"name\", COUNT(w.\"pid\") AS \"nombre\" FROM \"author\" a JOIN \"writes\" w ON w.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" GROUP BY a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" ORDER BY \"nombre\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelle publication a le plus grand nombre de citations ?","sql":"SELECT \"pid\", \"title\", \"citation_num\" FROM \"publication\" ORDER BY \"citation_num\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelle publication a le plus grand nombre de références ?","sql":"SELECT \"pid\", \"title\", \"reference_num\" FROM \"publication\" ORDER BY \"reference_num\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les trois publications les plus anciennes ?","sql":"SELECT \"pid\", \"title\", \"year\" FROM \"publication\" ORDER BY \"year\" ASC LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les trois publications les plus récentes ?","sql":"SELECT \"pid\", \"title\", \"year\" FROM \"publication\" ORDER BY \"year\" DESC LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont publié en 2021 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.\"name\" FROM \"author\" a JOIN \"writes\" w ON w.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" JOIN \"publication\" p ON p.\"pid\" = w.\"pid\" WHERE p.\"year\" = 2021;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont publié dans la revue 3 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" FROM \"author\" a JOIN \"writes\" w ON w.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" JOIN \"publication\" p ON p.\"pid\" = w.\"pid\" WHERE p.\"jid\" = 3;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont publié en conférence ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" FROM \"author\" a JOIN \"writes\" w ON w.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" JOIN \"publication\" p ON p.\"pid\" = w.\"pid\" WHERE p.\"cid\" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont publié à la fois en revue et en conférence ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" FROM \"author\" a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"writes\" w JOIN \"publication\" p ON p.\"pid\" = w.\"pid\" WHERE w.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" AND p.\"jid\" IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"writes\" w JOIN \"publication\" p ON p.\"pid\" = w.\"pid\" WHERE w.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" AND p.\"cid\" IS NOT NULL);"},{"question":"Quelles revues publient des articles après 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT j.\"jid\", j.\"name\" FROM \"journal\" j JOIN \"publication\" p ON p.\"jid\" = j.\"jid\" WHERE p.\"year\" > 2020;"},{"question":"Quelles conférences ont accueilli des publications avant 2015 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.\"cid\", c.\"name\" FROM \"conference\" c JOIN \"publication\" p ON p.\"cid\" = c.\"cid\" WHERE p.\"year\" < 2015;"},{"question":"Combien de citations les publications de chaque revue totalisent-elles ?","sql":"SELECT j.\"name\", COALESCE(SUM(p.\"citation_num\"), 0) AS \"total\" FROM \"journal\" j LEFT JOIN \"publication\" p ON p.\"jid\" = j.\"jid\" GROUP BY j.\"jid\", j.\"name\";"},{"question":"Quelle revue a la moyenne de citations la plus élevée ?","sql":"SELECT j.\"jid\", j.\"name\", AVG(p.\"citation_num\") AS \"moyenne\" FROM \"journal\" j JOIN \"publication\" p ON p.\"jid\" = j.\"jid\" GROUP BY j.\"jid\", j.\"name\" ORDER BY \"moyenne\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelles revues ont plus de publications que la moyenne des revues ?","sql":"SELECT j.\"jid\", j.\"name\", COUNT(p.\"pid\") AS \"nombre\" FROM \"journal\" j JOIN \"publication\" p ON p.\"jid\" = j.\"jid\" GROUP BY j.\"jid\", j.\"name\" HAVING COUNT(p.\"pid\") > (SELECT AVG(\"nombre\") FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS \"nombre\" FROM \"publication\" WHERE \"jid\" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY \"jid\"));"},{"question":"Quels domaines sont associés à la revue 4 ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"did\", d.\"name\" FROM \"domain\" d JOIN \"domain_journal\" dj ON dj.\"did\" = d.\"did\" WHERE dj.\"jid\" = 4;"},{"question":"Quelles conférences appartiennent au domaine nommé « Biology » ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"cid\", c.\"name\" FROM \"conference\" c JOIN \"domain_conference\" dc ON dc.\"cid\" = c.\"cid\" JOIN \"domain\" d ON d.\"did\" = dc.\"did\" WHERE d.\"name\" = 'Biology';"},{"question":"Quels mots-clés sont associés au même domaine que le mot-clé 1 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT k.\"kid\", k.\"keyword\" FROM \"keyword\" k JOIN \"domain_keyword\" dk ON dk.\"kid\" = k.\"kid\" WHERE dk.\"did\" IN (SELECT \"did\" FROM \"domain_keyword\" WHERE \"kid\" = 1) AND k.\"kid\" <> 1;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont au moins un domaine commun avec la publication 10 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" FROM \"author\" a JOIN \"domain_author\" da ON da.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" WHERE da.\"did\" IN (SELECT \"did\" FROM \"domain_publication\" WHERE \"pid\" = 10);"},{"question":"Quelles publications ont un domaine également associé à leur auteur ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.\"pid\", p.\"title\" FROM \"publication\" p JOIN \"domain_publication\" dp ON dp.\"pid\" = p.\"pid\" JOIN \"writes\" w ON w.\"pid\" = p.\"pid\" JOIN \"domain_author\" da ON da.\"aid\" = w.\"aid\" AND da.\"did\" = dp.\"did\";"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont écrit des publications contenant le mot-clé « machine learning » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" FROM \"author\" a JOIN \"writes\" w ON w.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" JOIN \"publication_keyword\" pk ON pk.\"pid\" = w.\"pid\" JOIN \"keyword\" k ON k.\"kid\" = pk.\"kid\" WHERE k.\"keyword\" = 'machine learning';"},{"question":"Quels domaines ont plus de mots-clés que de conférences ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"did\", d.\"name\" FROM \"domain\" d LEFT JOIN \"domain_keyword\" dk ON dk.\"did\" = d.\"did\" LEFT JOIN \"domain_conference\" dc ON dc.\"did\" = d.\"did\" GROUP BY d.\"did\", d.\"name\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dk.\"kid\") > COUNT(DISTINCT dc.\"cid\");"},{"question":"Quels domaines ont le plus de publications ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"did\", d.\"name\", COUNT(dp.\"pid\") AS \"nombre\" FROM \"domain\" d JOIN \"domain_publication\" dp ON dp.\"did\" = d.\"did\" GROUP BY d.\"did\", d.\"name\" ORDER BY \"nombre\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels domaines n'ont aucune conférence associée ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"did\", d.\"name\" FROM \"domain\" d LEFT JOIN \"domain_conference\" dc ON dc.\"did\" = d.\"did\" WHERE dc.\"cid\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels domaines n'ont aucune revue associée ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"did\", d.\"name\" FROM \"domain\" d LEFT JOIN \"domain_journal\" dj ON dj.\"did\" = d.\"did\" WHERE dj.\"jid\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels domaines n'ont aucun mot-clé associé ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"did\", d.\"name\" FROM \"domain\" d LEFT JOIN \"domain_keyword\" dk ON dk.\"did\" = d.\"did\" WHERE dk.\"kid\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels domaines n'ont aucune publication associée ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"did\", d.\"name\" FROM \"domain\" d LEFT JOIN \"domain_publication\" dp ON dp.\"did\" = d.\"did\" WHERE dp.\"pid\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien de domaines chaque auteur couvre-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"aid\", a.\"name\", COUNT(da.\"did\") AS \"nombre_domaines\" FROM \"author\" a LEFT JOIN \"domain_author\" da ON da.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" GROUP BY a.\"aid\", a.\"name\";"},{"question":"Quels auteurs couvrent au moins deux domaines ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" FROM \"author\" a JOIN \"domain_author\" da ON da.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" GROUP BY a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" HAVING COUNT(da.\"did\") >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont un nom commençant par A ?","sql":"SELECT \"aid\", \"name\" FROM \"author\" WHERE \"name\" LIKE 'A%';"},{"question":"Quels titres se terminent par « systems » ?","sql":"SELECT \"pid\", \"title\" FROM \"publication\" WHERE LOWER(\"title\") LIKE '% systems';"},{"question":"Quelles publications ont un résumé non vide ?","sql":"SELECT \"pid\", \"title\" FROM \"publication\" WHERE \"abstract\" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(\"abstract\") <> '';"},{"question":"Quelles organisations ont une page d'accueil renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT \"oid\", \"name\", \"homepage\" FROM \"organization\" WHERE \"homepage\" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels pays ou continents sont représentés par les organisations ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"continent\" FROM \"organization\" WHERE \"continent\" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY \"continent\";"},{"question":"Combien d'organisations y a-t-il par continent ?","sql":"SELECT \"continent\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre\" FROM \"organization\" GROUP BY \"continent\";"},{"question":"Quel continent compte le plus d'organisations ?","sql":"SELECT \"continent\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre\" FROM \"organization\" GROUP BY \"continent\" ORDER BY \"nombre\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs n'ont pas d'organisation valide ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" FROM \"author\" a ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Fname || ' ' || LName AS nom_complet FROM Student ORDER BY LName, Fname;"},{"question":"Combien d'enseignants participent à chaque activité ?","sql":"SELECT a.actid, nombre_enseignants DESC, a.activity_name;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants participent à plus d'activités que la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname, COUNT(fp.actid) AS nombre_activites FROM Faculty AS f JOIN Faculty_Participates_in AS fp ON fp.FacID = f.FacID GROUP BY f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname HAVING COUNT(fp.actid) > (SELECT AVG(nombre) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre FROM Faculty_Participates_in GROUP BY FacID)) ORDER BY nombre_activites DESC;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants participent à au moins deux activités ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, COUNT(p.actid) AS nombre_activites FROM Student AS s JOIN Participates_in AS p ON p.stuid = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName HAVING COUNT(p.actid) >= 2 ORDER BY nombre_activites DESC, s.LName;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ne participent qu'à une seule activité ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Participates_in AS p ON p.stuid = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants n'ont pas de conseiller renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Fname, LName FROM Student WHERE Advisor IS NULL ORDER BY LName, Fname;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants conseillent au moins un étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname FROM Faculty AS f JOIN Student AS s ON s.Advisor = f.FacID ORDER BY f.Lname, f.Fname;"},{"question":"Quelles activités sont pratiquées par des enseignants, avec la liste de leurs noms ?","sql":"SELECT a.activity_name, GROUP_CONCAT(f.Fname || ' ' || f.Lname, ', ') AS enseignants FROM Activity AS a JOIN Faculty_Participates_in AS fp ON fp.actid = a.actid JOIN Faculty AS f ON f.FacID = fp.FacID GROUP BY a.actid, a.activity_name ORDER BY a.activity_name;"},{"question":"Quelles activités pratique chaque étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, GROUP_CONCAT(a.activity_name, ', ') AS activites FROM Student AS s JOIN Participates_in AS p ON p.stuid = s.StuID JOIN Activity AS a ON a.actid = p.actid GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quel est l'âge maximal des étudiants de chaque majeure ?","sql":"SELECT Major, MAX(Age) AS age_maximum FROM Student GROUP BY Major ORDER BY Major;"},{"question":"Combien d'étudiants ont entre 18 et 22 ans inclus ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Student WHERE Age BETWEEN 18 AND 22;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants sont des femmes et ont le rang indiqué ?","sql":"SELECT FacID, Fname, Lname, Rank FROM Faculty WHERE Sex = 'F' AND Rank IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Lname, Fname;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants n'ont pas de numéro de téléphone renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT FacID, Fname, Lname FROM Faculty WHERE Phone IS NULL ORDER BY Lname, Fname;"},{"question":"Quelles activités ont un identifiant compris entre 10 et 20 ?","sql":"SELECT actid, activity_name FROM Activity WHERE actid BETWEEN 10 AND 20 ORDER BY actid;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants vivent dans une ville dont le code commence par la lettre A ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Fname, LName, city_code FROM Student WHERE city_code LIKE 'A%' ORDER BY city_code, LName;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants participent à toutes les activités auxquelles participe un étudiant donné ?","sql":"SELECT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname FROM Faculty AS f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Participates_in AS p WHERE p.stuid = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Faculty_Participates_in AS fp WHERE fp.FacID = f.FacID AND fp.actid = p.actid)) ORDER BY f.Lname, f.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels couples d'étudiants partagent le même code de ville ?","sql":"SELECT s1.StuID AS premier_etudiant, s1.Fname || ' ' || s1.LName AS premier_nom, s2.StuID AS second_etudiant, s2.Fname || ' ' || s2.LName AS second_nom, s1.city_code FROM Student AS s1 JOIN Student AS s2 ON s1.city_code = s2.city_code AND s1.StuID < s2.StuID ORDER BY s1.city_code, s1.StuID, s2.StuID;"},{"question":"Quelle est l'activité qui compte le plus de participants étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT a.actid, a.activity_name, COUNT(p.stuid) AS nombre_participants FROM Activity AS a LEFT JOIN Participates_in AS p ON p.actid = a.actid GROUP BY a.actid, a.activity_name HAVING COUNT(p.stuid) = (SELECT MAX(nombre) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre FROM Participates_in GROUP BY actid)) ORDER BY a.activity_name;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants ont le plus grand nombre d'activités ?","sql":"SELECT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname, COUNT(fp.actid) AS nombre_activites FROM Faculty AS f JOIN Faculty_Participates_in AS fp ON fp.FacID = f.FacID GROUP BY f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname HAVING COUNT(fp.actid) = (SELECT MAX(nombre) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre FROM Faculty_Participates_in GROUP BY FacID)) ORDER BY f.Lname, f.Fname;"},{"question":"Quelle majeure présente l'âge moyen le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT Major, AVG(Age) AS age_moyen FROM Student GROUP BY Major HAVING AVG(Age) = (SELECT MAX(age_moyen) FROM (SELECT AVG(Age) AS age_moyen FROM Student GROUP BY Major)) ORDER BY Major;"},{"question":"Pour chaque activité, combien de villes différentes sont représentées par les étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT a.actid, a.activity_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.city_code) AS nombre_villes FROM Activity AS a LEFT JOIN Participates_in AS p ON p.actid = a.actid LEFT JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = p.stuid GROUP BY a.actid, a.activity_name ORDER BY nombre_villes DESC, a.activity_name;"},{"question":"Quelles activités n'ont aucun enseignant participant ?","sql":"SELECT a.actid, a.activity_name FROM Activity AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Faculty_Participates_in AS fp WHERE fp.actid = a.actid) ORDER BY a.activity_name;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants conseillent des étudiants qui participent à une activité ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname FROM Faculty AS f JOIN Student AS s ON s.Advisor = f.FacID JOIN Participates_in AS p ON p.stuid = s.StuID ORDER BY f.Lname, f.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants participent à la même activité que leur conseiller ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, a.activity_name FROM Student AS s JOIN Participates_in AS p ON p.stuid = s.StuID JOIN Faculty_Participates_in AS fp ON fp.FacID = s.Advisor AND fp.actid = p.actid JOIN Activity AS a ON a.actid = p.actid ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname, a.activity_name;"},{"question":"Quels rangs d'enseignants ne sont associés à aucun enseignant participant à une activité ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f.Rank FROM Faculty AS f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Faculty AS f2 JOIN Faculty_Participates_in AS fp ON fp.FacID = f2.FacID WHERE f2.Rank = f.Rank) ORDER BY f.Rank;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont une majeure et un conseiller renseignés ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Fname, LName, Major, Advisor FROM Student WHERE Major IS NOT NULL AND Advisor IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Major, LName, Fname;"},{"question":"Quelles activités sont suivies par au moins un étudiant de chaque sexe présent dans les données ?","sql":"SELECT a.actid, a.activity_name FROM Activity AS a JOIN Participates_in AS p ON p.actid = a.actid JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = p.stuid GROUP BY a.actid, a.activity_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.Sex) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Sex) FROM Student) ORDER BY a.activity_name;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants travaillent dans le même bâtiment que le conseiller d'au moins un étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname, f.Building FROM Faculty AS f JOIN Student AS s ON s.Advisor = f.FacID JOIN Faculty AS colleague ON colleague.Building = f.Building AND colleague.FacID <> f.FacID ORDER BY f.Building, f.Lname;"},{"question":"Combien d'étudiants participent à chaque activité, avec leur âge moyen ?","sql":"SELECT a.activity_name, COUNT(p.stuid) AS nombre_etudiants, ROUND(AVG(s.Age), 2) AS age_moyen FROM Activity AS a LEFT JOIN Participates_in AS p ON p.actid = a.actid LEFT JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = p.stuid GROUP BY a.actid, a.activity_name ORDER BY a.activity_name;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont un âge supérieur à l'âge moyen de leur propre majeure ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, s.Major, s.Age FROM Student AS s WHERE s.Age > (SELECT AVG(s2.Age) FROM Student AS s2 WHERE s2.Major = s.Major) ORDER BY s.Major, s.Age DESC;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants ont le même rang qu'au moins un conseiller d'étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname, f.Rank FROM Faculty AS f JOIN Student AS s ON s.Advisor = f.FacID WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Faculty AS f2 WHERE f2.Rank = f.Rank AND f2.FacID <> f.FacID) ORDER BY f.Rank, f.Lname;"},{"question":"Quelles activités sont communes à au moins deux enseignants ?","sql":"SELECT a.actid, a.activity_name, COUNT(DISTINCT fp.FacID) AS nombre_enseignants FROM Activity AS a JOIN Faculty_Participates_in AS fp ON fp.actid = a.actid GROUP BY a.actid, a.activity_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fp.FacID) >= 2 ORDER BY nombre_enseignants DESC, a.activity_name;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants partagent au moins une activité avec un autre étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Participates_in AS p ON p.stuid = s.StuID WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Participates_in AS p2 WHERE p2.actid = p.actid AND p2.stuid <> s.StuID) ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels codes de ville comptent des étudiants dans plusieurs majeures ?","sql":"SELECT city_code, COUNT(DISTINCT Major) AS nombre_majeures FROM Student GROUP BY city_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Major) > 1 ORDER BY city_code;"},{"question":"Quelles activités ont davantage de participants étudiants que d'enseignants ?","sql":"SELECT a.actid, a.activity_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.stuid) AS etudiants, COUNT(DISTINCT fp.FacID) AS enseignants FROM Activity AS a LEFT JOIN Participates_in AS p ON p.actid = a.actid LEFT JOIN Faculty_Participates_in AS fp ON fp.actid = a.actid GROUP BY a.actid, a.activity_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.stuid) > COUNT(DISTINCT fp.FacID) ORDER BY etudiants DESC;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants conseillent au moins deux étudiants et participent à au moins une activité ?","sql":"SELECT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname, COUNT(DISTINCT s.StuID) AS nombre_conseilles FROM Faculty AS f JOIN Student AS s ON s.Advisor = f.FacID JOIN Faculty_Participates_in AS fp ON fp.FacID = f.FacID GROUP BY f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.StuID) >= 2 ORDER BY nombre_conseilles DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles activités sont suivies par des étudiants dont le conseiller participe aussi à cette activité ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.actid, a.activity_name FROM Activity AS a JOIN Participates_in AS p ON p.actid = a.actid JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = p.stuid JOIN Faculty_Participates_in AS fp ON fp.actid = p.actid AND fp.FacID = s.Advisor ORDER BY a.activity_name;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants ne conseillent aucun étudiant mais participent à une activité ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname FROM Faculty AS f JOIN Faculty_Participates_in AS fp ON fp.FacID = f.FacID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Student AS s WHERE s.Advisor = f.FacID) ORDER BY f.Lname, f.Fname;"},{"question":"Quelles activités ont au moins un participant étudiant âgé de plus de 25 ans ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.actid, a.activity_name FROM Activity AS a JOIN Participates_in AS p ON p.actid = a.actid JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = p.stuid WHERE s.Age > 25 ORDER BY a.activity_name;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants travaillent dans un bâtiment où aucun étudiant n'habite selon le code de ville ?","sql":"SELECT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname, f.Building FROM Faculty AS f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Student AS s WHERE s.city_code = f.Building) ORDER BY f.Building, f.Lname;"}]}

DESC;"},{"question":"Combien d'aéroports utilisent chaque aéronef ?","sql":"SELECT ac.\"Aircraft\", COUNT(aa.\"Airport_ID\") AS \"Nombre_Aeroports\" FROM aircraft AS ac LEFT JOIN airport_aircraft AS aa ON aa.\"Aircraft_ID\" = ac.\"Aircraft_ID\" GROUP BY ac.\"Aircraft_ID\", ac.\"Aircraft\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_Aeroports\" DESC, ac.\"Aircraft\";"},{"question":"Quels pilotes ont remporté des manches, p.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Dans quels lieux plusieurs manches ont-elles été disputées ?","sql":"SELECT \"Location\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_Manches\" FROM \"match\" GROUP BY \"Location\" HAVING COUNT(*) FROM \"match\" WHERE \"Fastest_Qualifying\" IS NOT NULL AND \"Fastest_Qualifying\" <> '' ORDER BY \"Fastest_Qualifying\";"},{"question":"Quels aéroports ont un total de passagers inférieur à la somme de leurs passagers internationaux, domestiques et en transit ?","sql":"SELECT \"Airport_Name\", \"Total_Passengers\", (\"International_Passengers\" + \"Domestic_Passengers\" + \"Transit_Passengers\") AS \"Somme_Details\" FROM airport WHERE \"Total_Passengers\" < (\"International_Passengers\" + \"Domestic_Passengers\" + \"Transit_Passengers\");"},{"question":"Quels aéronefs ne sont associés à aucun aéroport ?","sql":"SELECT ac.\"Aircraft_ID\", ac.\"Aircraft\" FROM aircraft AS ac WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM airport_aircraft AS aa WHERE aa.\"Aircraft_ID\" = ac.\"Aircraft_ID\") ORDER BY ac.\"Aircraft\";"},{"question":"Quels aéroports n'ont aucun aéronef associé ?","sql":"SELECT ap.\"Airport_ID\", ap.\"Airport_Name\" FROM airport AS ap WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM airport_aircraft AS aa WHERE aa.\"Airport_ID\" = ap.\"Airport_ID\") ORDER BY ap.\"Airport_Name\";"},{"question":"Quels pilotes plus âgés que la moyenne ont remporté au moins une manche ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.\"Name\", p.\"Age\" FROM pilot AS p JOIN \"match\" AS m ON m.\"Winning_Pilot\" = p.\"Pilot_Id\" WHERE p.\"Age\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Age\") FROM pilot) ORDER BY p.\"Age\" DESC, p.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Quels aéroports dépassent la moyenne du nombre total de passagers ?","sql":"SELECT \"Airport_Name\", \"Total_Passengers\" FROM airport WHERE \"Total_Passengers\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Total_Passengers\") FROM airport) ORDER BY \"Total_Passengers\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels noms apparaissent soit comme noms d'aéroports, soit comme lieux de manches ?","sql":"SELECT \"Airport_Name\" AS \"Nom\" FROM airport UNION SELECT \"Location\" AS \"Nom\" FROM \"match\" ORDER BY \"Nom\";"},{"question":"Quels aéronefs sont associés à au moins deux aéroports ?","sql":"SELECT ac.\"Aircraft\", COUNT(DISTINCT aa.\"Airport_ID\") AS \"Nombre_Aeroports\" FROM aircraft AS ac JOIN airport_aircraft AS aa ON aa.\"Aircraft_ID\" = ac.\"Aircraft_ID\" GROUP BY ac.\"Aircraft_ID\", ac.\"Aircraft\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT aa.\"Airport_ID\") >= 2 ORDER BY \"Nombre_Aeroports\" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de victoires chaque aéronef a-t-il remportées ?","sql":"SELECT ac.\"Aircraft\", COUNT(m.\"Round\") AS \"Victoires\" FROM aircraft AS ac LEFT JOIN \"match\" AS m ON m.\"Winning_Aircraft\" = ac.\"Aircraft_ID\" GROUP BY ac.\"Aircraft_ID\", ac.\"Aircraft\" ORDER BY \"Victoires\" DESC, ac.\"Aircraft\";"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois aéroports ayant le plus grand tonnage de fret ?","sql":"SELECT \"Airport_Name\", \"Freight_Metric_Tonnes\" FROM airport ORDER BY WHERE \"%_Change_2007\" LIKE '%\\%%' ESCAPE '\\' ORDER BY \"Airport_Name\";"},{"question":"Quels aéronefs n'ont remporté aucune manche ?","sql":"SELECT ac.\"Aircraft\" FROM aircraft AS ac WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"match\" AS m WHERE m.\"Winning_Aircraft\" = ac.\"Aircraft_ID\") ORDER BY ac.\"Aircraft\";"},{"question":"Quels pilotes n'ont remporté aucune manche ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Name\" FROM pilot AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"match\" AS m WHERE m.\"Winning_Pilot\" = p.\"Pilot_Id\") ORDER BY p.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Quelles associations indiquent le nom de l'aéroport et l'aéronef correspondant ?","sql":"SELECT ap.\"Airport_Name\", ac.\"Aircraft\", aa.\"ID\" FROM airport_aircraft AS aa JOIN airport AS ap ON ap.\"Airport_ID\" = aa.\"Airport_ID\" JOIN aircraft AS ac ON ac.\"Aircraft_ID\" = aa.\"Aircraft_ID\" ORDER BY ap.\"Airport_Name\", ac.\"Aircraft\";"},{"question":"Combien de victoires ont été remportées dans chaque pays ?","sql":"SELECT \"Country\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_Victoires\" FROM \"match\" GROUP BY \"Country\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_Victoires\" DESC, \"Country\";"},{"question":"Quel est le rang de chaque aéroport selon son nombre total de passagers ?","sql":"SELECT \"Airport_Name\", \"Total_Passengers\", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY \"Total_Passengers\" DESC) AS \"Rang\" FROM airport ORDER BY \"Rang\", \"Airport_Name\";"},{"question":"Quels pilotes ont gagné dans des pays où au moins deux manches ont été disputées ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.\"Name\", m.\"Country\" FROM pilot AS p JOIN \"match\" AS m ON m.\"Winning_Pilot\" = p.\"Pilot_Id\" WHERE pour chaque aéroport ?","sql":"SELECT \"Airport_Name\", SUM(\"Aircraft_Movements\") AS \"Total_Mouvements\", SUM(\"Freight_Metric_Tonnes\") AS \"Total_Fret\" FROM airport GROUP BY \"Airport_ID\", \"Airport_Name\" ORDER BY \"Total_Mouvements\" DESC;"}]}

(SELECT 1 FROM Student AS a WHERE a.StuID = s.Advisor) ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants n'ont aucun conseiller renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Fname, LName FROM Student Student AS s JOIN Student AS a ON a.StuID = s.Advisor WHERE s.city_code = a.city_code ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels sont les identifiants et noms des conseillers qui encadrent au moins un étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.StuID, a.Fname, a.LName FROM Student AS a JOIN Student AS s ON s.Advisor = a.StuID ORDER BY a.LName, a.Fname;"},{"question":"Combien d'étudiants sont suivis par chaque conseiller ?","sql":"SELECT Advisor, COUNT(*) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Student WHERE Advisor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Advisor ORDER BY nombre_etudiants DESC, Advisor;"},{"question":"Quels conseillers suivent au moins deux étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT Advisor, COUNT(*) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Student WHERE Advisor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Advisor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY nombre_etudiants DESC, Advisor;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont un conseiller plus âgé qu'eux ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, s.Age, a.Age AS age_conseiller FROM Student AS s JOIN Student AS a ON a.StuID = s.Advisor WHERE a.Age > s.Age ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quelles allergies sont définies dans le référentiel ?","sql":"SELECT Allergy, AllergyType FROM Allergy_Type ORDER BY Allergy;"},{"question":"Combien de types d'allergies sont répertoriés ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_allergies FROM Allergy_Type;"},{"question":"Quels types d'allergies sont associés à une allergie dont le code commence par « P » ?","sql":"SELECT Allergy, AllergyType FROM Allergy_Type WHERE Allergy LIKE 'P%' ORDER BY Allergy;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont au moins une allergie ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants n'ont aucune allergie enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Has_Allergy AS h WHERE h.StuID = s.StuID) ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Combien d'étudiants allergiques y a-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT StuID) AS nombre_etudiants_allergiques FROM Has_Allergy;"},{"question":"Combien d'allergies différentes sont déclarées par les étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Allergy) AS nombre_allergies_declarees FROM Has_Allergy;"},{"question":"Combien d'étudiants déclarent chaque allergie ?","sql":"SELECT Allergy, COUNT(DISTINCT StuID) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Has_Allergy GROUP BY Allergy ORDER BY nombre_etudiants DESC, Allergy;"},{"question":"Quelles allergies sont déclarées par au moins deux étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT Allergy, COUNT(DISTINCT StuID) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Has_Allergy GROUP BY Allergy HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT StuID) >= 2 ORDER BY nombre_etudiants DESC, Allergy;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants déclarent exactement une allergie ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT h.Allergy) = 1 ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants déclarent plus d'une allergie ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, COUNT(DISTINCT h.Allergy) AS nombre_allergies FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT h.Allergy) > 1 ORDER BY nombre_allergies DESC, s.LName;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen d'allergies par étudiant allergique ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(nombre_allergies) AS moyenne_allergies FROM (SELECT StuID, COUNT(DISTINCT Allergy) AS nombre_allergies FROM Has_Allergy GROUP BY StuID) AS t;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont allergiques au type d'allergie « pollen » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Allergy_Type AS a ON a.Allergy = h.Allergy WHERE LOWER(a.AllergyType) = 'pollen' ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms des étudiants et les types de leurs allergies ?","sql":"SELECT s.Fname, s.LName, a.AllergyType FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Allergy_Type AS a ON a.Allergy = h.Allergy ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname, a.AllergyType;"},{"question":"Quelles allergies répertoriées ne sont déclarées par aucun étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT a.Allergy, a.AllergyType FROM Allergy_Type AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Has_Allergy AS h WHERE h.Allergy = a.Allergy) ORDER BY a.Allergy;"},{"question":"Quels types d'allergies sont déclarés par au moins un étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.AllergyType FROM Allergy_Type AS a JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.Allergy = a.Allergy ORDER BY a.AllergyType;"},{"question":"Combien de déclarations d'allergie existe-t-il au total ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_declarations FROM Has_Allergy;"},{"question":"Dans quelles villes vivent des étudiants allergiques ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.city_code FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID WHERE s.city_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.city_code;"},{"question":"Combien d'étudiants allergiques résident dans chaque ville ?","sql":"SELECT s.city_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.StuID) AS nombre_etudiants_allergiques FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.city_code ORDER BY nombre_etudiants_allergiques DESC, s.city_code;"},{"question":"Quelles villes comptent plus d'étudiants non allergiques que d'étudiants allergiques ?","sql":"SELECT city_code FROM Student GROUP BY city_code HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Has_Allergy AS h WHERE h.StuID = Student.StuID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Has_Allergy AS h WHERE h.StuID = Student.StuID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ORDER BY city_code;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants allergiques ont au moins 21 ans ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, s.Age FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID WHERE s.Age >= 21 ORDER BY s.Age DESC, s.LName;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont allergiques et ont le même sexe qu'au moins un autre étudiant allergique ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, s.Sex FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID WHERE s.Sex IN (SELECT s2.Sex FROM Student AS s2 JOIN Has_Allergy AS h2 ON h2.StuID = s2.StuID GROUP BY s2.Sex HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s2.StuID) > 1) ORDER BY s.Sex, s.LName;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont une allergie dont le type contient le mot « alimentaire » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Allergy_Type AS a ON a.Allergy = h.Allergy WHERE LOWER(a.AllergyType) LIKE '%alimentaire%' ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels sont les codes d'allergie associés à des étudiants dont le prénom commence par « M » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT h.Allergy FROM Has_Allergy AS h JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = h.StuID WHERE s.Fname LIKE 'M%' ORDER BY h.Allergy;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont une allergie commune avec au moins un autre étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID WHERE h.Allergy IN (SELECT Allergy FROM Has_Allergy GROUP BY Allergy HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT StuID) > 1) ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont une allergie qui n'est déclarée par aucun autre étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, h.Allergy FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID WHERE h.Allergy IN (SELECT Allergy FROM Has_Allergy GROUP BY Allergy HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT StuID) = 1) ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont un conseiller qui souffre lui aussi d'au moins une allergie ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, s.Advisor FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.Advisor ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels conseillers ont au moins un étudiant allergique ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.StuID, a.Fname, a.LName FROM Student AS a JOIN Student AS s ON s.Advisor = a.StuID JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID ORDER BY a.LName, a.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont une allergie mais pas leur conseiller ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID WHERE s.Advisor IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Has_Allergy AS ha WHERE ha.StuID = s.Advisor) ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont le même âge qu'au moins un étudiant allergique ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, s.Age FROM Student AS s WHERE s.Age IN (SELECT DISTINCT s2.Age FROM Student AS s2 JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s2.StuID) ORDER BY s.Age, s.LName;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ne sont ni allergiques ni conseillers d'un autre étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Has_Allergy AS h WHERE h.StuID = s.StuID) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Student AS s2 WHERE s2.Advisor = s.StuID) ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont à la fois allergiques et conseillers d'au moins un autre étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Student AS s2 ON s2.Advisor = s.StuID ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels sont les étudiants allergiques ou âgés d'au moins 25 ans ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Fname, LName FROM Student WHERE StuID IN (SELECT StuID FROM Has_Allergy) UNION SELECT StuID, Fname, LName FROM Student WHERE Age >= 25 ORDER BY LName, Fname;"},{"question":"Quels sont les étudiants allergiques et âgés d'au moins 25 ans ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Fname, LName FROM Student WHERE StuID IN (SELECT StuID FROM Has_Allergy) INTERSECT SELECT StuID, Fname, LName FROM Student WHERE Age >= 25 ORDER BY LName, Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ne déclarent aucune allergie parmi les allergies répertoriées ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Fname, LName FROM Student EXCEPT SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Has_Allergy AS h ON h.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Allergy_Type AS a ON a.Allergy = h.Allergy ORDER BY LName, Fname;"},{"question":"Quelle est la répartition des étudiants par âge, du plus fréquent au moins fréquent ?","sql":"SELECT Age, COUNT(*) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Student GROUP BY Age ORDER BY nombre_etudiants DESC, Age;"},{"question":"Quels majeures sont associées à au moins trois étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT Major, COUNT(*) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Student GROUP BY Major HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY nombre_etudiants DESC, Major;"},{"question":"Quel est l'âge moyen des étudiants pour chaque sexe ?","sql":"SELECT Sex, AVG(Age) AS age_moyen FROM Student GROUP BY Sex ORDER BY Sex;"},{"question":"Quelle ville possède l'âge moyen des étudiants le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT city_code, AVG(Age) AS age_moyen FROM Student GROUP BY city_code HAVING AVG(Age) = (SELECT MAX(age_moyen) FROM (SELECT AVG(Age) AS age_moyen FROM Student GROUP BY city_code)) ORDER BY city_code;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms complets et les adresses de tous les immeubles ?","sql":"SELECT building_full_name, building_address
FROM Apartment_Buildings;"},{"question":"Quels appartements possèdent deux chambres ou plus ?","sql":"SELECT apt_id, apt_number, bedroom_count
FROM Apartments
WHERE bedroom_count >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels sont les appartements et leurs immeubles respectifs ?","sql":"SELECT a.apt_id, a.apt_number, b.building_full_name
FROM Apartments AS a
JOIN Apartment_Buildings AS b ON b.building_id = a.building_id;"},{"question":"Combien d'appartements se trouvent dans chaque immeuble ?","sql":"SELECT b.building_id, b.building_full_name, COUNT(a.apt_id) AS nombre_appartements
FROM Apartment_Buildings AS b
LEFT JOIN Apartments AS a ON a.building_id = b.building_id
GROUP BY b.building_id, b.building_full_name;"},{"question":"Quels invités ont effectué au moins une réservation ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT g.guest_id, g.guest_first_name, g.guest_last_name
FROM Guests AS g
JOIN Apartment_Bookings AS ab ON ab.guest_id = g.guest_id;"},{"question":"Affichez les réservations avec le nom de l'invité et le numéro de l'appartement.","sql":"SELECT ab.apt_booking_id, g.guest_first_name, g.guest_last_name, a.apt_number, ab.booking_status_code
FROM Apartment_Bookings AS ab
JOIN Guests AS g ON g.guest_id = ab.guest_id
LEFT JOIN Apartments AS a ON a.apt_id = ab.apt_id;"},{"question":"Quels appartements n'ont encore aucune réservation ?","sql":"SELECT a.apt_id, a.apt_number
FROM Apartments AS a
LEFT JOIN Apartment_Bookings AS ab ON ab.apt_id = a.apt_id
WHERE ab.apt_booking_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien de réservations chaque invité a-t-il effectuées ?","sql":"SELECT g.guest_id, g.guest_first_name, g.guest_last_name, COUNT(ab.apt_booking_id) AS nombre_reservations
FROM Guests AS g
LEFT JOIN Apartment_Bookings AS ab ON ab.guest_id = g.guest_id
GROUP BY g.guest_id, g.guest_first_name, g.guest_last_name;"},{"question":"Quels immeubles contiennent au moins trois appartements ?","sql":"SELECT b.building_id, b.building_full_name, COUNT(a.apt_id) AS nombre_appartements
FROM Apartment_Buildings AS b
JOIN Apartments AS a ON a.building_id = b.building_id
GROUP BY b.building_id, b.building_full_name
HAVING COUNT(a.apt_id) >= 3;"},{"question":"Quelles réservations commencent en 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT apt_booking_id, apt_id, guest_id, booking_start_date, booking_end_date
FROM Apartment_Bookings
WHERE booking_start_date >= '2024-01-01'
  AND booking_start_date < '2025-01-01';"},{"question":"Quels invités sont nés avant le 1er janvier 1980 ?","sql":"SELECT guest_id, guest_first_name, guest_last_name, date_of_birth
FROM Guests
WHERE date_of_birth < '1980-01-01';"},{"question":"Quelles installations sont associées à l'appartement 10 ?","sql":"SELECT facility_code
FROM Apartment_Facilities
WHERE apt_id = 10;"},{"question":"Combien d'installations chaque appartement possède-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT a.apt_id, a.apt_number, COUNT(af.facility_code) AS nombre_installations
FROM Apartments AS a
LEFT JOIN Apartment_Facilities AS af ON af.apt_id = a.apt_id
GROUP BY a.apt_id, a.apt_number;"},{"question":"Quels appartements disposent à la fois d'une installation WIFI et d'une installation PARKING ?","sql":"SELECT apt_id
FROM Apartment_Facilities
WHERE facility_code IN ('WIFI', 'PARKING')
GROUP BY apt_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT facility_code) = 2;"},{"question":"Quels appartements ont été disponibles au moins une fois selon l'historique des statuts ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.apt_id, a.apt_number
FROM Apartments AS a
JOIN View_Unit_Status AS vus ON vus.apt_id = a.apt_id
WHERE vus.available_yn = 1;"},{"question":"Quelles dates indiquent qu'aucun appartement n'était disponible ?","sql":"SELECT status_date
FROM View_Unit_Status
WHERE available_yn = 0;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de réservations par statut ?","sql":"SELECT booking_status_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reservations
FROM Apartment_Bookings
GROUP BY booking_status_code
ORDER BY nombre_reservations DESC;"},{"question":"Quels appartements ont plus de réservations que la moyenne des appartements réservés ?","sql":"SELECT apt_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reservations
FROM Apartment_Bookings
WHERE apt_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY apt_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > (
    SELECT AVG(nombre_reservations)
    FROM (
        SELECT apt_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reservations
        FROM Apartment_Bookings
        WHERE apt_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY apt_id
    )
);"},{"question":"Quels invités n'ont effectué aucune réservation ?","sql":"SELECT g.guest_id, g.guest_first_name, g.guest_last_name
FROM Guests AS g
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Apartment_Bookings AS ab
    WHERE ab.guest_id = g.guest_id
);"},{"question":"Quels appartements n'ont aucune installation enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT a.apt_id, a.apt_number
FROM Apartments AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Apartment_Facilities AS af
    WHERE af.apt_id = a.apt_id
);"},{"question":"Quels immeubles n'ont aucun appartement ?","sql":"SELECT b.building_id, b.building_full_name
FROM Apartment_Buildings AS b
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Apartments AS a
    WHERE a.building_id = b.building_id
);"},{"question":"Donnez le nombre moyen de chambres par immeuble.","sql":"SELECT b.building_id, b.building_full_name, AVG(a.bedroom_count) AS moyenne_chambres
FROM Apartment_Buildings AS b
JOIN Apartments AS a ON a.building_id = b.building_id
GROUP BY b.building_id, b.building_full_name;"},{"question":"Quels appartements ont le plus grand nombre de salles de bains ?","sql":"SELECT apt_id, apt_number, bathroom_count
FROM Apartments
WHERE bathroom_count = (
    SELECT MAX(bathroom_count)
    FROM Apartments
);"},{"question":"Quelles réservations concernent des appartements situés dans l'immeuble portant le nom complet indiqué ?","sql":"SELECT ab.apt_booking_id, ab.booking_status_code, a.apt_number, b.building_full_name
FROM Apartment_Bookings AS ab
JOIN Apartments AS a ON a.apt_id = ab.apt_id
JOIN Apartment_Buildings AS b ON b.building_id = a.building_id
WHERE b.building_full_name = 'Central Building';"},{"question":"Quels invités ont réservé un appartement d'au moins trois chambres ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT g.guest_id, g.guest_first_name, g.guest_last_name
FROM Guests AS g
JOIN Apartment_Bookings AS ab ON ab.guest_id = g.guest_id
JOIN Apartments AS a ON a.apt_id = ab.apt_id
WHERE a.bedroom_count >= 3;"},{"question":"Quels codes d'installation sont utilisés par au moins deux appartements ?","sql":"SELECT facility_code, COUNT(DISTINCT apt_id) AS nombre_appartements
FROM Apartment_Facilities
GROUP BY facility_code
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT apt_id) >= 2;"},{"question":"Combien de statuts sont enregistrés pour chaque appartement ?","sql":"SELECT a.apt_id, a.apt_number, COUNT(vus.status_date) AS nombre_statuts
FROM Apartments AS a
LEFT JOIN View_Unit_Status AS vus ON vus.apt_id = a.apt_id
GROUP BY a.apt_id, a.apt_number;"},{"question":"Quelles réservations ont une date de fin postérieure à leur date de début ?","sql":"SELECT apt_booking_id, apt_id, guest_id, booking_start_date, booking_end_date
FROM Apartment_Bookings
WHERE booking_end_date > booking_start_date;"},{"question":"Quels noms d'immeubles apparaissent aussi comme nom complet d'un immeuble ?","sql":"SELECT building_full_name
FROM Apartment_Buildings
WHERE building_full_name IS NOT NULL
INTERSECT
SELECT building_short_name
FROM Apartment_Buildings
WHERE building_short_name IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels appartements ont une réservation et au moins un statut de disponibilité ?","sql":"SELECT a.apt_id, a.apt_number
FROM Apartments AS a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Apartment_Bookings AS ab
    WHERE ab.apt_id = a.apt_id
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM View_Unit_Status AS vus
    WHERE vus.apt_id = a.apt_id
);"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de réservations par immeuble, y compris les immeubles sans réservation ?","sql":"SELECT b.building_id, b.building_full_name, COUNT(ab.apt_booking_id) AS nombre_reservations
FROM Apartment_Buildings AS b
LEFT JOIN Apartments AS a ON a.building_id = b.building_id
LEFT JOIN Apartment_Bookings AS ab ON ab.apt_id = a.apt_id
GROUP BY b.building_id, b.building_full_name;"},{"question":"Quels invités ont réservé tous les appartements qu'ils ont réservés dans un même immeuble ?","sql":"SELECT g.guest_id, g.guest_first_name, g.guest_last_name
FROM Guests AS g
JOIN Apartment_Bookings AS ab ON ab.guest_id = g.guest_id
JOIN Apartments AS a ON a.apt_id = ab.apt_id
GROUP BY g.guest_id, g.guest_first_name, g.guest_last_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.building_id) = 1;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les trois réservations les plus récentes selon leur date de début ?","sql":"SELECT apt_booking_id, apt_id, guest_id, booking_start_date
FROM Apartment_Bookings
WHERE booking_start_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY booking_start_date DESC
LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quels appartements ont exactement le même nombre de chambres qu'au moins un autre appartement ?","sql":"SELECT a1.apt_id, a1.apt_number, a1.bedroom_count
FROM Apartments AS a1
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Apartments AS a2
    WHERE a2.apt_id <> a1.apt_id
      AND a2.bedroom_count = a1.bedroom_count
);"},{"question":"Quels immeubles ont une réservation pour chacun de leurs appartements ?","sql":"SELECT b.building_id, b.building_full_name
FROM Apartment_Buildings AS b
JOIN Apartments AS a ON a.building_id = b.building_id
LEFT JOIN Apartment_Bookings AS ab ON ab.apt_id = a.apt_id
GROUP BY b.building_id, b.building_full_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.apt_id) = COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ab.apt_booking_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.apt_id END);"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Combien de ponts chaque architecte a-t-il conçus, y compris ceux qui n’en ont conçu aucun ?","sql":"SELECT a.id, a.name, COUNT(b.id) AS nombre_de_ponts
FROM architect AS a
LEFT JOIN bridge AS b ON b.architect_id = a.id
GROUP BY a.id, a.name;"},{"question":"Quelle est la longueur moyenne des ponts pour chaque nationalité d’architecte ?","sql":"SELECT a.nationality, AVG(b.length_meters) AS longueur_moyenne_metres
FROM architect AS a
JOIN bridge AS b ON b.architect_id = a.id
GROUP BY a.nationality;"},{"question":"Quel est le pont le plus long en mètres ?","sql":"SELECT id, name, location, length_meters
FROM bridge
WHERE length_meters = (SELECT MAX(length_meters) FROM bridge);"},{"question":"Quels moulins ont été construits après l’année moyenne de construction de tous les moulins ?","sql":"SELECT id, name, location, built_year
FROM mill
WHERE built_year > (SELECT AVG(built_year) FROM mill);"},{"question":"Quels architectes ont conçu à la fois au moins un pont et au moins un moulin ?","sql":"SELECT a.id, a.name
FROM architect AS a
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bridge AS b WHERE b.architect_id = a.id)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mill AS m WHERE m.architect_id = a.id);"},{"question":"Quelles localisations apparaissent pour au moins un pont ou un moulin, sans doublons ?","sql":"SELECT location FROM bridge
UNION
SELECT location FROM mill;"},{"question":"Combien d’architectes sont répertoriés pour chaque genre ?","sql":"SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS nombre_d_architectes
FROM architect
GROUP BY gender;"},{"question":"Quels types de moulins comptent au moins deux réalisations ?","sql":"SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_moulins
FROM mill
GROUP BY type
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels architectes n’ont conçu aucun moulin ?","sql":"SELECT a.id, a.name
FROM architect AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM mill AS m
    WHERE m.architect_id = a.id
);"},{"question":"Quels ponts présentent un écart de plus d’un centième de pied entre la longueur indiquée et la conversion des mètres en pieds ?","sql":"SELECT id, name, length_meters, length_feet
FROM bridge
WHERE length_meters IS NOT NULL
  AND length_feet IS NOT NULL
  AND ABS(length_feet - length_meters * 3.28084) > 0.01;"},{"question":"Quel est le plus ancien moulin de chaque architecte ?","sql":"SELECT a.name AS architecte, m.name AS moulin, m.built_year
FROM architect AS a
JOIN mill AS m ON m.architect_id = a.id
WHERE m.built_year = (
    SELECT MIN(m2.built_year)
    FROM mill AS m2
    WHERE m2.architect_id = a.id
);"},{"question":"Quels architectes ont conçu davantage de ponts que de moulins ?","sql":"SELECT a.id, a.name
FROM architect AS a
WHERE (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM bridge AS b
    WHERE b.architect_id = a.id
) > (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM mill AS m
    WHERE m.architect_id = a.id
);"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les actifs avec le nom de leur fournisseur ?","sql":"SELECT a.asset_id, a.asset_make, a.asset_model, c.company_name
FROM Assets AS a
JOIN Third_Party_Companies AS c ON c.company_id = a.supplier_company_id;"},{"question":"Quels actifs n'ont encore aucun défaut enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT a.asset_id, a.asset_make, a.asset_model
FROM Assets AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Fault_Log AS f
    WHERE f.asset_id = a.asset_id
);"},{"question":"Combien de défauts ont été enregistrés pour chaque actif ?","sql":"SELECT a.asset_id, a.asset_make, a.asset_model, COUNT(f.fault_log_entry_id) AS nombre_defauts
FROM Assets AS a
LEFT JOIN Fault_Log AS f ON f.asset_id = a.asset_id
GROUP BY a.asset_id, a.asset_make, a.asset_model;"},{"question":"Quels ingénieurs possèdent au moins une compétence, avec le code de chaque compétence ?","sql":"SELECT me.engineer_id, me.first_name, me.last_name, s.skill_code
FROM Maintenance_Engineers AS me
JOIN Engineer_Skills AS es ON es.engineer_id = me.engineer_id
JOIN Skills AS s ON s.skill_id = es.skill_id;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne des visites terminées pour chaque ingénieur, en heures ?","sql":"SELECT me.engineer_id, me.first_name, me.last_name,
       AVG((julianday(ev.visit_end_datetime) - julianday(ev.visit_start_datetime)) * 24.0) AS duree_moyenne_heures
FROM Maintenance_Engineers AS me
JOIN Engineer_Visits AS ev ON ev.engineer_id = me.engineer_id
WHERE ev.visit_start_datetime IS NOT NULL
  AND ev.visit_end_datetime IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY me.engineer_id, me.first_name, me.last_name;"},{"question":"Quels contrats de maintenance sont encore valides aujourd'hui ?","sql":"SELECT maintenance_contract_id, maintenance_contract_company_id, contract_start_date, contract_end_date
FROM Maintenance_Contracts
WHERE contract_start_date <= datetime('now')
  AND (contract_end_date IS NULL OR contract_end_date >= datetime('now'));"},{"question":"Combien d'actifs utilisent chaque pièce ?","sql":"SELECT p.part_id, p.part_name, COUNT(ap.asset_id) AS nombre_actifs
FROM Parts AS p
LEFT JOIN Asset_Parts AS ap ON ap.part_id = p.part_id
GROUP BY p.part_id, p.part_name;"},{"question":"Quels défauts ont été enregistrés par quel membre du personnel ?","sql":"SELECT f.fault_log_entry_id, f.fault_description, f.fault_log_entry_datetime,
       s.staff_id, s.staff_name
FROM Fault_Log AS f
JOIN Staff AS s ON s.staff_id = f.recorded_by_staff_id;"},{"question":"Quelles compétences sont requises pour corriger chaque panne de pièce ?","sql":"SELECT pf.part_fault_id, pf.fault_short_name, s.skill_code, s.skill_description
FROM Part_Faults AS pf
JOIN Skills_Required_To_Fix AS sr ON sr.part_fault_id = pf.part_fault_id
JOIN Skills AS s ON s.skill_id = sr.skill_id;"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises fournissent des actifs et gèrent aussi au moins un contrat de maintenance ?","sql":"SELECT c.company_id, c.company_name
FROM Third_Party_Companies AS c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Assets AS a
    WHERE a.supplier_company_id = c.company_id
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Maintenance_Contracts AS mc
    WHERE mc.maintenance_contract_company_id = c.company_id
);"},{"question":"Quel est le montant facturable moyen des pièces facturables ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(CAST(chargeable_amount AS REAL)) AS montant_moyen_facturable
FROM Parts
WHERE chargeable_yn = 'Y'
  AND chargeable_amount IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Combien de visites correspondent à chaque statut de défaut ?","sql":"SELECT fault_status, COUNT(*) AS nombre_visites
FROM Engineer_Visits
GROUP BY fault_status
ORDER BY nombre_visites DESC;"},{"question":"Combien d'actifs ont été acquis chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', asset_acquired_date) AS annee_acquisition,
       COUNT(*) AS nombre_actifs
FROM Assets
WHERE asset_acquired_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', asset_acquired_date)
ORDER BY annee_acquisition;"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel ont enregistré des défauts mais n'ont jamais été désignés comme contacts de visite ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.staff_name
FROM Staff AS s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Fault_Log AS f
    WHERE f.recorded_by_staff_id = s.staff_id
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Engineer_Visits AS ev
    WHERE ev.contact_staff_id = s.staff_id
);"},{"question":"Quels actifs sont associés à toutes les pièces qui leur sont attribuées ?","sql":"SELECT a.asset_id, a.asset_make, a.asset_model
FROM Assets AS a
WHERE (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Asset_Parts AS ap
    WHERE ap.asset_id = a.asset_id
) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels défauts concernent une pièce facturable ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f.fault_log_entry_id, f.fault_description, p.part_name
FROM Fault_Log AS f
JOIN Fault_Log_Parts AS flp ON flp.fault_log_entry_id = f.fault_log_entry_id
JOIN Part_Faults AS pf ON pf.part_fault_id = flp.part_fault_id
JOIN Parts AS p ON p.part_id = pf.part_id
WHERE p.chargeable_yn = 'Y';"},{"question":"Quels ingénieurs ne possèdent aucune compétence enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT me.engineer_id, me.first_name, me.last_name
FROM Maintenance_Engineers AS me
LEFT JOIN Engineer_Skills AS es ON es.engineer_id = me.engineer_id
WHERE es.engineer_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels contrats sont liés à des actifs et à une entreprise de maintenance dont le nom est connu ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT mc.maintenance_contract_id, mc.contract_start_date, mc.contract_end_date,
       c.company_name
FROM Maintenance_Contracts AS mc
JOIN Assets AS a ON a.maintenance_contract_id = mc.maintenance_contract_id
JOIN Third_Party_Companies AS c ON c.company_id = mc.maintenance_contract_company_id
WHERE c.company_name IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quelle visite a duré le plus longtemps parmi les visites terminées ?","sql":"SELECT engineer_visit_id, engineer_id, fault_log_entry_id,
       visit_start_datetime, visit_end_datetime,
       (julianday(visit_end_datetime) - julianday(visit_start_datetime)) * 24.0 AS duree_heures
FROM Engineer_Visits
WHERE visit_start_datetime IS NOT NULL
  AND visit_end_datetime IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY duree_heures DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Combien d'ingénieurs travaillent pour chaque entreprise ?","sql":"SELECT c.company_id, c.company_name, COUNT(me.engineer_id) AS nombre_ingenieurs
FROM Third_Party_Companies AS c
LEFT JOIN Maintenance_Engineers AS me ON me.company_id = c.company_id
GROUP BY c.company_id, c.company_name;"},{"question":"Quelles pannes de pièces n'ont jamais été associées à un journal de défaut ?","sql":"SELECT pf.part_fault_id, pf.fault_short_name, pf.fault_description
FROM Part_Faults AS pf
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Fault_Log_Parts AS flp
    WHERE flp.part_fault_id = pf.part_fault_id
);"},{"question":"Quels actifs possèdent au moins deux pièces différentes ?","sql":"SELECT a.asset_id, a.asset_make, a.asset_model, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.part_id) AS nombre_pieces
FROM Assets AS a
JOIN Asset_Parts AS ap ON ap.asset_id = a.asset_id
GROUP BY a.asset_id, a.asset_make, a.asset_model
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.part_id) >= 2;"},{"question":"Pour chaque défaut, quel est le dernier statut de visite connu ?","sql":"SELECT f.fault_log_entry_id, f.fault_description, ev.fault_status, ev.visit_end_datetime
FROM Fault_Log AS f
JOIN Engineer_Visits AS ev ON ev.fault_log_entry_id = f.fault_log_entry_id
WHERE ev.visit_end_datetime IS NULL
   OR NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM Engineer_Visits AS ev2
       WHERE ev2.fault_log_entry_id = ev.fault_log_entry_id
         AND ev2.visit_end_datetime IS NOT NULL
         AND ev2.visit_end_datetime > ev.visit_end_datetime
   );"},{"question":"Quels ingénieurs ont effectué des visites mais ne possèdent aucune compétence enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT me.engineer_id, me.first_name, me.last_name
FROM Maintenance_Engineers AS me
JOIN Engineer_Visits AS ev ON ev.engineer_id = me.engineer_id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Engineer_Skills AS es
    WHERE es.engineer_id = me.engineer_id
);"},{"question":"Quels actifs ont un nombre de défauts supérieur à la moyenne des actifs ?","sql":"SELECT a.asset_id, a.asset_make, a.asset_model, COUNT(f.fault_log_entry_id) AS nombre_defauts
FROM Assets AS a
JOIN Fault_Log AS f ON f.asset_id = a.asset_id
GROUP BY a.asset_id, a.asset_make, a.asset_model
HAVING COUNT(f.fault_log_entry_id) > (
    SELECT AVG(nombre_defauts)
    FROM (
        SELECT a2.asset_id, COUNT(f2.fault_log_entry_id) AS nombre_defauts
        FROM Assets AS a2
        LEFT JOIN Fault_Log AS f2 ON f2.asset_id = a2.asset_id
        GROUP BY a2.asset_id
    ) AS statistiques
);"},{"question":"Affichez chaque pièce avec le nombre de pannes qui lui sont associées, y compris celles sans panne.","sql":"SELECT p.part_id, p.part_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pf.part_fault_id) AS nombre_pannes
FROM Parts AS p
LEFT JOIN Part_Faults AS pf ON pf.part_id = p.part_id
GROUP BY p.part_id, p.part_name;"}]}

sélections All-Star chaque joueur compte-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT p.player_id, p.name_first, p.name_last, COUNT(*) AS selections FROM all_star a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY
