wins, losses FROM postseason WHERE year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010 AND round = 'WS' ORDER BY year;"},{"question":"Quelles équipes ont participé à au moins une série éliminatoire en 2018 ?","sql":"SELECT team_id_winner AS team_id FROM postseason WHERE year = 2018 UNION SELECT team_id_loser FROM postseason WHERE year = 2018;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont frappé au moins 50 circuits sur l'ensemble de leur carrière enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, SUM(b.hr) AS circuits FROM batting b JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.name_first, p.name_last HAVING SUM(b.hr) >= 50 ORDER BY circuits DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq meilleurs joueurs par nombre total de coups sûrs ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, SUM(b.h) AS coups_surs FROM batting b JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.name_first, p.name_last ORDER BY coups_surs DESC LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont réalisé au moins 30 buts volés en 2019 ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, b.team_id, b.sb FROM batting b JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id WHERE b.year = 2019 AND b.sb >= 30 ORDER BY b.sb DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle équipe a produit le plus de points en 2018 ?","sql":"SELECT name, r FROM team WHERE year = 2018 ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelles équipes ont eu une moyenne de points mérités inférieure à 3 en 2019 ?","sql":"SELECT name, team_id, era FROM team WHERE year = 2019 AND era < 3 ORDER BY era;"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne de victoires par équipe pour chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT year, AVG(w) AS moyenne_victoires FROM team GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;"},{"question":"Quels lanceurs ont remporté au moins 20 victoires en une saison ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, pi.year, pi.w FROM pitching pi JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pi.player_id WHERE pi.w >= 20 ORDER BY pi.w DESC, pi.year;"},{"question":"Quels lanceurs ont enregistré au moins 40 sauvetages en 2016 ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, pi.team_id, pi.sv FROM pitching pi JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pi.player_id WHERE pi.year = 2016 AND pi.sv >= 40 ORDER BY pi.sv DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les lanceurs ayant réalisé le plus de retraits sur prises au total ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, SUM(pi.so) AS retraits_sur_prises FROM pitching pi JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pi.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.name_first, p.name_last ORDER BY retraits_sur_prises DESC LIMIT 10;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont participé à la fois à la saison régulière et aux séries éliminatoires en 2015 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.name_first, p.name_last FROM batting b JOIN batting_postseason bp ON bp.player_id = b.player_id AND bp.year = b.year JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id WHERE b.year = 2015;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont frappé un coup de circuit en postseason 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, bp.round, bp.hr FROM batting_postseason bp JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id WHERE bp.year = 2020 AND bp.hr > 0 ORDER BY bp.hr DESC;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont été utilisés comme lanceurs et comme batteurs en 2018 ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last FROM pitching pi JOIN batting b ON b.player_id = pi.player_id AND b.year = pi.year JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pi.player_id WHERE pi.year = 2018 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.name_first, p.name_last;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont joué au moins 100 matchs au champ extérieur en 2017 ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, SUM(a.g_of) AS matchs_exterieur FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.year = 2017 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.name_first, p.name_last HAVING SUM(a.g_of) >= 100 ORDER BY matchs_exterieur DESC;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont disputé des matchs comme receveur et comme joueur de premier but en 2014 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.name_first, p.name_last FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.year = 2014 AND a.g_c > 0 AND a.g_1b > 0;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont eu plus de passes décisives que d'erreurs en carrière ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, SUM(f.a) AS passes, SUM(f.e) AS erreurs FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.name_first, p.name_last HAVING SUM(f.a) > SUM(f.e) ORDER BY passes DESC LIMIT 20;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont joué au moins 50 matchs à chacune des trois positions du champ extérieur en 2012 ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, o.glf, o.gcf, o.grf FROM fielding_outfield o JOIN player p ON p.player_id = o.player_id WHERE o.year = 2012 AND o.glf >= 50 AND o.gcf >= 50 AND o.grf >= 50;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont été managers et joueurs la même année ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.name_first, p.name_last, m.year FROM manager m JOIN batting b ON b.player_id = m.player_id AND b.year = m.year JOIN player p ON p.player_id = m.player_id ORDER BY m.year;"},{"question":"Quels managers ont obtenu au moins 100 victoires sur une saison ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, m.year, m.team_id, m.w FROM manager m JOIN player p ON p.player_id = m.player_id WHERE m.w >= 100 ORDER BY m.w DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles équipes ont terminé premières de leur division en 2019 ?","sql":"SELECT team_id, name, div_id, w, l FROM team WHERE year = 2019 AND div_win = 'Y' ORDER BY div_id;"},{"question":"Quelles franchises sont encore actives ?","sql":"SELECT franchise_id, franchise_name FROM team_franchise WHERE active = 'Y' ORDER BY franchise_name;"},{"question":"Combien de saisons chaque franchise a-t-elle disputées selon les équipes enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT tf.franchise_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.year) AS saisons FROM team_franchise tf JOIN team t ON t.franchise_id = tf.franchise_id GROUP BY tf.franchise_id, tf.franchise_name ORDER BY saisons DESC;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont reçu un salaire supérieur à 20 millions en 2019 ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, s.team_id, s.salary FROM salary s JOIN player p ON p.player_id = s.player_id WHERE s.year = 2019 AND s.salary > 20000000 ORDER BY s.salary DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle équipe a eu la masse salariale la plus élevée en 2018 ?","sql":"SELECT team_id, SUM(salary) AS masse_salariale FROM salary WHERE year = 2018 GROUP BY team_id ORDER BY masse_salariale DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont été titulaires dans au moins 100 matchs en 2016 ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, SUM(a.gs) AS matchs_titulaires FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.year = 2016 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.name_first, p.name_last HAVING SUM(a.gs) >= 100 ORDER BY matchs_titulaires DESC;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont été élus au Hall of Fame après 2010 ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, h.yearid, h.votedby FROM hall_of_fame h JOIN player p ON p.player_id = h.player_id WHERE h.inducted = 'Y' AND h.yearid > 2010 ORDER BY h.yearid;"},{"question":"Quels candidats au Hall of Fame ont obtenu plus de 400 votes ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, h.yearid, h.votes FROM hall_of_fame h JOIN player p ON p.player_id = h.player_id WHERE h.votes > 400 ORDER BY h.votes DESC;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont remporté une récompense et ont aussi été sélectionnés All-Star la même année ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.name_first, p.name_last, a.year FROM player_award a JOIN all_star s ON s.player_id = a.player_id AND s.year = a.year JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id ORDER BY a.year;"},{"question":"Quels lauréats d'une récompense ont obtenu au moins 90 % des points disponibles au vote ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, v.award_id, v.year, v.points_won, v.points_max FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_max > 0 AND CAST(v.points_won AS REAL) / v.points_max >= 0.9 ORDER BY v.year;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont participé à une postseason comme batteurs et comme défenseurs ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.name_first, p.name_last FROM batting_postseason b JOIN fielding_postseason f ON f.player_id = b.player_id AND f.year = b.year AND f.team_id = b.team_id JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont enregistré au moins 100 retraits défensifs en 2010 ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, SUM(f.po) AS retraits FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id WHERE f.year = 2010 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.name_first, p.name_last HAVING SUM(f.po) >= 100 ORDER BY retraits DESC;"},{"question":"Quels lanceurs ont accordé moins de 2 circuits par neuf manches en 2018, avec au moins 100 manches ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, SUM(pi.hr) AS circuits, SUM(pi.ipouts) / 3.0 AS manches FROM pitching pi JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pi.player_id WHERE pi.year = 2018 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.name_first, p.name_last HAVING SUM(pi.ipouts) >= 300 AND SUM(pi.hr) / (SUM(pi.ipouts) / 3.0) * 9 < 2 ORDER BY circuits;"},{"question":"Quelles équipes ont eu plus de victoires que de défaites en 2017 et ont gagné leur division ?","sql":"SELECT team_id, name, w, l FROM team WHERE year = 2017 AND w > l AND div_win = 'Y';"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont commencé leur carrière avant 1950 et sont nés hors des États-Unis ?","sql":"SELECT name_first, name_last, birth_country, debut FROM player WHERE debut < '1950-01-01' AND birth_country <> 'USA' AND birth_country IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le salaire moyen par ligue en 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT league_id, AVG(salary) AS salaire_moyen FROM salary WHERE year = 2020 GROUP BY league_id ORDER BY salaire_moyen DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles équipes ont joué dans un parc dont le nom contient « Stadium » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT t.team_id, t.name, p.park_name FROM team t JOIN park p ON p.park_name = t.park WHERE p.park_name LIKE '%Stadium%';"},{"question":"Quels managers ont eu un bilan positif lors de leur dernière saison enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, m.year, m.w, m.l FROM manager m JOIN player p ON p.player_id = m.player_id WHERE m.year = (SELECT MAX(m2.year) FROM manager m2 WHERE m2.player_id = m.player_id) AND m.w > m.l;"},{"question":"Quelles équipes ont eu une attendance supérieure à la moyenne de leur année ?","sql":"SELECT h.year, h.team_id, h.attendance FROM home_game h WHERE h.attendance > (SELECT AVG(h2.attendance) FROM home_game h2 WHERE h2.year = h.year) ORDER BY h.year, h.attendance DESC;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont frappé plus de coups sûrs en postseason qu'en saison régulière la même année ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, bp.year, SUM(b.h) AS coups_surs_saison, SUM(bp.h) AS coups_surs_postseason FROM batting b JOIN batting_postseason bp ON bp.player_id = b.player_id AND bp.year = b.year JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.name_first, p.name_last, bp.year HAVING SUM(bp.h) > SUM(b.h);"},{"question":"Quels joueurs apparaissent dans le champ intérieur mais jamais au champ extérieur en 2016 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.name_first, p.name_last FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id WHERE f.year = 2016 AND f.pos IN ('1B','2B','3B','SS') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fielding f2 WHERE f2.player_id = f.player_id AND f2.year = f.year AND f2.pos IN ('LF','CF','RF','OF'));"},{"question":"Combien de victoires et de défaites chaque équipe a-t-elle cumulées dans les séries éliminatoires comme vainqueur ou perdant ?","sql":"SELECT team_id, SUM(victoires) AS victoires, SUM(defaites) AS defaites FROM (SELECT team_id_winner AS team_id, wins AS victoires, 0 AS defaites FROM postseason UNION ALL SELECT team_id_loser, 0, losses FROM postseason) GROUP BY team_id ORDER BY victoires DESC;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont gagné un vote de récompense mais n'ont pas été intronisés au Hall of Fame ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.name_first, p.name_last FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hall_of_fame h WHERE h.player_id = v.player_id AND h.inducted = 'Y');"},{"question":"Quelles franchises ont eu des équipes dans plusieurs ligues différentes ?","sql":"SELECT tf.franchise_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.league_id) AS nombre_ligues FROM team_franchise tf JOIN team t ON t.franchise_id = tf.franchise_id GROUP BY tf.franchise_id, tf.franchise_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.league_id) > 1 ORDER BY nombre_ligues DESC;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont un total de buts volés supérieur à leur total de retraits sur prises ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, SUM(b.sb) AS buts_voles, SUM(b.so) AS retraits_sur_prises FROM batting b JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.name_first, p.name_last HAVING SUM(b.sb) > SUM(b.so) ORDER BY buts_voles DESC;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont participé à un All-Star Game sans avoir de ligne de frappeur cette même année ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.name_first, p.name_last, a.year FROM all_star a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM batting b WHERE b.player_id = a.player_id AND b.year = a.year) ORDER BY a.year;"},{"question":"Quelle est la fréquentation totale par parc et par pays ?","sql":"SELECT p.park_name, p.country, SUM(h.attendance) AS frequentation_totale FROM park p JOIN home_game h ON h.park_id = p.park_id GROUP BY p.park_id, p.park_name, p.country ORDER BY frequentation_totale DESC;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont eu un pourcentage de présence sur base supérieur à 40 % en 2019 ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, SUM(b.bb + b.hbp) AS presences, SUM(b.ab + b.bb + b.hbp + b.sf) AS opportunites FROM batting b JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id WHERE b.year = 2019 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.name_first, p.name_last HAVING CAST(SUM(b.bb + b.hbp) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(b.ab + b.bb + b.hbp + b.sf), 0) > 0.4 ORDER BY presences DESC;"},{"question":"Quels entraîneurs ont reçu un prix de manager en 2021 ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, ma.award_id, ma.league_id FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE ma.year = 2021;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont eu une carrière de batteur plus longue que dix saisons distinctes ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, COUNT(DISTINCT b.year) AS saisons FROM batting b JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.name_first, p.name_last HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.year) > 10 ORDER BY saisons DESC;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms complets des étudiants ainsi que la ville de leur adresse principale ?","sql":"SELECT s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS nom_complet, a.city
FROM Students AS s
JOIN Addresses AS a ON a.address_id = s.address_id;"},{"question":"Quels incidents ont été signalés, avec leur type et le nom de l’étudiant concerné ?","sql":"SELECT bi.incident_id, rit.incident_type_description, s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS etudiant, bi.date_incident_start
FROM Behavior_Incident AS bi
JOIN Ref_Incident_Type AS rit ON rit.incident_type_code = bi.incident_type_code
JOIN Students AS s ON s.student_id = bi.student_id
ORDER BY bi.date_incident_start;"},{"question":"Combien d’incidents chaque étudiant a-t-il eus, y compris ceux qui n’en ont eu aucun ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS etudiant, COUNT(bi.incident_id) AS nombre_incidents
FROM Students AS s
LEFT JOIN Behavior_Incident AS bi ON bi.student_id = s.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
ORDER BY nombre_incidents DESC, etudiant;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants ont rédigé au moins une note d’évaluation, et combien de notes chacun a-t-il rédigées ?","sql":"SELECT t.teacher_id, t.first_name || ' ' || t.last_name AS enseignant, COUNT(an.notes_id) AS nombre_notes
FROM Teachers AS t
JOIN Assessment_Notes AS an ON an.teacher_id = t.teacher_id
GROUP BY t.teacher_id, t.first_name, t.last_name
ORDER BY nombre_notes DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne des retenues, en heures, pour chaque type de retenue ?","sql":"SELECT rdt.detention_type_description,
       AVG((julianday(d.datetime_detention_end) - julianday(d.datetime_detention_start)) * 24.0) AS duree_moyenne_heures
FROM Detention AS d
JOIN Ref_Detention_Type AS rdt ON rdt.detention_type_code = d.detention_type_code
WHERE d.datetime_detention_start IS NOT NULL
  AND d.datetime_detention_end IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY rdt.detention_type_code, rdt.detention_type_description;"},{"question":"Quelles adresses étudiantes sont encore en cours aujourd’hui, c’est-à-dire sans date de fin ?","sql":"SELECT sa.student_id, s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS etudiant,
       a.line_1, a.city, a.zip_postcode, sa.date_address_from
FROM Student_Addresses AS sa
JOIN Students AS s ON s.student_id = sa.student_id
JOIN Addresses AS a ON a.address_id = sa.address_id
WHERE sa.date_address_to IS NULL
ORDER BY sa.student_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le loyer mensuel moyen par ville pour les adresses étudiantes ?","sql":"SELECT a.city, AVG(sa.monthly_rental) AS loyer_mensuel_moyen
FROM Student_Addresses AS sa
JOIN Addresses AS a ON a.address_id = sa.address_id
WHERE sa.monthly_rental IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.city
ORDER BY loyer_mensuel_moyen DESC;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont au moins un incident mais aucun lien avec une retenue ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS etudiant
FROM Students AS s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Behavior_Incident AS bi
    WHERE bi.student_id = s.student_id
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Students_in_Detention AS sid
    WHERE sid.student_id = s.student_id
);"},{"question":"Pour chaque enseignant, quelle est la date de sa note d’évaluation la plus récente ?","sql":"SELECT t.teacher_id, t.first_name || ' ' || t.last_name AS enseignant,
       MAX(an.date_of_notes) AS derniere_note
FROM Teachers AS t
LEFT JOIN Assessment_Notes AS an ON an.teacher_id = t.teacher_id
GROUP BY t.teacher_id, t.first_name, t.last_name;"},{"question":"Quels incidents ont commencé pendant l’année 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT incident_id, student_id, incident_type_code, date_incident_start, incident_summary
FROM Behavior_Incident
WHERE date_incident_start >= '2023-01-01'
  AND date_incident_start < '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY date_incident_start;"},{"question":"Quelles villes apparaissent dans les adresses des étudiants ou des enseignants, sans doublon ?","sql":"SELECT city
FROM Addresses
WHERE address_id IN (SELECT address_id FROM Students)
UNION
SELECT city
FROM Addresses
WHERE address_id IN (SELECT address_id FROM Teachers)
ORDER BY city;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont eu plus d’un incident comportemental ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS etudiant,
       COUNT(bi.incident_id) AS nombre_incidents
FROM Students AS s
JOIN Behavior_Incident AS bi ON bi.student_id = s.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
HAVING COUNT(bi.incident_id) > 1
ORDER BY nombre_incidents DESC;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont associés à une retenue et quel était le résumé de l’incident correspondant ?","sql":"SELECT s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS etudiant,
       d.detention_id,
       bi.incident_id,
       bi.incident_summary
FROM Students_in_Detention AS sid
JOIN Students AS s ON s.student_id = sid.student_id
JOIN Detention AS d ON d.detention_id = sid.detention_id
JOIN Behavior_Incident AS bi ON bi.incident_id = sid.incident_id
ORDER BY s.last_name, s.first_name;"},{"question":"Quelles descriptions de types d’adresse sont enregistrées dans la table de référence ?","sql":"SELECT address_type_code, address_type_description
FROM Ref_Address_Types
ORDER BY address_type_code;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants n’ont encore aucun incident enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS etudiant
FROM Students AS s
LEFT JOIN Behavior_Incident AS bi ON bi.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE bi.incident_id IS NULL
ORDER BY s.last_name, s.first_name;"},{"question":"Combien d’incidents sont associés à chaque type d’incident ?","sql":"SELECT rit.incident_type_code, rit.incident_type_description,
       COUNT(bi.incident_id) AS nombre_incidents
FROM Ref_Incident_Type AS rit
LEFT JOIN Behavior_Incident AS bi ON bi.incident_type_code = rit.incident_type_code
GROUP BY rit.incident_type_code, rit.incident_type_description
ORDER BY nombre_incidents DESC, rit.incident_type_code;"},{"question":"Quelles notes d’évaluation indiquent le nom de l’étudiant et celui de l’enseignant ?","sql":"SELECT an.date_of_notes,
       s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS etudiant,
       t.first_name || ' ' || t.last_name AS enseignant,
       an.text_of_notes
FROM Assessment_Notes AS an
LEFT JOIN Students AS s ON s.student_id = an.student_id
JOIN Teachers AS t ON t.teacher_id = an.teacher_id
ORDER BY an.date_of_notes;"},{"question":"Quel est le loyer mensuel le plus élevé enregistré pour chaque étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS etudiant,
       MAX(sa.monthly_rental) AS loyer_maximal
FROM Students AS s
JOIN Student_Addresses AS sa ON sa.student_id = s.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
ORDER BY loyer_maximal DESC;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont eu un incident dont le type est également utilisé pour au moins deux incidents ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS etudiant
FROM Students AS s
JOIN Behavior_Incident AS bi ON bi.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE bi.incident_type_code IN (
    SELECT incident_type_code
    FROM Behavior_Incident
    GROUP BY incident_type_code
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
ORDER BY etudiant;"},{"question":"Quelles retenues ont duré plus de deux heures ?","sql":"SELECT detention_id, detention_type_code, datetime_detention_start, datetime_detention_end,
       (julianday(datetime_detention_end) - julianday(datetime_detention_start)) * 24.0 AS duree_heures
FROM Detention
WHERE datetime_detention_start IS NOT NULL
  AND datetime_detention_end IS NOT NULL
  AND (julianday(datetime_detention_end) - julianday(datetime_detention_start)) * 24.0 > 2
ORDER BY duree_heures DESC;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont eu un incident mais ne figurent jamais parmi les étudiants placés en retenue ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS etudiant
FROM Students AS s
WHERE s.student_id IN (SELECT student_id FROM Behavior_Incident)
EXCEPT
SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS etudiant
FROM Students AS s
WHERE s.student_id IN (SELECT student_id FROM Students_in_Detention);"},{"question":"Quelles adresses sont partagées par plusieurs étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT a.address_id, a.line_1, a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT sa.student_id) AS nombre_etudiants
FROM Addresses AS a
JOIN Student_Addresses AS sa ON sa.address_id = a.address_id
GROUP BY a.address_id, a.line_1, a.city
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sa.student_id) > 1
ORDER BY nombre_etudiants DESC;"}]}

par ville ?","sql":"SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS nombre_stations FROM station GROUP BY city ORDER BY nombre_stations DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles stations disposent d'au moins 20 bornes ?","sql":"SELECT COALESCE(d.nombre_departures, 0) AS departs, COALESCE(a.nombre_arrivees, 0) AS arrivees FROM station AS s LEFT JOIN (SELECT start_station_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_departures FROM trip GROUP BY chaque station ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.name, AVG(t.duration) AS duree_moyenne FROM station AS s JOIN trip AS t ON t.start_station_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY duree_moyenne trip GROUP BY start_station_id, end_station_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY nombre_trajets DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de trajets ont été effectués par type d'abonnement et par mois ?","sql":"SELECT subscription_type, substr(start_date, 1, 7) AS mois, COUNT(*) AS nombre_trajets FROM trip GROUP BY subscription_type, mois ORDER BY mois, subscription_type;"},{"question":"Quels jours ont enregistré le plus de trajets ?","sql":"SELECT substr(start_date, 1, 10) AS jour, COUNT(*) AS nombre_trajets FROM trip GROUP BY jour ORDER BY nombre_trajets DESC LIMIT 10;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de trajets par année de départ ?","sql":"SELECT substr(start_date, 1, 4) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_trajets FROM trip GROUP BY annee ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quels trajets ont été réalisés par des utilisateurs dont le code postal est absent ?","sql":"SELECT id, duration, subscription_type FROM trip WHERE zip_code IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelle est la température maximale ?","sql":"SELECT zip_code, AVG(mean_temperature_f) AS temperature_moyenne FROM weather GROUP BY zip_code ORDER BY temperature_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quels jours ont enregistré des précipitations ?","sql":"SELECT date, precipitation_inches FROM weather WHERE precipitation_inches > 0 ORDER BY date;"},{"question":"Quelle a été la vitesse maximale du vent par jour ?","sql":"SELECT date, date;"},{"question":"Quelle est la pression moyenne au niveau de la mer par code postal ?","sql":"SELECT zip_code, AVG(mean_sea_level_pressure_inches) AS pression_moyenne FROM weather GROUP BY zip_code;"},{"question":"Quels jours avaient une visibilité minimale d'au moins 10 miles ?","sql":"SELECT date, min_visibility_miles FROM weather WHERE min_visibility_miles >= 10;"},{"question":"Quelle est la température minimale globale enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT MIN(min_temperature_f) AS temperature_minimale FROM weather;"},{"question":"Quels codes postaux disposent de données météorologiques et de trajets ?","sql":"SELECT zip_code FROM weather WHERE zip_code IS NOT NULL INTERSECT SELECT zip_code FROM trip WHERE zip_code IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels codes postaux apparaissent dans les trajets mais pas dans les relevés météorologiques ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT zip_code FROM trip WHERE zip_code IS NOT NULL EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT zip_code FROM weather WHERE zip_code IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels jours ont une température moyenne supérieure à la moyenne de toutes les journées ?","sql":"SELECT date, mean_temperature_f FROM weather WHERE mean_temperature_f > (SELECT AVG(mean_temperature_f) FROM weather);"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne des températures maximales par année ?","sql":"SELECT substr(date, 1, 4) AS annee, AVG(max_temperature_f) AS temperature_maximale_moyenne FROM weather GROUP BY annee ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quels jours ont à la fois des précipitations et un événement météorologique renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT date, precipitation_inches, events FROM weather WHERE precipitation_inches > 0 AND events IS NOT NULL AND events <> '';"},{"question":"Quelles stations ont plus de bornes que la relevés indiquent plus de vélos disponibles que de places libres ?","sql":"SELECT station_id, time, bikes_available, docks_available FROM status WHERE bikes_available > AS s WHERE bikes_available = (SELECT MAX(s2.bikes_available) FROM status AS s2 WHERE s2.station_id = s.station_id);"},{"question":"Quelles stations disposent d'au moins un relevé de statut ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.name FROM station AS s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM status AS st WHERE st.station_id = s.id);"},{"question":"Quels relevés de statut correspondent à une station située à Oakland ?","sql":"SELECT st.station_id, st.time, st.bikes_available, st.docks_available FROM status AS st JOIN station AS s ON s.id = st.station_id WHERE s.city = 'Oakland';"},{"question":"Combien de relevés de statut possède chaque station ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.name, COUNT(st.station_id) AS nombre_releves FROM station AS s LEFT JOIN status AS st ON st.station_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.name FROM status AS st JOIN station AS s ON s.id = st.station_id WHERE st.bikes_available = 0 AND st.docks_available > 0;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de places libres par ville ?","sql":"SELECT s.city, AVG(st.docks_available) AS moyenne_places_libres FROM status AS st JOIN station AS s ON s.id = st.station_id GROUP BY s.city;"},{"question":"Quelles stations ont été installées avant 2013 et ont au moins un trajet au départ ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.name, s.installation_date FROM station AS s WHERE s.installation_date < '2013-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip AS t WHERE t.start_station_id = s.id);"},{"question":"Quels trajets ont commencé un jour où la température maximale dépassait 80 degrés Fahrenheit ?","sql":"SELECT t.id, t.start_date, t.duration FROM trip AS t JOIN weather AS w ON w.date = substr(t.start_date, 1, 10) WHERE w.max_temperature_f > 80;"},{"question":"Combien de trajets ont commencé par jour de précipitations ?","sql":"SELECT substr(t.start_date, 1, 10) AS jour, COUNT(*) AS nombre_trajets FROM trip AS t JOIN weather AS w ON w.date = substr(t.start_date, 1, 10) WHERE w.precipitation_inches > 0 GROUP BY jour ORDER BY jour;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne des trajets selon qu'il pleuvait ou non ?","sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN w.precipitation_inches > 0 THEN 'Avec précipitations' ELSE 'Sans précipitations' END AS situation, AVG(t.duration) AS duree_moyenne FROM trip AS t JOIN weather AS w ON w.date = substr(t.start_date, 1, 10) GROUP BY situation;"},{"question":"Quels jours de météo n'ont enregistré aucun trajet commençant ce jour-là ?","sql":"SELECT w.date FROM weather AS w WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip AS t WHERE substr(t.start_date, 1, 10) = w.date);"},{"question":"Quelles stations ont une capacité supérieure à toutes les stations de San Jose ?","sql":"SELECT id, name, city, dock_count FROM station WHERE dock_count > (SELECT MAX(dock_count) FROM station WHERE city = 'San Jose');"},{"question":"Quels abonnements ont une durée moyenne supérieure à la durée moyenne globale ?","sql":"SELECT subscription_type, AVG(duration) AS duree_moyenne FROM trip GROUP BY subscription_type HAVING AVG(duration) > (SELECT AVG(duration) FROM trip);"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de trajets par ville de départ et par type d'abonnement ?","sql":"SELECT s.city, t.subscription_type, COUNT(*) AS nombre_trajets FROM trip AS t JOIN station AS s ON s.id = t.start_station_id GROUP BY s.city, t.subscription_type ORDER BY s.city, nombre_trajets DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles stations apparaissent à la fois comme départ et comme arrivée dans les trajets ?","sql":"SELECT id, name FROM station WHERE id IN (SELECT start_station_id FROM trip) AND id IN (SELECT end_station_id FROM trip);"},{"question":"Quelles sont les coordonnées des stations ayant le plus de départs ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.name, s.lat, s.long, COUNT(t.id) AS nombre_departs FROM station AS s JOIN trip AS t ON t.start_station_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.lat, s.long ORDER BY nombre_departs DESC LIMIT 5;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms des athlètes ainsi que leurs performances au snatch, à l'épaulé-jeté et leur total ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", b."Snatch", b."Clean_Jerk", b."Total"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "body_builder" AS b ON b."People_ID" = p."People_ID";"},{"question":"Quelle personne possède le meilleur total en haltérophilie ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", b."Total"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "body_builder" AS b ON b."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
WHERE b."Total" = (SELECT MAX("Total") FROM "body_builder");"},{"question":"Quel est le total moyen des performances pour chaque lieu de naissance ?","sql":"SELECT p."Birth_Place", AVG(b."Total") AS "Total_moyen"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "body_builder" AS b ON b."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
GROUP BY p."Birth_Place";"},{"question":"Quelles personnes sont enregistrées comme athlètes mais n'ont aucune performance associée ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name"
FROM "people" AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "body_builder" AS b
    WHERE b."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
);"},{"question":"Combien d'athlètes sont associés à chaque lieu de naissance ?","sql":"SELECT p."Birth_Place", COUNT(b."Body_Builder_ID") AS "Nombre_athletes"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "body_builder" AS b ON b."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
GROUP BY p."Birth_Place";"},{"question":"Quels athlètes ont un total supérieur à la moyenne de tous les totaux ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", b."Total"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "body_builder" AS b ON b."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
WHERE b."Total" > (SELECT AVG("Total") FROM "body_builder")
ORDER BY b."Total" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois meilleurs totaux avec le nom des athlètes correspondants ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", b."Total"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "body_builder" AS b ON b."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
ORDER BY b."Total" DESC
LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quels athlètes ont soulevé davantage au clean and jerk qu'au snatch ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", b."Snatch", b."Clean_Jerk"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "body_builder" AS b ON b."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
WHERE b."Clean_Jerk" > b."Snatch";"},{"question":"Quels lieux de naissance sont associés à au moins une personne plus grande que la taille moyenne ou plus lourde que le poids moyen ?","sql":"SELECT "Birth_Place"
FROM "people"
WHERE "Height" > (SELECT AVG("Height") FROM "people")
UNION
SELECT "Birth_Place"
FROM "people"
WHERE "Weight" > (SELECT AVG("Weight") FROM "people");"},{"question":"Quel est le poids moyen des personnes pour chaque date de naissance ?","sql":"SELECT "Birth_Date", AVG("Weight") AS "Poids_moyen"
FROM "people"
GROUP BY "Birth_Date";"},{"question":"Quelles sont les personnes nées le plus récemment parmi celles qui ont une performance enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", p."Birth_Date"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "body_builder" AS b ON b."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
WHERE p."Birth_Date" = (
    SELECT MAX(p2."Birth_Date")
    FROM "people" AS p2
    JOIN "body_builder" AS b2 ON b2."People_ID" = p2."People_ID"
);"},{"question":"Quels athlètes ont un total égal à la somme de leur snatch et de leur clean and jerk ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", b."Snatch", b."Clean_Jerk", b."Total"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "body_builder" AS b ON b."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
WHERE b."Total" = b."Snatch" + b."Clean_Jerk";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les titres des livres écrits par « Victor Hugo » ?","sql":"SELECT "Title"
FROM "book"
WHERE "Writer" = 'Victor Hugo';"},{"question":"Pour chaque éditeur, combien de publications possède-t-il et quel est le prix moyen de celles-ci ?","sql":"SELECT "Publisher", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_publications", AVG("Price") AS "Prix_moyen"
FROM "publication"
GROUP BY "Publisher";"},{"question":"Quels livres ont été publiés au moins une fois à un prix supérieur à 30 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT b."Book_ID", b."Title"
FROM "book" AS b
JOIN "publication" AS p ON p."Book_ID" = b."Book_ID"
WHERE p."Price" > 30;"},{"question":"Quel est le livre ayant le plus grand nombre d'éditions publiées ?","sql":"SELECT b."Title", COUNT(p."Publication_ID") AS "Nombre_de_publications"
FROM "book" AS b
JOIN "publication" AS p ON p."Book_ID" = b."Book_ID"
GROUP BY b."Book_ID", b."Title"
HAVING COUNT(p."Publication_ID") = (
    SELECT MAX("Nombre_de_publications")
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_publications"
        FROM "publication"
        GROUP BY "Book_ID"
    )
);"},{"question":"Quels livres n'ont encore aucune publication enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT "Title"
FROM "book"
WHERE "Book_ID" NOT IN (
    SELECT "Book_ID"
    FROM "publication"
    WHERE "Book_ID" IS NOT NULL
);"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et systèmes d’exploitation des accélérateurs clients ?","sql":"SELECT "name", "Operating_system"
FROM "Web_client_accelerator"
ORDER BY "name";"},{"question":"Quels navigateurs ont une part de marché supérieure à la part de marché moyenne de tous les navigateurs ?","sql":"SELECT "name", "market_share"
FROM "browser"
WHERE "market_share" > (SELECT AVG("market_share") FROM "browser")
ORDER BY "market_share" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque compatibilité, quel est l’accélérateur, quel est le navigateur et depuis quelle année sont-ils compatibles ?","sql":"SELECT a."name" AS accelerator_name,
       b."name" AS browser_name,
       c."compatible_since_year"
FROM "accelerator_compatible_browser" AS c
JOIN "Web_client_accelerator" AS a ON a."id" = c."accelerator_id"
JOIN "browser" AS b ON b."id" = c."browser_id"
ORDER BY a."name", b."name";"},{"question":"Combien de navigateurs sont compatibles avec chaque accélérateur, y compris ceux qui n’en ont aucun ?","sql":"SELECT a."name",
       COUNT(c."browser_id") AS compatible_browser_count
FROM "Web_client_accelerator" AS a
LEFT JOIN "accelerator_compatible_browser" AS c
  ON c."accelerator_id" = a."id"
GROUP BY a."id", a."name"
ORDER BY compatible_browser_count DESC, a."name";"},{"question":"Quel navigateur compatible possède la plus grande part de marché pour l’accélérateur nommé « Accelerator A » ?","sql":"SELECT b."name", b."market_share"
FROM "browser" AS b
JOIN "accelerator_compatible_browser" AS c ON c."browser_id" = b."id"
JOIN "Web_client_accelerator" AS a ON a."id" = c."accelerator_id"
WHERE a."name" = 'Accelerator A'
ORDER BY b."market_share" DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels accélérateurs sont compatibles avec le navigateur nommé « Browser A » ?","sql":"SELECT a."name"
FROM "Web_client_accelerator" AS a
WHERE a."id" IN (
    SELECT c."accelerator_id"
    FROM "accelerator_compatible_browser" AS c
    JOIN "browser" AS b ON b."id" = c."browser_id"
    WHERE b."name" = 'Browser A'
)
ORDER BY a."name";"},{"question":"Quels navigateurs sont compatibles avec au moins deux accélérateurs différents ?","sql":"SELECT b."name", COUNT(DISTINCT c."accelerator_id") AS accelerator_count
FROM "browser" AS b
JOIN "accelerator_compatible_browser" AS c ON c."browser_id" = b."id"
GROUP BY b."id", b."name"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c."accelerator_id") >= 2
ORDER BY accelerator_count DESC, b."name";"},{"question":"Quelle est l’année moyenne de début de compatibilité pour chaque accélérateur ?","sql":"SELECT a."name", AVG(c."compatible_since_year") AS average_compatible_since_year
FROM "Web_client_accelerator" AS a
JOIN "accelerator_compatible_browser" AS c ON c."accelerator_id" = a."id"
GROUP BY a."id", a."name"
ORDER BY average_compatible_since_year, a."name";"},{"question":"Quels accélérateurs ne sont compatibles avec aucun navigateur ?","sql":"SELECT a."name"
FROM "Web_client_accelerator" AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "accelerator_compatible_browser" AS c
    WHERE c."accelerator_id" = a."id"
)
ORDER BY a."name";"},{"question":"Quels navigateurs sont compatibles à la fois avec les accélérateurs « Accelerator A » et « Accelerator B » ?","sql":"SELECT b."id", b."name"
FROM "browser" AS b
JOIN "accelerator_compatible_browser" AS c ON c."browser_id" = b."id"
JOIN "Web_client_accelerator" AS a ON a."id" = c."accelerator_id"
WHERE a."name" = 'Accelerator A'
INTERSECT
SELECT b."id", b."name"
FROM "browser" AS b
JOIN "accelerator_compatible_browser" AS c ON c."browser_id" = b."id"
JOIN "Web_client_accelerator" AS a ON a."id" = c."accelerator_id"
WHERE a."name" = 'Accelerator B'
ORDER BY "name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque navigateur, quelle est l’année la plus ancienne de début de compatibilité ?","sql":"SELECT b."name", MIN(c."compatible_since_year") AS earliest_compatible_since_year
FROM "browser" AS b
JOIN "accelerator_compatible_browser" AS c ON c."browser_id" = b."id"
GROUP BY b."id", b."name"
ORDER BY earliest_compatible_since_year, b."name";"},{"question":"Quels accélérateurs ont au moins une compatibilité commencée après 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a."name"
FROM "Web_client_accelerator" AS a
JOIN "accelerator_compatible_browser" AS c ON c."accelerator_id" = a."id"
WHERE c."compatible_since_year" > 2020
ORDER BY a."name";"},{"question":"Quelle est la part de marché totale des navigateurs compatibles avec chaque accélérateur ?","sql":"SELECT a."name",
       COALESCE(SUM(b."market_share"), 0) AS total_market_share
FROM "Web_client_accelerator" AS a
LEFT JOIN "accelerator_compatible_browser" AS c ON c."accelerator_id" = a."id"
LEFT JOIN "browser" AS b ON b."id" = c."browser_id"
GROUP BY a."id", a."name"
ORDER BY total_market_share DESC, a."name";"},{"question":"Quels navigateurs ne sont compatibles avec aucun accélérateur utilisant le système d’exploitation « Windows » ?","sql":"SELECT b."name"
FROM "browser" AS b
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "accelerator_compatible_browser" AS c
    JOIN "Web_client_accelerator" AS a ON a."id" = c."accelerator_id"
    WHERE c."browser_id" = b."id"
      AND a."Operating_system" = 'Windows'
)
ORDER BY b."name";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels candidats ont un taux de soutien supérieur à leur taux d'opposition ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name, c.Support_rate, c.Oppose_rate
FROM candidate AS c
JOIN people AS p ON p.People_ID = c.People_ID
WHERE c.Support_rate > c.Oppose_rate;"},{"question":"Quel est le taux moyen de soutien pour chaque sexe ?","sql":"SELECT p.Sex, AVG(c.Support_rate) AS taux_moyen_soutien
FROM candidate AS c
JOIN people AS p ON p.People_ID = c.People_ID
GROUP BY p.Sex;"},{"question":"Quel candidat a le taux de soutien le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name, c.Support_rate
FROM candidate AS c
JOIN people AS p ON p.People_ID = c.People_ID
WHERE c.Support_rate = (SELECT MAX(Support_rate) FROM candidate);"},{"question":"Quelles personnes n'apparaissent dans aucun sondage ?","sql":"SELECT p.People_ID, p.Name
FROM people AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM candidate AS c
    WHERE c.People_ID = p.People_ID
);"},{"question":"Quels candidats ont été mesurés dans au moins trois sondages ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_sondages
FROM candidate AS c
JOIN people AS p ON p.People_ID = c.People_ID
GROUP BY c.People_ID, p.Name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;"},{"question":"Quelle est la date la plus récente de sondage pour chaque source ?","sql":"SELECT Poll_Source, MAX(Date) AS date_la_plus_recente
FROM candidate
GROUP BY Poll_Source;"},{"question":"Quels candidats ont un écart d'au moins 20 points entre leur soutien et leur opposition ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name, c.Support_rate, c.Oppose_rate,
       c.Support_rate - c.Oppose_rate AS ecart
FROM candidate AS c
JOIN people AS p ON p.People_ID = c.People_ID
WHERE ABS(c.Support_rate - c.Oppose_rate) >= 20;"},{"question":"Quels sont les taux moyens de soutien, de considération et d'opposition par source de sondage ?","sql":"SELECT Poll_Source,
       AVG(Support_rate) AS soutien_moyen,
       AVG(Consider_rate) AS consideration_moyenne,
       AVG(Oppose_rate) AS opposition_moyenne
FROM candidate
GROUP BY Poll_Source;"},{"question":"Quels candidats ont un taux de soutien supérieur à la moyenne de tous les candidats ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name, c.Support_rate
FROM candidate AS c
JOIN people AS p ON p.People_ID = c.People_ID
WHERE c.Support_rate > (SELECT AVG(Support_rate) FROM candidate);"},{"question":"Quelles sont les trois personnes les plus grandes ?","sql":"SELECT Name, Height
FROM people
ORDER BY Height DESC
LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quels noms correspondent à un taux de soutien supérieur à 70 % ou à un taux d'opposition supérieur à 70 % ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name
FROM candidate AS c
JOIN people AS p ON p.People_ID = c.People_ID
WHERE c.Support_rate > 70
UNION
SELECT p.Name
FROM candidate AS c
JOIN people AS p ON p.People_ID = c.People_ID
WHERE c.Oppose_rate > 70;"},{"question":"Combien de sondages chaque personne possède-t-elle, y compris celles sans sondage ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name, COUNT(c.Candidate_ID) AS nombre_de_sondages
FROM people AS p
LEFT JOIN candidate AS c ON c.People_ID = p.People_ID
GROUP BY p.People_ID, p.Name;"},{"question":"Quels candidats ont des taux de soutien, de considération et d'opposition dont la somme dépasse 100 % ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name,
       c.Support_rate + c.Consider_rate + c.Oppose_rate AS somme_des_taux
FROM candidate AS c
JOIN people AS p ON p.People_ID = c.People_ID
WHERE c.Support_rate + c.Consider_rate + c.Oppose_rate > 100;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes sont associées à plusieurs sources de sondage distinctes ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.Poll_Source) AS nombre_de_sources
FROM people AS p
JOIN candidate AS c ON c.People_ID = p.People_ID
GROUP BY p.People_ID, p.Name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.Poll_Source) > 1;"},{"question":"Pour chaque source, quel est le taux de soutien maximal observé ?","sql":"SELECT c.Poll_Source, p.Name, c.Support_rate
FROM candidate AS c
JOIN people AS p ON p.People_ID = c.People_ID
WHERE c.Support_rate = (
    SELECT MAX(c2.Support_rate)
    FROM candidate AS c2
    WHERE c2.Poll_Source = c.Poll_Source
);"},{"question":"Quelle est la taille moyenne des personnes pour chaque sexe ?","sql":"SELECT Sex, AVG(Height) AS taille_moyenne
FROM people
GROUP BY Sex;"},{"question":"Quels candidats ont un taux d'incertitude inférieur à la moyenne des taux d'incertitude ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name, c.Unsure_rate
FROM candidate AS c
JOIN people AS p ON p.People_ID = c.People_ID
WHERE c.Unsure_rate < (SELECT AVG(Unsure_rate) FROM candidate);"},{"question":"Quelles sont les personnes dont le poids est supérieur au poids moyen de toutes les personnes ?","sql":"SELECT Name, Weight
FROM people
WHERE Weight > (SELECT AVG(Weight) FROM people);"},{"question":"Combien de candidats distincts sont recensés par source de sondage ?","sql":"SELECT Poll_Source, COUNT(DISTINCT People_ID) AS nombre_de_candidats
FROM candidate
GROUP BY Poll_Source;"},{"question":"Quels candidats ont le taux d'incertitude le plus faible parmi ceux dont le soutien dépasse 50 % ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name, c.Unsure_rate, c.Support_rate
FROM candidate AS c
JOIN people AS p ON p.People_ID = c.People_ID
WHERE c.Support_rate > 50
  AND c.Unsure_rate = (
      SELECT MIN(c2.Unsure_rate)
      FROM candidate AS c2
      WHERE c2.Support_rate > 50
  );"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms de tous les artistes, classés par ordre alphabétique ?","sql":"SELECT Name FROM Artist ORDER BY Name;"},{"question":"Quels albums appartiennent à l’artiste nommé « AC/DC » ?","sql":"SELECT a.Title FROM Album AS a JOIN Artist AS ar ON ar.ArtistId = a.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC' ORDER BY a.Title;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les dix pistes les plus longues, avec leur durée en minutes ?","sql":"SELECT Name, ROUND(Milliseconds / 60000.0, 2) AS duree_minutes FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 10;"},{"question":"Combien de pistes chaque genre contient-il ?","sql":"SELECT g.Name AS genre, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS nombre_pistes FROM Genre AS g LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY nombre_pistes DESC, genre;"},{"question":"Quel est le prix moyen des pistes pour chaque type de média ?","sql":"SELECT m.Name AS type_media, ROUND(AVG(t.UnitPrice), 2) AS prix_moyen FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name ORDER BY prix_moyen DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de pistes figurent dans chaque playlist ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name AS playlist, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS nombre_pistes FROM Playlist AS p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name ORDER BY nombre_pistes DESC, playlist;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total facturé à chaque client ?","sql":"SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0), 2) AS total_facture FROM Customer AS c LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY total_facture DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de clients résident dans chaque pays ?","sql":"SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS nombre_clients FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY nombre_clients DESC, Country;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq clients ayant dépensé le plus ?","sql":"SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS total_depense FROM Customer AS c JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY total_depense DESC LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Quels employés reportent directement à un autre employé, et à qui ?","sql":"SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employe, m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName AS responsable FROM Employee AS e JOIN Employee AS m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo ORDER BY responsable, employe;"},{"question":"Quelles factures ont un total supérieur à 20 ?","sql":"SELECT InvoiceId, CustomerId, InvoiceDate, Total FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 20 ORDER BY Total DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le chiffre d’affaires regroupé par année de facture ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS annee, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS chiffre_affaires FROM Invoice GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quel montant de ventes chaque genre a-t-il généré ?","sql":"SELECT g.Name AS genre, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS ventes FROM Genre AS g JOIN Track AS t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY ventes DESC;"},{"question":"Quels artistes ont publié au moins cinq albums ?","sql":"SELECT ar.Name AS artiste, COUNT(a.AlbumId) AS nombre_albums FROM Artist AS ar JOIN Album AS a ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name HAVING COUNT(a.AlbumId) >= 5 ORDER BY nombre_albums DESC, artiste;"},{"question":"Quelles pistes n’ont jamais été achetées ?","sql":"SELECT t.TrackId, t.Name FROM Track AS t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM InvoiceLine AS il WHERE il.TrackId = t.TrackId) ORDER BY t.Name;"},{"question":"Quelles playlists ne contiennent aucune piste ?","sql":"SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name FROM Playlist AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PlaylistTrack AS pt WHERE pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId) ORDER BY p.Name;"},{"question":"Quelles pistes apparaissent dans au moins trois playlists ?","sql":"SELECT t.Name, COUNT(pt.PlaylistId) AS nombre_playlists FROM Track AS t JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY t.TrackId, t.Name HAVING COUNT(pt.PlaylistId) >= 3 ORDER BY nombre_playlists DESC, t.Name;"},{"question":"Quel est le chiffre d’affaires total de chaque facture calculé à partir de ses lignes ?","sql":"SELECT i.InvoiceId, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS total_lignes FROM Invoice AS i JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId ORDER BY i.InvoiceId;"},{"question":"Quels sont les albums dont la durée totale dépasse une heure ?","sql":"SELECT a.Title, ROUND(SUM(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) AS duree_minutes FROM Album AS a JOIN Track AS t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title HAVING SUM(t.Milliseconds) > 3600000 ORDER BY duree_minutes DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le prix moyen des pistes de chaque genre ?","sql":"SELECT g.Name AS genre, ROUND(AVG(t.UnitPrice), 2) AS prix_moyen FROM Genre AS g JOIN Track AS t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY prix_moyen DESC;"},{"question":"Quels clients sont suivis par chaque représentant commercial ?","sql":"SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS representant, c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS client FROM Employee AS e JOIN Customer AS c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId ORDER BY representant, client;"},{"question":"Quels employés ne suivent aucun client ?","sql":"SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee AS e LEFT JOIN Customer AS c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId WHERE c.CustomerId IS NULL ORDER BY e.LastName, e.FirstName;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des factures par pays de facturation ?","sql":"SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS total_facture FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY total_facture DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la facture la plus élevée ?","sql":"SELECT InvoiceId, CustomerId, InvoiceDate, Total FROM Invoice WHERE Total = (SELECT MAX(Total) FROM Invoice);"},{"question":"Quels compositeurs sont associés à au moins dix pistes ?","sql":"SELECT Composer, COUNT(*) AS nombre_pistes FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Composer HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY nombre_pistes DESC, Composer;"},{"question":"Quelles playlists contiennent le plus de pistes ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS nombre_pistes FROM Playlist AS p JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name ORDER BY nombre_pistes DESC LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Quels albums ne contiennent aucune piste ?","sql":"SELECT a.AlbumId, a.Title FROM Album AS a LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId WHERE t.TrackId IS NULL ORDER BY a.Title;"},{"question":"Pour chaque genre, quelle est la piste la plus chère ?","sql":"SELECT g.Name AS genre, t.Name AS piste, t.UnitPrice FROM Genre AS g JOIN Track AS t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE t.UnitPrice = (SELECT MAX(t2.UnitPrice) FROM Track AS t2 WHERE t2.GenreId = t.GenreId) ORDER BY genre, piste;"},{"question":"Quelles pistes ont été achetées par le client dont l’adresse e-mail est « leonie@example.com » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT t.Name FROM Track AS t JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Email = 'leonie@example.com' ORDER BY t.Name;"},{"question":"Quels clients n’ont encore reçu aucune facture ?","sql":"SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer AS c LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceId IS NULL ORDER BY c.LastName, c.FirstName;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant moyen des factures pour chaque client ayant au moins une facture ?","sql":"SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, ROUND(AVG(i.Total), 2) AS facture_moyenne FROM Customer AS c JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY facture_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quels pays apparaissent soit comme pays de résidence d’un client, soit comme pays de facturation ?","sql":"SELECT Country AS pays FROM Customer WHERE Country IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT BillingCountry AS pays FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pays;"},{"question":"Quelles pistes sont plus longues que la moyenne de toutes les pistes ?","sql":"SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > (SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM Track) ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque pays de facturation, quelle est la facture la plus élevée ?","sql":"SELECT i.BillingCountry, i.InvoiceId, i.Total FROM Invoice AS i WHERE i.Total = (SELECT MAX(i2.Total) FROM Invoice AS i2 WHERE i2.BillingCountry = i.BillingCountry) ORDER BY i.BillingCountry;"},{"question":"Quels employés et leurs responsables ont-ils le même pays ?","sql":"SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employe, m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName AS responsable, e.Country FROM Employee AS e JOIN Employee AS m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo WHERE e.Country = m.Country ORDER BY e.LastName, e.FirstName;"},{"question":"Quels types de média ne sont associés à aucune piste ?","sql":"SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name FROM MediaType AS m LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.TrackId IS NULL ORDER BY m.Name;"},{"question":"Quel chiffre d’affaires chaque artiste a-t-il généré grâce aux ventes de ses pistes ?","sql":"SELECT ar.Name AS artiste, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS chiffre_affaires FROM Artist AS ar JOIN Album AS a ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track AS t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les cinémas situés à Paris, classés par capacité décroissante ?","sql":"SELECT "Cinema_ID", "Name", "Capacity"
FROM "cinema"
WHERE "Location" = 'Paris'
ORDER BY "Capacity" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films ne sont programmés dans aucun cinéma ?","sql":"SELECT f."Film_ID", f."Title"
FROM "film" AS f
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "schedule" AS s
    WHERE s."Film_ID" = f."Film_ID"
)
ORDER BY f."Title";"},{"question":"Pour chaque cinéma proposant au moins un film, quelle est sa programmation moyenne en nombre de séances quotidiennes et son prix moyen ?","sql":"SELECT c."Cinema_ID", c."Name",
       AVG(s."Show_times_per_day") AS "Moyenne_seances_par_jour",
       AVG(s."Price") AS "Prix_moyen"
FROM "cinema" AS c
JOIN "schedule" AS s ON s."Cinema_ID" = c."Cinema_ID"
GROUP BY c."Cinema_ID", c."Name"
ORDER BY "Prix_moyen" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel ou quels cinémas ont la plus grande capacité ?","sql":"SELECT "Cinema_ID", "Name", "Capacity"
FROM "cinema"
WHERE "Capacity" = (
    SELECT MAX("Capacity")
    FROM "cinema"
);"},{"question":"Quels films sont programmés dans au moins deux cinémas différents ?","sql":"SELECT f."Film_ID", f."Title", COUNT(DISTINCT s."Cinema_ID") AS "Nombre_de_cinemas"
FROM "film" AS f
JOIN "schedule" AS s ON s."Film_ID" = f."Film_ID"
GROUP BY f."Film_ID", f."Title"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s."Cinema_ID") >= 2
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_cinemas" DESC, f."Title";"},{"question":"Pour chaque cinéma, quel est le revenu quotidien théorique maximal si toutes les places sont vendues à chaque séance programmée ?","sql":"SELECT c."Cinema_ID", c."Name",
       SUM(c."Capacity" * s."Show_times_per_day" * s."Price") AS "Revenu_quotidien_theorique"
FROM "cinema" AS c
JOIN "schedule" AS s ON s."Cinema_ID" = c."Cinema_ID"
GROUP BY c."Cinema_ID", c."Name"
ORDER BY "Revenu_quotidien_theorique" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels cinémas ont soit ouvert avant 2000, soit une capacité supérieure à 500 places ?","sql":"SELECT "Cinema_ID", "Name", "Openning_year", "Capacity"
FROM "cinema"
WHERE "Openning_year" < 2000
UNION
SELECT "Cinema_ID", "Name", "Openning_year", "Capacity"
FROM "cinema"
WHERE "Capacity" > 500
ORDER BY "Openning_year", "Name";"},{"question":"Quels sont les titres des films programmés avec leur cinéma, leur date et leur prix ?","sql":"SELECT f."Title", c."Name" AS "Cinema", s."Date", s."Price"
FROM "schedule" AS s
JOIN "film" AS f ON f."Film_ID" = s."Film_ID"
JOIN "cinema" AS c ON c."Cinema_ID" = s."Cinema_ID"
ORDER BY s."Date", c."Name", f."Title";"},{"question":"Combien de films chaque réalisateur a-t-il réalisés ?","sql":"SELECT "Directed_by", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_films"
FROM "film"
GROUP BY "Directed_by"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_films" DESC, "Directed_by";"},{"question":"Quels films sont diffusés dans un cinéma dont le prix est supérieur au prix moyen de toutes les séances ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f."Film_ID", f."Title"
FROM "film" AS f
JOIN "schedule" AS s ON s."Film_ID" = f."Film_ID"
WHERE s."Price" > (
    SELECT AVG("Price")
    FROM "schedule"
)
ORDER BY f."Title";"}]}

c.ClubID, c.ClubName FROM Club AS c JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.ClubID = c.ClubID JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = m.StuID WHERE s.Age < 18;"},{"question":"Quel est l'âge moyen des membres de chaque club ?","sql":"SELECT c.ClubID, c.ClubName, AVG(s.Age) AS Age_moyen FROM Club AS c JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.ClubID = c.ClubID JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = m.StuID GROUP BY c.ClubID, c.ClubName;"},{"question":"Quels clubs ont un âge moyen des membres supérieur à 21 ans ?","sql":"SELECT c.ClubID, c.ClubName, AVG(s.Age) AS Age_moyen FROM Club AS c JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON ?","sql":"SELECT c.ClubID, c.ClubName FROM Club AS c JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.ClubID = c.ClubID GROUP BY c.ClubID, c.ClubName HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;"},{"question":"Combien de clubs différents chaque étudiant fréquente-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname, COUNT(DISTINCT m.ClubID) AS Nombre_clubs FROM Student AS s LEFT JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont inscrits dans tous les clubs ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname FROM Student AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Club AS c WHERE ?","sql":"SELECT c.ClubID, c.ClubName FROM Club AS c JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.ClubID = c.ClubID JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = m.StuID GROUP BY c.ClubID, c.ClubName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.Sex) = 2;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants appartiennent à un club mais n'en sont pas responsables ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname FROM Student AS s JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.StuID = Longueur_moyenne FROM Club WHERE ClubDesc IS NOT NULL AND ClubDesc <> '';"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont un identifiant pair ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, LName, Fname FROM Student WHERE StuID % 2 = ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname FROM Student AS s JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.StuID = s.StuID WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Student AS e WHERE e.Advisor = s.StuID);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ne conseillent personne et n'appartiennent à aucun club ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname FROM Student AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Student AS e WHERE e.Advisor = s.StuID) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Member_of_club AS m WHERE m.StuID = s.StuID);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants conseillent au moins un membre d'un club ?","sql":"SELECT existe dans le même club ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.ClubID, c.ClubName FROM Club AS c JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.ClubID = c.ClubID JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = m.StuID JOIN Member_of_club AS ma ON ma.ClubID = c.ClubID AND ma.StuID = s.Advisor;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants n'ont pas le même code de ville que leur conseiller ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname, s.city_code, a.city_code AS code_ville_conseiller FROM Student AS s JOIN Student AS a ON a.StuID = s.Advisor WHERE s.city_code <> a.city_code OR s.city_code IS NULL OR a.city_code IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels clubs sont situés dans une ville où aucun étudiant n'est enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT c.ClubID, c.ClubName, c.ClubLocation FROM Club AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Student AS s WHERE s.city_code = c.ClubLocation);"},{"question":"Quels codes de ville n'ont aucun club correspondant à leur localisation ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.city_code FROM Student AS s WHERE s.city_code IS NOT NULL AND NOT s.LName, s.Fname FROM Student AS s JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Club AS c ON c.ClubID = m.ClubID WHERE c.ClubName LIKE 'C%';"},{"question":"Quels clubs accueillent un étudiant nommé Dupont ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.ClubID, c.ClubName FROM Club AS c JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.ClubID = c.ClubID JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = m.StuID WHERE s.LName = Member_of_club AS m ON m.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Club AS c ON c.ClubID = m.ClubID WHERE c.ClubDesc LIKE '%musique%';"},{"question":"Quels clubs ne comptent aucun membre âgé de moins de 18 ans ?","sql":"SELECT c.ClubID, c.ClubName FROM Club AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Member_of_club AS m JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = m.StuID WHERE m.ClubID = c.ClubID AND s.Age < 18);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont plus âgés que tous les membres du club 1 ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname, s.Age FROM Student AS s WHERE s.Age > (SELECT MAX(st.Age) FROM Student AS st JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.StuID = st.StuID WHERE m.ClubID = 1);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont moins âgés qu'au moins un membre du club 1 ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname, s.Age FROM Student AS s WHERE s.Age < (SELECT MAX(st.Age) FROM Student AS st JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.StuID = st.StuID WHERE m.ClubID = 1);"},{"question":"Quels clubs ont exactement le même nombre de membres que le club 1 ?","sql":"SELECT c.ClubID, c.ClubName, COUNT(m.StuID) AS Nombre_membres FROM Club AS c LEFT JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.ClubID = c.ClubID GROUP BY c.ClubID, c.ClubName HAVING COUNT(m.StuID) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Member_of_club WHERE ClubID = 1);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont membres d'un club situé à Paris ou à Lyon ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname FROM Student AS s JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Club AS c ON c.ClubID = m.ClubID WHERE c.ClubLocation IN ('Paris', 'Lyon');"},{"question":"Quels clubs sont situés à Paris ou comptent au moins cinq membres ?","sql":"SELECT ClubID, ClubName FROM Club WHERE ClubLocation = 'Paris' UNION SELECT m.ClubID, c.ClubName FROM Member_of_club AS m JOIN Club AS c ON c.ClubID = m.ClubID GROUP BY m.ClubID, c.ClubName HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont soit membres d'un club, soit conseillers, sans doublon ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, LName, Fname FROM Student WHERE StuID IN (SELECT StuID FROM Member_of_club UNION SELECT Advisor FROM Student WHERE Advisor IS NOT NULL);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont membres d'un club mais ne sont conseillers d'aucun étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname FROM Student AS s JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.StuID = s.StuID WHERE s.StuID NOT IN (SELECT Advisor FROM Student WHERE Advisor IS NOT NULL);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ne sont ni membres d'un club ni conseillers ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, LName, Fname FROM Student EXCEPT SELECT StuID, LName, Fname FROM Student WHERE StuID IN (SELECT StuID FROM Member_of_club UNION SELECT Advisor FROM Student WHERE Advisor IS NOT NULL);"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre d'étudiants par spécialité ?","sql":"SELECT Major, COUNT(*) AS Nombre_etudiants FROM Student GROUP BY Major ORDER BY Nombre_etudiants DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles spécialités comptent au moins trois étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT Major, COUNT(*) AS Nombre_etudiants FROM Student GROUP BY Major HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne d'âge par spécialité ?","sql":"SELECT Major, AVG(Age) AS Age_moyen FROM Student GROUP BY Major ORDER BY Major;"},{"question":"Quelles spécialités sont représentées dans au moins un club ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.Major FROM Student AS s JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.StuID = s.StuID;"},{"question":"Quels clubs regroupent des étudiants de plusieurs spécialités ?","sql":"SELECT c.ClubID, c.ClubName, COUNT(DISTINCT s.Major) AS Nombre_specialites FROM Club AS c JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.ClubID = c.ClubID JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = m.StuID GROUP BY c.ClubID, c.ClubName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.Major) > 1;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont une spécialité différente de celle de leur conseiller ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname, s.Major, a.Major AS Specialite_conseiller FROM Student AS s JOIN Student AS a ON a.StuID = s.Advisor WHERE s.Major <> a.Major;"},{"question":"Quels clubs ont plus de membres que le club ayant l'identifiant 1 ?","sql":"SELECT c.ClubID, c.ClubName, COUNT(m.StuID) AS Nombre_membres FROM Club AS c LEFT JOIN Member_of_club AS m ON m.ClubID = c.ClubID GROUP BY c.ClubID, c.ClubName HAVING COUNT(m.StuID) > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Member_of_club WHERE ClubID = 1);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont au moins un homonyme de prénom et de nom, mais un identifiant différent ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname FROM Student AS s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Student AS t WHERE t.StuID <> s.StuID AND t.LName = = c.ClubID WHERE m.Position IS NULL OR m.Position = '';"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles boutiques ont un score supérieur au score moyen de toutes les boutiques ?","sql":"SELECT "Shop_ID", "Address", "Score"
FROM "shop"
WHERE "Score" > (SELECT AVG("Score") FROM "shop");"},{"question":"Quels membres ont dépensé plus que le montant moyen de toutes les participations aux happy hours ?","sql":"SELECT m."Member_ID", m."Name", hhm."Total_amount"
FROM "member" AS m
JOIN "happy_hour_member" AS hhm ON hhm."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
WHERE hhm."Total_amount" > (SELECT AVG("Total_amount") FROM "happy_hour_member");"},{"question":"Pour chaque boutique, combien d'enregistrements de happy hour sont associés à cette boutique ?","sql":"SELECT s."Shop_ID", s."Address", COUNT(h."HH_ID") AS "nombre_de_happy_hours"
FROM "shop" AS s
LEFT JOIN "happy_hour" AS h ON h."Shop_ID" = s."Shop_ID"
GROUP BY s."Shop_ID", s."Address";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de salariés en charge des happy hours pour chaque mois ?","sql":"SELECT "Month", AVG("Num_of_shaff_in_charge") AS "moyenne_des_salaries"
FROM "happy_hour"
GROUP BY "Month"
ORDER BY "Month";"},{"question":"Quels membres n'ont participé à aucun happy hour ?","sql":"SELECT m."Member_ID", m."Name"
FROM "member" AS m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "happy_hour_member" AS hhm
    WHERE hhm."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
);"},{"question":"Quels membres ont dépensé plus de 100 au total lors des happy hours ?","sql":"SELECT m."Member_ID", m."Name", SUM(hhm."Total_amount") AS "depense_totale"
FROM "member" AS m
JOIN "happy_hour_member" AS hhm ON hhm."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
GROUP BY m."Member_ID", m."Name"
HAVING SUM(hhm."Total_amount") > 100
ORDER BY "depense_totale" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles boutiques n'ont jamais organisé de happy hour ?","sql":"SELECT s."Shop_ID", s."Address"
FROM "shop" AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "happy_hour" AS h
    WHERE h."Shop_ID" = s."Shop_ID"
);"},{"question":"Quel est le montant moyen dépensé par niveau d'adhésion ?","sql":"SELECT m."Level_of_membership", AVG(hhm."Total_amount") AS "montant_moyen"
FROM "member" AS m
JOIN "happy_hour_member" AS hhm ON hhm."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
GROUP BY m."Level_of_membership"
ORDER BY m."Level_of_membership";"},{"question":"Quelles adresses apparaissent à la fois parmi les boutiques et parmi les membres ?","sql":"SELECT "Address"
FROM "shop"
INTERSECT
SELECT "Address"
FROM "member";"},{"question":"Quels membres âgés d'au moins 30 ans ont participé à un happy hour avec un montant supérieur à 50 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m."Member_ID", m."Name", m."Age"
FROM "member" AS m
JOIN "happy_hour_member" AS hhm ON hhm."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
WHERE m."Age" >= 30
  AND hhm."Total_amount" > 50;"},{"question":"Pour chaque mois, combien de participations de membres aux happy hours ont été enregistrées et quel est leur montant total ?","sql":"SELECT h."Month", COUNT(hhm."Member_ID") AS "nombre_de_participations", SUM(hhm."Total_amount") AS "montant_total"
FROM "happy_hour" AS h
JOIN "happy_hour_member" AS hhm ON hhm."HH_ID" = h."HH_ID"
GROUP BY h."Month"
ORDER BY h."Month";"},{"question":"Quel membre a réalisé la dépense totale la plus élevée pendant les happy hours ?","sql":"SELECT m."Member_ID", m."Name", SUM(hhm."Total_amount") AS "depense_totale"
FROM "member" AS m
JOIN "happy_hour_member" AS hhm ON hhm."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
GROUP BY m."Member_ID", m."Name"
HAVING SUM(hhm."Total_amount") = (
    SELECT MAX("depense_totale")
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM("Total_amount") AS "depense_totale"
        FROM "happy_hour_member"
        GROUP BY "Member_ID"
    )
);"},{"question":"Quelles boutiques ont le score maximal ?","sql":"SELECT "Shop_ID", "Address", "Score"
FROM "shop"
WHERE "Score" = (SELECT MAX("Score") FROM "shop");"},{"question":"Quels membres ont une carte d'adhésion renseignée et n'ont jamais participé à un happy hour ?","sql":"SELECT m."Member_ID", m."Name", m."Membership_card"
FROM "member" AS m
WHERE m."Membership_card" IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM "happy_hour_member" AS hhm
      WHERE hhm."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
  );"}]}

t.semester = h.semester AND t.year = h.year GROUP BY i.ID, i.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.ID) > 10;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont un titre unique dans la table des cours ?","sql":"SELECT title FROM course GROUP BY title HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;"},{"question":"Quels départements ont au moins une salle située dans leur bâtiment ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.dept_name FROM department AS d JOIN classroom AS c ON c.building = d.building;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont un conseiller qui appartient à un département différent ?","sql":"SELECT s.ID, s.name FROM student AS s JOIN advisor AS a ON a.s_ID = s.ID JOIN instructor AS i ON i.ID = a.i_ID WHERE s.dept_name <> i.dept_name;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont au moins une section dans une salle dont la capacité est exactement 50 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.course_id, c.title FROM course AS c JOIN section AS s ON s.course_id = c.course_id JOIN classroom AS r ON r.building = s.building AND r.room_number = s.room_number WHERE r.capacity = 50;"},{"question":"Quels jours ont un créneau qui commence et se termine pendant la même heure ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT day FROM time_slot WHERE start_hr = end_hr;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont plus de sections que la moyenne des cours proposés ?","sql":"SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_sections FROM section GROUP BY course_id HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(nombre) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre FROM section GROUP BY course_id));"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont suivi plus de cours distincts que la moyenne des étudiants inscrits ?","sql":"SELECT ID, COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) AS nombre_cours FROM takes GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) > (SELECT AVG(nombre) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) AS nombre FROM takes GROUP BY ID));"},{"question":"Quels enseignants enseignent dans le même département que leur propre conseiller n'est pas applicable, mais ont au moins un étudiant conseiller dans leur département ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT i.ID, i.name FROM instructor AS i JOIN advisor AS a ON a.i_ID = i.ID JOIN student AS s ON s.ID = a.s_ID WHERE i.dept_name = s.dept_name;"}]}

étudiants ont plus de 20 ans ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, LName, Fname, Age FROM Student WHERE Age > 20 ORDER BY Age DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les étudiantes âgées de moins de 22 ans ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, LName, Fname, Age FROM Student WHERE Sex = 'F' AND Age < 22 ORDER BY LName;"},{"question":"Quels départements se trouvent dans le bâtiment « Science » ?","sql":"SELECT DNO, dispensés par un enseignant nommé Smith ?","sql":"SELECT c.CID, c.CName, f.Fname, f.Lname FROM Course AS c JOIN Faculty AS f ON f.FacID = c.Instructor WHERE f.Lname = 'Smith' ORDER BY
