LIKE '%computer%' OR LOWER(d.DName) LIKE '%informatique%' ORDER BY c.CName;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont un cours avec une note A ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.StuID = s.StuID WHERE e.Grade = 'A' ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Combien d’étudiants sont inscrits à chaque cours ?","sql":"SELECT c.CID, c.CName, COUNT(e.StuID) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Course AS c LEFT JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.CID = c.CID GROUP BY c.CID, c.CName ORDER BY nombre_etudiants DESC, c.CID;"},{"question":"Combien de cours chaque enseignant dispense-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname, COUNT(c.CID) AS nombre_de_cours FROM Faculty AS f LEFT JOIN Course AS c ON c.Instructor = f.FacID GROUP BY f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname ORDER BY nombre_de_cours DESC, f.Lname;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre d’étudiants par département principal ?","sql":"SELECT d.DNO, d.DName, COUNT(s.StuID) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Department AS d LEFT JOIN Student AS s ON s.Major = d.DNO GROUP BY d.DNO, d.DName ORDER BY nombre_etudiants DESC, d.DName;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de membres par département ?","sql":"SELECT d.DNO, d.DName, COUNT(m.FacID) AS nombre_membres FROM Department AS d LEFT JOIN Member_of AS m ON m.DNO = d.DNO GROUP BY d.DNO, d.DName ORDER BY nombre_membres DESC, d.DName;"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne d’âge des étudiants de chaque sexe ?","sql":"SELECT Sex, AVG(Age) AS age_moyen FROM Student GROUP BY Sex ORDER BY Sex;"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne des points de chaque lettre de note ?","sql":"SELECT lettergrade, AVG(gradepoint) AS moyenne_points FROM Gradeconversion GROUP BY lettergrade ORDER BY moyenne_points DESC;"},{"question":"Quels départements proposent plus de deux cours ?","sql":"SELECT d.DNO, d.DName, COUNT(c.CID) AS nombre_de_cours FROM Department AS d JOIN Course AS c ON c.DNO = d.DNO GROUP BY d.DNO, d.DName HAVING COUNT(c.CID) > 2 ORDER BY nombre_de_cours DESC;"},{"question":"Quels cours comptent plus de cinq étudiants inscrits ?","sql":"SELECT c.CID, c.CName, COUNT(e.StuID) AS nombre_inscrits FROM Course AS c JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.CID = c.CID GROUP BY c.CID, c.CName HAVING COUNT(e.StuID) > 5 ORDER BY nombre_inscrits DESC;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants suivent au moins deux cours ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, COUNT(e.CID) AS nombre_de_cours FROM Student AS s JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName HAVING COUNT(e.CID) >= 2 ORDER BY nombre_de_cours DESC, s.LName;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants appartiennent à plusieurs départements ?","sql":"SELECT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname, COUNT(m.DNO) AS nombre_de_departements FROM Faculty AS f JOIN Member_of AS m ON m.FacID = f.FacID GROUP BY f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname HAVING COUNT(m.DNO) > 1 ORDER BY nombre_de_departements DESC, f.LName;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants n’ont encore aucune inscription à un cours ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s LEFT JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.StuID = s.StuID WHERE e.StuID IS NULL ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels cours n’ont aucun étudiant inscrit ?","sql":"SELECT c.CID, c.CName FROM Course AS c LEFT JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.CID = c.CID WHERE e.CID IS NULL ORDER BY c.CName;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants ne donnent aucun cours ?","sql":"SELECT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname FROM Faculty AS f LEFT JOIN Course AS c ON c.Instructor = f.FacID WHERE c.CID IS NULL ORDER BY f.LName, f.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels départements n’ont aucun cours ?","sql":"SELECT d.DNO, d.DName FROM Department AS d LEFT JOIN Course AS c ON c.DNO = d.DNO WHERE c.CID IS NULL ORDER BY d.DName;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont une note dont la valeur numérique est supérieure à 3 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Gradeconversion AS g ON g.lettergrade = e.Grade WHERE g.gradepoint > 3 ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Pour chaque cours, quelle est la moyenne des points obtenus par ses étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT c.CID, c.CName, AVG(g.gradepoint) AS moyenne_points FROM Course AS c JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.CID = c.CID JOIN Gradeconversion AS g ON g.lettergrade = e.Grade GROUP BY c.CID, c.CName ORDER BY moyenne_points DESC;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont une moyenne de points supérieure à 3,5 ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, AVG(g.gradepoint) AS moyenne_points FROM Student AS s JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Gradeconversion AS g ON g.lettergrade = e.Grade GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName HAVING AVG(g.gradepoint) > 3.5 ORDER BY moyenne_points DESC;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont pour conseiller un enseignant donné comme instructeur d’au moins un cours ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Faculty AS f ON f.FacID = s.Advisor JOIN Course AS c ON c.Instructor = f.FacID ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont une mineure dans un département différent de leur majeure ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, s.Major, m.DNO AS mineure FROM Student AS s JOIN Minor_in AS m ON m.StuID = s.StuID WHERE m.DNO <> s.Major ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants sont membres du département auquel leur cours principal est rattaché ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname, d.DName FROM Faculty AS f JOIN Course AS c ON c.Instructor = f.FacID JOIN Member_of AS m ON m.FacID = f.FacID AND m.DNO = c.DNO JOIN Department AS d ON d.DNO = c.DNO ORDER BY f.LName, f.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont plus de crédits que la moyenne de tous les cours ?","sql":"SELECT CID, CName, Credits FROM Course WHERE Credits > (SELECT AVG(Credits) FROM Course) ORDER BY Credits DESC, CName;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont plus âgés que la moyenne d’âge ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Fname, LName, Age FROM Student WHERE Age > (SELECT AVG(Age) FROM Student) ORDER BY Age DESC, LName;"},{"question":"Quel est le cours ayant le plus grand nombre de crédits ?","sql":"SELECT CID, CName, Credits FROM Course WHERE Credits = (SELECT MAX(Credits) FROM Course) ORDER BY CID;"},{"question":"Quels départements ont au moins un étudiant majeur et au moins un étudiant mineur ?","sql":"SELECT d.DNO, d.DName FROM Department AS d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Student AS s WHERE s.Major = d.DNO) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Minor_in AS m WHERE m.DNO = d.DNO) ORDER BY d.DName;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants n’appartiennent à aucun département ?","sql":"SELECT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname FROM Faculty AS f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Member_of AS m WHERE m.FacID = f.FacID) ORDER BY f.LName, f.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont lieu aux mêmes jours qu’au moins un autre cours ?","sql":"SELECT c.CID, c.CName, c.Days FROM Course AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Course AS c2 WHERE c2.Days = c.Days AND c2.CID <> c.CID) ORDER BY c.Days, c.CID;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont à la fois majeurs et mineurs dans le même département ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, s.Major FROM Student AS s JOIN Minor_in AS m ON m.StuID = s.StuID AND m.DNO = s.Major ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants apparaissent à la fois comme conseiller et comme instructeur ?","sql":"SELECT Advisor AS FacID FROM Student WHERE Advisor IS NOT NULL INTERSECT SELECT Instructor FROM Course WHERE Instructor IS NOT NULL ORDER BY FacID;"},{"question":"Quels départements n’ont aucun étudiant majeur ?","sql":"SELECT DNO, DName FROM Department EXCEPT SELECT d.DNO, d.DName FROM Department AS d JOIN Student AS s ON s.Major = d.DNO ORDER BY DNO;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont une majeure ou une mineure dans le département 10 ?","sql":"SELECT StuID FROM Student WHERE Major = 10 UNION SELECT StuID FROM Minor_in WHERE DNO = 10 ORDER BY StuID;"},{"question":"Quels noms de famille apparaissent chez les étudiants ou chez les enseignants ?","sql":"SELECT LName AS nom FROM Student UNION SELECT Lname AS nom FROM Faculty ORDER BY nom;"},{"question":"Quel est le total de crédits suivis par chaque étudiant inscrit ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, SUM(c.Credits) AS total_credits FROM Student AS s JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Course AS c ON c.CID = e.CID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName ORDER BY total_credits DESC, s.LName;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles entreprises réalisent plus de ventes que la moyenne de toutes les entreprises ?","sql":"SELECT Company_ID, Name, Sales_in_Billion
FROM company
WHERE Sales_in_Billion > (SELECT AVG(Sales_in_Billion) FROM company);"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms et nationalités des employés travaillant pour une entreprise dont le siège est en France ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name, p.Nationality
FROM people AS p
JOIN employment AS e ON e.People_ID = p.People_ID
JOIN company AS c ON c.Company_ID = e.Company_ID
WHERE c.Headquarters = 'France';"},{"question":"Combien de personnes travaillent dans chaque entreprise, y compris celles qui n'ont aucun employé enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT c.Name, COUNT(e.People_ID) AS Nombre_employes
FROM company AS c
LEFT JOIN employment AS e ON e.Company_ID = c.Company_ID
GROUP BY c.Company_ID, c.Name;"},{"question":"Quelle ou quelles entreprises ont réalisé le bénéfice le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT Company_ID, Name, Profits_in_Billion
FROM company
WHERE Profits_in_Billion = (SELECT MAX(Profits_in_Billion) FROM company);"},{"question":"Quelles nationalités sont représentées parmi les employés des entreprises du secteur de la technologie ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.Nationality
FROM people AS p
JOIN employment AS e ON e.People_ID = p.People_ID
JOIN company AS c ON c.Company_ID = e.Company_ID
WHERE c.Industry = 'Technology';"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises n'ont actuellement aucune personne associée dans la table des emplois ?","sql":"SELECT c.Company_ID, c.Name
FROM company AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM employment AS e
    WHERE e.Company_ID = c.Company_ID
);"},{"question":"Pour chaque nationalité, quel est l'âge moyen des personnes employées et combien sont-elles ?","sql":"SELECT p.Nationality,
       AVG(p.Age) AS Age_moyen,
       COUNT(*) AS Nombre_personnes
FROM people AS p
JOIN employment AS e ON e.People_ID = p.People_ID
GROUP BY p.Nationality;"},{"question":"Quels employés travaillent à la fois pour une entreprise dont la valeur de marché dépasse la moyenne et pour une entreprise dont les ventes dépassent la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT p.People_ID, p.Name
FROM people AS p
JOIN employment AS e ON e.People_ID = p.People_ID
JOIN company AS c ON c.Company_ID = e.Company_ID
WHERE c.Market_Value_in_Billion > (SELECT AVG(Market_Value_in_Billion) FROM company)
INTERSECT
SELECT p.People_ID, p.Name
FROM people AS p
JOIN employment AS e ON e.People_ID = p.People_ID
JOIN company AS c ON c.Company_ID = e.Company_ID
WHERE c.Sales_in_Billion > (SELECT AVG(Sales_in_Billion) FROM company);"},{"question":"Quelle est l'entreprise ayant la plus grande valeur de marché dans chaque secteur ?","sql":"SELECT c.Industry, c.Name, c.Market_Value_in_Billion
FROM company AS c
WHERE c.Market_Value_in_Billion = (
    SELECT MAX(c2.Market_Value_in_Billion)
    FROM company AS c2
    WHERE c2.Industry = c.Industry
);"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises comptent au moins cinq employés âgés de plus de 40 ans ?","sql":"SELECT c.Name, COUNT(*) AS Nombre_employes_de_plus_de_40_ans
FROM company AS c
JOIN employment AS e ON e.Company_ID = c.Company_ID
JOIN people AS p ON p.People_ID = e.People_ID
WHERE p.Age > 40
GROUP BY c.Company_ID, c.Name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Combien d'entreprises appartiennent à chaque secteur d'activité ?","sql":"SELECT "Industry", COUNT(*) AS nombre_entreprises
FROM "Companies"
GROUP BY "Industry"
ORDER BY nombre_entreprises DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq bâtiments les plus hauts ?","sql":"SELECT "name", "City", "Height"
FROM "buildings"
ORDER BY "Height" DESC
LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises occupent quels bâtiments, avec leur ville et leur année d'installation ?","sql":"SELECT c."name" AS entreprise, b."name" AS batiment, b."City", o."move_in_year"
FROM "Office_locations" AS o
JOIN "Companies" AS c ON c."id" = o."company_id"
JOIN "buildings" AS b ON b."id" = o."building_id"
ORDER BY c."name", b."name";"},{"question":"Quelle est la hauteur moyenne des bâtiments dans chaque ville ?","sql":"SELECT "City", AVG("Height") AS hauteur_moyenne
FROM "buildings"
GROUP BY "City"
ORDER BY hauteur_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises ne disposent d'aucun emplacement de bureau enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT c."id", c."name"
FROM "Companies" AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "Office_locations" AS o
    WHERE o."company_id" = c."id"
)
ORDER BY c."name";"},{"question":"Combien de bâtiments sont associés à chaque entreprise, y compris celles sans bâtiment ?","sql":"SELECT c."name", COUNT(DISTINCT o."building_id") AS nombre_batiments
FROM "Companies" AS c
LEFT JOIN "Office_locations" AS o ON o."company_id" = c."id"
GROUP BY c."id", c."name"
ORDER BY nombre_batiments DESC, c."name";"},{"question":"Quelle ou quelles entreprises possèdent le plus grand montant d'actifs ?","sql":"SELECT "name", "Assets_billion"
FROM "Companies"
WHERE "Assets_billion" = (SELECT MAX("Assets_billion") FROM "Companies");"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises ont un chiffre d'affaires supérieur à la moyenne de toutes les entreprises ?","sql":"SELECT "name", "Sales_billion"
FROM "Companies"
WHERE "Sales_billion" > (SELECT AVG("Sales_billion") FROM "Companies")
ORDER BY "Sales_billion" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels bâtiments accueillent au moins une entreprise dont le siège est indiqué ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT b."id", b."name", b."City"
FROM "buildings" AS b
JOIN "Office_locations" AS o ON o."building_id" = b."id"
JOIN "Companies" AS c ON c."id" = o."company_id"
WHERE c."Headquarters" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY b."name";"},{"question":"Quelles villes apparaissent comme siège social ou comme ville d'implantation d'un bâtiment ?","sql":"SELECT "Headquarters" AS ville
FROM "Companies"
WHERE "Headquarters" IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT "City" AS ville
FROM "buildings"
WHERE "City" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ville;"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises ont une valeur de marché supérieure à 100 milliards selon la conversion numérique du champ texte ?","sql":"SELECT "name", "Market_Value_billion"
FROM "Companies"
WHERE CAST("Market_Value_billion" AS REAL) > 100
ORDER BY CAST("Market_Value_billion" AS REAL) DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises sont associées à plusieurs bâtiments ?","sql":"SELECT c."name", COUNT(DISTINCT o."building_id") AS nombre_batiments
FROM "Companies" AS c
JOIN "Office_locations" AS o ON o."company_id" = c."id"
GROUP BY c."id", c."name"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o."building_id") > 1
ORDER BY nombre_batiments DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque entreprise ayant un bureau, quel est son emplacement installé le plus récemment ?","sql":"SELECT c."name" AS entreprise, b."name" AS batiment, o."move_in_year"
FROM "Companies" AS c
JOIN "Office_locations" AS o ON o."company_id" = c."id"
JOIN "buildings" AS b ON b."id" = o."building_id"
WHERE o."move_in_year" = (
    SELECT MAX(o2."move_in_year")
    FROM "Office_locations" AS o2
    WHERE o2."company_id" = o."company_id"
)
ORDER BY c."name";"},{"question":"Quel bâtiment accueille le plus grand nombre d'entreprises ?","sql":"SELECT b."id", b."name", b."City", COUNT(DISTINCT o."company_id") AS nombre_entreprises
FROM "buildings" AS b
JOIN "Office_locations" AS o ON o."building_id" = b."id"
GROUP BY b."id", b."name", b."City"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o."company_id") = (
    SELECT MAX(nombre)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "company_id") AS nombre
        FROM "Office_locations"
        GROUP BY "building_id"
    )
)
ORDER BY b."name";"},{"question":"Quelles villes sont à la fois des sièges sociaux et des villes où se trouvent des bâtiments ?","sql":"SELECT "Headquarters" AS ville
FROM "Companies"
WHERE "Headquarters" IS NOT NULL
INTERSECT
SELECT "City" AS ville
FROM "buildings"
WHERE "City" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ville;"},{"question":"Quel est le chiffre d'affaires total par secteur d'activité ?","sql":"SELECT "Industry", SUM("Sales_billion") AS ventes_totales_milliards
FROM "Companies"
GROUP BY "Industry"
ORDER BY ventes_totales_milliards DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque statut de bâtiment, combien y a-t-il de bâtiments et quelle est leur hauteur moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT "Status", COUNT(*) AS nombre_batiments, AVG("Height") AS hauteur_moyenne
FROM "buildings"
GROUP BY "Status"
ORDER BY nombre_batiments DESC, "Status";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels comtés ont un taux de criminalité supérieur au taux moyen de criminalité de tous les comtés ?","sql":"SELECT "County_ID", "Name", "Crime_rate"
FROM "county_public_safety"
WHERE "Crime_rate" > (SELECT AVG("Crime_rate") FROM "county_public_safety");"},{"question":"Quelles villes appartiennent à des comtés comptant plus de 100 policiers ?","sql":"SELECT c."Name" AS "Ville", co."Name" AS "Comté", co."Police_officers"

JOIN "county_public_safety" AS co ON c."County_ID" = co."County_ID"

    FROM "city" AS c

);"},{"question":"Quels noms apparaissent à la fois parmi les villes et parmi les comtés ?","sql":"SELECT "Name" FROM "city"
INTERSECT
SELECT "Name" FROM "county_public_safety";"},{"question":"Quels comtés ont à la fois plus de policiers que la moyenne et une charge de dossiers supérieure à la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT "County_ID", "Name", "Police_officers", "Case_burden"
FROM "county_public_safety"
WHERE "Police_officers" > (SELECT AVG("Police_officers") FROM "county_public_safety")
  AND "Case_burden" > (SELECT AVG("Case_burden") FROM "county_public_safety");"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne des parts blanche et noire pour chaque ville ?","sql":"SELECT "City_ID", "Name", ("White" + "Black") / 2.0 AS "Moyenne_blanc_noir"
FROM "city";"},{"question":"Combien de villes sont rattachées à chaque comté, y compris ceux qui n'en ont aucune ?","sql":"SELECT co."County_ID", co."Name", COUNT(c."City_ID") AS "Nombre_de_villes"
FROM "county_public_safety" AS co
LEFT JOIN "city" AS c ON c."County_ID" = co."County_ID"
GROUP BY co."County_ID", co."Name"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_villes" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels comtés possèdent au moins une ville dont la part hispanique dépasse 50 ?","sql":"SELECT co."County_ID", co."Name"
FROM "county_public_safety" AS co
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "city" AS c
    WHERE c."County_ID" = co."County_ID"
      AND c."Hispanic" > 50
);"},{"question":"Pour chaque ville, quel est le nombre de résidents par policier de son comté et son taux de criminalité ?","sql":"SELECT c."Name" AS "Ville", co."Name" AS "Comté", co."Residents_per_officer", co."Crime_rate"
FROM "city" AS c
JOIN "county_public_safety" AS co ON c."County_ID" = co."County_ID";"},{"question":"Quels sont les comtés dont la population est supérieure à la population moyenne des comtés ?","sql":"SELECT "County_ID", "Name", "Population"
FROM "county_public_safety"
WHERE "Population" > (SELECT AVG("Population") FROM "county_public_safety")
ORDER BY "Population" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle proportion de la population totale représente chaque comté ?","sql":"SELECT "County_ID", "Name", "Population",
       100.0 * "Population" / (SELECT SUM("Population") FROM "county_public_safety") AS "Pourcentage_population"
FROM "county_public_safety"
ORDER BY "Pourcentage_population" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels noms figurent dans les villes ou les comtés, sans doublons ?","sql":"SELECT "Name" FROM "city"
UNION
SELECT "Name" FROM "county_public_safety"
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque comté ayant des villes, quelles sont la part hispanique minimale et maximale observées ?","sql":"SELECT co."County_ID", co."Name",
       MIN(c."Hispanic") AS "Hispanique_minimale",
       MAX(c."Hispanic") AS "Hispanique_maximale"
FROM "county_public_safety" AS co
JOIN "city" AS c ON c."County_ID" = co."County_ID"
GROUP BY co."County_ID", co."Name";"},{"question":"Quelles forces de police couvrent au moins deux comtés ?","sql":"SELECT "Police_force", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_comtes"
FROM "county_public_safety"
GROUP BY "Police_force"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quelles villes sont situées dans un comté dont le taux de criminalité est inférieur au taux minimal des comtés ayant plus de 50 policiers ?","sql":"SELECT c."City_ID", c."Name", co."Name" AS "Comté", co."Crime_rate"
FROM "city" AS c
JOIN "county_public_safety" AS co ON c."County_ID" = co."County_ID"
WHERE co."Crime_rate" < (
    SELECT MIN("Crime_rate")
    FROM "county_public_safety"
    WHERE "Police_officers" > 50
);"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les documents avec leur statut et leur type, accompagnés de leurs descriptions respectives ?","sql":"SELECT d.document_id,
       d.document_status_code,
       s.document_status_description,
       d.document_type_code,
       t.document_type_description
FROM Documents AS d
JOIN Ref_Document_Status AS s
  ON s.document_status_code = d.document_status_code
JOIN Ref_Document_Types AS t
  ON t.document_type_code = d.document_type_code
ORDER BY d.document_id;"},{"question":"Combien de brouillons chaque document possède-t-il, y compris ceux qui n’en possèdent aucun ?","sql":"SELECT d.document_id,
       COUNT(dd.draft_number) AS nombre_brouillons
FROM Documents AS d
LEFT JOIN Document_Drafts AS dd
  ON dd.document_id = d.document_id
GROUP BY d.document_id
ORDER BY d.document_id;"},{"question":"Quels employés ont fait circuler des copies, et combien de circulations sont enregistrées pour chacun, avec leur rôle ?","sql":"SELECT e.employee_id,
       e.employee_name,
       r.role_description,
       COUNT(ch.document_id) AS nombre_circulations
FROM Employees AS e
JOIN Roles AS r
  ON r.role_code = e.role_code
JOIN Circulation_History AS ch
  ON ch.employee_id = e.employee_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.employee_name, r.role_description
ORDER BY nombre_circulations DESC, e.employee_id;"},{"question":"Pour chaque envoi postal, quel document a été envoyé, à quelle adresse et à quelle date ?","sql":"SELECT dm.document_id,
       a.address_id,
       a.address_details,
       dm.mailing_date
FROM Documents_Mailed AS dm
JOIN Addresses AS a
  ON a.address_id = dm.mailed_to_address_id
ORDER BY dm.mailing_date, dm.document_id;"},{"question":"Quels agents d’expédition sont associés à combien de documents, y compris ceux qui n’en ont encore aucun ?","sql":"SELECT sa.shipping_agent_code,
       sa.shipping_agent_name,
       COUNT(d.document_id) AS nombre_documents
FROM Ref_Shipping_Agents AS sa
LEFT JOIN Documents AS d
  ON d.shipping_agent_code = sa.shipping_agent_code
GROUP BY sa.shipping_agent_code, sa.shipping_agent_name
ORDER BY nombre_documents DESC, sa.shipping_agent_code;"},{"question":"Quels documents possèdent au moins deux brouillons ?","sql":"SELECT document_id,
       COUNT(*) AS nombre_brouillons
FROM Document_Drafts
GROUP BY document_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY document_id;"},{"question":"Quels employés ont fait circuler au moins une copie d’un document ?","sql":"SELECT e.employee_id,
       e.employee_name
FROM Employees AS e
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Circulation_History AS ch
    WHERE ch.employee_id = e.employee_id
)
ORDER BY e.employee_id;"},{"question":"Quels documents n’ont jamais été envoyés par courrier ?","sql":"SELECT document_id
FROM Documents
EXCEPT
SELECT document_id
FROM Documents_Mailed
ORDER BY document_id;"},{"question":"Combien de copies chaque brouillon possède-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT dc.document_id,
       dc.draft_number,
       COUNT(dc.copy_number) AS nombre_copies
FROM Draft_Copies AS dc
GROUP BY dc.document_id, dc.draft_number
ORDER BY dc.document_id, dc.draft_number;"},{"question":"Quelle est la répartition des documents par statut, avec le nombre de documents pour chaque statut ?","sql":"SELECT s.document_status_code,
       s.document_status_description,
       COUNT(d.document_id) AS nombre_documents
FROM Ref_Document_Status AS s
LEFT JOIN Documents AS d
  ON d.document_status_code = s.document_status_code
GROUP BY s.document_status_code, s.document_status_description
ORDER BY s.document_status_code;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les documents avec le nom de leur type ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, t.Document_Type_Name
FROM All_Documents AS d
JOIN Ref_Document_Types AS t ON t.Document_Type_Code = d.Document_Type_Code;"},{"question":"Quels documents ne sont associés à aucun emplacement ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name
FROM All_Documents AS d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Document_Locations AS l
    WHERE l.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
);"},{"question":"Combien de documents chaque emplacement a-t-il accueillis ?","sql":"SELECT l.Location_Code, r.Location_Name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.Document_ID) AS Nombre_de_documents
FROM Ref_Locations AS r
LEFT JOIN Document_Locations AS l ON l.Location_Code = r.Location_Code
GROUP BY l.Location_Code, r.Location_Name;"},{"question":"Quels documents se trouvent encore dans un emplacement, sans date de sortie ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, r.Location_Name
FROM All_Documents AS d
JOIN Document_Locations AS l ON l.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
JOIN Ref_Locations AS r ON r.Location_Code = l.Location_Code
WHERE l.Date_in_Locaton_To IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels documents doivent être détruits et qui a autorisé leur destruction ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, e.Employee_Name AS Autorisateur, x.Planned_Destruction_Date
FROM Documents_to_be_Destroyed AS x
JOIN All_Documents AS d ON d.Document_ID = x.Document_ID
LEFT JOIN Employees AS e ON e.Employee_ID = x.Destruction_Authorised_by_Employee_ID;"},{"question":"Quels documents avaient une destruction prévue avant le 1er janvier 2024 mais ne sont pas encore détruits ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, x.Planned_Destruction_Date
FROM Documents_to_be_Destroyed AS x
JOIN All_Documents AS d ON d.Document_ID = x.Document_ID
WHERE x.Planned_Destruction_Date < '2024-01-01'
  AND x.Actual_Destruction_Date IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien d'employés occupent chaque rôle ?","sql":"SELECT r.Role_Code, r.Role_Name, COUNT(e.Employee_ID) AS Nombre_d_employes
FROM Roles AS r
LEFT JOIN Employees AS e ON e.Role_Code = r.Role_Code
GROUP BY r.Role_Code, r.Role_Name;"},{"question":"Quels employés n'ont participé à aucune destruction de document ?","sql":"SELECT e.Employee_ID, e.Employee_Name
FROM Employees AS e
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Documents_to_be_Destroyed AS x
    WHERE x.Destruction_Authorised_by_Employee_ID = e.Employee_ID
       OR x.Destroyed_by_Employee_ID = e.Employee_ID
);"},{"question":"Combien de documents existe-t-il pour chaque type ?","sql":"SELECT t.Document_Type_Code, t.Document_Type_Name, COUNT(d.Document_ID) AS Nombre_de_documents
FROM Ref_Document_Types AS t
LEFT JOIN All_Documents AS d ON d.Document_Type_Code = t.Document_Type_Code
GROUP BY t.Document_Type_Code, t.Document_Type_Name;"},{"question":"Quels jours du calendrier correspondent à la date de stockage d'au moins un document ?","sql":"SELECT c.Calendar_Date, c.Day_Number, COUNT(d.Document_ID) AS Nombre_de_documents
FROM Ref_Calendar AS c
JOIN All_Documents AS d ON d.Date_Stored = c.Calendar_Date
GROUP BY c.Calendar_Date, c.Day_Number
ORDER BY c.Calendar_Date;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne de présence des documents dans chaque emplacement, en jours ?","sql":"SELECT r.Location_Code, r.Location_Name,
       AVG(julianday(l.Date_in_Locaton_To) - julianday(l.Date_in_Location_From)) AS Duree_moyenne_en_jours
FROM Ref_Locations AS r
JOIN Document_Locations AS l ON l.Location_Code = r.Location_Code
WHERE l.Date_in_Locaton_To IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.Location_Code, r.Location_Name;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont été enregistrés dans plusieurs emplacements différents ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.Location_Code) AS Nombre_d_emplacements
FROM All_Documents AS d
JOIN Document_Locations AS l ON l.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
GROUP BY d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.Location_Code) > 1;"},{"question":"Quels documents de type donné ont été placés dans un emplacement dont le nom contient « Archive » ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, t.Document_Type_Name, r.Location_Name
FROM All_Documents AS d
JOIN Ref_Document_Types AS t ON t.Document_Type_Code = d.Document_Type_Code
JOIN Document_Locations AS l ON l.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
JOIN Ref_Locations AS r ON r.Location_Code = l.Location_Code
WHERE r.Location_Name LIKE '%Archive%';"},{"question":"Quels documents ont déjà été détruits, avec le nom de l'employé qui les a détruits ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, x.Actual_Destruction_Date, e.Employee_Name AS Destructeur
FROM Documents_to_be_Destroyed AS x
JOIN All_Documents AS d ON d.Document_ID = x.Document_ID
JOIN Employees AS e ON e.Employee_ID = x.Destroyed_by_Employee_ID
WHERE x.Actual_Destruction_Date IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels rôles ne sont associés à aucun employé ?","sql":"SELECT r.Role_Code, r.Role_Name
FROM Roles AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Employees AS e
    WHERE e.Role_Code = r.Role_Code
);"},{"question":"Qui est l'employé le plus ancien selon sa date de naissance ?","sql":"SELECT Employee_ID, Employee_Name, Date_of_Birth
FROM Employees
WHERE Date_of_Birth = (SELECT MIN(Date_of_Birth) FROM Employees);"},{"question":"Quels types de documents contiennent plus de cinq documents ?","sql":"SELECT t.Document_Type_Code, t.Document_Type_Name, COUNT(d.Document_ID) AS Nombre_de_documents
FROM Ref_Document_Types AS t
JOIN All_Documents AS d ON d.Document_Type_Code = t.Document_Type_Code
GROUP BY t.Document_Type_Code, t.Document_Type_Name
HAVING COUNT(d.Document_ID) > 5;"},{"question":"Quels employés ont autorisé ou réalisé au moins une destruction ?","sql":"SELECT Employee_ID, Employee_Name
FROM Employees
WHERE Employee_ID IN (
    SELECT Destruction_Authorised_by_Employee_ID
    FROM Documents_to_be_Destroyed
    WHERE Destruction_Authorised_by_Employee_ID IS NOT NULL
)
UNION
SELECT Employee_ID, Employee_Name
FROM Employees
WHERE Employee_ID IN (
    SELECT Destroyed_by_Employee_ID
    FROM Documents_to_be_Destroyed
    WHERE Destroyed_by_Employee_ID IS NOT NULL
);"},{"question":"Quels documents ont été stockés le même jour que leur date prévue de destruction ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, d.Date_Stored
FROM All_Documents AS d
JOIN Documents_to_be_Destroyed AS x ON x.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
WHERE d.Date_Stored = x.Planned_Destruction_Date;"},{"question":"Quel est le dernier emplacement connu de chaque document ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, r.Location_Name, l.Date_in_Location_From
FROM All_Documents AS d
JOIN Document_Locations AS l ON l.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
JOIN Ref_Locations AS r ON r.Location_Code = l.Location_Code
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Document_Locations AS l2
    WHERE l2.Document_ID = l.Document_ID
      AND l2.Date_in_Location_From > l.Date_in_Location_From
);"},{"question":"Quels documents ont une description contenant le mot « contrat » ?","sql":"SELECT Document_ID, Document_Name, Document_Description
FROM All_Documents
WHERE Document_Description LIKE '%contrat%';"},{"question":"Combien d'employés de chaque sexe sont présents dans chaque rôle ?","sql":"SELECT r.Role_Name, e.Gender_MFU, COUNT(*) AS Nombre_d_employes
FROM Employees AS e
JOIN Roles AS r ON r.Role_Code = e.Role_Code
GROUP BY r.Role_Code, r.Role_Name, e.Gender_MFU;"},{"question":"Combien de documents sont actuellement présents dans chaque emplacement ?","sql":"SELECT r.Location_Code, r.Location_Name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.Document_ID) AS Nombre_de_documents_actuels
FROM Ref_Locations AS r
LEFT JOIN Document_Locations AS l
  ON l.Location_Code = r.Location_Code
 AND l.Date_in_Locaton_To IS NULL
GROUP BY r.Location_Code, r.Location_Name;"},{"question":"À quelles dates des documents ont-ils été effectivement détruits ?","sql":"SELECT c.Calendar_Date, COUNT(x.Document_ID) AS Nombre_de_documents_détruits
FROM Ref_Calendar AS c
JOIN Documents_to_be_Destroyed AS x ON x.Actual_Destruction_Date = c.Calendar_Date
GROUP BY c.Calendar_Date
ORDER BY c.Calendar_Date;"},{"question":"Quels documents appartiennent à un type dont le nombre de documents dépasse la moyenne par type ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, d.Document_Type_Code
FROM All_Documents AS d
WHERE d.Document_Type_Code IN (
    SELECT Document_Type_Code
    FROM All_Documents
    GROUP BY Document_Type_Code
    HAVING COUNT(*) > (
        SELECT AVG(Nombre)
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS Nombre
            FROM All_Documents
            GROUP BY Document_Type_Code
        )
    )
);"},{"question":"Quels employés ont à la fois autorisé et effectué au moins une destruction ?","sql":"SELECT e.Employee_ID, e.Employee_Name
FROM Employees AS e
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Documents_to_be_Destroyed AS x
    WHERE x.Destruction_Authorised_by_Employee_ID = e.Employee_ID
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Documents_to_be_Destroyed AS y
    WHERE y.Destroyed_by_Employee_ID = e.Employee_ID
);"},{"question":"Quels jours du calendrier ne correspondent à aucun stockage de document ?","sql":"SELECT c.Calendar_Date, c.Day_Number
FROM Ref_Calendar AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM All_Documents AS d
    WHERE d.Date_Stored = c.Calendar_Date
);"},{"question":"Quels documents sont dans un emplacement dont la description mentionne « sécurisé » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, r.Location_Name
FROM All_Documents AS d
JOIN Document_Locations AS l ON l.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
JOIN Ref_Locations AS r ON r.Location_Code = l.Location_Code
WHERE r.Location_Description LIKE '%sécurisé%';"},{"question":"Pour chaque type, quelle est la date de stockage la plus ancienne ?","sql":"SELECT t.Document_Type_Code, t.Document_Type_Name, MIN(d.Date_Stored) AS Premiere_date_de_stockage
FROM Ref_Document_Types AS t
JOIN All_Documents AS d ON d.Document_Type_Code = t.Document_Type_Code
GROUP BY t.Document_Type_Code, t.Document_Type_Name;"},{"question":"Quels emplacements ont accueilli des documents mais n'en accueillent actuellement aucun ?","sql":"SELECT r.Location_Code, r.Location_Name
FROM Ref_Locations AS r
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Document_Locations AS l
    WHERE l.Location_Code = r.Location_Code
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Document_Locations AS l
    WHERE l.Location_Code = r.Location_Code
      AND l.Date_in_Locaton_To IS NULL
);"},{"question":"Quels documents sont soit sans emplacement, soit marqués pour destruction ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name
FROM All_Documents AS d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Document_Locations AS l
    WHERE l.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
)
UNION
SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name
FROM All_Documents AS d
JOIN Documents_to_be_Destroyed AS x ON x.Document_ID = d.Document_ID;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les documents associés à chaque projet ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details
FROM Documents AS d
JOIN Projects AS p ON p.Project_ID = d.Project_ID
ORDER BY p.Project_ID, d.Document_ID;"},{"question":"Quels documents correspondent à chaque type de document ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, r.Document_Type_Code, r.Document_Type_Name
FROM Documents AS d
JOIN Ref_Document_Types AS r ON r.Document_Type_Code = d.Document_Type_Code
ORDER BY r.Document_Type_Name, d.Document_ID;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont une dépense et quel code budgétaire leur est associé ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, b.Budget_Type_Code, b.Budget_Type_Description
FROM Documents AS d
JOIN Documents_with_Expenses AS e ON e.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
JOIN Ref_Budget_Codes AS b ON b.Budget_Type_Code = e.Budget_Type_Code
ORDER BY d.Document_ID;"},{"question":"Quels comptes sont rattachés à quels relevés ?","sql":"SELECT a.Account_ID, a.Account_Details, s.Statement_ID, s.Statement_Details
FROM Accounts AS a
JOIN Statements AS s ON s.Statement_ID = a.Statement_ID
ORDER BY a.Account_ID;"},{"question":"Quels documents n'ont pas de date renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT Document_ID, Document_Name, Document_Type_Code
FROM Documents
WHERE Document_Date IS NULL
ORDER BY Document_ID;"},{"question":"Quels projets ne possèdent encore aucun document ?","sql":"SELECT p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details
FROM Projects AS p
LEFT JOIN Documents AS d ON d.Project_ID = p.Project_ID
WHERE d.Document_ID IS NULL
ORDER BY p.Project_ID;"},{"question":"Combien de documents chaque projet contient-il ?","sql":"SELECT p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details, COUNT(d.Document_ID) AS nombre_de_documents
FROM Projects AS p
LEFT JOIN Documents AS d ON d.Project_ID = p.Project_ID
GROUP BY p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details
ORDER BY nombre_de_documents DESC, p.Project_ID;"},{"question":"Combien de documents sont associés à chaque code budgétaire ?","sql":"SELECT b.Budget_Type_Code, b.Budget_Type_Description, COUNT(e.Document_ID) AS nombre_de_documents
FROM Ref_Budget_Codes AS b
LEFT JOIN Documents_with_Expenses AS e ON e.Budget_Type_Code = b.Budget_Type_Code
GROUP BY b.Budget_Type_Code, b.Budget_Type_Description
ORDER BY nombre_de_documents DESC, b.Budget_Type_Code;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total de documents ayant une dépense ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_documents_avec_depense
FROM Documents_with_Expenses;"},{"question":"Quelle est la date du document le plus récent ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(Document_Date) AS date_du_document_le_plus_recent
FROM Documents;"},{"question":"Quels documents avec dépenses appartiennent à chaque projet ?","sql":"SELECT p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details, d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, e.Budget_Type_Code
FROM Projects AS p
JOIN Documents AS d ON d.Project_ID = p.Project_ID
JOIN Documents_with_Expenses AS e ON e.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
ORDER BY p.Project_ID, d.Document_ID;"},{"question":"Quels documents n'ont aucune dépense associée ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, d.Project_ID
FROM Documents AS d
LEFT JOIN Documents_with_Expenses AS e ON e.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
WHERE e.Document_ID IS NULL
ORDER BY d.Document_ID;"},{"question":"Quels codes budgétaires ne sont utilisés par aucun document ?","sql":"SELECT b.Budget_Type_Code, b.Budget_Type_Description
FROM Ref_Budget_Codes AS b
LEFT JOIN Documents_with_Expenses AS e ON e.Budget_Type_Code = b.Budget_Type_Code
WHERE e.Document_ID IS NULL
ORDER BY b.Budget_Type_Code;"},{"question":"Combien de documents y a-t-il pour chaque type, y compris les types non utilisés ?","sql":"SELECT r.Document_Type_Code, r.Document_Type_Name, COUNT(d.Document_ID) AS nombre_de_documents
FROM Ref_Document_Types AS r
LEFT JOIN Documents AS d ON d.Document_Type_Code = r.Document_Type_Code
GROUP BY r.Document_Type_Code, r.Document_Type_Name
ORDER BY nombre_de_documents DESC, r.Document_Type_Code;"},{"question":"Quels projets contiennent au moins deux documents ?","sql":"SELECT p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details, COUNT(d.Document_ID) AS nombre_de_documents
FROM Projects AS p
JOIN Documents AS d ON d.Project_ID = p.Project_ID
GROUP BY p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details
HAVING COUNT(d.Document_ID) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_de_documents DESC, p.Project_ID;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont été créés pendant l'année 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT Document_ID, Document_Name, Document_Date
FROM Documents
WHERE Document_Date >= '2023-01-01'
  AND Document_Date < '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY Document_Date, Document_ID;"},{"question":"Quels projets sont associés à des documents du type dont le code est DOC-A ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details
FROM Projects AS p
JOIN Documents AS d ON d.Project_ID = p.Project_ID
WHERE d.Document_Type_Code = 'DOC-A'
ORDER BY p.Project_ID;"},{"question":"Quels projets ont à la fois des documents avec dépenses et des documents sans dépenses ?","sql":"SELECT p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details
FROM Projects AS p
JOIN Documents AS d ON d.Project_ID = p.Project_ID
LEFT JOIN Documents_with_Expenses AS e ON e.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
GROUP BY p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN e.Document_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN e.Document_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY p.Project_ID;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de documents sont à la fois dans les documents et dans les documents avec dépenses ?","sql":"SELECT Document_ID
FROM Documents
INTERSECT
SELECT Document_ID
FROM Documents_with_Expenses
ORDER BY Document_ID;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de documents existent dans Documents mais pas dans Documents_with_Expenses ?","sql":"SELECT Document_ID
FROM Documents
EXCEPT
SELECT Document_ID
FROM Documents_with_Expenses
ORDER BY Document_ID;"},{"question":"Quel projet possède le plus grand nombre de documents ?","sql":"SELECT p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details, COUNT(d.Document_ID) AS nombre_de_documents
FROM Projects AS p
JOIN Documents AS d ON d.Project_ID = p.Project_ID
GROUP BY p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details
HAVING COUNT(d.Document_ID) = (
    SELECT MAX(nombre_de_documents)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_documents
        FROM Documents
        GROUP BY Project_ID
    ) AS compteurs
)
ORDER BY p.Project_ID;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont la date la plus récente renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT Document_ID, Document_Name, Document_Date
FROM Documents
WHERE Document_Date = (
    SELECT MAX(Document_Date)
    FROM Documents
    WHERE Document_Date IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY Document_ID;"},{"question":"Combien de comptes chaque relevé possède-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT s.Statement_ID, s.Statement_Details, COUNT(a.Account_ID) AS nombre_de_comptes
FROM Statements AS s
LEFT JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.Statement_ID = s.Statement_ID
GROUP BY s.Statement_ID, s.Statement_Details
ORDER BY nombre_de_comptes DESC, s.Statement_ID;"},{"question":"Quels relevés ne possèdent aucun compte ?","sql":"SELECT s.Statement_ID, s.Statement_Details
FROM Statements AS s
LEFT JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.Statement_ID = s.Statement_ID
WHERE a.Account_ID IS NULL
ORDER BY s.Statement_ID;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont un nom de plus de 20 caractères ?","sql":"SELECT Document_ID, Document_Name, LENGTH(Document_Name) AS longueur_du_nom
FROM Documents
WHERE LENGTH(Document_Name) > 20
ORDER BY longueur_du_nom DESC, Document_ID;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont une description contenant le mot « facture » ?","sql":"SELECT Document_ID, Document_Name, Document_Description
FROM Documents
WHERE LOWER(Document_Description) LIKE '%facture%'
ORDER BY Document_ID;"},{"question":"Quels codes budgétaires sont classés par ordre alphabétique de leur description ?","sql":"SELECT Budget_Type_Code, Budget_Type_Description
FROM Ref_Budget_Codes
ORDER BY Budget_Type_Description, Budget_Type_Code;"},{"question":"Combien de documents ont été enregistrés pour chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', Document_Date) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_documents
FROM Documents
WHERE Document_Date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', Document_Date)
ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de documents par projet parmi les projets ayant au moins un document ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(nombre_de_documents) AS moyenne_de_documents_par_projet
FROM (
    SELECT Project_ID, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_documents
    FROM Documents
    GROUP BY Project_ID
) AS compteurs;"},{"question":"Quels comptes sont associés au relevé qui porte le même identifiant qu'un document ?","sql":"SELECT a.Account_ID, a.Account_Details, a.Statement_ID, d.Document_Name
FROM Accounts AS a
JOIN Statements AS s ON s.Statement_ID = a.Statement_ID
JOIN Documents AS d ON d.Document_ID = s.Statement_ID
ORDER BY a.Account_ID;"},{"question":"Quel type de document est le plus représenté ?","sql":"SELECT r.Document_Type_Code, r.Document_Type_Name, COUNT(d.Document_ID) AS nombre_de_documents
FROM Ref_Document_Types AS r
JOIN Documents AS d ON d.Document_Type_Code = r.Document_Type_Code
GROUP BY r.Document_Type_Code, r.Document_Type_Name
HAVING COUNT(d.Document_ID) = (
    SELECT MAX(nombre_de_documents)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_documents
        FROM Documents
        GROUP BY Document_Type_Code
    ) AS compteurs
)
ORDER BY r.Document_Type_Code;"},{"question":"Quels documents possèdent une dépense dont la description budgétaire contient le mot « personnel » ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, b.Budget_Type_Code, b.Budget_Type_Description
FROM Documents AS d
JOIN Documents_with_Expenses AS e ON e.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
JOIN Ref_Budget_Codes AS b ON b.Budget_Type_Code = e.Budget_Type_Code
WHERE LOWER(b.Budget_Type_Description) LIKE '%personnel%'
ORDER BY d.Document_ID;"},{"question":"Quels projets ont au moins un document daté et au moins un document non daté ?","sql":"SELECT p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details
FROM Projects AS p
JOIN Documents AS d ON d.Project_ID = p.Project_ID
GROUP BY p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.Document_Date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.Document_Date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY p.Project_ID;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont une dépense et affichent aussi les détails de cette dépense ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, e.Budget_Type_Code, e.Document_Details
FROM Documents AS d
JOIN Documents_with_Expenses AS e ON e.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
WHERE e.Document_Details IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.Document_ID;"},{"question":"Quels projets sont classés selon la date de leur premier document ?","sql":"SELECT p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details, MIN(d.Document_Date) AS date_du_premier_document
FROM Projects AS p
LEFT JOIN Documents AS d ON d.Project_ID = p.Project_ID
GROUP BY p.Project_ID, p.Project_Details
ORDER BY date_du_premier_document IS NULL, date_du_premier_document, p.Project_ID;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont le même type que le document nommé « Rapport final » ?","sql":"SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, d.Document_Type_Code
FROM Documents AS d
WHERE d.Document_Type_Code IN (
    SELECT Document_Type_Code
    FROM Documents
    WHERE Document_Name = 'Rapport final'
)
ORDER BY d.Document_ID;"}]}

réservation ?","sql":"SELECT g.Workshop_Group_ID, g.Store_Name FROM Drama_Workshop_Groups AS g LEFT JOIN Bookings AS b ON b.Workshop_Group_ID = g.Workshop_Group_ID WHERE b.Booking_ID IS visiteurs distincts ont fréquenté chaque attraction ?","sql":"SELECT ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID, ta.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT v.Tourist_ID) AS visiteurs_distincts FROM Tourist_Attractions AS ta LEFT JOIN Visits AS v ON v.Tourist_Attraction_ID = ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID GROUP BY ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID, ta.Name;"},{"question":"Quels visiteurs n'ont enregistré aucune visite ?","sql":"SELECT vi.Tourist_ID, vi.Tourist_Details FROM Visitors AS vi LEFT JOIN Visits AS v ON v.Tourist_ID = vi.Tourist_ID WHERE v.Visit_ID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles caractéristiques sont associées à chaque attraction ?","sql":"SELECT ta.Name AS attraction, f.Feature_Details AS caracteristique FROM Tourist_Attractions AS ta JOIN Tourist_Attraction_Features AS taf ON taf.Tourist_Attraction_ID = ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID JOIN Features AS f ON f.Feature_ID = taf.Feature_ID ORDER BY ta.Name, f.Feature_Details;"},{"question":"Quelles caractéristiques ne sont associées à aucune attraction ?","sql":"SELECT f.Feature_ID, f.Feature_Details FROM Features AS f LEFT JOIN Tourist_Attraction_Features AS taf ON taf.Feature_ID = f.Feature_ID WHERE taf.Tourist_Attraction_ID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles attractions possèdent au moins deux caractéristiques ?","sql":"SELECT ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID, ta.Name, COUNT(taf.Feature_ID) AS nombre_caracteristiques FROM Tourist_Attractions AS ta JOIN Tourist_Attraction_Features AS taf ON taf.Tourist_Attraction_ID = ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID GROUP BY ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID, ta.Name HAVING COUNT(taf.Feature_ID) >= la fois comme visiteurs et comme identifiants d'attractions ?","sql":"SELECT Tourist_ID AS identifiant FROM Visitors INTERSECT SELECT Tourist_Attraction_ID FROM Tourist_ID FROM Visitors;"},{"question":"Quels hôtels acceptent les animaux ?","sql":"SELECT hotel_id, star_rating_code, price_range FROM Hotels WHERE pets_allowed_yn = 'Y';"},{"question":"Quels hôtels ont leur description de classement étoilé ?","sql":"SELECT h.hotel_id, h.price_range, r.star_rating_description FROM Hotels AS h JOIN Ref_Hotel_Star_Ratings AS r ON r.star_rating_code = prix moyen de tous les hôtels ?","sql":"SELECT hotel_id, price_range FROM Hotels WHERE price_range > (SELECT AVG(price_range) FROM Hotels) ORDER BY price_range DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de photos sont disponibles pour chaque attraction ?","sql":"SELECT ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID, ta.Name, COUNT(p.Photo_ID) AS nombre_photos FROM Tourist_Attractions AS ta LEFT JOIN Photos AS p ON contenant le mot « bus » ?","sql":"SELECT Tourist_Attraction_ID, Name, How_to_Get_There FROM Tourist_Attractions WHERE How_to_Get_There LIKE '%bus%';"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de visites par attraction, avec une catégorie selon sa fréquentation ?","sql":"SELECT ta.Name, COUNT(v.Visit_ID) AS nombre_visites, CASE WHEN COUNT(v.Visit_ID) = 0 THEN 'Aucune visite' WHEN COUNT(v.Visit_ID) < 5 THEN 'Faible fréquentation' ELSE 'Forte fréquentation' END AS categorie FROM Tourist_Attractions AS ta LEFT JOIN Visits AS v ON v.Tourist_Attraction_ID = ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID GROUP BY ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID, ta.Name;"},{"question":"Quelles attractions ont reçu plus de visites que l'attraction moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID, ta.Name, COUNT(v.Visit_ID) AS nombre_visites FROM Tourist_Attractions AS ta LEFT JOIN Visits AS v ON v.Tourist_Attraction_ID = ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID GROUP BY ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID, ta.Name HAVING COUNT(v.Visit_ID) > (SELECT AVG(nombre_visites) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_visites FROM Visits GROUP BY Tourist_Attraction_ID));"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel travaillent dans chaque attraction ?","sql":"SELECT ta.Name AS attraction, s.Staff_ID, s.Name AS membre_du_personnel, s.Other_Details FROM Staff AS s JOIN Tourist_Attractions AS ta ON ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID = s.Tourist_Attraction_ID ORDER BY ta.Name, s.Name;"},{"question":"Quelles attractions sont liées à la famille royale ?","sql":"SELECT ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID, ta.Name, rf.Royal_Family_Details FROM Royal_Family AS rf JOIN Tourist_Attractions AS ta ON ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID = rf.Royal_Family_ID;"},{"question":"Quels musées sont enregistrés avec leur description ?","sql":"SELECT ta.Name, m.Museum_Details FROM Museums AS m JOIN Tourist_Attractions AS ta ON ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID = m.Museum_ID;"},{"question":"Quelles attractions sont soit des boutiques soit des marchés de rue ?","sql":"SELECT ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID, ta.Name, 'Boutique' AS categorie FROM Shops AS s JOIN Tourist_Attractions AS ta ON ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID = s.Shop_ID UNION SELECT ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID, ta.Name, 'Marché de rue' AS categorie FROM Street_Markets AS sm JOIN Tourist_Attractions AS ta ON ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID = sm.Market_ID;"},{"question":"Quels emplacements possèdent le plus grand nombre d'attractions ?","sql":"SELECT l.Location_ID, l.Location_Name, COUNT(ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID) AS nombre_attractions FROM Locations AS l JOIN Tourist_Attractions AS ta ON ta.Location_ID = l.Location_ID GROUP BY l.Location_ID, l.Location_Name HAVING COUNT(ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID) = (SELECT MAX(nombre_attractions) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_attractions FROM Tourist_Attractions GROUP BY Location_ID));"},{"question":"Quels détails de visite contiennent le mot « guidée » ?","sql":"SELECT Visit_ID, Tourist_ID, Tourist_Attraction_ID, Visit_Date, Visit_Details FROM Visits WHERE Visit_Details LIKE '%guidée%';"},{"question":"Quelles attractions ont au moins une photo et au moins une caractéristique ?","sql":"SELECT ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID, ta.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS ta WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Photos AS p WHERE p.Tourist_Attraction_ID = ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Tourist_Attraction_Features AS taf WHERE taf.Tourist_Attraction_ID = ta.Tourist_Attraction_ID);"},{"question":"Combien d'attractions chaque visiteur a-t-il visitées distinctement ?","sql":"SELECT vi.Tourist_ID, vi.Tourist_Details, COUNT(DISTINCT v.Tourist_Attraction_ID) AS attractions_visitees FROM Visitors AS vi LEFT JOIN Visits AS v ON v.Tourist_ID = vi.Tourist_ID GROUP BY vi.Tourist_ID, vi.Tourist_Details ORDER BY attractions_visitees DESC;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms, lieux et comtés de tous les campus ?","sql":"SELECT \"Campus\", \"Location\", \"County\" FROM \"Campuses\";"},{"question":"Quels campus ont été créés ou recensés après l’année 2000 ?","sql":"SELECT \"Campus\", \"Year\" FROM \"Campuses\" WHERE \"Year\" > 2000 ORDER BY \"Year\", \"Campus\";"},{"question":"Combien de campus se trouvent dans chaque comté ?","sql":"SELECT \"County\", COUNT(*) AS \"NombreCampus\" FROM \"Campuses\" GROUP BY \"County\" ORDER BY \"NombreCampus\" DESC, \"County\";"},{"question":"Quels campus ont des frais supérieurs à 5000 ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\", f.\"CampusFee\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"csu_fees\" AS f ON f.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" WHERE f.\"CampusFee\" > 5000 ORDER BY f.\"CampusFee\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant moyen des frais par campus ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(\"CampusFee\") AS \"FraisMoyens\" FROM \"csu_fees\";"},{"question":"Quels sont les campus dont les frais sont supérieurs à la moyenne de tous les campus ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\", f.\"CampusFee\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"csu_fees\" AS f ON f.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" WHERE f.\"CampusFee\" > (SELECT AVG(\"CampusFee\") FROM \"csu_fees\") ORDER BY f.\"CampusFee\" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de diplômes chaque campus a-t-il délivrés ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\", d.\"Degrees\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"degrees\" AS d ON d.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" ORDER BY d.\"Degrees\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont délivré plus de 1000 diplômes ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\", d.\"Year\", d.\"Degrees\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"degrees\" AS d ON d.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" WHERE d.\"Degrees\" > 1000 ORDER BY d.\"Degrees\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total de diplômes par année ?","sql":"SELECT \"Year\", SUM(\"Degrees\") AS \"TotalDiplomes\" FROM \"degrees\" GROUP BY \"Year\" ORDER BY \"Year\";"},{"question":"Quelle année a enregistré le plus grand nombre total de diplômes ?","sql":"SELECT \"Year\", SUM(\"Degrees\") AS \"TotalDiplomes\" FROM \"degrees\" GROUP BY \"Year\" ORDER BY \"TotalDiplomes\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont une population étudiante totale supérieure à 20000 ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\", e.\"Year\", e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"enrollments\" AS e ON e.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" WHERE e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\" > 20000 ORDER BY e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est l’inscription totale moyenne par année ?","sql":"SELECT \"Year\", AVG(\"TotalEnrollment_AY\") AS \"InscriptionMoyenne\" FROM \"enrollments\" GROUP BY \"Year\" ORDER BY \"Year\";"},{"question":"Quels campus ont une inscription totale supérieure à la moyenne de leur année ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Campus\", e.\"Year\", e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\" FROM \"enrollments\" AS e WHERE e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\" > (SELECT AVG(e2.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\") FROM \"enrollments\" AS e2 WHERE e2.\"Year\" = e.\"Year\") ORDER BY e.\"Year\", e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le total des équivalents temps plein par année ?","sql":"SELECT \"Year\", SUM(\"FTE_AY\") AS \"TotalFTE\" FROM \"enrollments\" GROUP BY \"Year\" ORDER BY \"Year\";"},{"question":"Quels campus ont plus d’étudiants que d’équivalents temps plein ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\", e.\"Year\", e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\", e.\"FTE_AY\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"enrollments\" AS e ON e.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" WHERE e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\" > e.\"FTE_AY\" ORDER BY c.\"Campus\";"},{"question":"Quels campus comptent des effectifs de premier cycle supérieurs aux effectifs diplômés ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\", de.\"Undergraduate\", de.\"Graduate\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"discipline_enrollments\" AS de ON de.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" WHERE de.\"Undergraduate\" > de.\"Graduate\" ORDER BY de.\"Undergraduate\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total d’étudiants de premier cycle par discipline ?","sql":"SELECT \"Discipline\", SUM(\"Undergraduate\") AS \"TotalPremierCycle\" FROM \"discipline_enrollments\" GROUP BY \"Discipline\" ORDER BY \"TotalPremierCycle\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle discipline possède le plus grand nombre total d’étudiants diplômés ?","sql":"SELECT \"Discipline\", SUM(\"Graduate\") AS \"TotalDiplomes\" FROM \"discipline_enrollments\" GROUP BY \"Discipline\" ORDER BY \"TotalDiplomes\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont au moins une discipline avec plus de 500 étudiants diplômés ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.\"Campus\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"discipline_enrollments\" AS de ON de.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" WHERE de.\"Graduate\" > 500 ORDER BY c.\"Campus\";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de membres du corps enseignant par campus ?","sql":"SELECT \"Campus\", AVG(\"Faculty\") AS \"MoyenneCorpsEnseignant\" FROM \"faculty\" GROUP BY \"Campus\" ORDER BY \"Campus\";"},{"question":"Quels campus ont plus de 100 membres du corps enseignant ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\", f.\"Year\", f.\"Faculty\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"faculty\" AS f ON f.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" WHERE f.\"Faculty\" > 100 ORDER BY f.\"Faculty\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle année compte le plus grand nombre total d’enseignants ?","sql":"SELECT \"Year\", SUM(\"Faculty\") AS \"TotalEnseignants\" FROM \"faculty\" GROUP BY \"Year\" ORDER BY \"TotalEnseignants\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels campus disposent à la fois de données d’inscription et de données de diplômes ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"enrollments\" AS e WHERE e.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\") AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"degrees\" AS d WHERE d.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\") ORDER BY c.\"Campus\";"},{"question":"Quels campus ont des frais mais aucune donnée de diplômes ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"csu_fees\" AS f ON f.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"degrees\" AS d WHERE d.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\") ORDER BY c.\"Campus\";"},{"question":"Quels campus apparaissent dans les inscriptions ou dans les données du corps enseignant ?","sql":"SELECT \"Campus\" FROM \"enrollments\" UNION SELECT \"Campus\" FROM \"faculty\" ORDER BY \"Campus\";"},{"question":"Quels campus apparaissent à la fois dans les inscriptions et dans les données du corps enseignant ?","sql":"SELECT \"Campus\" FROM \"enrollments\" INTERSECT SELECT \"Campus\" FROM \"faculty\" ORDER BY \"Campus\";"},{"question":"Quels campus possèdent des données d’inscription mais pas de données de frais ?","sql":"SELECT \"Campus\" FROM \"enrollments\" EXCEPT SELECT \"Campus\" FROM \"csu_fees\" ORDER BY \"Campus\";"},{"question":"Quel est le ratio entre l’inscription totale et le nombre d’enseignants pour chaque campus et année ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Campus\", e.\"Year\", e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\", f.\"Faculty\", e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\" * 1.0 / NULLIF(f.\"Faculty\", 0) AS \"EtudiantsParEnseignant\" FROM \"enrollments\" AS e JOIN \"faculty\" AS f ON f.\"Campus\" = e.\"Campus\" AND f.\"Year\" = e.\"Year\" ORDER BY \"EtudiantsParEnseignant\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont plus de diplômes que d’enseignants pour une même année ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"Campus\", d.\"Year\", d.\"Degrees\", f.\"Faculty\" FROM \"degrees\" AS d JOIN \"faculty\" AS f ON f.\"Campus\" = d.\"Campus\" AND f.\"Year\" = d.\"Year\" WHERE d.\"Degrees\" > f.\"Faculty\" ORDER BY d.\"Degrees\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont des frais supérieurs à 3000 et une inscription totale inférieure à 10000 ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\", f.\"CampusFee\", e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"csu_fees\" AS f ON f.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" JOIN \"enrollments\" AS e ON e.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" WHERE f.\"CampusFee\" > 3000 AND e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\" < 10000 ORDER BY c.\"Campus\";"},{"question":"Pour chaque comté, quelle est l’inscription totale cumulée de ses campus ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"County\", SUM(e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\") AS \"InscriptionTotale\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"enrollments\" AS e ON e.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" GROUP BY c.\"County\" ORDER BY \"InscriptionTotale\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel campus a le plus grand effectif total d’étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\", e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"enrollments\" AS e ON e.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" ORDER BY e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont une moyenne d’effectifs par discipline supérieure à 1000 étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\", AVG(de.\"Undergraduate\" + de.\"Graduate\") AS \"MoyenneParDiscipline\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"discipline_enrollments\" AS de ON de.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" GROUP BY c.\"Id\", c.\"Campus\" HAVING AVG(de.\"Undergraduate\" + de.\"Graduate\") > 1000 ORDER BY \"MoyenneParDiscipline\" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de disciplines distinctes sont recensées pour chaque campus ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\", COUNT(DISTINCT de.\"Discipline\") AS \"NombreDisciplines\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"discipline_enrollments\" AS de ON de.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" GROUP BY c.\"Id\", c.\"Campus\" ORDER BY \"NombreDisciplines\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont des frais exactement égaux au montant maximal des frais ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\", f.\"CampusFee\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"csu_fees\" AS f ON f.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" WHERE f.\"CampusFee\" = (SELECT MAX(\"CampusFee\") FROM \"csu_fees\") ORDER BY c.\"Campus\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la différence entre l’inscription totale et le nombre d’équivalents temps plein pour chaque campus ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Campus\", e.\"Year\", e.\"TotalEnrollment_AY\" - e.\"FTE_AY\" AS \"DifferenceEffectifs\" FROM \"Campuses\" AS c JOIN \"enrollments\" AS e ON e.\"Campus\" = c.\"Id\" ORDER BY \"DifferenceEffectifs\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels comtés comptent au moins deux campus ?","sql":"SELECT \"County\", COUNT(*) AS \"NombreCampus\" FROM \"Campuses\" GROUP BY \"County\" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY \"NombreCampus\" DESC, \"County\";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les titres des livres publiés après 2010, avec leur auteur ou éditeur ?","sql":"SELECT \"Book_Title\", \"Author_or_Editor\" FROM \"book_club\" WHERE \"Year\" > 2010 ORDER BY \"Year\", \"Book_Title\";"},{"question":"Quels films ont un budget supérieur à 100 millions ?","sql":"SELECT \"Title\", \"Budget_million\" FROM \"movie\" WHERE \"Budget_million\" > 100 ORDER BY \"Budget_million\" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien d'entreprises appartiennent à chaque type ?","sql":"SELECT \"Type\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_entreprises\" FROM \"culture_company\" GROUP BY \"Type\" ORDER BY \"nombre_entreprises\" DESC, \"Type\";"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises sont associées à un film, et quels sont les titres de ces films ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Company_name\", m.\"Title\" FROM \"culture_company\" AS c JOIN \"movie\" AS m ON c.\"movie_id\" = CAST(m.\"movie_id\" AS TEXT) ORDER BY c.\"Company_name\";"},{"question":"Quels livres sont liés à des entreprises, avec le nom de l'entreprise et la catégorie du livre ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Company_name\", b.\"Book_Title\", b.\"Category\" FROM \"culture_company\" AS c JOIN \"book_club\" AS b ON c.\"book_club_id\" = \"Director\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_films\", AVG(\"Gross_worldwide\") AS \"revenu_moyen\" FROM \"movie\" GROUP BY \"Director\" ORDER BY \"revenu_moyen\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films ont un budget supérieur au budget moyen de l'ensemble des films ?","sql":"SELECT \"Title\", \"Budget_million\" FROM \"movie\" WHERE \"Budget_million\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Budget_million\") FROM \"movie\") ORDER BY \"nombre_livres\" FROM \"book_club\" GROUP BY \"Result\" ORDER BY \"nombre_livres\" DESC, \"Result\";"},{"question":"Quels films sont sortis entre 2000 et 2010 inclusivement ?","sql":"SELECT \"Title\", \"Year\", \"Director\" FROM \"movie\" WHERE \"Year\" BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010 ORDER BY \"Year\", \"Title\";"},{"question":"Quel film a généré le revenu mondial le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT des livres de catégorie « Fiction » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.\"Company_name\" FROM \"culture_company\" AS c JOIN \"book_club\" AS b ON c.\"book_club_id\" = CAST(b.\"book_club_id\" AS TEXT) WHERE ORDER BY b.\"Year\";"},{"question":"Quelles sont les années d'incorporation distinctes des entreprises, classées par ordre croissant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"Incorporated_in\" FROM c.\"Company_name\", b.\"Book_Title\", m.\"Title\" FROM \"culture_company\" AS c JOIN \"book_club\" AS b ON c.\"book_club_id\" = CAST(b.\"book_club_id\" AS TEXT) JOIN \"movie\" AS m ON c.\"movie_id\" = ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"Director\" FROM \"movie\" AS m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"movie\" AS m2 WHERE m2.\"Director\" = m.\"Director\" AND m2.\"Gross_worldwide\" > (SELECT {"examples":[{"question":"Quelles sont les réclamations avec le nom du produit et le nom du client ?","sql":"SELECT c.complaint_id, p.product_name, cu.customer_id, cu.email_address, c.complaint_status_code, c.date_complaint_raised
FROM Complaints AS c
JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = c.product_id
JOIN Customers AS cu ON cu.customer_id = c.customer_id;"},{"question":"Combien de réclamations sont enregistrées pour chaque statut ?","sql":"SELECT complaint_status_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Complaints
GROUP BY complaint_status_code
ORDER BY nombre_reclamations DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles catégories de produits ont reçu le plus de réclamations ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_category_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Complaints AS c
JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = c.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_category_code
ORDER BY nombre_reclamations DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne de traitement des réclamations clôturées, en jours ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(julianday(date_complaint_closed) - julianday(date_complaint_raised)) AS duree_moyenne_jours
FROM Complaints
WHERE date_complaint_closed IS NOT NULL
  AND date_complaint_raised IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont déposé au moins trois réclamations ?","sql":"SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.email_address, COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Customers AS cu
JOIN Complaints AS c ON c.customer_id = cu.customer_id
GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.email_address
HAVING COUNT(c.complaint_id) >= 3
ORDER BY nombre_reclamations DESC;"},{"question":"Quels produits n'ont jamais fait l'objet d'une réclamation ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_category_code
FROM Products AS p
LEFT JOIN Complaints AS c ON c.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.complaint_id IS NULL
ORDER BY p.product_name;"},{"question":"Combien de réclamations chaque membre du personnel a-t-il traité ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Staff AS s
LEFT JOIN Complaints AS c ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
ORDER BY nombre_reclamations DESC, s.last_name;"},{"question":"Quelle est la réclamation la plus récente avec ses informations client et produit ?","sql":"SELECT c.complaint_id, c.date_complaint_raised, cu.email_address, p.product_name
FROM Complaints AS c
JOIN Customers AS cu ON cu.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = c.product_id
WHERE c.date_complaint_raised = (SELECT MAX(date_complaint_raised) FROM Complaints);"},{"question":"Quelle est la répartition des réclamations par code de résultat ?","sql":"SELECT complaint_outcome_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Complaints
GROUP BY complaint_outcome_code
ORDER BY nombre_reclamations DESC, complaint_outcome_code;"},{"question":"Combien de clients ayant déposé une réclamation résident dans chaque ville ?","sql":"SELECT cu.town_city, COUNT(DISTINCT cu.customer_id) AS nombre_clients
FROM Customers AS cu
JOIN Complaints AS c ON c.customer_id = cu.customer_id
GROUP BY cu.town_city
ORDER BY nombre_clients DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le prix moyen des produits par catégorie ?","sql":"SELECT product_category_code, AVG(product_price) AS prix_moyen
FROM Products
GROUP BY product_category_code
ORDER BY product_category_code;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un produit parent, avec le nom de ce parent ?","sql":"SELECT child.product_id, child.product_name AS produit, parent.product_id AS parent_id, parent.product_name AS produit_parent
FROM Products AS child
JOIN Products AS parent ON parent.product_id = child.parent_product_id
ORDER BY child.product_name;"},{"question":"Quels clients n'ont enregistré aucune réclamation ?","sql":"SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.email_address, cu.town_city
FROM Customers AS cu
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Complaints AS c
    WHERE c.customer_id = cu.customer_id
)
ORDER BY cu.customer_id;"},{"question":"Combien de réclamations ont été soumises chaque mois ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date_complaint_raised) AS mois, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Complaints
WHERE date_complaint_raised IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date_complaint_raised)
ORDER BY mois;"},{"question":"Quelles réclamations ont nécessité plus de trente jours avant leur clôture ?","sql":"SELECT complaint_id, date_complaint_raised, date_complaint_closed,
       julianday(date_complaint_closed) - julianday(date_complaint_raised) AS duree_jours
FROM Complaints
WHERE date_complaint_raised IS NOT NULL
  AND date_complaint_closed IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday(date_complaint_closed) - julianday(date_complaint_raised) > 30
ORDER BY duree_jours DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles catégories ont un prix moyen supérieur au prix moyen de tous les produits ?","sql":"SELECT product_category_code, AVG(product_price) AS prix_moyen_categorie
FROM Products
GROUP BY product_category_code
HAVING AVG(product_price) > (SELECT AVG(product_price) FROM Products)
ORDER BY prix_moyen_categorie DESC;"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel n'ont été associés à aucune réclamation ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
FROM Staff AS s
LEFT JOIN Complaints AS c ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id
WHERE c.complaint_id IS NULL
ORDER BY s.last_name, s.first_name;"},{"question":"Combien de réclamations existe-t-il pour chaque combinaison de type et de statut ?","sql":"SELECT complaint_type_code, complaint_status_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Complaints
GROUP BY complaint_type_code, complaint_status_code
ORDER BY complaint_type_code, complaint_status_code;"},{"question":"Quels clients utilisent une adresse électronique contenant le domaine gmail.com ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, email_address
FROM Customers
WHERE lower(email_address) LIKE '%@gmail.com'
ORDER BY customer_id;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont été discontinués après leur première disponibilité ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, date_product_first_available, date_product_discontinued
FROM Products
WHERE date_product_first_available IS NOT NULL
  AND date_product_discontinued IS NOT NULL
  AND date_product_discontinued > date_product_first_available
ORDER BY date_product_discontinued;"},{"question":"Quel client a déposé le plus grand nombre de réclamations ?","sql":"SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.email_address, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Customers AS cu
JOIN Complaints AS c ON c.customer_id = cu.customer_id
GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.email_address
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(nombre)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre
        FROM Complaints
        GROUP BY customer_id
    )
)
ORDER BY cu.customer_id;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont à la fois une réclamation et une adresse renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id
FROM Complaints
INTERSECT
SELECT customer_id
FROM Customers
WHERE address_line_1 IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles réclamations concernent un produit plus cher que le prix moyen de tous les produits ?","sql":"SELECT c.complaint_id, p.product_name, p.product_price, c.complaint_status_code
FROM Complaints AS c
JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = c.product_id
WHERE p.product_price > (SELECT AVG(product_price) FROM Products)
ORDER BY p.product_price DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles adresses électroniques de clients apparaissent plusieurs fois ?","sql":"SELECT email_address, COUNT(*) AS nombre_clients
FROM Customers
WHERE email_address IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY email_address
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY nombre_clients DESC, email_address;"},{"question":"Combien de réclamations ouvertes sont attribuées à chaque membre du personnel ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS reclamations_ouvertes
FROM Staff AS s
LEFT JOIN Complaints AS c
  ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id
 AND upper(c.complaint_status_code) = 'OPEN'
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
ORDER BY reclamations_ouvertes DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque réclamation clôturée, quelles sont les dates de début et de fin ainsi que sa durée en jours ?","sql":"SELECT complaint_id, date_complaint_raised, date_complaint_closed,
       ROUND(julianday(date_complaint_closed) - julianday(date_complaint_raised), 2) AS duree_jours
FROM Complaints
WHERE date_complaint_closed IS NOT NULL
  AND date_complaint_raised IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY date_complaint_raised;"},{"question":"Quels produits et leurs produits parents appartiennent à la même catégorie ?","sql":"SELECT child.product_id, child.product_name, parent.product_id AS parent_product_id, parent.product_name AS parent_name
FROM Products AS child
JOIN Products AS parent ON parent.product_id = child.parent_product_id
WHERE child.product_category_code = parent.product_category_code
ORDER BY child.product_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de réclamations par État des clients ?","sql":"SELECT cu.state, COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Customers AS cu
JOIN Complaints AS c ON c.customer_id = cu.customer_id
GROUP BY cu.state
ORDER BY nombre_reclamations DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de réclamations ont été déposées chaque jour de la semaine ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%w', date_complaint_raised) AS jour_semaine, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Complaints
WHERE date_complaint_raised IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%w', date_complaint_raised)
ORDER BY jour_semaine;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont utilisé au moins deux types de réclamation différents ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT complaint_type_code) AS nombre_types
FROM Complaints
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT complaint_type_code) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_types DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de réclamations par membre du personnel ayant traité au moins une réclamation ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(nombre_reclamations) AS moyenne_reclamations_par_membre
FROM (
    SELECT staff_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reclamations
    FROM Complaints
    GROUP BY staff_id
) AS statistiques;"},{"question":"Quelles réclamations ont été déposées après la date de première disponibilité du produit concerné ?","sql":"SELECT c.complaint_id, c.date_complaint_raised, p.product_name, p.date_product_first_available
FROM Complaints AS c
JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = c.product_id
WHERE c.date_complaint_raised IS NOT NULL
  AND p.date_product_first_available IS NOT NULL
  AND c.date_complaint_raised >= p.date_product_first_available
ORDER BY c.date_complaint_raised;"},{"question":"Quels sont les différents codes de résultat utilisés, classés par ordre alphabétique ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT complaint_outcome_code
FROM Complaints
ORDER BY complaint_outcome_code;"},{"question":"Quels clients n'ont aucune réclamation encore ouverte ?","sql":"SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.email_address
FROM Customers AS cu
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Complaints AS c
    WHERE c.customer_id = cu.customer_id
      AND upper(c.complaint_status_code) = 'OPEN'
)
ORDER BY cu.customer_id;"},{"question":"Quelles catégories de produits ont plus de réclamations que la moyenne des catégories ?","sql":"WITH reclamations_par_categorie AS (
    SELECT p.product_category_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reclamations
    FROM Complaints AS c
    JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = c.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_category_code
)
SELECT product_category_code, nombre_reclamations
FROM reclamations_par_categorie
WHERE nombre_reclamations > (SELECT AVG(nombre_reclamations) FROM reclamations_par_categorie)
ORDER BY nombre_reclamations DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles réclamations ont été déposées au cours des trente derniers jours de la période observée ?","sql":"SELECT complaint_id, date_complaint_raised, complaint_status_code
FROM Complaints
WHERE date_complaint_raised >= datetime((SELECT MAX(date_complaint_raised) FROM Complaints), '-30 days')
ORDER BY date_complaint_raised DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles réclamations sont encore ouvertes et ont une date de dépôt renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT complaint_id, customer_id, product_id, date_complaint_raised
FROM Complaints
WHERE upper(complaint_status_code) = 'OPEN'
  AND date_complaint_raised IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY date_complaint_raised;"},{"question":"Combien de produits appartiennent à chaque tranche de prix ?","sql":"SELECT CASE
           WHEN product_price IS NULL THEN 'Prix inconnu'
           WHEN product_price < 50 THEN 'Moins de 50'
           WHEN product_price < 200 THEN 'De 50 à moins de 200'
           ELSE '200 ou plus'
       END AS tranche_prix,
       COUNT(*) AS nombre_produits
FROM Products
GROUP BY tranche_prix
ORDER BY tranche_prix;"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel ont traité au moins une réclamation, avec leur nom complet ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS nom_complet,
       COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Staff AS s
JOIN Complaints AS c ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
ORDER BY s.last_name, s.first_name;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont reçu des réclamations provenant de clients de plusieurs États différents ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cu.state) AS nombre_etats
FROM Products AS p
JOIN Complaints AS c ON c.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Customers AS cu ON cu.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cu.state) > 1
ORDER BY nombre_etats DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de clients et la moyenne de réclamations par type de client ?","sql":"SELECT cu.customer_type_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cu.customer_id) AS nombre_clients,
       COUNT(c.complaint_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT cu.customer_id), 0) AS moyenne_reclamations_par_client
FROM Customers AS cu
LEFT JOIN Complaints AS c ON c.customer_id = cu.customer_id
GROUP BY cu.customer_type_code
ORDER BY cu.customer_type_code;"},{"question":"Quelles réclamations ont été clôturées le même jour que leur dépôt ?","sql":"SELECT complaint_id, date_complaint_raised, date_complaint_closed
FROM Complaints
WHERE date_complaint_raised IS NOT NULL
  AND date_complaint_closed IS NOT NULL
  AND date(date_complaint_raised) = date(date_complaint_closed)
ORDER BY date_complaint_raised;"}]}
