{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et adresses e-mail des clients vivant en France ?","sql":"SELECT customer_first_name, customer_last_name, email_address
FROM Customers
WHERE country = 'France';"},{"question":"Quels comptes sont associés à chaque client, avec leur date d'ouverture ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, a.account_name, a.date_account_opened
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY c.customer_last_name, a.date_account_opened;"},{"question":"Combien de commandes chaque client a-t-il passées, y compris ceux qui n'en ont passé aucune ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS nombre_commandes
FROM Customers AS c
LEFT JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
ORDER BY nombre_commandes DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles factures ont été émises en 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT invoice_number, order_id, invoice_date
FROM Invoices
WHERE invoice_date >= '2023-01-01'
  AND invoice_date < '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY invoice_date;"},{"question":"Quel est le coût total calculé pour chaque ligne de facture ?","sql":"SELECT invoice_number, order_item_id, product_title, derived_total_cost
FROM Invoice_Line_Items
ORDER BY invoice_number, order_item_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le prix unitaire moyen des produits par catégorie ?","sql":"SELECT pc.production_type_code, pc.product_type_description, AVG(p.unit_price) AS prix_unitaire_moyen
FROM Product_Categories AS pc
LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code
GROUP BY pc.production_type_code, pc.product_type_description;"},{"question":"Quels produits n'apparaissent dans aucune ligne de facture ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM Products AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    WHERE ili.product_id = p.product_id
)
ORDER BY p.product_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des transactions pour chaque type de transaction ?","sql":"SELECT transaction_type, SUM(transaction_amount) AS montant_total
FROM Financial_Transactions
GROUP BY transaction_type
ORDER BY montant_total DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles transactions sont liées à une facture et à un client ?","sql":"SELECT ft.transaction_id, ft.transaction_date, ft.transaction_amount, ft.invoice_number,
       c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft
JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ft.invoice_number
JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
ORDER BY ft.transaction_date;"},{"question":"Quels clients possèdent plus d'un compte ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, COUNT(a.account_id) AS nombre_comptes
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
HAVING COUNT(a.account_id) > 1;"},{"question":"Quelles commandes ne possèdent aucune facture ?","sql":"SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.date_order_placed
FROM Orders AS o
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Invoices AS i
    WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id
)
ORDER BY o.date_order_placed;"},{"question":"Quels sont les dix produits apparaissant le plus souvent dans les articles commandés ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS nombre_articles
FROM Products AS p
JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY nombre_articles DESC, p.product_name
LIMIT 10;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des lignes de chaque facture ?","sql":"SELECT i.invoice_number, i.invoice_date,
       COALESCE(SUM(ili.derived_total_cost), 0) AS total_facture
FROM Invoices AS i
LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
GROUP BY i.invoice_number, i.invoice_date
ORDER BY i.invoice_date;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont dépensé plus de 1000 selon leurs transactions ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name,
       SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_transactions
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
HAVING SUM(ft.transaction_amount) > 1000
ORDER BY total_transactions DESC;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un nom identique à celui d'au moins un autre produit ?","sql":"SELECT product_name, COUNT(*) AS nombre_produits
FROM Products
WHERE product_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY product_name;"},{"question":"Combien de comptes ont été ouverts chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', date_account_opened) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_comptes
FROM Accounts
WHERE date_account_opened IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', date_account_opened)
ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Combien de produits contient chaque catégorie ?","sql":"SELECT pc.production_type_code, pc.product_type_description,
       COUNT(p.product_id) AS nombre_produits
FROM Product_Categories AS pc
LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code
GROUP BY pc.production_type_code, pc.product_type_description
ORDER BY nombre_produits DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles commandes ont été passées par des clients résidant au Canada ?","sql":"SELECT o.order_id, o.date_order_placed, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
FROM Orders AS o
JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.country = 'Canada'
ORDER BY o.date_order_placed;"},{"question":"Quelles lignes de facture indiquent une quantité supérieure à 5 ?","sql":"SELECT invoice_number, order_item_id, product_title, product_quantity
FROM Invoice_Line_Items
WHERE CAST(product_quantity AS INTEGER) > 5
ORDER BY invoice_number, order_item_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total de TVA par facture ?","sql":"SELECT invoice_number, SUM(derived_vat_payable) AS total_tva
FROM Invoice_Line_Items
GROUP BY invoice_number
ORDER BY total_tva DESC;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont passé au moins une commande mais ne possèdent aucun compte ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
FROM Customers AS c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Accounts AS a WHERE a.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
ORDER BY c.customer_last_name;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un prix unitaire supérieur au prix moyen de tous les produits ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, unit_price
FROM Products
WHERE unit_price > (SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM Products)
ORDER BY unit_price DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la transaction la plus élevée de chaque compte ?","sql":"SELECT ft.account_id, ft.transaction_id, ft.transaction_amount, ft.transaction_date
FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft
WHERE ft.transaction_amount = (
    SELECT MAX(ft2.transaction_amount)
    FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft2
    WHERE ft2.account_id = ft.account_id
)
ORDER BY ft.account_id;"},{"question":"Quels pays sont représentés par les clients, sans doublons ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT country
FROM Customers
WHERE country IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY country;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen d'articles par commande ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(nombre_articles) AS moyenne_articles_par_commande
FROM (
    SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS nombre_articles
    FROM Orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id
) AS commandes;"},{"question":"Pour chaque facture, quel est le total des transactions qui lui sont associées ?","sql":"SELECT i.invoice_number,
       COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS total_transactions
FROM Invoices AS i
LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
GROUP BY i.invoice_number
ORDER BY i.invoice_number;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un produit parent ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name,
       parent.product_id AS parent_id, parent.product_name AS parent_name
FROM Products AS p
JOIN Products AS parent ON parent.product_id = p.parent_product_id
ORDER BY p.product_name;"},{"question":"Quels clients n'ont pas renseigné d'adresse e-mail ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, customer_first_name, customer_last_name
FROM Customers
WHERE email_address IS NULL OR TRIM(email_address) = ''
ORDER BY customer_last_name, customer_first_name;"},{"question":"Quelle catégorie possède le taux de TVA le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT production_type_code, product_type_description, vat_rating
FROM Product_Categories
WHERE vat_rating = (SELECT MAX(vat_rating) FROM Product_Categories);"},{"question":"Combien de transactions ont un commentaire renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_transactions_commentees
FROM Financial_Transactions
WHERE transaction_comment IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(transaction_comment) <> '';"},{"question":"Combien de produits distincts sont associés à chaque commande ?","sql":"SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS nombre_produits_distincts
FROM Orders AS o
LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_id
ORDER BY nombre_produits_distincts DESC, o.order_id;"},{"question":"Combien de factures ont été émises chaque mois ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date) AS mois, COUNT(*) AS nombre_factures
FROM Invoices
WHERE invoice_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date)
ORDER BY mois;"},{"question":"Quelles villes comptent au moins deux clients ?","sql":"SELECT town_city, COUNT(*) AS nombre_clients
FROM Customers
WHERE town_city IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY town_city
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_clients DESC, town_city;"},{"question":"Quels comptes n'ont enregistré aucune transaction ?","sql":"SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, a.customer_id
FROM Accounts AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft
    WHERE ft.account_id = a.account_id
)
ORDER BY a.account_id;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants apparaissent à la fois parmi les commandes et les factures ?","sql":"SELECT order_id AS identifiant, 'commande' AS origine
FROM Orders
UNION
SELECT order_id AS identifiant, 'facture' AS origine
FROM Invoices
ORDER BY identifiant, origine;"},{"question":"Combien de produits existe-t-il pour chaque taille ?","sql":"SELECT product_size, COUNT(*) AS nombre_produits
FROM Products
WHERE product_size IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product_size
ORDER BY nombre_produits DESC, product_size;"},{"question":"Quelle est la ligne la plus coûteuse de chaque facture ?","sql":"SELECT ili.invoice_number, ili.order_item_id, ili.product_title, ili.derived_total_cost
FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
WHERE ili.derived_total_cost = (
    SELECT MAX(ili2.derived_total_cost)
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili2
    WHERE ili2.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number
)
ORDER BY ili.invoice_number;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels produits sont plus chers que le prix moyen de tous les produits ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, product_price
FROM Products
WHERE product_price > (SELECT AVG(product_price) FROM Products)
ORDER BY product_price DESC;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont passé au moins deux commandes ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(co.order_id) AS nombre_commandes
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Customer_Orders AS co ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
HAVING COUNT(co.order_id) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_commandes DESC, c.customer_name;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les adresses actuelles des clients, avec leur nom et leur ville ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, a.line_1_number_building, a.city, a.zip_postcode, a.country
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Customer_Address_History AS cah ON cah.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Addresses AS a ON a.address_id = cah.address_id
WHERE cah.date_to IS NULL
ORDER BY c.customer_name;"},{"question":"Combien de contacts de genre F sont associés à chaque client qui en possède au moins un ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(ct.contact_id) AS nombre_de_contacts
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Contacts AS ct ON ct.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE ct.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY nombre_de_contacts DESC, c.customer_name;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les quantités totales commandées pour chaque produit ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS quantite_totale
FROM Products AS p
JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY quantite_totale DESC, p.product_name;"},{"question":"Quels clients n'ont encore passé aucune commande ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_email
FROM Customers AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Customer_Orders AS co
    WHERE co.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
ORDER BY c.customer_name;"},{"question":"Quelles commandes contiennent au moins deux produits distincts ?","sql":"SELECT co.order_id, co.customer_id, co.order_date, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS nombre_de_produits
FROM Customer_Orders AS co
JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
GROUP BY co.order_id, co.customer_id, co.order_date
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) >= 2
ORDER BY co.order_date DESC;"},{"question":"Quels clients apparaissent soit dans les contacts, soit dans les commandes, avec leur identifiant et leur nom ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Contacts AS ct ON ct.customer_id = c.customer_id
UNION
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Customer_Orders AS co ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY customer_name;"},{"question":"Combien d'adresses historiques distinctes chaque client a-t-il eues ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cah.address_id) AS nombre_adresses
FROM Customers AS c
LEFT JOIN Customer_Address_History AS cah ON cah.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY nombre_adresses DESC, c.customer_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le prix moyen des produits pour chaque type de produit ?","sql":"SELECT product_type_code, AVG(product_price) AS prix_moyen
FROM Products
GROUP BY product_type_code
ORDER BY prix_moyen DESC;"},{"question":"Quel produit a été commandé en plus grande quantité totale ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS quantite_totale
FROM Products AS p
JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY quantite_totale DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Combien de clients utilisent chaque mode de paiement ?","sql":"SELECT payment_method_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_clients
FROM Customers
GROUP BY payment_method_code
ORDER BY nombre_de_clients DESC, payment_method_code;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels clients ont passé au moins une commande, et combien de commandes chacun a-t-il passées ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS nombre_commandes
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Customer_Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY nombre_commandes DESC, c.customer_id;"},{"question":"Pour chaque campagne d’envoi, combien de clients distincts ont été ciblés ?","sql":"SELECT mc.mailshot_id, mc.mailshot_name, COUNT(DISTINCT mcu.customer_id) AS nombre_clients
FROM Mailshot_Campaigns AS mc
LEFT JOIN Mailshot_Customers AS mcu ON mcu.mailshot_id = mc.mailshot_id
GROUP BY mc.mailshot_id, mc.mailshot_name
ORDER BY mc.mailshot_id;"},{"question":"Quels produits n’ont jamais été inclus dans une commande ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_category
FROM Products AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Order_Items AS oi
    WHERE oi.product_id = p.product_id
)
ORDER BY p.product_id;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les adresses actuelles des clients, avec le type et les détails du lieu correspondant ?","sql":"SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.premise_id, p.premises_type, p.premise_details, ca.address_type_code
FROM Customer_Addresses AS ca
JOIN Premises AS p ON p.premise_id = ca.premise_id
WHERE ca.date_address_to IS NULL
ORDER BY ca.customer_id, ca.premise_id;"},{"question":"Quelle est la quantité moyenne commandée pour chaque catégorie de produit ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_category, AVG(CAST(oi.item_order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS quantite_moyenne
FROM Products AS p
JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_category
ORDER BY p.product_category;"},{"question":"Quelles commandes ont été livrées plus de sept jours après leur passage ?","sql":"SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_placed_datetime, order_delivered_datetime,
       CAST(julianday(order_delivered_datetime) - julianday(order_placed_datetime) AS INTEGER) AS delai_jours
FROM Customer_Orders
WHERE order_delivered_datetime IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday(order_delivered_datetime) - julianday(order_placed_datetime) > 7
ORDER BY delai_jours DESC, order_id;"},{"question":"Pour chaque campagne, combien de clients ont répondu selon chaque code de résultat ?","sql":"SELECT mc.mailshot_id, mc.mailshot_name, mcu.outcome_code,
       COUNT(*) AS nombre_clients
FROM Mailshot_Campaigns AS mc
JOIN Mailshot_Customers AS mcu ON mcu.mailshot_id = mc.mailshot_id
GROUP BY mc.mailshot_id, mc.mailshot_name, mcu.outcome_code
ORDER BY mc.mailshot_id, mcu.outcome_code;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont été contactés dans au moins une campagne mais n’ont passé aucune commande ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_email
FROM Customers AS c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Mailshot_Customers AS mcu
    WHERE mcu.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Customer_Orders AS o
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
ORDER BY c.customer_id;"},{"question":"Quelles catégories de produits sont présentes à la fois dans le catalogue et dans les campagnes d’envoi ?","sql":"SELECT product_category
FROM Products
INTERSECT
SELECT product_category
FROM Mailshot_Campaigns
WHERE product_category IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY product_category;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels débats ont attiré un nombre de spectateurs supérieur à la moyenne de tous les débats, avec leur lieu et leur date ?","sql":"SELECT Debate_ID, Date, Venue, Num_of_Audience
FROM debate
WHERE Num_of_Audience > (
    SELECT AVG(Num_of_Audience)
    FROM debate
)
ORDER BY Num_of_Audience DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de débats chaque personne a-t-elle disputés, en incluant celles qui n'ont participé à aucun débat ?","sql":"SELECT p.People_ID, p.Name, COUNT(dp.Debate_ID) AS Nombre_de_debats
FROM people AS p
LEFT JOIN debate_people AS dp
    ON p.People_ID = dp.Affirmative
    OR p.People_ID = dp.Negative
GROUP BY p.People_ID, p.Name
ORDER BY Nombre_de_debats DESC, p.Name;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont participé au moins une fois comme affirmative et au moins une fois comme négative ?","sql":"SELECT p.People_ID, p.Name, p.Party
FROM people AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM debate_people AS dp1
    WHERE dp1.Affirmative = p.People_ID
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM debate_people AS dp2
    WHERE dp2.Negative = p.People_ID
)
ORDER BY p.Name;"},{"question":"Pour chaque débat remporté par l'affirmative, quels sont la date, le lieu, le nom de l'affirmative et le nom de la négative ?","sql":"SELECT d.Debate_ID, d.Date, d.Venue,
       pa.Name AS Nom_affirmative,
       pn.Name AS Nom_negative
FROM debate AS d
JOIN debate_people AS dp
    ON d.Debate_ID = dp.Debate_ID
JOIN people AS pa
    ON dp.Affirmative = pa.People_ID
JOIN people AS pn
    ON dp.Negative = pn.People_ID
WHERE dp.If_Affirmative_Win = 1
ORDER BY d.Date, d.Debate_ID;"},{"question":"Quels lieux ont accueilli au moins deux débats, avec le nombre de débats et leur audience moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT Venue,
       COUNT(*) AS Nombre_debats,
       AVG(Num_of_Audience) AS Audience_moyenne
FROM debate
GROUP BY Venue
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY Nombre_debats DESC, Venue;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes n'ont participé à aucun débat, ni comme affirmative ni comme négative ?","sql":"SELECT p.People_ID, p.Name, p.District, p.Party
FROM people AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM debate_people AS dp
    WHERE dp.Affirmative = p.People_ID
       OR dp.Negative = p.People_ID
)
ORDER BY p.Name;"},{"question":"Quels débats ont soit une audience supérieure à la moyenne, soit été remportés par l'affirmative ?","sql":"SELECT d.Debate_ID, d.Date, d.Venue
FROM debate AS d
WHERE d.Num_of_Audience > (
    SELECT AVG(Num_of_Audience)
    FROM debate
)
UNION
SELECT d.Debate_ID, d.Date, d.Venue
FROM debate AS d
JOIN debate_people AS dp
    ON d.Debate_ID = dp.Debate_ID
WHERE dp.If_Affirmative_Win = 1
ORDER BY Date, Debate_ID;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels départements ont un budget supérieur au budget moyen de tous les départements ?","sql":"SELECT "Department_ID", "Name", "Budget_in_Billions"
FROM "department"
WHERE "Budget_in_Billions" > (
    SELECT AVG("Budget_in_Billions")
    FROM "department"
)
ORDER BY "Budget_in_Billions" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque département, combien de responsables lui sont associés, y compris ceux qui n’en ont aucun ?","sql":"SELECT d."Department_ID", d."Name", COUNT(m."head_ID") AS "Nombre_de_responsables"
FROM "department" AS d
LEFT JOIN "management" AS m
    ON m."department_ID" = d."Department_ID"
GROUP BY d."Department_ID", d."Name"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_responsables" DESC, d."Name";"},{"question":"Quels responsables dirigent des départements dont le classement est inférieur ou égal à 10 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT h."head_ID", h."name"
FROM "head" AS h
JOIN "management" AS m
    ON m."head_ID" = h."head_ID"
JOIN "department" AS d
    ON d."Department_ID" = m."department_ID"
WHERE d."Ranking" <= 10
ORDER BY h."name";"},{"question":"Quels sont les départements ayant le plus grand nombre d’employés ?","sql":"SELECT "Department_ID", "Name", "Num_Employees"
FROM "department"
WHERE "Num_Employees" = (
    SELECT MAX("Num_Employees")
    FROM "department"
);"},{"question":"Quels responsables sont associés à au moins deux départements ?","sql":"SELECT h."head_ID", h."name", COUNT(DISTINCT m."department_ID") AS "Nombre_de_departements"
FROM "head" AS h
JOIN "management" AS m
    ON m."head_ID" = h."head_ID"
GROUP BY h."head_ID", h."name"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m."department_ID") >= 2
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_departements" DESC, h."name";"},{"question":"Quels départements n’ont encore aucun responsable associé ?","sql":"SELECT d."Department_ID", d."Name"
FROM "department" AS d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "management" AS m
    WHERE m."department_ID" = d."Department_ID"
)
ORDER BY d."Name";"},{"question":"Quels départements ont à la fois un budget supérieur à la moyenne et un nombre d’employés supérieur à la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT "Department_ID", "Name"
FROM "department"
WHERE "Department_ID" IN (
    SELECT "Department_ID"
    FROM "department"
    WHERE "Budget_in_Billions" > (SELECT AVG("Budget_in_Billions") FROM "department")
)
INTERSECT
SELECT "Department_ID", "Name"
FROM "department"
WHERE "Department_ID" IN (
    SELECT "Department_ID"
    FROM "department"
    WHERE "Num_Employees" > (SELECT AVG("Num_Employees") FROM "department")
);"}]}

customer_id, order_date FROM Customer_Orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01';"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un prix compris entre 20 et 50 ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, product_price FROM Products WHERE product_price BETWEEN 20 AND 50;"},{"question":"Quels noms de clients commencent par A ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM Customers WHERE customer_name LIKE 'A%';"},{"question":"Quels produits contiennent le mot « shirt » dans leur nom ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name FROM Products WHERE product_name LIKE '%shirt%';"},{"question":"Quels magasins sont classés par nom ?","sql":"SELECT dept_store_id, store_name FROM Department_Stores ORDER BY store_name;"},{"question":"Quelles commandes sont classées de la plus récente à la plus ancienne ?","sql":"SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date FROM Customer_Orders ORDER BY order_date DESC;"},{"question":"Quels codes de statut de commande sont distincts ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT order_status_code FROM Customer_Orders;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont à la fois une commande et une adresse ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM Customers WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM Customer_Orders) AND customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM Customer_Addresses);"},{"question":"Quels fournisseurs sont aussi associés à une adresse dont la fin est inconnue ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name FROM Suppliers s JOIN Supplier_Addresses sa ON sa.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE sa.date_to IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels produits sont soit commandés, soit fournis par un fournisseur ?","sql":"SELECT product_id FROM Order_Items UNION SELECT product_id FROM Product_Suppliers;"},{"question":"Quels produits sont à la fois commandés et fournis par un fournisseur ?","sql":"SELECT product_id FROM Order_Items INTERSECT SELECT product_id FROM Product_Suppliers;"},{"question":"Quels produits sont fournis mais jamais commandés ?","sql":"SELECT product_id FROM Product_Suppliers EXCEPT SELECT product_id FROM Order_Items;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont des commandes dont le statut est « shipped » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.customer_name FROM Customers c JOIN Customer_Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status_code = 'shipped';"},{"question":"Combien d'adresses chaque client possède-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(ca.address_id) AS nombre_adresses FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Customer_Addresses ca ON ca.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name;"},{"question":"Combien d'adresses chaque fournisseur possède-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, COUNT(sa.address_id) AS nombre_adresses FROM Suppliers s LEFT JOIN Supplier_Addresses sa ON sa.supplier_id = s.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name;"},{"question":"Combien d'employés chaque département compte-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT d.department_id, d.department_name, COUNT(a.staff_id) AS nombre_employes FROM Departments d LEFT JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments a ON a.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant acheté moyen par relation produit-fournisseur ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(total_value_purchased) AS valeur_moyenne_achetee FROM Product_Suppliers;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont une valeur d'achat fournisseur supérieure à la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, supplier_id, total_value_purchased FROM Product_Suppliers WHERE total_value_purchased > (SELECT AVG(total_value_purchased) FROM Product_Suppliers);"},{"question":"Quels clients ont passé une commande à la date la plus récente ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.customer_name FROM Customers c JOIN Customer_Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date = (SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM Customer_Orders);"},{"question":"Quelle est la dernière date de commande pour chaque client ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, MAX(order_date) AS derniere_commande FROM Customer_Orders GROUP BY customer_id;"},{"question":"Quels magasins n'appartiennent à aucune chaîne ?","sql":"SELECT dept_store_id, store_name FROM Department_Stores WHERE dept_store_chain_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles chaînes n'ont aucun magasin ?","sql":"SELECT c.dept_store_chain_id, c.dept_store_chain_name FROM Department_Store_Chain c LEFT JOIN Department_Stores s ON s.dept_store_chain_id = c.dept_store_chain_id WHERE s.dept_store_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels noms de produits sont classés par ordre alphabétique ?","sql":"SELECT product_name FROM Products WHERE product_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY product_name COLLATE NOCASE;"},{"question":"Combien de relations d'approvisionnement sont encore actives ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_approvisionnements_actifs FROM Product_Suppliers WHERE date_supplied_to IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien d'affectations de personnel sont terminées ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_affectations_terminees FROM Staff_Department_Assignments WHERE date_assigned_to IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont une adresse qui correspond à leur adresse textuelle personnelle ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.customer_name FROM Customers c JOIN Customer_Addresses ca ON ca.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN Addresses a ON a.address_id = ca.address_id WHERE a.address_details = c.customer_address;"},{"question":"Quels fournisseurs fournissent plusieurs produits dont le prix moyen est supérieur à 100 ?","sql":"SELECT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, AVG(p.product_price) AS prix_moyen FROM Suppliers s JOIN Product_Suppliers ps ON ps.supplier_id = s.supplier_id JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ps.product_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name HAVING COUNT(p.product_id) > 1 AND AVG(p.product_price) > 100;"},{"question":"Quels départements sont situés dans un magasin dont le nom est renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT d.department_id, d.department_name, s.store_name FROM Departments d JOIN Department_Stores s ON s.dept_store_id = d.dept_store_id WHERE s.store_name IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels employés ont été affectés après 2022 ?","sql":"SELECT staff_id, department_id, date_assigned_from FROM Staff_Department_Assignments WHERE date_assigned_from >= '2023-01-01';"},{"question":"Combien de clients utilisent chaque domaine d'adresse électronique ?","sql":"SELECT SUBSTR(customer_email, INSTR(customer_email, '@') + 1) AS domaine, COUNT(*) AS nombre_clients FROM Customers WHERE customer_email IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(customer_email, '@') > 0 GROUP BY domaine;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont au moins un fournisseur mais aucun article commandé ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM Products p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Product_Suppliers ps WHERE ps.product_id = p.product_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Order_Items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.product_id);"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les appareils associés à chaque opérateur et plateforme logicielle ?","sql":"SELECT "Device", "Carrier", "Software_Platform"
FROM "device"
ORDER BY "Carrier", "Device";"},{"question":"Quelles boutiques ont ouvert à partir de 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT "Shop_Name", "Location", "Open_Date"
FROM "shop"
WHERE "Open_Year" >= 2020
ORDER BY "Open_Year", "Shop_Name";"},{"question":"Quels appareils sont actuellement en stock dans chaque boutique, avec leur quantité ?","sql":"SELECT s."Shop_Name", d."Device", st."Quantity"
FROM "stock" AS st
JOIN "shop" AS s ON s."Shop_ID" = st."Shop_ID"
JOIN "device" AS d ON d."Device_ID" = st."Device_ID"
WHERE st."Quantity" > 0
ORDER BY s."Shop_Name", d."Device";"},{"question":"Combien d'unités sont disponibles dans chaque boutique, y compris celles sans stock ?","sql":"SELECT s."Shop_Name", COALESCE(SUM(st."Quantity"), 0) AS "Total_Units"
FROM "shop" AS s
LEFT JOIN "stock" AS st ON st."Shop_ID" = s."Shop_ID"
GROUP BY s."Shop_ID", s."Shop_Name"
ORDER BY "Total_Units" DESC, s."Shop_Name";"},{"question":"Quelle est la quantité totale disponible pour chaque appareil ?","sql":"SELECT d."Device", COALESCE(SUM(st."Quantity"), 0) AS "Total_Quantity"
FROM "device" AS d
LEFT JOIN "stock" AS st ON st."Device_ID" = d."Device_ID"
GROUP BY d."Device_ID", d."Device"
ORDER BY "Total_Quantity" DESC, d."Device";"},{"question":"Quelles boutiques ne possèdent aucun appareil en stock ?","sql":"SELECT s."Shop_Name", s."Location"
FROM "shop" AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "stock" AS st
    WHERE st."Shop_ID" = s."Shop_ID" AND st."Quantity" > 0
)
ORDER BY s."Shop_Name";"},{"question":"Quels appareils ne sont présents dans aucune boutique ?","sql":"SELECT d."Device", d."Carrier"
FROM "device" AS d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "stock" AS st
    WHERE st."Device_ID" = d."Device_ID" AND st."Quantity" > 0
)
ORDER BY d."Device";"},{"question":"Quelle est la quantité moyenne d'unités par ligne de stock pour chaque boutique ?","sql":"SELECT s."Shop_Name", ROUND(AVG(st."Quantity"), 2) AS "Average_Quantity"
FROM "shop" AS s
JOIN "stock" AS st ON st."Shop_ID" = s."Shop_ID"
GROUP BY s."Shop_ID", s."Shop_Name"
ORDER BY "Average_Quantity" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels opérateurs proposent au moins deux appareils différents ?","sql":"SELECT "Carrier", COUNT(*) AS "Device_Count"
FROM "device"
GROUP BY "Carrier"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY "Device_Count" DESC, "Carrier";"},{"question":"Quels appareils sont disponibles dans plusieurs boutiques ?","sql":"SELECT d."Device", COUNT(DISTINCT st."Shop_ID") AS "Shop_Count"
FROM "device" AS d
JOIN "stock" AS st ON st."Device_ID" = d."Device_ID"
WHERE st."Quantity" > 0
GROUP BY d."Device_ID", d."Device"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT st."Shop_ID") > 1
ORDER BY "Shop_Count" DESC, d."Device";"},{"question":"Quelles boutiques ont un stock total supérieur à la moyenne des stocks totaux des boutiques ?","sql":"SELECT s."Shop_Name", SUM(st."Quantity") AS "Total_Quantity"
FROM "shop" AS s
JOIN "stock" AS st ON st."Shop_ID" = s."Shop_ID"
GROUP BY s."Shop_ID", s."Shop_Name"
HAVING SUM(st."Quantity") > (
    SELECT AVG("Total_Quantity")
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM("Quantity") AS "Total_Quantity"
        FROM "stock"
        GROUP BY "Shop_ID"
    )
)
ORDER BY "Total_Quantity" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les appareils dont la quantité disponible est supérieure à la quantité moyenne de leur propre appareil ?","sql":"SELECT s."Shop_Name", d."Device", st."Quantity"
FROM "stock" AS st
JOIN "shop" AS s ON s."Shop_ID" = st."Shop_ID"
JOIN "device" AS d ON d."Device_ID" = st."Device_ID"
WHERE st."Quantity" > (
    SELECT AVG(st2."Quantity")
    FROM "stock" AS st2
    WHERE st2."Device_ID" = st."Device_ID"
)
ORDER BY d."Device", st."Quantity" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles boutiques ont ouvert avant 2018 et disposent d'au moins un appareil en stock ?","sql":"SELECT s."Shop_Name", s."Open_Year"
FROM "shop" AS s
WHERE s."Open_Year" < 2018
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM "stock" AS st
      WHERE st."Shop_ID" = s."Shop_ID" AND st."Quantity" > 0
  )
ORDER BY s."Open_Year", s."Shop_Name";"},{"question":"Quels appareils ont une version de logiciel renseignée et sont stockés dans au moins une boutique ?","sql":"SELECT d."Device", d."Package_Version"
FROM "device" AS d
WHERE d."Package_Version" IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM "stock" AS st
      WHERE st."Device_ID" = d."Device_ID" AND st."Quantity" > 0
  )
ORDER BY d."Device";"},{"question":"Quelles lignes de stock contiennent au plus cinq unités ?","sql":"SELECT s."Shop_Name", d."Device", st."Quantity"
FROM "stock" AS st
JOIN "shop" AS s ON s."Shop_ID" = st."Shop_ID"
JOIN "device" AS d ON d."Device_ID" = st."Device_ID"
WHERE st."Quantity" <= 5
ORDER BY st."Quantity", s."Shop_Name", d."Device";"},{"question":"Quels noms de boutiques correspondent soit à une ouverture avant 2019, soit à une boutique ayant du stock ?","sql":"SELECT "Shop_Name"
FROM "shop"
WHERE "Open_Year" < 2019
UNION
SELECT s."Shop_Name"
FROM "shop" AS s
JOIN "stock" AS st ON st."Shop_ID" = s."Shop_ID"
WHERE st."Quantity" > 0
ORDER BY "Shop_Name";"},{"question":"Combien d'appareils distincts sont stockés par plateforme logicielle ?","sql":"SELECT d."Software_Platform", COUNT(DISTINCT d."Device_ID") AS "Device_Count"
FROM "device" AS d
JOIN "stock" AS st ON st."Device_ID" = d."Device_ID"
WHERE st."Quantity" > 0
GROUP BY d."Software_Platform"
ORDER BY "Device_Count" DESC, d."Software_Platform";"},{"question":"Quels appareils ont une liste d'applications contenant le terme « mail » ?","sql":"SELECT "Device", "Applications"
FROM "device"
WHERE LOWER("Applications") LIKE '%mail%'
ORDER BY "Device";"},{"question":"Pour chaque boutique, quel est l'appareil ayant la plus grande quantité en stock ?","sql":"SELECT s."Shop_Name", d."Device", st."Quantity"
FROM "stock" AS st
JOIN "shop" AS s ON s."Shop_ID" = st."Shop_ID"
JOIN "device" AS d ON d."Device_ID" = st."Device_ID"
WHERE st."Quantity" = (
    SELECT MAX(st2."Quantity")
    FROM "stock" AS st2
    WHERE st2."Shop_ID" = st."Shop_ID"
)
ORDER BY s."Shop_Name", d."Device";"},{"question":"Quelles boutiques proposent tous les appareils du catalogue ?","sql":"SELECT s."Shop_Name"
FROM "shop" AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "device" AS d
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "stock" AS st
        WHERE st."Shop_ID" = s."Shop_ID"
          AND st."Device_ID" = d."Device_ID"
          AND st."Quantity" > 0
    )
)
ORDER BY s."Shop_Name";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et les codes de tous les documents, triés par nom ?","sql":"SELECT document_code, document_name
FROM Documents
ORDER BY document_name, document_code;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont un nombre d'accès supérieur à 100 ?","sql":"SELECT document_code, document_name, access_count
FROM Documents
WHERE access_count > 100
ORDER BY access_count DESC;"},{"question":"Quels documents appartiennent à chaque structure documentaire ?","sql":"SELECT d.document_code, d.document_name, s.document_structure_description
FROM Documents AS d
JOIN Document_Structures AS s
  ON s.document_structure_code = d.document_structure_code
ORDER BY s.document_structure_description, d.document_name;"},{"question":"Quelles structures documentaires possèdent une structure parente, et quel est le nom de cette parente ?","sql":"SELECT child.document_structure_code,
       child.document_structure_description,
       parent.document_structure_description AS parent_description
FROM Document_Structures AS child
JOIN Document_Structures AS parent
  ON parent.document_structure_code = child.parent_document_structure_code
ORDER BY child.document_structure_description;"},{"question":"Combien de documents sont associés à chaque structure documentaire ?","sql":"SELECT s.document_structure_code,
       s.document_structure_description,
       COUNT(d.document_code) AS nombre_documents
FROM Document_Structures AS s
LEFT JOIN Documents AS d
  ON d.document_structure_code = s.document_structure_code
GROUP BY s.document_structure_code, s.document_structure_description
ORDER BY nombre_documents DESC, s.document_structure_code;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen d'accès des documents ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(access_count) AS moyenne_acces
FROM Documents;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont reçu plus d'accès que la moyenne de tous les documents ?","sql":"SELECT document_code, document_name, access_count
FROM Documents
WHERE access_count > (SELECT AVG(access_count) FROM Documents)
ORDER BY access_count DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les documents ayant le plus grand nombre d'accès ?","sql":"SELECT document_code, document_name, access_count
FROM Documents
WHERE access_count = (SELECT MAX(access_count) FROM Documents);"},{"question":"Combien de sections chaque document contient-il, y compris ceux qui n'en ont aucune ?","sql":"SELECT d.document_code,
       d.document_name,
       COUNT(ds.section_id) AS nombre_sections
FROM Documents AS d
LEFT JOIN Document_Sections AS ds
  ON ds.document_code = d.document_code
GROUP BY d.document_code, d.document_name
ORDER BY nombre_sections DESC, d.document_code;"},{"question":"Quelles sections sont associées à des images ?","sql":"SELECT ds.section_id,
       ds.document_code,
       ds.section_title,
       i.image_id,
       i.image_name
FROM Document_Sections AS ds
JOIN Document_Sections_Images AS dsi
  ON dsi.section_id = ds.section_id
JOIN Images AS i
  ON i.image_id = dsi.image_id
ORDER BY ds.document_code, ds.section_sequence, i.image_id;"},{"question":"Quelles images ne sont associées à aucune section ?","sql":"SELECT i.image_id, i.image_name, i.image_alt_text
FROM Images AS i
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Document_Sections_Images AS dsi
    WHERE dsi.image_id = i.image_id
)
ORDER BY i.image_id;"},{"question":"Combien d'images chaque section utilise-t-elle ?","sql":"SELECT ds.section_id,
       ds.document_code,
       ds.section_title,
       COUNT(dsi.image_id) AS nombre_images
FROM Document_Sections AS ds
LEFT JOIN Document_Sections_Images AS dsi
  ON dsi.section_id = ds.section_id
GROUP BY ds.section_id, ds.document_code, ds.section_title
ORDER BY nombre_images DESC, ds.section_id;"},{"question":"Quelles sections n'utilisent aucune image ?","sql":"SELECT ds.section_id, ds.document_code, ds.section_title
FROM Document_Sections AS ds
LEFT JOIN Document_Sections_Images AS dsi
  ON dsi.section_id = ds.section_id
WHERE dsi.image_id IS NULL
ORDER BY ds.document_code, ds.section_sequence;"},{"question":"Quels domaines fonctionnels sont associés à chaque document ?","sql":"SELECT d.document_code,
       d.document_name,
       fa.functional_area_code,
       fa.functional_area_description
FROM Documents AS d
JOIN Document_Functional_Areas AS dfa
  ON dfa.document_code = d.document_code
JOIN Functional_Areas AS fa
  ON fa.functional_area_code = dfa.functional_area_code
ORDER BY d.document_code, fa.functional_area_description;"},{"question":"Combien de documents sont associés à chaque domaine fonctionnel ?","sql":"SELECT fa.functional_area_code,
       fa.functional_area_description,
       COUNT(dfa.document_code) AS nombre_documents
FROM Functional_Areas AS fa
LEFT JOIN Document_Functional_Areas AS dfa
  ON dfa.functional_area_code = fa.functional_area_code
GROUP BY fa.functional_area_code, fa.functional_area_description
ORDER BY nombre_documents DESC, fa.functional_area_code;"},{"question":"Quels documents ne sont rattachés à aucun domaine fonctionnel ?","sql":"SELECT d.document_code, d.document_name
FROM Documents AS d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Document_Functional_Areas AS dfa
    WHERE dfa.document_code = d.document_code
)
ORDER BY d.document_code;"},{"question":"Quels domaines fonctionnels ne sont associés à aucun document ?","sql":"SELECT fa.functional_area_code, fa.functional_area_description
FROM Functional_Areas AS fa
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Document_Functional_Areas AS dfa
    WHERE dfa.functional_area_code = fa.functional_area_code
)
ORDER BY fa.functional_area_code;"},{"question":"Quels domaines fonctionnels ont un domaine parent, et quelle est sa description ?","sql":"SELECT child.functional_area_code,
       child.functional_area_description,
       parent.functional_area_description AS parent_description
FROM Functional_Areas AS child
JOIN Functional_Areas AS parent
  ON parent.functional_area_code = child.parent_functional_area_code
ORDER BY child.functional_area_description;"},{"question":"Combien de domaines fonctionnels dépendent de chaque domaine parent ?","sql":"SELECT parent.functional_area_code,
       parent.functional_area_description,
       COUNT(child.functional_area_code) AS nombre_enfants
FROM Functional_Areas AS parent
LEFT JOIN Functional_Areas AS child
  ON child.parent_functional_area_code = parent.functional_area_code
GROUP BY parent.functional_area_code, parent.functional_area_description
ORDER BY nombre_enfants DESC, parent.functional_area_code;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs et quels rôles leur sont attribués ?","sql":"SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.user_login, r.role_code, r.role_description
FROM Users AS u
JOIN Roles AS r
  ON r.role_code = u.role_code
ORDER BY u.user_name, u.user_id;"},{"question":"Combien d'utilisateurs possède chaque rôle ?","sql":"SELECT r.role_code,
       r.role_description,
       COUNT(u.user_id) AS nombre_utilisateurs
FROM Roles AS r
LEFT JOIN Users AS u
  ON u.role_code = r.role_code
GROUP BY r.role_code, r.role_description
ORDER BY nombre_utilisateurs DESC, r.role_code;"},{"question":"Quels rôles ne sont attribués à aucun utilisateur ?","sql":"SELECT r.role_code, r.role_description
FROM Roles AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Users AS u
    WHERE u.role_code = r.role_code
)
ORDER BY r.role_code;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs ont un nom commençant par la lettre A ?","sql":"SELECT user_id, user_name, user_login
FROM Users
WHERE user_name LIKE 'A%'
ORDER BY user_name, user_id;"},{"question":"Quelles sections d'un document donné sont classées par ordre de séquence ?","sql":"SELECT section_id, document_code, section_sequence, section_code, section_title
FROM Document_Sections
WHERE document_code = 'DOC001'
ORDER BY section_sequence, section_id;"},{"question":"Quels titres de sections contiennent le mot « sécurité » ?","sql":"SELECT section_id, document_code, section_title
FROM Document_Sections
WHERE section_title LIKE '%sécurité%'
ORDER BY document_code, section_sequence;"},{"question":"Quels documents possèdent au moins cinq sections ?","sql":"SELECT d.document_code, d.document_name
FROM Documents AS d
WHERE (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM Document_Sections AS ds
    WHERE ds.document_code = d.document_code
) >= 5
ORDER BY d.document_code;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total d'associations entre documents et domaines fonctionnels ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_associations
FROM Document_Functional_Areas;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total d'images utilisées dans les sections ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_associations_images
FROM Document_Sections_Images;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont à la fois au moins une section et au moins un domaine fonctionnel ?","sql":"SELECT d.document_code, d.document_name
FROM Documents AS d
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Document_Sections AS ds
    WHERE ds.document_code = d.document_code
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Document_Functional_Areas AS dfa
    WHERE dfa.document_code = d.document_code
)
ORDER BY d.document_code;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont une section mais aucun domaine fonctionnel ?","sql":"SELECT d.document_code, d.document_name
FROM Documents AS d
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Document_Sections AS ds
    WHERE ds.document_code = d.document_code
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Document_Functional_Areas AS dfa
    WHERE dfa.document_code = d.document_code
)
ORDER BY d.document_code;"},{"question":"Quels codes apparaissent à la fois comme code de structure documentaire et comme code de domaine fonctionnel ?","sql":"SELECT document_structure_code AS code
FROM Document_Structures
INTERSECT
SELECT functional_area_code AS code
FROM Functional_Areas
ORDER BY code;"},{"question":"Quels codes de rôles ne correspondent à aucun code de structure documentaire ?","sql":"SELECT role_code AS code
FROM Roles
EXCEPT
SELECT document_structure_code AS code
FROM Document_Structures
ORDER BY code;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont un nom renseigné et un nombre d'accès non nul ?","sql":"SELECT document_code, document_name, access_count
FROM Documents
WHERE document_name IS NOT NULL
  AND access_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY access_count DESC, document_name;"},{"question":"Quelle est la somme des accès par structure documentaire ?","sql":"SELECT s.document_structure_code,
       s.document_structure_description,
       COALESCE(SUM(d.access_count), 0) AS total_acces
FROM Document_Structures AS s
LEFT JOIN Documents AS d
  ON d.document_structure_code = s.document_structure_code
GROUP BY s.document_structure_code, s.document_structure_description
ORDER BY total_acces DESC, s.document_structure_code;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les sections dont la séquence est supérieure à la séquence moyenne de leur document ?","sql":"SELECT ds.section_id,
       ds.document_code,
       ds.section_title,
       ds.section_sequence
FROM Document_Sections AS ds
WHERE ds.section_sequence > (
    SELECT AVG(ds2.section_sequence)
    FROM Document_Sections AS ds2
    WHERE ds2.document_code = ds.document_code
)
ORDER BY ds.document_code, ds.section_sequence;"},{"question":"Quels documents utilisent une image dont le texte alternatif est renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.document_code, d.document_name
FROM Documents AS d
JOIN Document_Sections AS ds
  ON ds.document_code = d.document_code
JOIN Document_Sections_Images AS dsi
  ON dsi.section_id = ds.section_id
JOIN Images AS i
  ON i.image_id = dsi.image_id
WHERE i.image_alt_text IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.document_code;"},{"question":"Quelle est la répartition des documents selon leur nombre d'accès : moins de 10, de 10 à 99, ou au moins 100 ?","sql":"SELECT CASE
           WHEN access_count < 10 THEN 'Moins de 10'
           WHEN access_count < 100 THEN 'De 10 à 99'
           ELSE '100 ou plus'
       END AS tranche_acces,
       COUNT(*) AS nombre_documents
FROM Documents
GROUP BY CASE
             WHEN access_count < 10 THEN 'Moins de 10'
             WHEN access_count < 100 THEN 'De 10 à 99'
             ELSE '100 ou plus'
         END
ORDER BY CASE tranche_acces
             WHEN 'Moins de 10' THEN 1
             WHEN 'De 10 à 99' THEN 2
             ELSE 3
         END;"}]}

a.city ORDER BY nombre_clients DESC, a.city;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un montant restant dû supérieur à zéro ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, amount_outstanding FROM Customers WHERE amount_outstanding > 0 ORDER BY amount_outstanding DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des paiements enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_payment), 0) AS montant_total_paiements FROM Customer_Payments;"},{"question":"Combien de paiements ont été effectués avec chaque moyen de paiement ?","sql":"SELECT payment_method_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_paiements FROM Customer_Payments GROUP BY payment_method_code ORDER BY nombre_paiements DESC;"},{"question":"Quels clients n'ont encore effectué aucun paiement ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM Customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Customer_Payments p WHERE p.customer_id = c.customer_id) ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le total payé par chaque client, y compris ceux qui n'ont rien payé ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_payment), 0) AS total_paye FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Customer_Payments p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_paye DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles leçons sont associées à chaque client et à quel véhicule ?","sql":"SELECT l.lesson_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, l.lesson_date, l.lesson_time, v.vehicle_details FROM Lessons l JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id JOIN Vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id = l.vehicle_id ORDER BY l.lesson_date, l.lesson_time;"},{"question":"Combien de leçons chaque membre du personnel a-t-il encadrées, y compris ceux qui n'en ont encadré aucune ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(l.lesson_id) AS nombre_lecons FROM Staff s LEFT JOIN Lessons l ON l.staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name ORDER BY nombre_lecons DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le prix moyen des leçons pour chaque statut de leçon ?","sql":"SELECT lesson_status_code, AVG(price) AS prix_moyen FROM Lessons GROUP BY lesson_status_code ORDER BY lesson_status_code;"},{"question":"Pour chaque client, quelle est la date de sa dernière leçon ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, MAX(l.lesson_date) AS derniere_lecon FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Lessons l ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY derniere_lecon DESC;"},{"question":"Quels véhicules n'ont jamais été utilisés pour une leçon ?","sql":"SELECT v.vehicle_id, v.vehicle_details FROM Vehicles v WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Lessons l WHERE l.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id) ORDER BY v.vehicle_id;"},{"question":"Combien de leçons ont été données avec chaque véhicule ?","sql":"SELECT v.vehicle_id, v.vehicle_details, COUNT(l.lesson_id) AS nombre_lecons FROM Vehicles v LEFT JOIN Lessons l ON l.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id GROUP BY v.vehicle_id, v.vehicle_details ORDER BY nombre_lecons DESC;"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel résident dans chaque ville ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, a.city, a.country FROM Staff s JOIN Addresses a ON a.address_id = s.staff_address_id ORDER BY a.city, s.last_name, s.first_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de clients par code de statut ?","sql":"SELECT customer_status_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_clients FROM Customers GROUP BY customer_status_code ORDER BY nombre_clients DESC, customer_status_code;"},{"question":"Quels clients sont nés après le 1er janvier 2000 ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, date_of_birth FROM Customers WHERE date_of_birth > '2000-01-01' ORDER BY date_of_birth;"},{"question":"Quel montant a été payé chaque mois ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', datetime_payment) AS mois, SUM(amount_payment) AS total_paye FROM Customer_Payments GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', datetime_payment) ORDER BY mois;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont au moins une leçon mais aucun paiement ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM Customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Lessons l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Customer_Payments p WHERE p.customer_id = c.customer_id) ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les villes présentes à la fois parmi les adresses des clients et celles du personnel ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.city FROM Addresses a JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_address_id = a.address_id INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT a2.city FROM Addresses a2 JOIN Staff s ON s.staff_address_id = a2.address_id ORDER BY city;"},{"question":"Quels véhicules sont utilisés dans des leçons, mais lesquels n'apparaissent jamais dans la table des leçons ?","sql":"SELECT vehicle_id FROM Vehicles EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id FROM Lessons ORDER BY vehicle_id;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont effectué plus d'un paiement ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(p.datetime_payment) AS nombre_paiements FROM Customers c JOIN Customer_Payments p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(p.datetime_payment) > 1 ORDER BY nombre_paiements DESC;"},{"question":"Quel client a payé le montant total le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount_payment) AS total_paye FROM Customers c JOIN Customer_Payments p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_paye DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Combien de leçons sont planifiées à chaque date ?","sql":"SELECT date(lesson_date) AS date_lecon, COUNT(*) AS nombre_lecons FROM Lessons WHERE lesson_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY date(lesson_date) ORDER BY date_lecon;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant restant dû moyen par statut de client ?","sql":"SELECT customer_status_code, AVG(amount_outstanding) AS montant_moyen_du FROM Customers GROUP BY customer_status_code ORDER BY customer_status_code;"},{"question":"Quels clients n'ont encore suivi aucune leçon ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Lessons l ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE l.lesson_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel sont toujours en poste ?","sql":"SELECT staff_id, first_name, middle_name, last_name, date_joined_staff FROM Staff WHERE date_left_staff IS NULL ORDER BY date_joined_staff;"},{"question":"Quelles leçons concernent des clients habitant dans une adresse donnée par leur ville ?","sql":"SELECT l.lesson_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, a.city, l.lesson_date, l.lesson_status_code FROM Lessons l JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id JOIN Addresses a ON a.address_id = c.customer_address_id ORDER BY a.city, l.lesson_date;"},{"question":"Quels paiements sont supérieurs au montant moyen de tous les paiements ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, datetime_payment, payment_method_code, amount_payment FROM Customer_Payments WHERE amount_payment > (SELECT AVG(amount_payment) FROM Customer_Payments) ORDER BY amount_payment DESC;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un montant restant dû supérieur à la moyenne de tous les clients ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, amount_outstanding FROM Customers WHERE amount_outstanding > (SELECT AVG(amount_outstanding) FROM Customers) ORDER BY amount_outstanding DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque combinaison de membre du personnel et de véhicule, combien de leçons ont été enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, v.vehicle_id, v.vehicle_details, COUNT(*) AS nombre_lecons FROM Lessons l JOIN Staff s ON s.staff_id = l.staff_id JOIN Vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id = l.vehicle_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, v.vehicle_id, v.vehicle_details ORDER BY nombre_lecons DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le premier client enregistré dans la base ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, date_became_customer FROM Customers WHERE date_became_customer = (SELECT MIN(date_became_customer) FROM Customers);"},{"question":"Quel est le montant moyen des paiements pour chaque moyen de paiement ?","sql":"SELECT payment_method_code, AVG(amount_payment) AS montant_moyen FROM Customer_Payments GROUP BY payment_method_code ORDER BY montant_moyen DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de leçons n'ont aucun membre du personnel affecté ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS lecons_sans_personnel FROM Lessons WHERE staff_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont payé au moins autant que le montant restant dû qui leur est associé ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.amount_outstanding, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_payment), 0) AS total_paye FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Customer_Payments p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.amount_outstanding HAVING COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_payment), 0) >= COALESCE(c.amount_outstanding, 0) ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;"},{"question":"Quels codes postaux sont utilisés par plusieurs clients ?","sql":"SELECT a.zip_postcode, COUNT(*) AS nombre_clients FROM Customers c JOIN Addresses a ON a.address_id = c.customer_address_id GROUP BY a.zip_postcode HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY nombre_clients DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le prix total des leçons pour chaque client ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COALESCE(SUM(l.price), 0) AS total_prix_lecons FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Lessons l ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_prix_lecons DESC;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont à la fois le statut de leurs leçons et un paiement enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM Customers c JOIN Lessons l ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN Customer_Payments p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et les types de tous les services, classés par nom ?","sql":"SELECT service_name, service_type_code
FROM Services
ORDER BY service_name;"},{"question":"Quels formulaires sont associés à chaque service ?","sql":"SELECT f.form_id, f.form_name, f.form_type_code, s.service_name
FROM Forms AS f
JOIN Services AS s ON s.service_id = f.service_id
ORDER BY s.service_name, f.form_name;"},{"question":"Quelles parties disposent d'une adresse, avec la ville et le pays correspondants ?","sql":"SELECT p.party_id, a.town_city, a.zip_postcode, a.country
FROM Parties AS p
JOIN Party_Addresses AS pa ON pa.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN Addresses AS a ON a.address_id = pa.address_id
ORDER BY p.party_id;"},{"question":"Combien de parties utilisent chaque mode de paiement ?","sql":"SELECT payment_method_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_parties
FROM Parties
GROUP BY payment_method_code
ORDER BY nombre_parties DESC, payment_method_code;"},{"question":"Quelles organisations ont été créées depuis le 1er janvier 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT organization_id, organization_name, date_formed
FROM Organizations
WHERE date_formed >= '2020-01-01'
ORDER BY date_formed;"},{"question":"Quels individus sont contacts d'organisations, et quelles sont ces organisations ?","sql":"SELECT i.individual_id, i.individual_first_name, i.individual_last_name,
       o.organization_id, o.organization_name
FROM Organization_Contact_Individuals AS oci
JOIN Individuals AS i ON i.individual_id = oci.individual_id
JOIN Organizations AS o ON o.organization_id = oci.organization_id
ORDER BY o.organization_name, i.individual_last_name, i.individual_first_name;"},{"question":"Quelles adresses sont actuellement rattachées à une partie ?","sql":"SELECT pa.party_id, a.address_id, a.line_1_number_building, a.town_city,
       pa.address_type_code
FROM Party_Addresses AS pa
JOIN Addresses AS a ON a.address_id = pa.address_id
WHERE pa.date_address_to IS NULL
ORDER BY pa.party_id, a.address_id;"},{"question":"Quels formulaires commencés par les parties ne sont pas encore entièrement terminés ?","sql":"SELECT pf.party_id, pf.form_id, f.form_name, pf.date_completion_started
FROM Party_Forms AS pf
JOIN Forms AS f ON f.form_id = pf.form_id
WHERE pf.date_fully_completed IS NULL
ORDER BY pf.date_completion_started;"},{"question":"Combien de réservations chaque service a-t-il reçues ?","sql":"SELECT s.service_id, s.service_name, COUNT(ps.booking_id) AS nombre_reservations
FROM Services AS s
LEFT JOIN Party_Services AS ps ON ps.service_id = s.service_id
GROUP BY s.service_id, s.service_name
ORDER BY nombre_reservations DESC, s.service_id;"},{"question":"Quelles parties n'ont rempli aucun formulaire ?","sql":"SELECT p.party_id, p.party_phone, p.party_email
FROM Parties AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Party_Forms AS pf
    WHERE pf.party_id = p.party_id
)
ORDER BY p.party_id;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les villes distinctes présentes dans les adresses ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT town_city
FROM Addresses
WHERE town_city IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY town_city;"},{"question":"Combien de contacts chaque organisation possède-t-elle, y compris celles sans contact ?","sql":"SELECT o.organization_id, o.organization_name,
       COUNT(oci.individual_id) AS nombre_contacts
FROM Organizations AS o
LEFT JOIN Organization_Contact_Individuals AS oci
  ON oci.organization_id = o.organization_id
GROUP BY o.organization_id, o.organization_name
ORDER BY nombre_contacts DESC, o.organization_name;"},{"question":"Combien de formulaires sont associés à chaque service, y compris les services sans formulaire ?","sql":"SELECT s.service_id, s.service_name, COUNT(f.form_id) AS nombre_formulaires
FROM Services AS s
LEFT JOIN Forms AS f ON f.service_id = s.service_id
GROUP BY s.service_id, s.service_name
ORDER BY s.service_id;"},{"question":"Quel mode de paiement est utilisé par le plus grand nombre de parties ?","sql":"SELECT payment_method_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_parties
FROM Parties
GROUP BY payment_method_code
ORDER BY nombre_parties DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelles parties ont à la fois rempli un formulaire et réservé un service ?","sql":"SELECT party_id
FROM Party_Forms
INTERSECT
SELECT customer_id
FROM Party_Services
ORDER BY party_id;"},{"question":"Quels services n'ont encore été réservés par aucune partie ?","sql":"SELECT s.service_id, s.service_name
FROM Services AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Party_Services AS ps
    WHERE ps.service_id = s.service_id
)
ORDER BY s.service_id;"},{"question":"Pour chaque partie, quelle est la date de début de son adresse la plus récente ?","sql":"SELECT p.party_id, MAX(pa.date_address_from) AS derniere_adresse_depuis
FROM Parties AS p
LEFT JOIN Party_Addresses AS pa ON pa.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id
ORDER BY p.party_id;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne, en jours, entre le début et la finalisation des formulaires terminés ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(julianday(date_fully_completed) - julianday(date_completion_started))
       AS duree_moyenne_jours
FROM Party_Forms
WHERE date_fully_completed IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels services ont été réservés depuis le 1er janvier 2023, avec la partie concernée ?","sql":"SELECT ps.booking_id, ps.service_datetime, s.service_name,
       ps.customer_id AS party_id
FROM Party_Services AS ps
JOIN Services AS s ON s.service_id = ps.service_id
WHERE ps.service_datetime >= '2023-01-01'
ORDER BY ps.service_datetime;"},{"question":"Quels individus sont actuellement contacts d'au moins une organisation ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT i.individual_id, i.individual_first_name,
       i.individual_last_name, i.individual_email
FROM Individuals AS i
JOIN Organization_Contact_Individuals AS oci
  ON oci.individual_id = i.individual_id
WHERE oci.date_contact_to IS NULL
ORDER BY i.individual_last_name, i.individual_first_name;"},{"question":"Combien d'adresses sont enregistrées pour chaque pays ?","sql":"SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS nombre_adresses
FROM Addresses
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY nombre_adresses DESC, country;"},{"question":"Quelles organisations ont plus d'un individu comme contact ?","sql":"SELECT o.organization_id, o.organization_name,
       COUNT(oci.individual_id) AS nombre_contacts
FROM Organizations AS o
JOIN Organization_Contact_Individuals AS oci
  ON oci.organization_id = o.organization_id
GROUP BY o.organization_id, o.organization_name
HAVING COUNT(oci.individual_id) > 1
ORDER BY nombre_contacts DESC, o.organization_name;"},{"question":"Combien de réservations chaque type de service compte-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT s.service_type_code, COUNT(ps.booking_id) AS nombre_reservations
FROM Services AS s
LEFT JOIN Party_Services AS ps ON ps.service_id = s.service_id
GROUP BY s.service_type_code
ORDER BY nombre_reservations DESC, s.service_type_code;"},{"question":"Quelles parties ont davantage d'une adresse enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT p.party_id, COUNT(pa.address_id) AS nombre_adresses
FROM Parties AS p
JOIN Party_Addresses AS pa ON pa.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id
HAVING COUNT(pa.address_id) > 1
ORDER BY nombre_adresses DESC, p.party_id;"},{"question":"Quels formulaires ont été entièrement terminés en 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT pf.party_id, f.form_name, pf.date_fully_completed
FROM Party_Forms AS pf
JOIN Forms AS f ON f.form_id = pf.form_id
WHERE pf.date_fully_completed >= '2024-01-01'
  AND pf.date_fully_completed < '2025-01-01'
ORDER BY pf.date_fully_completed;"},{"question":"Quelles parties ont utilisé à la fois une adresse de type « domicile » et une adresse d'un autre type ?","sql":"SELECT party_id
FROM Party_Addresses
WHERE address_type_code = 'domicile'
INTERSECT
SELECT party_id
FROM Party_Addresses
WHERE address_type_code <> 'domicile'
ORDER BY party_id;"},{"question":"Quels services ont reçu au moins cinq réservations ?","sql":"SELECT s.service_id, s.service_name, COUNT(ps.booking_id) AS nombre_reservations
FROM Services AS s
JOIN Party_Services AS ps ON ps.service_id = s.service_id
GROUP BY s.service_id, s.service_name
HAVING COUNT(ps.booking_id) >= 5
ORDER BY nombre_reservations DESC, s.service_id;"},{"question":"Pour chaque partie, combien de formulaires sont terminés et combien restent en attente ?","sql":"SELECT p.party_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN pf.date_fully_completed IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS formulaires_termines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN pf.date_fully_completed IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS formulaires_en_attente
FROM Parties AS p
LEFT JOIN Party_Forms AS pf ON pf.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id
ORDER BY p.party_id;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les cours avec leur matière et le nom de leur auteur ou tuteur ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, s.subject_name, a.personal_name, a.family_name
FROM Courses AS c
JOIN Subjects AS s ON s.subject_id = c.subject_id
JOIN Course_Authors_and_Tutors AS a ON a.author_id = c.author_id;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants se sont inscrits le plus récemment ?","sql":"SELECT student_id, personal_name, middle_name, family_name, date_of_registration
FROM Students
ORDER BY date_of_registration DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de cours existe-t-il dans chaque matière ?","sql":"SELECT s.subject_id, s.subject_name, COUNT(c.course_id) AS nombre_de_cours
FROM Subjects AS s
LEFT JOIN Courses AS c ON c.subject_id = s.subject_id
GROUP BY s.subject_id, s.subject_name
ORDER BY nombre_de_cours DESC;"},{"question":"Combien d'étudiants sont inscrits à chaque cours ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(e.registration_id) AS nombre_d_inscriptions
FROM Courses AS c
LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id
GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name
ORDER BY nombre_d_inscriptions DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen d'inscriptions par cours ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(nombre_inscriptions) AS moyenne_des_inscriptions
FROM (
  SELECT c.course_id, COUNT(e.registration_id) AS nombre_inscriptions
  FROM Courses AS c
  LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id
  GROUP BY c.course_id
) AS statistiques;"},{"question":"Quels cours n'ont encore aucune inscription ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name
FROM Courses AS c
LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id
WHERE e.registration_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.course_name;"},{"question":"Combien de cours chaque auteur ou tuteur a-t-il créé ?","sql":"SELECT a.author_id, a.personal_name, a.family_name, COUNT(c.course_id) AS nombre_de_cours
FROM Course_Authors_and_Tutors AS a
LEFT JOIN Courses AS c ON c.author_id = a.author_id
GROUP BY a.author_id, a.personal_name, a.family_name
ORDER BY nombre_de_cours DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles inscriptions ont été complétées, avec le nom de l'étudiant et du cours ?","sql":"SELECT e.registration_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name, c.course_name, e.date_of_completion
FROM Student_Course_Enrolment AS e
JOIN Students AS s ON s.student_id = e.student_id
JOIN Courses AS c ON c.course_id = e.course_id
WHERE e.date_of_completion IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY e.date_of_completion DESC;"},{"question":"Quels tests ont été passés, avec l'étudiant et le cours concernés ?","sql":"SELECT t.registration_id, st.personal_name, st.family_name, c.course_name, t.date_test_taken, t.test_result
FROM Student_Tests_Taken AS t
JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.registration_id = t.registration_id
JOIN Students AS st ON st.student_id = e.student_id
JOIN Courses AS c ON c.course_id = e.course_id
ORDER BY t.date_test_taken;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ne sont inscrits à aucun cours ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name
FROM Students AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Student_Course_Enrolment AS e
  WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id
)
ORDER BY s.family_name, s.personal_name;"},{"question":"Quelle est la dernière inscription de chaque étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT e.registration_id, e.student_id, e.course_id, e.date_of_enrolment
FROM Student_Course_Enrolment AS e
WHERE e.date_of_enrolment = (
  SELECT MAX(e2.date_of_enrolment)
  FROM Student_Course_Enrolment AS e2
  WHERE e2.student_id = e.student_id
);"},{"question":"Quels cours comptent au moins deux inscriptions ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(e.registration_id) AS nombre_d_inscriptions
FROM Courses AS c
JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id
GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name
HAVING COUNT(e.registration_id) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quelles matières ne possèdent aucun cours ?","sql":"SELECT s.subject_id, s.subject_name
FROM Subjects AS s
LEFT JOIN Courses AS c ON c.subject_id = s.subject_id
WHERE c.course_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien de tests ont été passés pour chaque cours ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(t.registration_id) AS nombre_de_tests
FROM Courses AS c
LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id
LEFT JOIN Student_Tests_Taken AS t ON t.registration_id = e.registration_id
GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name
ORDER BY nombre_de_tests DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne entre l'inscription et la fin de chaque cours ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, AVG(julianday(e.date_of_completion) - julianday(e.date_of_enrolment)) AS duree_moyenne_en_jours
FROM Courses AS c
JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id
GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ou tuteurs ont l'identifiant ATB indiqué ?","sql":"SELECT author_id, personal_name, middle_name, family_name, author_tutor_ATB
FROM Course_Authors_and_Tutors
WHERE author_tutor_ATB IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY author_tutor_ATB, family_name;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont un nom de famille commençant par la lettre A ?","sql":"SELECT student_id, personal_name, middle_name, family_name
FROM Students
WHERE family_name LIKE 'A%'
ORDER BY family_name, personal_name;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de connexion apparaissent à la fois chez des étudiants et chez des auteurs ou tuteurs ?","sql":"SELECT login_name
FROM Students
WHERE login_name IS NOT NULL
INTERSECT
SELECT login_name
FROM Course_Authors_and_Tutors
WHERE login_name IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont plus d'inscriptions que la moyenne de tous les cours ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(e.registration_id) AS nombre_d_inscriptions
FROM Courses AS c
LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id
GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name
HAVING COUNT(e.registration_id) > (
  SELECT AVG(nombre_inscriptions)
  FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(e2.registration_id) AS nombre_inscriptions
    FROM Courses AS c2
    LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e2 ON e2.course_id = c2.course_id
    GROUP BY c2.course_id
  )
);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont inscrits à au moins deux cours différents ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.course_id) AS nombre_de_cours
FROM Students AS s
JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.student_id = s.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.course_id) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont au moins un test passé ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name
FROM Courses AS c
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Student_Course_Enrolment AS e
  JOIN Student_Tests_Taken AS t ON t.registration_id = e.registration_id
  WHERE e.course_id = c.course_id
)
ORDER BY c.course_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le dernier test passé pour chaque inscription ?","sql":"SELECT t.registration_id, t.date_test_taken, t.test_result
FROM Student_Tests_Taken AS t
WHERE t.date_test_taken = (
  SELECT MAX(t2.date_test_taken)
  FROM Student_Tests_Taken AS t2
  WHERE t2.registration_id = t.registration_id
);"},{"question":"Quelles dates d'inscription concernent plusieurs étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT date_of_enrolment, COUNT(*) AS nombre_d_inscriptions
FROM Student_Course_Enrolment
GROUP BY date_of_enrolment
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY date_of_enrolment;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont créé des cours dans chaque matière qui existe dans le catalogue ?","sql":"SELECT a.author_id, a.personal_name, a.family_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.subject_id) AS nombre_de_matieres
FROM Course_Authors_and_Tutors AS a
JOIN Courses AS c ON c.author_id = a.author_id
GROUP BY a.author_id, a.personal_name, a.family_name
ORDER BY nombre_de_matieres DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la date de la première inscription à chaque cours ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, MIN(e.date_of_enrolment) AS premiere_inscription
FROM Courses AS c
LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id
GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name;"},{"question":"Quels noms de famille sont partagés par plusieurs étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT family_name, COUNT(*) AS nombre_d_etudiants
FROM Students
WHERE family_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY family_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY nombre_d_etudiants DESC, family_name;"},{"question":"Quels cours appartiennent à une matière ayant au moins un autre cours ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, c.subject_id
FROM Courses AS c
WHERE c.subject_id IN (
  SELECT subject_id
  FROM Courses
  GROUP BY subject_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
ORDER BY c.subject_id, c.course_name;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de cours apparaissent soit dans le catalogue, soit dans les inscriptions ?","sql":"SELECT course_id FROM Courses
UNION
SELECT course_id FROM Student_Course_Enrolment
ORDER BY course_id;"},{"question":"Quelles inscriptions n'ont aucun test associé ?","sql":"SELECT e.registration_id, e.student_id, e.course_id, e.date_of_enrolment
FROM Student_Course_Enrolment AS e
LEFT JOIN Student_Tests_Taken AS t ON t.registration_id = e.registration_id
WHERE t.registration_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont passé au moins un test sans résultat renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name
FROM Students AS s
JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.student_id = s.student_id
JOIN Student_Tests_Taken AS t ON t.registration_id = e.registration_id
WHERE t.test_result IS NULL OR TRIM(t.test_result) = '';"},{"question":"Combien d'inscriptions ont été enregistrées chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', date_of_enrolment) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_d_inscriptions
FROM Student_Course_Enrolment
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', date_of_enrolment)
ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quelle matière contient le plus de cours ?","sql":"SELECT s.subject_id, s.subject_name, COUNT(c.course_id) AS nombre_de_cours
FROM Subjects AS s
JOIN Courses AS c ON c.subject_id = s.subject_id
GROUP BY s.subject_id, s.subject_name
ORDER BY nombre_de_cours DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ou tuteurs n'ont créé aucun cours ?","sql":"SELECT a.author_id, a.personal_name, a.family_name
FROM Course_Authors_and_Tutors AS a
LEFT JOIN Courses AS c ON c.author_id = a.author_id
WHERE c.course_id IS NULL
ORDER BY a.family_name, a.personal_name;"},{"question":"Pour chaque étudiant, combien de cours sont commencés et combien sont terminés ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name,
       COUNT(e.registration_id) AS cours_commences,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.date_of_completion IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cours_termines
FROM Students AS s
LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.student_id = s.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name
ORDER BY s.family_name, s.personal_name;"}]}
