{"examples":[{"question":"Quels représentants ont participé à au moins une élection, avec le nombre d’élections auxquelles chacun a participé ?","sql":"SELECT r."Representative_ID", r."Name", COUNT(e."Election_ID") AS nombre_elections
FROM "representative" AS r
JOIN "election" AS e ON e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
GROUP BY r."Representative_ID", r."Name"
ORDER BY nombre_elections DESC, r."Name";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de votes obtenus dans chaque État ?","sql":"SELECT r."State", AVG(e."Votes") AS moyenne_votes
FROM "representative" AS r
JOIN "election" AS e ON e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
GROUP BY r."State"
ORDER BY moyenne_votes DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle élection affiche le plus grand pourcentage de votes, et quel représentant y est associé ?","sql":"SELECT e."Election_ID", e."Date", r."Name", e."Vote_Percent"
FROM "election" AS e
JOIN "representative" AS r ON r."Representative_ID" = e."Representative_ID"
WHERE e."Vote_Percent" = (SELECT MAX("Vote_Percent") FROM "election")
ORDER BY e."Election_ID";"},{"question":"Quels représentants n’ont participé à aucune élection ?","sql":"SELECT r."Representative_ID", r."Name", r."State", r."Party"
FROM "representative" AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "election" AS e
    WHERE e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
)
ORDER BY r."Name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque parti ayant obtenu au moins un siège au total, combien de sièges ses représentants ont-ils obtenus ?","sql":"SELECT r."Party", SUM(e."Seats") AS total_sieges
FROM "representative" AS r
JOIN "election" AS e ON e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
GROUP BY r."Party"
HAVING SUM(e."Seats") > 0
ORDER BY total_sieges DESC, r."Party";"},{"question":"Quelles élections ont enregistré davantage de votes que la moyenne des élections du même État ?","sql":"SELECT e."Election_ID", e."Date", r."Name", r."State", e."Votes"
FROM "election" AS e
JOIN "representative" AS r ON r."Representative_ID" = e."Representative_ID"
WHERE e."Votes" > (
    SELECT AVG(e2."Votes")
    FROM "election" AS e2
    JOIN "representative" AS r2 ON r2."Representative_ID" = e2."Representative_ID"
    WHERE r2."State" = r."State"
)
ORDER BY r."State", e."Votes" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels partis sont représentés à la fois par des candidats ayant remporté des sièges et par des candidats ayant obtenu au moins 50 % des votes ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT r."Party"
FROM "representative" AS r
JOIN "election" AS e ON e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
WHERE e."Seats" > 0
INTERSECT
SELECT DISTINCT r2."Party"
FROM "representative" AS r2
JOIN "election" AS e2 ON e2."Representative_ID" = r2."Representative_ID"
WHERE e2."Vote_Percent" >= 50
ORDER BY "Party";"}]}

qui n'en ont aucune ?","sql":"SELECT i.i_id, i.title, COUNT(r.a_id) AS nombre_evaluations FROM item AS i LEFT JOIN review AS r ON r.i_id = i.i_id GROUP BY i.i_id, i.title ORDER BY nombre_evaluations DESC, i.i_id;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont une note moyenne supérieure ou égale à 4 ?","sql":"SELECT i.i_id, i.title, AVG(r.rating) AS note_moyenne FROM item AS i JOIN review AS r ON r.i_id = i.i_id GROUP BY i.i_id, i.title HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 4 ORDER BY note_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Combien d'avis chaque utilisateur a-t-il publiés ?","sql":"SELECT u.u_id, u.name, COUNT(r.a_id) AS nombre_avis FROM useracct AS u LEFT JOIN review AS r ON r.u_id = u.u_id GROUP BY u.u_id, u.name ORDER BY nombre_avis DESC, u.u_id;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les trois évaluations les mieux notées ?","sql":"SELECT a_id, u_id, i_id, rating FROM review WHERE rating IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rating DESC, a_id LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Combien de relations de confiance sortantes chaque utilisateur possède-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT u.u_id, u.name, COUNT(t.target_u_id) AS nombre_relations FROM useracct AS u LEFT JOIN trust AS t ON t.source_u_id = u.u_id GROUP BY u.u_id, u.name ORDER BY nombre_relations DESC, u.u_id;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs n'ont encore publié aucun avis ?","sql":"SELECT u.u_id, u.name FROM useracct AS u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review AS r WHERE r.u_id = u.u_id) ORDER BY u.u_id;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs ont évalué l'article intitulé « Produit A » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT u.u_id, u.name FROM useracct AS u JOIN review AS r ON r.u_id = u.u_id JOIN item AS i ON i.i_id = r.i_id WHERE i.title = 'Produit A' ORDER BY u.u_id;"},{"question":"Quelle est la note moyenne de l'ensemble des évaluations ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(rating) AS note_moyenne_generale FROM review;"},{"question":"Quelles évaluations sont supérieures à la note moyenne générale ?","sql":"SELECT a_id, u_id, i_id, rating FROM review WHERE rating > (SELECT AVG(rating) FROM review) ORDER BY rating DESC, a_id;"},{"question":"Quelles paires d'utilisateurs se font confiance réciproquement ?","sql":"SELECT t.source_u_id, t.target_u_id FROM trust AS t JOIN trust AS inverse ON inverse.source_u_id = t.target_u_id AND inverse.target_u_id = t.source_u_id WHERE t.source_u_id < t.target_u_id ORDER BY t.source_u_id, t.target_u_id;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs ont reçu la confiance d'au moins deux personnes distinctes ?","sql":"SELECT u.u_id, u.name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.source_u_id) AS nombre_de_soutiens FROM useracct AS u JOIN trust AS t ON t.target_u_id = u.u_id GROUP BY u.u_id, u.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.source_u_id) >= 2 ORDER BY nombre_de_soutiens DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque article, quelle est la meilleure note qui lui a été attribuée ?","sql":"SELECT i.i_id, i.title, MAX(r.rating) AS meilleure_note FROM item AS i LEFT JOIN review AS r ON r.i_id = i.i_id GROUP BY i.i_id, i.title ORDER BY i.i_id;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs ont évalué au moins deux articles différents ?","sql":"SELECT u.u_id, u.name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.i_id) AS articles_evalues FROM useracct AS u JOIN review AS r ON r.u_id = u.u_id GROUP BY u.u_id, u.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.i_id) >= 2 ORDER BY articles_evalues DESC;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs apparaissent comme source ou comme cible d'une relation de confiance ?","sql":"SELECT u_id, name FROM useracct WHERE u_id IN (SELECT source_u_id FROM trust UNION SELECT target_u_id FROM trust) ORDER BY u_id;"},{"question":"Quelle est la note moyenne donnée par chaque utilisateur, y compris ceux qui n'ont aucun avis ?","sql":"SELECT u.u_id, u.name, AVG(r.rating) AS note_moyenne FROM useracct AS u LEFT JOIN review AS r ON r.u_id = u.u_id GROUP BY u.u_id, u.name ORDER BY u.u_id;"},{"question":"Combien d'évaluations existent pour chaque valeur de note ?","sql":"SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS nombre_evaluations FROM review WHERE rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont reçu au moins une note maximale parmi toutes les évaluations ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT i.i_id, i.title FROM item AS i JOIN review AS r ON r.i_id = i.i_id WHERE r.rating = (SELECT MAX(rating) FROM review) ORDER BY i.i_id;"},{"question":"Quel utilisateur a reçu le plus grand nombre de relations de confiance ?","sql":"SELECT u.u_id, u.name, COUNT(t.source_u_id) AS nombre_de_soutiens FROM useracct AS u JOIN trust AS t ON t.target_u_id = u.u_id GROUP BY u.u_id, u.name ORDER BY nombre_de_soutiens DESC, u.u_id LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelles évaluations n'ont pas de rang renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT a_id, u_id, i_id, rating FROM review WHERE \"rank\" IS NULL ORDER BY a_id;"},{"question":"Quel article a reçu le plus grand nombre d'évaluations ?","sql":"WITH comptes AS (SELECT i.i_id, i.title, COUNT(r.a_id) AS nombre_evaluations FROM item AS i LEFT JOIN review AS r ON r.i_id = i.i_id GROUP BY i.i_id, i.title) SELECT i_id, title, nombre_evaluations FROM comptes WHERE nombre_evaluations = (SELECT MAX(nombre_evaluations) FROM comptes) ORDER BY i_id;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs n'ont publié aucun avis inférieur à 4, tout en ayant publié au moins un avis ?","sql":"SELECT u.u_id, u.name FROM useracct AS u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review AS r WHERE r.u_id = u.u_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review AS r WHERE r.u_id = u.u_id AND r.rating < 4) ORDER BY u.u_id;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles villes ont une population supérieure à la population moyenne de toutes les villes ?","sql":"SELECT "Official_Name", "Population"
FROM "city"
WHERE "Population" > (SELECT AVG("Population") FROM "city");"},{"question":"Quelle ferme possède le plus grand nombre total de bovins ?","sql":"SELECT "Farm_ID", "Total_Cattle"
FROM "farm"
WHERE "Total_Cattle" = (SELECT MAX("Total_Cattle") FROM "farm");"},{"question":"Pour chaque compétition, quel est le nom de la ville qui l’a accueillie ?","sql":"SELECT fc."Competition_ID", fc."Year", fc."Theme", c."Official_Name"
FROM "farm_competition" AS fc
JOIN "city" AS c ON c."City_ID" = fc."Host_city_ID";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de chevaux et de bovins par année d’exploitation ?","sql":"SELECT "Year", AVG("Total_Horses") AS "Moyenne_chevaux", AVG("Total_Cattle") AS "Moyenne_bovins"
FROM "farm"
GROUP BY "Year"
ORDER BY "Year";"},{"question":"Quelles fermes ont obtenu la première place dans au moins une compétition ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f."Farm_ID"
FROM "farm" AS f
JOIN "competition_record" AS cr ON cr."Farm_ID" = f."Farm_ID"
WHERE cr."Rank" = 1;"},{"question":"Quelles fermes n’ont participé à aucune compétition ?","sql":"SELECT f."Farm_ID"
FROM "farm" AS f
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "competition_record" AS cr
    WHERE cr."Farm_ID" = f."Farm_ID"
);"},{"question":"Combien de compétitions chaque ville a-t-elle accueillies, y compris celles qui n’en ont accueilli aucune ?","sql":"SELECT c."City_ID", c."Official_Name", COUNT(fc."Competition_ID") AS "Nombre_de_competitions"
FROM "city" AS c
LEFT JOIN "farm_competition" AS fc ON fc."Host_city_ID" = c."City_ID"
GROUP BY c."City_ID", c."Official_Name"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_competitions" DESC, c."Official_Name";"},{"question":"Quel pourcentage du cheptel bovin de chaque ferme est constitué de vaches, lorsque le nombre total de bovins est positif ?","sql":"SELECT "Farm_ID", 100.0 * "Cows" / "Total_Cattle" AS "Pourcentage_de_vaches"
FROM "farm"
WHERE "Total_Cattle" > 0
ORDER BY "Pourcentage_de_vaches" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les trois fermes ayant le plus grand cheptel total, en additionnant chevaux, bovins, porcs et ovins ou caprins ?","sql":"SELECT "Farm_ID",
       ("Total_Horses" + "Total_Cattle" + "Pigs" + "Sheep_and_Goats") AS "Cheptel_total"
FROM "farm"
ORDER BY "Cheptel_total" DESC
LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quelles compétitions ont été accueillies dans une ville dont la superficie est supérieure à la superficie moyenne des villes ?","sql":"SELECT fc."Competition_ID", fc."Theme", c."Official_Name", c."Area_km_2"
FROM "farm_competition" AS fc
JOIN "city" AS c ON c."City_ID" = fc."Host_city_ID"
WHERE c."Area_km_2" > (SELECT AVG("Area_km_2") FROM "city");"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de fermes sont soit associés à une compétition, soit comptent plus de 100 bovins ?","sql":"SELECT "Farm_ID"
FROM "competition_record"
UNION
SELECT "Farm_ID"
FROM "farm"
WHERE "Total_Cattle" > 100
ORDER BY "Farm_ID";"},{"question":"Quelles fermes comptent davantage de chevaux au total que de chevaux de travail ?","sql":"SELECT "Farm_ID", "Total_Horses", "Working_Horses"
FROM "farm"
WHERE "Total_Horses" > "Working_Horses";"},{"question":"Pour chaque compétition, quel est le classement moyen des fermes participantes ?","sql":"SELECT fc."Competition_ID", fc."Theme", AVG(cr."Rank") AS "Classement_moyen", COUNT(cr."Farm_ID") AS "Nombre_de_participants"
FROM "farm_competition" AS fc
JOIN "competition_record" AS cr ON cr."Competition_ID" = fc."Competition_ID"
GROUP BY fc."Competition_ID", fc."Theme"
ORDER BY fc."Competition_ID";"},{"question":"Quelles fermes ont davantage de chevaux que la moyenne des fermes de leur même année ?","sql":"SELECT f."Farm_ID", f."Year", f."Total_Horses"
FROM "farm" AS f
WHERE f."Total_Horses" > (
    SELECT AVG(f2."Total_Horses")
    FROM "farm" AS f2
    WHERE f2."Year" = f."Year"
)
ORDER BY f."Year", f."Total_Horses" DESC;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les titres des films du studio Pixar, avec leurs recettes décroissantes ?","sql":"SELECT \"Title\", \"Gross_in_dollar\" FROM \"film\" WHERE \"Studio\" = 'Pixar' ORDER BY \"Gross_in_dollar\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films ont été réalisés par Christopher Nolan ?","sql":"SELECT \"Title\" FROM \"film\" WHERE \"Director\" = 'Christopher Nolan' ORDER BY \"Title\";"},{"question":"Quels marchés comptent plus de 20 villes ?","sql":"SELECT \"Country\", \"Number_cities\" FROM \"market\" WHERE \"Number_cities\" > 20 ORDER BY \"Number_cities\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films disposent d'une estimation de marché, avec le pays concerné et la fourchette estimée ?","sql":"SELECT f.\"Title\", m.\"Country\", e.\"Low_Estimate\", e.\"High_Estimate\" FROM \"film\" AS f JOIN \"film_market_estimation\" AS e ON e.\"Film_ID\" = f.\"Film_ID\" JOIN \"market\" AS m ON m.\"Market_ID\" = e.\"Market_ID\" ORDER BY f.\"Title\", m.\"Country\";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de films et la recette moyenne pour chaque studio ?","sql":"SELECT \"Studio\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_films\", AVG(\"Gross_in_dollar\") AS \"Recette_moyenne\" FROM \"film\" GROUP BY \"Studio\" ORDER BY \"Recette_moyenne\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels réalisateurs ont réalisé au moins deux films ?","sql":"SELECT \"Director\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_films\" FROM \"film\" GROUP BY \"Director\" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY \"Nombre_films\" DESC, \"Director\";"},{"question":"Quelle est l'estimation haute moyenne par pays ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Country\", AVG(e.\"High_Estimate\") AS \"Estimation_haute_moyenne\" FROM \"market\" AS m JOIN \"film_market_estimation\" AS e ON e.\"Market_ID\" = m.\"Market_ID\" GROUP BY m.\"Market_ID\", m.\"Country\" ORDER BY \"Estimation_haute_moyenne\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films n'ont aucune estimation de marché ?","sql":"SELECT f.\"Title\" FROM \"film\" AS f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"film_market_estimation\" AS e WHERE e.\"Film_ID\" = f.\"Film_ID\") ORDER BY f.\"Title\";"},{"question":"Quels films ont généré des recettes supérieures à la recette moyenne de tous les films ?","sql":"SELECT \"Title\", \"Gross_in_dollar\" FROM \"film\" WHERE \"Gross_in_dollar\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Gross_in_dollar\") FROM \"film\") ORDER BY \"Gross_in_dollar\" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque type d'estimation, quelles sont les estimations hautes maximales et les films correspondants ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Type\", f.\"Title\", e.\"High_Estimate\" FROM \"film_market_estimation\" AS e JOIN \"film\" AS f ON f.\"Film_ID\" = e.\"Film_ID\" WHERE e.\"High_Estimate\" = (SELECT MAX(e2.\"High_Estimate\") FROM \"film_market_estimation\" AS e2 WHERE e2.\"Type\" = e.\"Type\") ORDER BY e.\"Type\";"},{"question":"Quels pays possèdent au moins un marché de plus de 50 villes ou au moins une estimation haute supérieure à 1000000 ?","sql":"SELECT \"Country\" FROM \"market\" WHERE \"Number_cities\" > 50 UNION SELECT m.\"Country\" FROM \"market\" AS m JOIN \"film_market_estimation\" AS e ON e.\"Market_ID\" = m.\"Market_ID\" WHERE e.\"High_Estimate\" > 1000000 ORDER BY \"Country\";"},{"question":"Pour chaque marché, quel est le total des estimations hautes associées ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Country\", COALESCE(SUM(e.\"High_Estimate\"), 0) AS \"Total_estimations_hautes\" FROM \"market\" AS m LEFT JOIN \"film_market_estimation\" AS e ON e.\"Market_ID\" = m.\"Market_ID\" GROUP BY m.\"Market_ID\", m.\"Country\" ORDER BY \"Total_estimations_hautes\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles années contiennent des estimations, et combien en compte chacune ?","sql":"SELECT \"Year\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_estimations\" FROM \"film_market_estimation\" GROUP BY \"Year\" ORDER BY \"Year\";"},{"question":"Quels films ont au moins trois estimations de marché ?","sql":"SELECT f.\"Title\", COUNT(e.\"Estimation_ID\") AS \"Nombre_estimations\" FROM \"film\" AS f JOIN \"film_market_estimation\" AS e ON e.\"Film_ID\" = f.\"Film_ID\" GROUP BY f.\"Film_ID\", f.\"Title\" HAVING COUNT(e.\"Estimation_ID\") >= 3 ORDER BY \"Nombre_estimations\" DESC, f.\"Title\";"},{"question":"Quels studios ont au moins un film dont les recettes dépassent 100 millions de dollars ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"Studio\" FROM \"film\" WHERE \"Gross_in_dollar\" > 100000000 ORDER BY \"Studio\";"},{"question":"Quels sont les différents types d'estimation enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"Type\" FROM \"film_market_estimation\" WHERE \"Type\" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY \"Type\";"},{"question":"Quels films ont uniquement des estimations hautes supérieures à 500000, parmi les films ayant au moins une estimation ?","sql":"SELECT f.\"Title\" FROM \"film\" AS f WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"film_market_estimation\" AS e WHERE e.\"Film_ID\" = f.\"Film_ID\") AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"film_market_estimation\" AS e WHERE e.\"Film_ID\" = f.\"Film_ID\" AND e.\"High_Estimate\" <= 500000) ORDER BY f.\"Title\";"},{"question":"Quel est le ou les marchés ayant le plus grand nombre de villes ?","sql":"SELECT \"Country\", \"Number_cities\" FROM \"market\" WHERE \"Number_cities\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Number_cities\") FROM \"market\");"},{"question":"Pour chaque année, quelles sont les estimations basse et haute moyennes ?","sql":"SELECT \"Year\", AVG(\"Low_Estimate\") AS \"Estimation_basse_moyenne\", AVG(\"High_Estimate\") AS \"Estimation_haute_moyenne\" FROM \"film_market_estimation\" GROUP BY \"Year\" ORDER BY \"Year\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la différence moyenne entre l'estimation haute et l'estimation basse pour chaque type ?","sql":"SELECT \"Type\", AVG(\"High_Estimate\" - \"Low_Estimate\") AS \"Ecart_moyen\" FROM \"film_market_estimation\" GROUP BY \"Type\" ORDER BY \"Ecart_moyen\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films ont le même réalisateur et le même studio qu'au moins un autre film ?","sql":"SELECT \"Title\", \"Director\", \"Studio\" FROM \"film\" WHERE (\"Director\", \"Studio\") IN (SELECT \"Director\", \"Studio\" FROM \"film\" GROUP BY \"Director\", \"Studio\" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) ORDER BY \"Director\", \"Studio\", \"Title\";"},{"question":"Quels pays ont au moins deux estimations de marché ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Country\", COUNT(e.\"Estimation_ID\") AS \"Nombre_estimations\" FROM \"market\" AS m JOIN \"film_market_estimation\" AS e ON e.\"Market_ID\" = m.\"Market_ID\" GROUP BY m.\"Market_ID\", m.\"Country\" HAVING COUNT(e.\"Estimation_ID\") >= 2 ORDER BY \"Nombre_estimations\" DESC, m.\"Country\";"},{"question":"Quels films sont à la fois au-dessus de la recette moyenne et associés à au moins une estimation ?","sql":"SELECT \"Title\" FROM \"film\" WHERE \"Film_ID\" IN (SELECT \"Film_ID\" FROM \"film\" WHERE \"Gross_in_dollar\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Gross_in_dollar\") FROM \"film\") INTERSECT SELECT \"Film_ID\" FROM \"film_market_estimation\") ORDER BY \"Title\";"},{"question":"Pour chaque film, quelles sont ses recettes et le total de ses estimations hautes, y compris les films sans estimation ?","sql":"SELECT f.\"Title\", f.\"Gross_in_dollar\", COALESCE(SUM(e.\"High_Estimate\"), 0) AS \"Total_estimations_hautes\" FROM \"film\" AS f LEFT JOIN \"film_market_estimation\" AS e ON e.\"Film_ID\" = f.\"Film_ID\" GROUP BY f.\"Film_ID\", f.\"Title\", f.\"Gross_in_dollar\" ORDER BY \"Total_estimations_hautes\" DESC, f.\"Title\";"}]}

AS f WHERE f.price < (SELECT AVG(f2.price) FROM flight AS f2 WHERE f2.origin = f.origin);"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total de certificats enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS certificate_count FROM certificate;"},{"question":"Quels noms d'appareils sont associés à des vols vers Londres ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.name FROM aircraft AS a JOIN flight AS f ON f.aid = a.aid WHERE f.destination = 'Londres';"},{"question":"Quels employés sont certifiés pour un appareil qui n'est utilisé par aucun vol ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT e.eid, e.name FROM employee AS e JOIN nombre_routes FROM airlines AS al JOIN routes AS r ON r.alid = al.alid GROUP BY al.alid, al.name ORDER BY nombre_routes DESC, al.alid LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels aéroports ont le plus grand nombre une altitude moyenne d'aéroport supérieure à la moyenne générale ?","sql":"SELECT country, AVG(elevation) AS altitude_moyenne FROM airports GROUP BY country HAVING AVG(elevation) > (SELECT d'aéroports sont reliées par plusieurs routes ?","sql":"SELECT src_apid, dst_apid, COUNT(*) AS nombre_routes FROM routes GROUP BY src_apid, dst_apid HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY nombre_routes DESC, IATA ni code ICAO ?","sql":"SELECT apid, name, city, country FROM airports WHERE (iata IS NULL OR iata = '') AND (icao IS NULL OR icao = '') ORDER BY name;"},{"question":"Combien de routes y a-t-il pour chaque valeur de partage de code ?","sql":"SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(codeshare, ''), 'Sans indication') AS partage_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_routes FROM routes GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(codeshare, COUNT(DISTINCT r.dst_apid) AS aeroports_accessibles FROM airlines AS al LEFT JOIN routes AS r ON r.alid = al.alid GROUP BY al.alid, al.name ORDER BY aeroports_accessibles DESC, ?","sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN src.country = dst.country THEN 'Même pays' ELSE 'Pays différents' END AS type_liaison, COUNT(*) AS nombre_routes FROM routes AS r JOIN airports AS src ON src.apid = = (SELECT MAX(elevation) FROM airports)) OR r.dst_apid = (SELECT apid FROM airports WHERE elevation = (SELECT MAX(elevation) FROM airports)) ORDER BY al.name;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les aéroports situés en France, avec leur ville et leur code IATA ?","sql":"SELECT "name", "City", "IATA"
FROM "airport"
WHERE "Country" = 'France'
ORDER BY "City", "name";"},{"question":"Quels vols sont associés à chaque compagnie et à quel aéroport sont-ils rattachés ?","sql":"SELECT f."Vehicle_Flight_number", f."Date", oc."name" AS "company_name", a."name" AS "airport_name"
FROM "flight" AS f
JOIN "operate_company" AS oc ON oc."id" = f."company_id"
JOIN "airport" AS a ON a."id" = f."airport_id"
ORDER BY f."Date", f."Vehicle_Flight_number";"},{"question":"Quelles compagnies exploitent au moins deux vols, et combien de vols chacune exploite-t-elle ?","sql":"SELECT oc."name", COUNT(f."id") AS "flight_count"
FROM "operate_company" AS oc
JOIN "flight" AS f ON f."company_id" = oc."id"
GROUP BY oc."id", oc."name"
HAVING COUNT(f."id") >= 2
ORDER BY "flight_count" DESC, oc."name";"},{"question":"Quel est le vol qui atteint l'altitude maximale, avec son numéro et sa compagnie ?","sql":"SELECT f."Vehicle_Flight_number", f."Altitude", oc."name" AS "company_name"
FROM "flight" AS f
JOIN "operate_company" AS oc ON oc."id" = f."company_id"
WHERE f."Altitude" = (SELECT MAX("Altitude") FROM "flight")
ORDER BY f."Vehicle_Flight_number";"},{"question":"Quelles compagnies n'ont encore aucun vol enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT oc."name"
FROM "operate_company" AS oc
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "flight" AS f
    WHERE f."company_id" = oc."id"
)
ORDER BY oc."name";"},{"question":"Quels vols ont une altitude supérieure à l'altitude moyenne de tous les vols ?","sql":"SELECT "Vehicle_Flight_number", "Altitude", "Date"
FROM "flight"
WHERE "Altitude" > (SELECT AVG("Altitude") FROM "flight")
ORDER BY "Altitude" DESC, "Vehicle_Flight_number";"},{"question":"Combien de vols sont associés à chaque pays où se trouve un aéroport ?","sql":"SELECT a."Country", COUNT(f."id") AS "flight_count"
FROM "airport" AS a
LEFT JOIN "flight" AS f ON f."airport_id" = a."id"
GROUP BY a."Country"
ORDER BY "flight_count" DESC, a."Country";"},{"question":"Quels pays apparaissent à la fois comme pays d'aéroport et comme pays d'incorporation d'une compagnie ?","sql":"SELECT "Country" AS "country"
FROM "airport"
INTERSECT
SELECT "Incorporated_in" AS "country"
FROM "operate_company"
ORDER BY "country";"},{"question":"Pour chaque compagnie ayant des vols, quel est le vol le plus récent ?","sql":"SELECT oc."name" AS "company_name", f."Vehicle_Flight_number", f."Date"
FROM "operate_company" AS oc
JOIN "flight" AS f ON f."company_id" = oc."id"
WHERE f."Date" = (
    SELECT MAX(f2."Date")
    FROM "flight" AS f2
    WHERE f2."company_id" = f."company_id"
)
ORDER BY oc."name", f."Vehicle_Flight_number";"},{"question":"Quelles compagnies ont une vitesse moyenne supérieure à la vitesse moyenne de l'ensemble des vols ?","sql":"SELECT oc."name", AVG(f."Velocity") AS "average_velocity"
FROM "operate_company" AS oc
JOIN "flight" AS f ON f."company_id" = oc."id"

HAVING AVG(f."Velocity") > (SELECT AVG("Velocity") FROM "flight")

FROM "airport" AS a
LEFT JOIN "flight" AS f ON f."airport_id" = a."id"
WHERE f."id" IS NULL
ORDER BY a."City", a."name";"},{"question":"Quel est l'aéroport associé au plus grand nombre de vols ?","sql":"SELECT a."name", a."City", COUNT(f."id") AS "flight_count"
FROM "airport" AS a
JOIN "flight" AS f ON f."airport_id" = a."id"

ORDER BY "flight_count" DESC, a."name"

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms des gymnastes classés par total de points décroissant ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", g."Total_Points"
FROM "gymnast" AS g
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = g."Gymnast_ID"
ORDER BY g."Total_Points" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le total moyen de points par ville d'origine ?","sql":"SELECT p."Hometown", AVG(g."Total_Points") AS moyenne_total
FROM "gymnast" AS g
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = g."Gymnast_ID"
GROUP BY p."Hometown"
ORDER BY moyenne_total DESC;"},{"question":"Quels gymnastes ont obtenu un total supérieur à la moyenne de tous les gymnastes ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", g."Total_Points"
FROM "gymnast" AS g
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = g."Gymnast_ID"
WHERE g."Total_Points" > (SELECT AVG("Total_Points") FROM "gymnast")
ORDER BY g."Total_Points" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de gymnastes sont associés à chaque ville d'origine ?","sql":"SELECT p."Hometown", COUNT(*) AS nombre_gymnastes
FROM "gymnast" AS g
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = g."Gymnast_ID"
GROUP BY p."Hometown"
ORDER BY nombre_gymnastes DESC, p."Hometown";"},{"question":"Qui a obtenu la meilleure note au sol ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", g."Floor_Exercise_Points"
FROM "gymnast" AS g
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = g."Gymnast_ID"
WHERE g."Floor_Exercise_Points" = (SELECT MAX("Floor_Exercise_Points") FROM "gymnast");"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne des notes aux anneaux pour les gymnastes âgés d'au moins 25 ans ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(g."Rings_Points") AS moyenne_anneaux
FROM "gymnast" AS g
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = g."Gymnast_ID"
WHERE p."Age" >= 25;"},{"question":"Quels gymnastes ont un total enregistré différent de la somme de leurs six notes d'agrès ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", g."Total_Points", (g."Floor_Exercise_Points" + g."Pommel_Horse_Points" + g."Rings_Points" + g."Vault_Points" + g."Parallel_Bars_Points" + g."Horizontal_Bar_Points") AS somme_notes
FROM "gymnast" AS g
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = g."Gymnast_ID"
WHERE g."Total_Points" <> (g."Floor_Exercise_Points" + g."Pommel_Horse_Points" + g."Rings_Points" + g."Vault_Points" + g."Parallel_Bars_Points" + g."Horizontal_Bar_Points");"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ne disposent d'aucune fiche de résultats en gymnastique ?","sql":"SELECT p."People_ID", p."Name"

ORDER BY p."Name";"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois meilleurs gymnastes au saut ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", g."Vault_Points"

ORDER BY g."Vault_Points" DESC

ORDER BY taille_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quels gymnastes ont une note aux anneaux supérieure à la moyenne des notes aux anneaux ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", g."Rings_Points"
FROM "gymnast" AS g
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = g."Gymnast_ID"
WHERE g."Rings_Points" > (SELECT AVG("Rings_Points") FROM "gymnast")
ORDER BY g."Rings_Points" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le classement des gymnastes selon leur total de points, avec leur ville d'origine ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", p."Hometown", g."Total_Points", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY g."Total_Points" DESC) AS classement

WHERE g."Total_Points" >= 80
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque ville, quel est le total maximal obtenu par un gymnaste et combien de gymnastes y sont recensés ?","sql":"SELECT p."Hometown", MAX(g."Total_Points") AS meilleur_total, COUNT(g."Gymnast_ID") AS nombre_gymnastes

infirmier assistant ?","sql":"SELECT u.Patient, u.Procedures, u.Stay, u.DateUndergoes FROM Undergoes u WHERE u.AssistingNurse IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels patients ont subi la même procédure lors de plusieurs séjours ?","sql":"SELECT p.SSN, p.Name, u.Procedures, COUNT(DISTINCT u.Stay) AS NombreSejours FROM Patient p JOIN Undergoes u ON u.Patient = p.SSN GROUP BY p.SSN, p.Name, u.Procedures HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT u.Stay) > 1;"},{"question":"Quels médecins ont réalisé plus de procédures que la moyenne des médecins ?","sql":"WITH compte AS (SELECT ph.EmployeeID, ph.Name, COUNT(u.Procedures) AS suivis ?","sql":"SELECT ph.EmployeeID, ph.Name FROM Physician ph WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Patient p WHERE p.PCP = ph.EmployeeID) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Appointment a JOIN Patient p2 ON p2.SSN = Nurse;"},{"question":"Quels employés sont à la fois médecins et infirmiers selon leur identifiant ?","sql":"SELECT EmployeeID FROM Physician INTERSECT SELECT EmployeeID FROM Nurse;"},{"question":"Quels numéros d'employé figurent parmi les médecins mais pas parmi les infirmiers ?","sql":"SELECT EmployeeID FROM Physician EXCEPT SELECT EmployeeID FROM Nurse;"},{"question":"Quels patients ont une adresse et un numéro de téléphone distincts de ceux de tous les autres patients ?","sql":"SELECT p.SSN, p.Name, p.Address, p.Phone FROM Patient p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Patient p2 WHERE p2.SSN <> p.SSN AND p2.Address = p.Address AND p2.Phone = p.Phone);"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de prescriptions par marque de médicament ?","sql":"SELECT m.Brand, COUNT(*) AS NombrePrescriptions FROM Medication m JOIN Prescribes pr ON pr.Medication = m.Code GROUP BY m.Brand ORDER BY NombrePrescriptions DESC;"},{"question":"Quels départements ont un responsable affilié à ce même département ?","sql":"SELECT d.DepartmentID, d.Name FROM Department d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Affiliated_With a WHERE a.Department = d.DepartmentID AND a.Physician = d.Head);"},{"question":"Quels médecins ont été à la fois responsables d'un département et prescripteurs ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT ph.EmployeeID, ph.Name FROM Physician ph JOIN Department d ON d.Head = ph.EmployeeID JOIN Prescribes pr ON pr.Physician = ph.EmployeeID;"},{"question":"Quels patients ont séjourné dans une chambre du bloc 1 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.SSN, p.Name FROM Patient p JOIN Stay s ON s.Patient = p.SSN JOIN Room r ON r.RoomNumber = s.Room WHERE r.BlockFloor = 1;"}]}

?","sql":"SELECT \"name\" FROM \"company\" WHERE LOWER(\"name\") LIKE '%film%';"},{"question":"Combien d'entreprises possède chaque code pays ?","sql":"SELECT \"country_code\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre\" FROM \"company\" GROUP BY \"country_code\";"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises n'ont pas de code pays ?","sql":"SELECT \"name\" FROM \"company\" WHERE \"country_code\" IS NULL OR \"country_code\" = m.\"mid\" JOIN \"company\" AS c ON c.\"id\" = cp.\"cid\";"},{"question":"Combien de films sont associés à chaque entreprise ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"name\", COUNT(DISTINCT m.\"mid\") AS \"nombre_films\" FROM \"company\" AS c JOIN \"copyright\" AS cp ON cp.\"cid\" = c.\"id\" JOIN \"movie\" AS m ON m.\"mid\" = cp.\"msid\" GROUP BY c.\"id\", c.\"name\" ORDER BY \"nombre_films\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises sont associées à au moins un film sorti après 2015 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.\"name\" FROM \"company\" AS c JOIN \"copyright\" AS cp ON cp.\"cid\" = c.\"id\" JOIN \"movie\" AS m ON m.\"mid\" = cp.\"msid\" WHERE m.\"release_year\" > 2015;"},{"question":"Quels films n'ont aucune association dans la table copyright ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m LEFT JOIN \"copyright\" AS cp ON cp.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" WHERE cp.\"msid\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien d'enregistrements copyright existent par entreprise ?","sql":"SELECT \"cid\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_enregistrements\" FROM \"copyright\" GROUP BY \"cid\" ORDER BY \"nombre_enregistrements\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de films apparaissent dans copyright ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"msid\" FROM \"copyright\" ORDER BY \"msid\";"},{"question":"Quels films ont au moins un acteur associé ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"cast\" AS ca ON ca.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" ORDER BY m.\"title\";"},{"question":"Quels acteurs jouent dans le film intitulé « Titanic » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.\"name\" FROM \"actor\" AS a JOIN \"cast\" AS ca ON ca.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" JOIN \"movie\" AS m ON m.\"mid\" = ca.\"msid\" WHERE m.\"title\" = 'Titanic';"},{"question":"Combien d'acteurs sont associés à chaque film ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"title\", DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films ont plus de trois acteurs associés ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"title\", COUNT(DISTINCT ca.\"aid\") AS \"nombre_acteurs\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"cast\" AS ca ON ca.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" GROUP BY m.\"mid\", m.\"title\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.\"aid\") > 3;"},{"question":"Quels acteurs apparaissent dans au moins deux films ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"name\", COUNT(DISTINCT ca.\"msid\") AS \"nombre_films\" FROM \"actor\" AS a JOIN \"cast\" AS ca ON ca.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" GROUP BY a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.\"msid\") >= 2 ORDER BY \"nombre_films\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films ont un acteur né avant 1930 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"cast\" AS ca ON ca.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" JOIN \"actor\" AS a ON a.\"aid\" = ca.\"aid\" WHERE a.\"birth_year\" < 1930;"},{"question":"Quels acteurs ne sont associés à aucun rôle ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"name\" FROM \"actor\" AS a LEFT JOIN \"cast\" AS ca ON ca.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" WHERE ca.\"aid\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen d'acteurs par film associé à la distribution ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(\"nombre_acteurs\") AS \"moyenne_acteurs_par_film\" FROM (SELECT \"msid\", COUNT(DISTINCT \"aid\") AS \"nombre_acteurs\" FROM \"cast\" GROUP BY \"msid\");"},{"question":"Quels numéros de rôle sont utilisés dans la distribution ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"role\" FROM \"cast\" WHERE \"role\" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY \"role\";"},{"question":"Quels films sont classés dans le genre « Action » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"classification\" AS cl ON cl.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" JOIN \"genre\" AS g ON g.\"gid\" = cl.\"gid\" WHERE LOWER(g.\"genre\") = 'action';"},{"question":"Combien de films sont associés à chaque genre ?","sql":"SELECT g.\"genre\", COUNT(DISTINCT cl.\"msid\") AS \"nombre_films\" FROM \"genre\" AS g JOIN \"classification\" AS cl ON cl.\"gid\" = g.\"gid\" JOIN \"movie\" AS m ON m.\"mid\" = cl.\"msid\" GROUP BY g.\"gid\", g.\"genre\" ORDER BY \"nombre_films\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels genres sont associés à au moins dix films ?","sql":"SELECT g.\"genre\", COUNT(DISTINCT cl.\"msid\") AS \"nombre_films\" FROM \"genre\" AS g JOIN \"classification\" AS cl ON cl.\"gid\" = g.\"gid\" GROUP BY g.\"gid\", g.\"genre\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.\"msid\") >= 10;"},{"question":"Quels films appartiennent à plusieurs genres ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"title\", COUNT(DISTINCT cl.\"gid\") AS \"nombre_genres\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"classification\" AS cl ON cl.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" GROUP BY m.\"mid\", m.\"title\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.\"gid\") > 1;"},{"question":"Quels genres ne sont associés à aucun film ?","sql":"SELECT g.\"genre\" FROM \"genre\" AS g LEFT JOIN \"classification\" AS cl ON cl.\"gid\" = g.\"gid\" WHERE cl.\"gid\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels films n'ont pas de classification ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m LEFT JOIN \"classification\" AS cl ON cl.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" WHERE cl.\"msid\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien de classifications existent par genre ?","sql":"SELECT g.\"genre\", COUNT(cl.\"id\") AS \"nombre_classifications\" FROM \"genre\" AS g LEFT JOIN \"classification\" AS cl ON cl.\"gid\" = g.\"gid\" GROUP BY g.\"gid\", g.\"genre\";"},{"question":"Quels films sont à la fois classés Action et Comedy ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"classification\" AS c1 ON c1.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" JOIN \"genre\" AS g1 ON g1.\"gid\" = c1.\"gid\" JOIN \"classification\" AS c2 ON c2.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" JOIN \"genre\" AS g2 ON g2.\"gid\" = c2.\"gid\" WHERE LOWER(g1.\"genre\") = 'action' AND LOWER(g2.\"genre\") = 'comedy';"},{"question":"Quels films sont associés à un réalisateur ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"directed_by\" AS db ON db.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\";"},{"question":"Quels réalisateurs ont dirigé au moins un film ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.\"name\" FROM \"director\" AS d JOIN \"directed_by\" AS db ON db.\"did\" = d.\"did\";"},{"question":"Combien de films chaque réalisateur a-t-il dirigés ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"name\", COUNT(DISTINCT db.\"msid\") AS \"nombre_films\" FROM \"director\" AS d JOIN \"directed_by\" AS db ON db.\"did\" = d.\"did\" GROUP BY d.\"did\", d.\"name\" ORDER BY \"nombre_films\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels réalisateurs ont dirigé plus de deux films ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"name\", COUNT(DISTINCT db.\"msid\") AS \"nombre_films\" FROM \"director\" AS d JOIN \"directed_by\" AS db ON db.\"did\" = d.\"did\" GROUP BY d.\"did\", d.\"name\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT db.\"msid\") > 2;"},{"question":"Quels films sont dirigés par un réalisateur né après 1975 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"directed_by\" AS db ON db.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" JOIN \"director\" AS d ON d.\"did\" = db.\"did\" WHERE d.\"birth_year\" > 1975;"},{"question":"Quels réalisateurs n'ont dirigé aucun film ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"name\" FROM \"director\" AS d LEFT JOIN \"directed_by\" AS db ON db.\"did\" = d.\"did\" WHERE db.\"did\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels films ont été dirigés par au moins deux réalisateurs ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"title\", COUNT(DISTINCT db.\"did\") AS \"nombre_realisateurs\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"directed_by\" AS db ON db.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" GROUP BY m.\"mid\", m.\"title\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT db.\"did\") >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels films ont été produits par au moins un producteur ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"made_by\" AS mb ON mb.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\";"},{"question":"Quels producteurs ont produit au moins un film ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.\"name\" FROM \"producer\" AS p JOIN \"made_by\" AS mb ON mb.\"pid\" = p.\"pid\";"},{"question":"Combien de films chaque producteur a-t-il produits ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"name\", COUNT(DISTINCT mb.\"msid\") AS \"nombre_films\" FROM \"producer\" AS p JOIN \"made_by\" AS mb ON mb.\"pid\" = p.\"pid\" GROUP BY p.\"pid\", p.\"name\" ORDER BY \"nombre_films\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels producteurs ont produit plus de trois films ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"name\", COUNT(DISTINCT mb.\"msid\") AS \"nombre_films\" FROM \"producer\" AS p JOIN \"made_by\" AS mb ON mb.\"pid\" = p.\"pid\" GROUP BY p.\"pid\", p.\"name\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mb.\"msid\") > 3;"},{"question":"Quels films ont été produits par une personne de nationalité française ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"made_by\" AS mb ON mb.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" JOIN \"producer\" AS p ON p.\"pid\" = mb.\"pid\" WHERE LOWER(p.\"nationality\") IN ('française', 'français', 'french');"},{"question":"Quels producteurs ne sont associés à aucun film ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"name\" FROM \"producer\" AS p LEFT JOIN \"made_by\" AS mb ON mb.\"pid\" = p.\"pid\" WHERE mb.\"pid\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels films ont à la fois un réalisateur et un producteur associés ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"directed_by\" AS db ON db.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" JOIN \"made_by\" AS mb ON mb.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\";"},{"question":"Quels films ont un scénariste associé ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"written_by\" AS wb ON wb.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\";"},{"question":"Quels scénaristes sont associés à au moins un film ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT w.\"name\" FROM \"writer\" AS w JOIN \"written_by\" AS wb ON wb.\"wid\" = w.\"wid\";"},{"question":"Combien de films chaque scénariste a-t-il écrits ?","sql":"SELECT w.\"name\", COUNT(DISTINCT wb.\"msid\") AS \"nombre_films\" FROM \"writer\" AS w JOIN \"written_by\" AS wb ON wb.\"wid\" = w.\"wid\" GROUP BY w.\"wid\", w.\"name\" ORDER BY \"nombre_films\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films ont plusieurs scénaristes ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"title\", COUNT(DISTINCT wb.\"wid\") AS \"nombre_scenaristes\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"written_by\" AS wb ON wb.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" GROUP BY m.\"mid\", m.\"title\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT wb.\"wid\") > 1;"},{"question":"Quels scénaristes ont écrit plus de deux films ?","sql":"SELECT w.\"name\", COUNT(DISTINCT wb.\"msid\") AS \"nombre_films\" FROM \"writer\" AS w JOIN \"written_by\" AS wb ON wb.\"wid\" = w.\"wid\" GROUP BY w.\"wid\", w.\"name\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT wb.\"msid\") > 2;"},{"question":"Quels films ont un scénariste né avant 1940 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"written_by\" AS wb ON wb.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" JOIN \"writer\" AS w ON w.\"wid\" = wb.\"wid\" WHERE w.\"birth_year\" < 1940;"},{"question":"Quels scénaristes ne sont associés à aucun film ?","sql":"SELECT w.\"name\" FROM \"writer\" AS w LEFT JOIN \"written_by\" AS wb ON wb.\"wid\" = w.\"wid\" WHERE wb.\"wid\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels films ont simultanément un acteur et un réalisateur associés ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"cast\" AS ca ON ca.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" JOIN \"directed_by\" AS db ON db.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\";"},{"question":"Quels films sont soit classés dans un genre, soit associés à un mot-clé dans les tags ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"msid\" FROM \"classification\" UNION SELECT DISTINCT \"msid\" FROM \"tags\";"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de médias ont à la fois une classification et un tag ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.\"msid\" FROM \"classification\" AS c INNER JOIN \"tags\" AS t ON t.\"msid\" = c.\"msid\";"},{"question":"Quels films ont un titre distinct de leur titre alternatif ?","sql":"SELECT \"title\", \"title_aka\" FROM \"movie\" WHERE \"title_aka\" IS NOT NULL AND \"title\" <> \"title_aka\";"},{"question":"Quels films sont plus anciens que la moyenne des années de sortie ?","sql":"SELECT \"title\", \"release_year\" FROM \"movie\" WHERE \"release_year\" < (SELECT AVG(\"release_year\") FROM \"movie\") ORDER BY \"release_year\";"},{"question":"Quels films ont la même année de sortie qu'au moins une série ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\", m.\"release_year\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"tv_series\" AS s ON s.\"release_year\" = m.\"release_year\";"},{"question":"Quelles années apparaissent à la fois pour les films et les séries ?","sql":"SELECT \"release_year\" FROM \"movie\" INTERSECT SELECT \"release_year\" FROM \"tv_series\" ORDER BY \"release_year\";"},{"question":"Quelles années de sortie concernent des films mais aucune série ?","sql":"SELECT \"release_year\" FROM \"movie\" EXCEPT SELECT \"release_year\" FROM \"tv_series\" ORDER BY \"release_year\";"},{"question":"Quels noms sont à la fois ceux d'un acteur et d'un réalisateur ?","sql":"SELECT \"name\" FROM \"actor\" INTERSECT SELECT \"name\" FROM \"director\" ORDER BY \"name\";"},{"question":"Quels noms apparaissent parmi les acteurs ou les producteurs, sans doublon ?","sql":"SELECT \"name\" FROM \"actor\" UNION SELECT \"name\" FROM \"producer\" ORDER BY \"name\";"},{"question":"Combien de médias différents possèdent au moins une classification ou un tag ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_medias\" FROM (SELECT \"msid\" FROM \"classification\" UNION SELECT \"msid\" FROM \"tags\");"},{"question":"Quels films sont associés à la fois à un acteur et à un genre ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"cast\" AS ca ON ca.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" JOIN \"classification\" AS cl ON cl.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\";"},{"question":"Quels films ont plus d'acteurs que la moyenne des films distribués ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"title\", COUNT(DISTINCT ca.\"aid\") AS \"nombre_acteurs\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"cast\" AS ca ON ca.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" GROUP BY m.\"mid\", m.\"title\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.\"aid\") > (SELECT AVG(\"nombre_acteurs\") FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT \"aid\") AS \"nombre_acteurs\" FROM \"cast\" GROUP BY \"msid\"));"},{"question":"Quels réalisateurs ont dirigé un film sorti après l'année moyenne de sortie ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.\"name\" FROM \"director\" AS d JOIN \"directed_by\" AS db ON db.\"did\" = d.\"did\" JOIN \"movie\" AS m ON m.\"mid\" = db.\"msid\" WHERE m.\"release_year\" > (SELECT AVG(\"release_year\") FROM \"movie\");"},{"question":"Quels producteurs ont la même nationalité qu'au moins un acteur ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.\"name\", p.\"nationality\" FROM \"producer\" AS p JOIN \"actor\" AS a ON a.\"nationality\" = p.\"nationality\";"},{"question":"Quels films ont été associés à plus d'une entreprise ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"title\", COUNT(DISTINCT cp.\"cid\") AS \"nombre_entreprises\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"copyright\" AS cp ON cp.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" GROUP BY m.\"mid\", m.\"title\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cp.\"cid\") > 1;"},{"question":"Quels médias sont présents dans copyright mais absents des films ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"msid\" FROM \"copyright\" EXCEPT SELECT \"mid\" FROM \"movie\";"},{"question":"Quels médias sont présents dans les films mais absents de copyright ?","sql":"SELECT \"mid\" FROM \"movie\" EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT \"msid\" FROM \"copyright\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne en épisodes des séries par année de sortie ?","sql":"SELECT \"release_year\", AVG(\"num_of_episodes\") AS \"moyenne_episodes\" FROM \"tv_series\" GROUP BY \"release_year\" ORDER BY \"release_year\";"},{"question":"Quelles séries ont plus de saisons que la moyenne des séries ?","sql":"SELECT \"title\", \"num_of_seasons\" FROM \"tv_series\" WHERE \"num_of_seasons\" > (SELECT AVG(\"num_of_seasons\") FROM \"tv_series\") ORDER BY \"num_of_seasons\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films ont le même titre qu'une série ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m INNER JOIN \"tv_series\" AS s ON s.\"title\" = m.\"title\";"},{"question":"Quels acteurs ont joué dans les films les plus récents ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.\"name\" FROM \"actor\" AS a JOIN \"cast\" AS ca ON ca.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" JOIN \"movie\" AS m ON m.\"mid\" = ca.\"msid\" WHERE m.\"release_year\" = (SELECT MAX(\"release_year\") FROM \"movie\");"},{"question":"Combien de classifications chaque film possède-t-il, y compris ceux sans classification ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"title\", COUNT(DISTINCT cl.\"gid\") AS \"nombre_genres\" FROM \"movie\" AS m LEFT JOIN \"classification\" AS cl ON cl.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" GROUP BY m.\"mid\", m.\"title\" ORDER BY \"nombre_genres\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels acteurs ont joué dans au moins un film classé dans chaque genre existant ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"name\" FROM \"actor\" AS a JOIN \"cast\" AS ca ON ca.\"aid\" = a.\"aid\" JOIN \"classification\" AS cl ON cl.\"msid\" = ca.\"msid\" GROUP BY a.\"aid\", a.\"name\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.\"gid\") = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM \"genre\");"},{"question":"Quels réalisateurs et producteurs partagent le même nom ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"name\" FROM \"director\" AS d INNER JOIN \"producer\" AS p ON p.\"name\" = d.\"name\" GROUP BY d.\"name\";"},{"question":"Quels films sont associés à un acteur dont la nationalité est renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"cast\" AS ca ON ca.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" JOIN \"actor\" AS a ON a.\"aid\" = ca.\"aid\" WHERE a.\"nationality\" IS NOT NULL AND a.\"nationality\" <> '';"},{"question":"Quels films ont au moins un acteur et aucun réalisateur associé ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"cast\" AS ca ON ca.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" LEFT JOIN \"directed_by\" AS db ON db.\"msid\" = m.\"mid\" WHERE db.\"msid\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels genres sont associés à des films sortis après 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT g.\"genre\" FROM \"genre\" AS g JOIN \"classification\" AS cl ON cl.\"gid\" = g.\"gid\" JOIN \"movie\" AS m ON m.\"mid\" = cl.\"msid\" WHERE m.\"release_year\" > 2020;"},{"question":"Quels films ont un nombre d'épisodes correspondant à celui d'une série ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"title\", s.\"title\" AS \"serie\" FROM \"movie\" AS m JOIN \"tv_series\" AS s ON CAST(m.\"budget\" AS INTEGER) = s.\"num_of_episodes\" WHERE m.\"budget\" GLOB '[0-9]*';"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles chambres ont une capacité maximale supérieure à la capacité maximale moyenne de toutes les chambres ?","sql":"SELECT "RoomId", "roomName", "maxOccupancy"
FROM "Rooms"
WHERE "maxOccupancy" > (SELECT AVG("maxOccupancy") FROM "Rooms");"},{"question":"Quelles réservations sont prévues entre le 1er juin 2024 et le 30 juin 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT "Code", "Room", "CheckIn", "CheckOut", "LastName", "FirstName"
FROM "Reservations"
WHERE "CheckIn" >= '2024-06-01'
  AND "CheckIn" < '2024-07-01'
ORDER BY "CheckIn";"},{"question":"Affiche le nom de la chambre et le tarif de chaque réservation, triés du tarif le plus élevé au plus faible.","sql":"SELECT r."Code", rm."roomName", r."Rate"
FROM "Reservations" AS r
JOIN "Rooms" AS rm ON rm."RoomId" = r."Room"
ORDER BY r."Rate" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de réservations chaque chambre a-t-elle reçues, y compris les chambres sans réservation ?","sql":"SELECT rm."RoomId", rm."roomName", COUNT(r."Code") AS "NombreReservations"
FROM "Rooms" AS rm
LEFT JOIN "Reservations" AS r ON r."Room" = rm."RoomId"
GROUP BY rm."RoomId", rm."roomName"
ORDER BY "NombreReservations" DESC, rm."RoomId";"},{"question":"Quel est le prix de base moyen pour chaque type de lit ?","sql":"SELECT "bedType", AVG("basePrice") AS "PrixBaseMoyen"
FROM "Rooms"
GROUP BY "bedType"
ORDER BY "PrixBaseMoyen" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles réservations concernent plus de personnes que la capacité maximale de leur chambre ?","sql":"SELECT r."Code", r."Room", r."Adults", r."Kids", rm."maxOccupancy"
FROM "Reservations" AS r
JOIN "Rooms" AS rm ON rm."RoomId" = r."Room"
WHERE r."Adults" + r."Kids" > rm."maxOccupancy";"},{"question":"Quelle est la réservation dont le tarif est le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT "Code", "Room", "Rate", "LastName", "FirstName"
FROM "Reservations"
WHERE "Rate" = (SELECT MAX("Rate") FROM "Reservations");"},{"question":"Quelles chambres n'ont jamais fait l'objet d'une réservation ?","sql":"SELECT rm."RoomId", rm."roomName"
FROM "Rooms" AS rm
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "Reservations" AS r
    WHERE r."Room" = rm."RoomId"
);"},{"question":"Combien de réservations ont commencé chaque mois ?","sql":"SELECT substr("CheckIn", 1, 7) AS "Mois", COUNT(*) AS "NombreReservations"
FROM "Reservations"
GROUP BY substr("CheckIn", 1, 7)
ORDER BY "Mois";"},{"question":"Quels décors de chambre sont associés à au moins deux chambres ?","sql":"SELECT "decor", COUNT(*) AS "NombreChambres"
FROM "Rooms"
GROUP BY "decor"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY "NombreChambres" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles chambres ont un tarif moyen de réservation supérieur à leur prix de base ?","sql":"SELECT rm."RoomId", rm."roomName", rm."basePrice", AVG(r."Rate") AS "TarifMoyen"
FROM "Rooms" AS rm
JOIN "Reservations" AS r ON r."Room" = rm."RoomId"
GROUP BY rm."RoomId", rm."roomName", rm."basePrice"
HAVING AVG(r."Rate") > rm."basePrice";"},{"question":"Quelles sont les cinq réservations accueillant le plus grand nombre total de personnes ?","sql":"SELECT "Code", "Room", "LastName", "FirstName", "Adults" + "Kids" AS "NombrePersonnes"
FROM "Reservations"
ORDER BY "NombrePersonnes" DESC, "Code"
LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Quelles réservations ont lieu entièrement pendant le mois de juillet 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT "Code", "Room", "CheckIn", "CheckOut", "LastName", "FirstName"
FROM "Reservations"
WHERE "CheckIn" >= '2024-07-01'
  AND "CheckOut" <= '2024-08-01'
ORDER BY "CheckIn";"},{"question":"Quelles chambres possèdent au moins deux lits ?","sql":"SELECT "RoomId", "roomName", "beds", "bedType", "maxOccupancy"
FROM "Rooms"
WHERE "beds" >= 2
ORDER BY "beds" DESC, "RoomId";"},{"question":"Quels clients portant le même nom ont effectué plusieurs réservations ?","sql":"SELECT "LastName", COUNT(*) AS "NombreReservations"
FROM "Reservations"
GROUP BY "LastName"
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY "NombreReservations" DESC, "LastName";"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de chambres ont soit un prix de base supérieur au prix moyen, soit une capacité maximale supérieure à 4 ?","sql":"SELECT "RoomId"
FROM "Rooms"
WHERE "basePrice" > (SELECT AVG("basePrice") FROM "Rooms")
UNION
SELECT "RoomId"
FROM "Rooms"
WHERE "maxOccupancy" > 4
ORDER BY "RoomId";"},{"question":"Quelles réservations ont un tarif supérieur au tarif moyen des réservations de leur propre chambre ?","sql":"SELECT r."Code", r."Room", r."Rate", r."LastName", r."FirstName"
FROM "Reservations" AS r
WHERE r."Rate" > (
    SELECT AVG(r2."Rate")
    FROM "Reservations" AS r2
    WHERE r2."Room" = r."Room"
)
ORDER BY r."Room", r."Rate" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total d'adultes et d'enfants par date d'arrivée ?","sql":"SELECT "CheckIn", SUM("Adults") AS "TotalAdultes", SUM("Kids") AS "TotalEnfants"
FROM "Reservations"
GROUP BY "CheckIn"
ORDER BY "CheckIn";"},{"question":"Quelles chambres ont à la fois un prix de base inférieur au prix moyen et une capacité maximale d'au moins quatre personnes ?","sql":"SELECT "RoomId", "roomName", "basePrice", "maxOccupancy"
FROM "Rooms"
WHERE "basePrice" < (SELECT AVG("basePrice") FROM "Rooms")
  AND "maxOccupancy" >= 4
ORDER BY "basePrice";"},{"question":"Quelle chambre compte le plus grand nombre de réservations ?","sql":"WITH "Comptage" AS (
    SELECT rm."RoomId", rm."roomName", COUNT(r."Code") AS "NombreReservations"
    FROM "Rooms" AS rm
    LEFT JOIN "Reservations" AS r ON r."Room" = rm."RoomId"
    GROUP BY rm."RoomId", rm."roomName"
)
SELECT "RoomId", "roomName", "NombreReservations"
FROM "Comptage"
WHERE "NombreReservations" = (SELECT MAX("NombreReservations") FROM "Comptage");"}]}

FROM Claim_Headers
GROUP BY Claim_Status_Code;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant moyen payé pour chaque type de sinistre ?","sql":"SELECT Claim_Type_Code, AVG(Amount_Piad) AS montant_moyen_paye
FROM Claim_Headers
GROUP BY Claim_Type_Code;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les polices avec les informations de leur client ?","sql":"SELECT p.Policy_ID, p.Policy_Type_Code, p.Start_Date, p.End_Date,
       c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Details
FROM Policies AS p
JOIN Customers AS c ON c.Customer_ID = p.Customer_ID;"},{"question":"Quels sinistres ne possèdent encore aucun document ?","sql":"SELECT ch.Claim_Header_ID, ch.Claim_Status_Code, ch.Date_of_Claim
FROM Claim_Headers AS ch
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Claims_Documents AS cd
    WHERE cd.Claim_ID = ch.Claim_Header_ID
);"},{"question":"Quels traitements indiquent leur étape et le statut associé à cette étape ?","sql":"SELECT cp.Claim_Processing_ID, cp.Claim_ID, cp.Claim_Outcome_Code,
       cps.Claim_Stage_ID, cps.Claim_Status_Name
FROM Claims_Processing AS cp
JOIN Claims_Processing_Stages AS cps
  ON cps.Claim_Stage_ID = cp.Claim_Stage_ID;"},{"question":"Combien de traitements chaque membre du personnel a-t-il effectués ?","sql":"SELECT s.Staff_ID, s.Staff_Details, COUNT(cp.Claim_Processing_ID) AS nombre_traitements
FROM Staff AS s
LEFT JOIN Claims_Processing AS cp ON cp.Staff_ID = s.Staff_ID
GROUP BY s.Staff_ID, s.Staff_Details;"},{"question":"Quel est le délai moyen, en jours, entre la déclaration et le règlement des sinistres réglés ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(julianday(Date_of_Settlement) - julianday(Date_of_Claim)) AS delai_moyen_jours
FROM Claim_Headers
WHERE Date_of_Claim IS NOT NULL
  AND Date_of_Settlement IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Combien de polices chaque client possède-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Details, COUNT(p.Policy_ID) AS nombre_polices
FROM Customers AS c
LEFT JOIN Policies AS p ON p.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID
GROUP BY c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Details;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total réclamé et payé pour chaque police ?","sql":"SELECT p.Policy_ID,
       COALESCE(SUM(ch.Amount_Claimed), 0) AS total_reclame,
       COALESCE(SUM(ch.Amount_Piad), 0) AS total_paye
FROM Policies AS p
LEFT JOIN Claim_Headers AS ch ON ch.Policy_ID = p.Policy_ID
GROUP BY p.Policy_ID;"},{"question":"Combien de documents de chaque type ont été créés ?","sql":"SELECT Document_Type_Code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_documents
FROM Claims_Documents
GROUP BY Document_Type_Code;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant réclamé maximal pour chaque statut de sinistre ?","sql":"SELECT Claim_Status_Code, MAX(Amount_Claimed) AS montant_reclame_maximal
FROM Claim_Headers
GROUP BY Claim_Status_Code;"},{"question":"Quels sinistres ont un montant réclamé supérieur à la moyenne de tous les sinistres ?","sql":"SELECT Claim_Header_ID, Policy_ID, Amount_Claimed
FROM Claim_Headers
WHERE Amount_Claimed > (
    SELECT AVG(Amount_Claimed)
    FROM Claim_Headers
);"},{"question":"Quelles polices n'ont encore aucun sinistre ?","sql":"SELECT p.Policy_ID, p.Policy_Type_Code, p.Customer_ID
FROM Policies AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Claim_Headers AS ch
    WHERE ch.Policy_ID = p.Policy_ID
);"},{"question":"Quels sont les différents résultats de traitement enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Outcome_Code
FROM Claims_Processing
ORDER BY Claim_Outcome_Code;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les étapes et leurs éventuelles étapes suivantes ?","sql":"SELECT s.Claim_Stage_ID,
       s.Claim_Status_Name,
       s.Next_Claim_Stage_ID,
       n.Claim_Status_Name AS prochain_statut
FROM Claims_Processing_Stages AS s
LEFT JOIN Claims_Processing_Stages AS n
  ON n.Claim_Stage_ID = s.Next_Claim_Stage_ID;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total payé pour les sinistres de chaque client ?","sql":"SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Details,
       COALESCE(SUM(ch.Amount_Piad), 0) AS total_paye
FROM Customers AS c
LEFT JOIN Policies AS p ON p.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID
LEFT JOIN Claim_Headers AS ch ON ch.Policy_ID = p.Policy_ID
GROUP BY c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Details;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont été créés par un membre du personnel, avec les détails de ce dernier ?","sql":"SELECT cd.Claim_ID, cd.Document_Type_Code, cd.Created_Date,
       s.Staff_ID, s.Staff_Details
FROM Claims_Documents AS cd
JOIN Staff AS s ON s.Staff_ID = cd.Created_by_Staff_ID;"},{"question":"Combien de sinistres ont été déclarés chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', Date_of_Claim) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_sinistres
FROM Claim_Headers
WHERE Date_of_Claim IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', Date_of_Claim)
ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Pour chaque sinistre, quelle est la différence entre le montant réclamé et le montant payé ?","sql":"SELECT Claim_Header_ID, Amount_Claimed, Amount_Piad,
       Amount_Claimed - Amount_Piad AS difference_montants
FROM Claim_Headers;"},{"question":"Quel est le sinistre le plus récent de chaque police ?","sql":"SELECT ch.Claim_Header_ID, ch.Policy_ID, ch.Date_of_Claim, ch.Claim_Status_Code
FROM Claim_Headers AS ch
WHERE ch.Date_of_Claim = (
    SELECT MAX(ch2.Date_of_Claim)
    FROM Claim_Headers AS ch2
    WHERE ch2.Policy_ID = ch.Policy_ID
);"},{"question":"Quels clients ont au moins une police et au moins un sinistre ?","sql":"SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Details
FROM Customers AS c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Policies AS p
    WHERE p.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Policies AS p
    JOIN Claim_Headers AS ch ON ch.Policy_ID = p.Policy_ID
    WHERE p.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID
);"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de sinistre apparaissent soit dans les documents, soit dans les traitements ?","sql":"SELECT Claim_ID
FROM Claims_Documents
UNION
SELECT Claim_ID
FROM Claims_Processing
ORDER BY Claim_ID;"},{"question":"Combien de traitements ont été enregistrés par sinistre ?","sql":"SELECT ch.Claim_Header_ID, COUNT(cp.Claim_Processing_ID) AS nombre_traitements
FROM Claim_Headers AS ch
LEFT JOIN Claims_Processing AS cp ON cp.Claim_ID = ch.Claim_Header_ID
GROUP BY ch.Claim_Header_ID;"},{"question":"Quels sinistres n'ont pas encore été réglés ?","sql":"SELECT Claim_Header_ID, Policy_ID, Claim_Status_Code, Amount_Claimed
FROM Claim_Headers
WHERE Date_of_Settlement IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels types de sinistre représentent plus de deux déclarations ?","sql":"SELECT Claim_Type_Code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_sinistres
FROM Claim_Headers
GROUP BY Claim_Type_Code
HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;"},{"question":"Quels clients n'ont aucune police enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Details
FROM Customers AS c
LEFT JOIN Policies AS p ON p.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID
WHERE p.Policy_ID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles étapes de traitement ne sont utilisées par aucun traitement ?","sql":"SELECT cps.Claim_Stage_ID, cps.Claim_Status_Name
FROM Claims_Processing_Stages AS cps
LEFT JOIN Claims_Processing AS cp
  ON cp.Claim_Stage_ID = cps.Claim_Stage_ID
WHERE cp.Claim_Processing_ID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels sinistres ont été déclarés au cours de l'année 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT Claim_Header_ID, Policy_ID, Date_of_Claim, Amount_Claimed
FROM Claim_Headers
WHERE Date_of_Claim >= '2023-01-01'
  AND Date_of_Claim < '2024-01-01';"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel ont traité au moins un sinistre, avec le nombre de sinistres concernés ?","sql":"SELECT s.Staff_ID, s.Staff_Details,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_ID) AS nombre_sinistres_traites
FROM Staff AS s
JOIN Claims_Processing AS cp ON cp.Staff_ID = s.Staff_ID
GROUP BY s.Staff_ID, s.Staff_Details;"},{"question":"Quels sinistres possèdent plusieurs documents ?","sql":"SELECT ch.Claim_Header_ID, COUNT(cd.Document_Type_Code) AS nombre_documents
FROM Claim_Headers AS ch
JOIN Claims_Documents AS cd ON cd.Claim_ID = ch.Claim_Header_ID
GROUP BY ch.Claim_Header_ID
HAVING COUNT(cd.Document_Type_Code) > 1;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée en jours de chaque police entre sa date de début et sa date de fin ?","sql":"SELECT Policy_ID, Policy_Type_Code,
       julianday(End_Date) - julianday(Start_Date) AS duree_jours
FROM Policies
WHERE Start_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND End_Date IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels sinistres ont été payés au-dessus de la moyenne des paiements de leur type ?","sql":"SELECT ch.Claim_Header_ID, ch.Claim_Type_Code, ch.Amount_Piad
FROM Claim_Headers AS ch
WHERE ch.Amount_Piad > (
    SELECT AVG(ch2.Amount_Piad)
    FROM Claim_Headers AS ch2
    WHERE ch2.Claim_Type_Code = ch.Claim_Type_Code
);"},{"question":"Quels sinistres n'ont jamais fait l'objet d'un traitement ?","sql":"SELECT ch.Claim_Header_ID, ch.Policy_ID, ch.Claim_Status_Code
FROM Claim_Headers AS ch
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Claims_Processing AS cp
    WHERE cp.Claim_ID = ch.Claim_Header_ID
);"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de documents et de traitements pour chaque sinistre ?","sql":"SELECT ch.Claim_Header_ID,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cd.Document_Type_Code) AS nombre_documents,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Processing_ID) AS nombre_traitements
FROM Claim_Headers AS ch
LEFT JOIN Claims_Documents AS cd ON cd.Claim_ID = ch.Claim_Header_ID
LEFT JOIN Claims_Processing AS cp ON cp.Claim_ID = ch.Claim_Header_ID
GROUP BY ch.Claim_Header_ID;"},{"question":"Quelles polices ont une date de fin antérieure à la date du sinistre ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.Policy_ID, p.End_Date, ch.Claim_Header_ID, ch.Date_of_Claim
FROM Policies AS p
JOIN Claim_Headers AS ch ON ch.Policy_ID = p.Policy_ID
WHERE p.End_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND ch.Date_of_Claim IS NOT NULL
  AND p.End_Date < ch.Date_of_Claim;"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel ont créé des documents mais n'ont effectué aucun traitement ?","sql":"SELECT s.Staff_ID, s.Staff_Details
FROM Staff AS s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Claims_Documents AS cd
    WHERE cd.Created_by_Staff_ID = s.Staff_ID
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Claims_Processing AS cp
    WHERE cp.Staff_ID = s.Staff_ID
);"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total réclamé par type de police ?","sql":"SELECT p.Policy_Type_Code,
       SUM(ch.Amount_Claimed) AS total_reclame
FROM Policies AS p
JOIN Claim_Headers AS ch ON ch.Policy_ID = p.Policy_ID
GROUP BY p.Policy_Type_Code;"},{"question":"Quels sinistres ont à la fois un document et un traitement associé ?","sql":"SELECT ch.Claim_Header_ID, ch.Claim_Status_Code
FROM Claim_Headers AS ch
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Claims_Documents AS cd
    WHERE cd.Claim_ID = ch.Claim_Header_ID
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Claims_Processing AS cp
    WHERE cp.Claim_ID = ch.Claim_Header_ID
);"}]}

ap.Policy_ID;"},{"question":"Combien d'indemnisations ont été enregistrées pour chaque année d'effet ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', Effective_Date) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_d_indemnisations FROM HAVING COUNT(f.FNOL_ID) = (SELECT MAX(nombre) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre FROM First_Notification_of_Loss GROUP BY Service_ID) AS comptages);"},{"question":"Combien de polices y a-t-il pour chaque type de police ?","sql":"SELECT policy_type_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_polices FROM Available_Policies GROUP BY policy_type_code ORDER BY nombre_de_polices DESC, policy_type_code;"},{"question":"Quels sont les sinistres avec le nom du client concerné et leur date d'effet ?","sql":"SELECT cl.Claim_ID, c.Customer_name, cl.Effective_Date FROM Claims AS cl JOIN comprises entre 1 000 et 5 000 inclus ?","sql":"SELECT Settlement_ID, Claim_ID, Settlement_Amount FROM Settlements WHERE Settlement_Amount BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 ORDER BY Settlement_Amount, Settlement_ID;"},{"question":"Quelles polices ont été clôturées après leur date d'ouverture ?","sql":"SELECT Policy_ID, Customer_ID, Date_Opened, Date_Closed FROM Customers_Policies WHERE Date_Closed IS NOT NULL AND Date_Opened IS NOT NULL AND Date_Closed > Date_Opened ORDER BY Date_Closed;"},{"question":"Quelles déclarations de sinistre ne sont liées à aucun sinistre enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT f.FNOL_ID, f.Customer_ID, f.Policy_ID, f.Service_ID FROM First_Notification_of_Loss AS f LEFT JOIN Claims AS cl ON cl.FNOL_ID = f.FNOL_ID WHERE cl.Claim_ID IS NULL ORDER BY f.FNOL_ID;"},{"question":"Pour chaque client, combien y a-t-il de déclarations et quel est le montant total indemnisé ?","sql":"SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FNOL_ID) AS nombre_de_declarations, COALESCE(SUM(s.Settlement_Amount), 0) AS total_indemnise FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN First_Notification_of_Loss AS f ON f.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID LEFT JOIN Claims AS cl ON cl.FNOL_ID = f.FNOL_ID LEFT JOIN Settlements AS s ON s.Claim_ID = cl.Claim_ID GROUP BY c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_name ORDER BY total_indemnise DESC, c.Customer_name;"},{"question":"Pour chaque sinistre, quel est son statut d'indemnisation ?","sql":"SELECT cl.Claim_ID, CASE WHEN COUNT(s.Settlement_ID) = 0 THEN 'Non indemnisé' ELSE 'Indemnisé' END AS statut_indemnisation, COALESCE(SUM(s.Settlement_Amount), 0) AS montant_total FROM Claims AS cl LEFT JOIN Settlements AS s ON s.Claim_ID = cl.Claim_ID GROUP BY cl.Claim_ID ORDER BY cl.Claim_ID;"},{"question":"Quels clients détiennent plusieurs polices ?","sql":"SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_name, COUNT(cp.Policy_ID) AS nombre_de_polices FROM Customers AS c JOIN Customers_Policies AS cp ON cp.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID GROUP BY c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_name HAVING COUNT(cp.Policy_ID) > 1 ORDER BY nombre_de_polices DESC, c.Customer_name;"},{"question":"Quelles déclarations sont associées à un sinistre et à quel service ont-elles été adressées ?","sql":"SELECT f.FNOL_ID, cl.Claim_ID, s.Service_name, cl.Effective_Date FROM First_Notification_of_Loss AS f JOIN Claims AS cl ON cl.FNOL_ID = f.FNOL_ID JOIN Services AS s ON s.Service_ID = f.Service_ID ORDER BY cl.Effective_Date;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont déclaré au moins un sinistre mais n'ont reçu aucune indemnisation ?","sql":"SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_name FROM Customers AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM First_Notification_of_Loss AS f JOIN Claims AS cl ON cl.FNOL_ID = f.FNOL_ID WHERE f.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM First_Notification_of_Loss AS f2 JOIN Claims AS cl2 ON cl2.FNOL_ID = f2.FNOL_ID JOIN Settlements AS s ON s.Claim_ID = cl2.Claim_ID WHERE f2.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID) ORDER BY c.Customer_name;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles polices étaient encore en vigueur au 1er janvier 2022 ?","sql":"SELECT Policy_ID, Customer_ID, Policy_Type_Code
FROM Customer_Policies
WHERE Start_Date <= '2022-01-01'
  AND (End_Date IS NULL OR End_Date >= '2022-01-01');"},{"question":"Quels sinistres présentent un montant réglé inférieur au montant réclamé ?","sql":"SELECT Claim_ID, Policy_ID, Amount_Claimed, Amount_Settled
FROM Claims

JOIN Customer_Policies AS p ON p.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID
WHERE p.Policy_Type_Code = 'habitation';"},{"question":"Combien de polices existe-t-il pour chaque type de police ?","sql":"SELECT Policy_Type_Code, COUNT(*) AS Nombre_de_polices
FROM Customer_Policies
GROUP BY Policy_Type_Code
ORDER BY Nombre_de_polices DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total réclamé pour chaque police ?","sql":"SELECT p.Policy_ID, COALESCE(SUM(c.Amount_Claimed), 0) AS Total_reclame
FROM Customer_Policies AS p
LEFT JOIN Claims AS c ON c.Policy_ID = p.Policy_ID
GROUP BY p.Policy_ID

JOIN Payments AS p ON p.Settlement_ID = s.Settlement_ID
GROUP BY s.Settlement_ID, s.Claim_ID;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des paiements associés à chaque règlement ?","sql":"SELECT s.Settlement_ID, COALESCE(SUM(p.Amount_Payment), 0) AS Total_paiements
FROM Settlements AS s
LEFT JOIN Payments AS p ON p.Settlement_ID = s.Settlement_ID
