FROM Claims AS c
LEFT JOIN Settlements AS s ON s.Claim_ID = c.Claim_ID
WHERE s.Settlement_ID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles polices n'ont donné lieu à aucun sinistre ?","sql":"SELECT p.Policy_ID, p.Customer_ID, p.Policy_Type_Code
FROM Customer_Policies AS p
LEFT JOIN Claims AS c ON c.Policy_ID = p.Policy_ID
WHERE c.Claim_ID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien de polices chaque client possède-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Details, COUNT(p.Policy_ID) AS Nombre_de_polices
FROM Customers AS c
LEFT JOIN Customer_Policies AS p ON p.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID
GROUP BY c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Details
ORDER BY Nombre_de_polices DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les montants moyens réclamé et réglé par type de police ?","sql":"SELECT p.Policy_Type_Code,
       AVG(c.Amount_Claimed) AS Montant_moyen_reclame,
       AVG(c.Amount_Settled) AS Montant_moyen_regle
FROM Customer_Policies AS p
JOIN Claims AS c ON c.Policy_ID = p.Policy_ID
GROUP BY p.Policy_Type_Code;"},{"question":"Combien de jours s'écoulent en moyenne entre la déclaration et le règlement des sinistres ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(julianday(Date_Claim_Settled) - julianday(Date_Claim_Made)) AS Delai_moyen_jours
FROM Claims
WHERE Date_Claim_Made IS NOT NULL
  AND Date_Claim_Settled IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le sinistre dont le montant réclamé est le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT Claim_ID, Policy_ID, Amount_Claimed
FROM Claims
WHERE Amount_Claimed = (SELECT MAX(Amount_Claimed) FROM Claims);"},{"question":"Quels modes de paiement ont été utilisés et pour quels montants totaux ?","sql":"SELECT Payment_Method_Code, COUNT(*) AS Nombre_de_paiements,
       SUM(Amount_Payment) AS Total_paye
FROM Payments
GROUP BY Payment_Method_Code
ORDER BY Total_paye DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles polices ont commencé après le 1er janvier 2020 et se terminent avant le 31 décembre 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT Policy_ID, Customer_ID, Policy_Type_Code, Start_Date, End_Date
FROM Customer_Policies
WHERE Start_Date > '2020-01-01'
  AND End_Date < '2023-12-31';"},{"question":"Quels sinistres ont un montant réclamé supérieur à la moyenne de tous les sinistres ?","sql":"SELECT Claim_ID, Policy_ID, Amount_Claimed
FROM Claims
WHERE Amount_Claimed > (SELECT AVG(Amount_Claimed) FROM Claims)
ORDER BY Amount_Claimed DESC;"},{"question":"Quels règlements ont un montant réglé différent de celui du sinistre correspondant ?","sql":"SELECT s.Settlement_ID, s.Claim_ID,
       c.Amount_Settled AS Montant_sinistre,
       s.Amount_Settled AS Montant_reglement
FROM Settlements AS s
JOIN Claims AS c ON c.Claim_ID = s.Claim_ID
WHERE s.Amount_Settled <> c.Amount_Settled;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont déclaré au moins un sinistre ?","sql":"SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Details
FROM Customers AS c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Customer_Policies AS p
    JOIN Claims AS cl ON cl.Policy_ID = p.Policy_ID
    WHERE p.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID
);"},{"question":"Quels sinistres sont liés à au moins un paiement par l'intermédiaire d'un règlement ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.Claim_ID, c.Policy_ID
FROM Claims AS c
JOIN Settlements AS s ON s.Claim_ID = c.Claim_ID
JOIN Payments AS p ON p.Settlement_ID = s.Settlement_ID;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de police apparaissent dans les polices ou dans les sinistres ?","sql":"SELECT Policy_ID FROM Customer_Policies
UNION
SELECT Policy_ID FROM Claims
ORDER BY Policy_ID;"},{"question":"Combien de sinistres ont été déclarés chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', Date_Claim_Made) AS Annee,
       COUNT(*) AS Nombre_de_sinistres
FROM Claims
WHERE Date_Claim_Made IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', Date_Claim_Made)
ORDER BY Annee;"},{"question":"Quels règlements ont reçu des paiements dont le total dépasse leur montant réglé ?","sql":"SELECT s.Settlement_ID, s.Amount_Settled,
       SUM(p.Amount_Payment) AS Total_paiements
FROM Settlements AS s
JOIN Payments AS p ON p.Settlement_ID = s.Settlement_ID
GROUP BY s.Settlement_ID, s.Amount_Settled
HAVING SUM(p.Amount_Payment) > s.Amount_Settled;"},{"question":"Quels clients possèdent plus de polices que la moyenne des clients ?","sql":"SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Details, COUNT(p.Policy_ID) AS Nombre_de_polices
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Customer_Policies AS p ON p.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID
GROUP BY c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Details
HAVING COUNT(p.Policy_ID) > (
    SELECT AVG(Nombre_de_polices)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS Nombre_de_polices
        FROM Customer_Policies
        GROUP BY Customer_ID
    )
);"},{"question":"Quel est le taux moyen de règlement des sinistres par type de police, calculé comme montant réglé divisé par montant réclamé ?","sql":"SELECT p.Policy_Type_Code,
       AVG(CAST(c.Amount_Settled AS REAL) / NULLIF(c.Amount_Claimed, 0)) AS Taux_moyen_reglement
FROM Customer_Policies AS p
JOIN Claims AS c ON c.Policy_ID = p.Policy_ID
GROUP BY p.Policy_Type_Code;"},{"question":"Quelles polices ont fait l'objet de plusieurs sinistres ?","sql":"SELECT p.Policy_ID, p.Customer_ID, COUNT(c.Claim_ID) AS Nombre_de_sinistres
FROM Customer_Policies AS p
JOIN Claims AS c ON c.Policy_ID = p.Policy_ID
GROUP BY p.Policy_ID, p.Customer_ID
HAVING COUNT(c.Claim_ID) > 1;"},{"question":"Quels règlements ne disposent d'aucun paiement enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT s.Settlement_ID, s.Claim_ID, s.Amount_Settled
FROM Settlements AS s
LEFT JOIN Payments AS p ON p.Settlement_ID = s.Settlement_ID
WHERE p.Payment_ID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels sinistres ont été réglés après la date de fin de leur police ?","sql":"SELECT c.Claim_ID, c.Policy_ID, c.Date_Claim_Settled, p.End_Date
FROM Claims AS c
JOIN Customer_Policies AS p ON p.Policy_ID = c.Policy_ID
WHERE c.Date_Claim_Settled IS NOT NULL
  AND p.End_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND c.Date_Claim_Settled > p.End_Date;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total réclamé par client ?","sql":"SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Details,
       SUM(cl.Amount_Claimed) AS Total_reclame
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Customer_Policies AS p ON p.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID
JOIN Claims AS cl ON cl.Policy_ID = p.Policy_ID
GROUP BY c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Details
ORDER BY Total_reclame DESC;"},{"question":"Quels paiements ne sont associés à aucun règlement existant ?","sql":"SELECT p.Payment_ID, p.Settlement_ID, p.Amount_Payment
FROM Payments AS p
LEFT JOIN Settlements AS s ON s.Settlement_ID = p.Settlement_ID
WHERE s.Settlement_ID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels règlements concernent un sinistre absent de la table des sinistres ?","sql":"SELECT s.Settlement_ID, s.Claim_ID, s.Amount_Claimed
FROM Settlements AS s
LEFT JOIN Claims AS c ON c.Claim_ID = s.Claim_ID
WHERE c.Claim_ID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels sinistres ont été déclarés mais ne sont toujours pas réglés à la date du 31 décembre 2022 ?","sql":"SELECT Claim_ID, Policy_ID, Date_Claim_Made
FROM Claims
WHERE Date_Claim_Made <= '2022-12-31'
  AND (Date_Claim_Settled IS NULL OR Date_Claim_Settled > '2022-12-31');"},{"question":"Quelles polices ont uniquement des sinistres réglés, lorsqu'elles ont au moins un sinistre ?","sql":"SELECT p.Policy_ID, p.Customer_ID
FROM Customer_Policies AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Claims AS c WHERE c.Policy_ID = p.Policy_ID
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Claims AS c
    WHERE c.Policy_ID = p.Policy_ID
      AND (c.Date_Claim_Settled IS NULL OR c.Amount_Settled IS NULL)
);"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de paiements et leur montant moyen pour chaque règlement ?","sql":"SELECT Settlement_ID,
       COUNT(*) AS Nombre_de_paiements,
       AVG(Amount_Payment) AS Montant_moyen_paiement
FROM Payments
GROUP BY Settlement_ID
ORDER BY Settlement_ID;"},{"question":"Quels clients n'ont aucune police enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Details
FROM Customers AS c
LEFT JOIN Customer_Policies AS p ON p.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID
WHERE p.Policy_ID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des sinistres par année de règlement ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', Date_Claim_Settled) AS Annee,
       SUM(Amount_Settled) AS Total_regle
FROM Claims
WHERE Date_Claim_Settled IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', Date_Claim_Settled)
ORDER BY Annee;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels éditeurs sont plus âgés que l’âge moyen de tous les éditeurs ?","sql":"SELECT "Editor_ID", "Name", "Age"
FROM "editor"
WHERE "Age" > (SELECT AVG("Age") FROM "editor")
ORDER BY "Age" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels journaux ont réalisé au moins 1 000 ventes, classés du plus vendu au moins vendu ?","sql":"SELECT "Journal_ID", "Date", "Theme", "Sales"
FROM "journal"
WHERE "Sales" >= 1000
ORDER BY "Sales" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien d’éditeurs siègent au comité de chaque journal, y compris les journaux sans éditeur ?","sql":"SELECT j."Journal_ID", j."Theme", COUNT(jc."Editor_ID") AS "Nombre_editeurs"
FROM "journal" AS j
LEFT JOIN "journal_committee" AS jc
  ON jc."Journal_ID" = j."Journal_ID"
GROUP BY j."Journal_ID", j."Theme"
ORDER BY "Nombre_editeurs" DESC, j."Journal_ID";"},{"question":"Quels éditeurs n’ont participé à aucun journal ?","sql":"SELECT e."Editor_ID", e."Name", e."Age"
FROM "editor" AS e
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "journal_committee" AS jc
    WHERE jc."Editor_ID" = e."Editor_ID"
)
ORDER BY e."Name";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de ventes des journaux pour chaque type de travail ?","sql":"SELECT jc."Work_Type", AVG(j."Sales") AS "Ventes_moyennes"
FROM "journal_committee" AS jc
JOIN "journal" AS j
  ON j."Journal_ID" = jc."Journal_ID"
GROUP BY jc."Work_Type"
ORDER BY "Ventes_moyennes" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels journaux ont plus d’éditeurs au comité que la moyenne des journaux représentés dans le comité ?","sql":"SELECT j."Journal_ID", j."Theme", COUNT(jc."Editor_ID") AS "Nombre_editeurs"
FROM "journal" AS j
JOIN "journal_committee" AS jc
  ON jc."Journal_ID" = j."Journal_ID"
GROUP BY j."Journal_ID", j."Theme"
HAVING COUNT(jc."Editor_ID") > (
    SELECT AVG("Nombre_editeurs")
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_editeurs"
        FROM "journal_committee"
        GROUP BY "Journal_ID"
    )
)
ORDER BY "Nombre_editeurs" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels éditeurs ont travaillé sur des journaux dont le thème est « Science » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT e."Editor_ID", e."Name"
FROM "editor" AS e
JOIN "journal_committee" AS jc
  ON jc."Editor_ID" = e."Editor_ID"
JOIN "journal" AS j
  ON j."Journal_ID" = jc."Journal_ID"
WHERE j."Theme" = 'Science'
ORDER BY e."Name";"},{"question":"Quels journaux sont soit associés à un éditeur de moins de 30 ans, soit au-dessus de la moyenne des ventes ?","sql":"SELECT j."Journal_ID", j."Theme"
FROM "journal" AS j
JOIN "journal_committee" AS jc
  ON jc."Journal_ID" = j."Journal_ID"
JOIN "editor" AS e
  ON e."Editor_ID" = jc."Editor_ID"
WHERE e."Age" < 30
UNION
SELECT "Journal_ID", "Theme"
FROM "journal"
WHERE "Sales" > (SELECT AVG("Sales") FROM "journal")
ORDER BY "Journal_ID";"},{"question":"Quels éditeurs ont participé au plus grand nombre de journaux ?","sql":"SELECT e."Editor_ID", e."Name", COUNT(jc."Journal_ID") AS "Nombre_journaux"
FROM "editor" AS e
JOIN "journal_committee" AS jc
  ON jc."Editor_ID" = e."Editor_ID"
GROUP BY e."Editor_ID", e."Name"
HAVING COUNT(jc."Journal_ID") = (
    SELECT MAX("Nombre_journaux")
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_journaux"
        FROM "journal_committee"
        GROUP BY "Editor_ID"
    )
)
ORDER BY e."Name";"}]}

l.loan_ID) AS nombre_prets FROM bank AS b LEFT JOIN customer AS c ON c.branch_ID = b.branch_ID LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.branch_ID = b.branch_ID GROUP BY b.branch_ID, b.bname;"},{"question":"Quelles agences ont un nombre de clients différent du nombre déclaré dans bank ?","sql":"SELECT b.branch_ID, b.bname, b.no_of_customers, COUNT(c.cust_ID) AS nombre_observe FROM bank AS b LEFT JOIN customer AS SUM(l.amount) AS total_prets, AVG(l.amount) AS montant_moyen FROM customer AS c JOIN loan AS l ON l.cust_ID = c.cust_ID GROUP BY c.cust_ID, c.cust_name;"},{"question":"Quelles agences ont au moins un client mais aucun prêt enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT b.branch_ID, b.bname FROM bank AS b WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer AS c WHERE c.branch_ID = b.branch_ID) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan AS c.branch_ID, c.acc_bal FROM customer AS c WHERE c.acc_bal >= ALL (SELECT c2.acc_bal FROM customer AS c2 WHERE c2.branch_ID = c.branch_ID AND c2.cust_ID <> c.cust_ID);"},{"question":"Quels types de prêts concernent au moins deux clients distincts ?","sql":"SELECT loan_type, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_ID) AS nombre_clients FROM loan GROUP BY loan_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cust_ID) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quel est le classement des agences selon le montant total de leurs prêts ?","sql":"SELECT b.branch_ID, b.bname, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_prets FROM bank AS b LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.branch_ID = b.branch_ID GROUP BY b.branch_ID, b.bname ORDER BY total_prets DESC, b.branch_ID;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un score de crédit inférieur au score moyen de leur État ?","sql":"SELECT c.cust_ID, c.cust_name, c.state, c.credit_score FROM customer AS c WHERE c.credit_score < (SELECT AVG(c2.credit_score) FROM customer AS c2 WHERE c2.state = le prêt le plus élevé de toute la base et quel client l'a contracté ?","sql":"SELECT l.loan_ID, l.loan_type, l.amount, c.cust_ID, c.cust_name FROM loan AS l JOIN customer AS c ON c.cust_ID = l.cust_ID TEXT) FROM bank;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles propriétés comptent au moins un résident, et combien de résidents y sont actuellement ou ont été enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT p.property_id, p.property_address, COUNT(r.resident_id) AS nombre_de_residents
FROM Properties AS p
JOIN Residents AS r ON r.property_id = p.property_id
GROUP BY p.property_id, p.property_address
ORDER BY nombre_de_residents DESC;"},{"question":"Quels services n'ont encore jamais été demandés par un résident ?","sql":"SELECT s.service_id, s.service_type_code, s.service_details
FROM Services AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Residents_Services AS rs
    WHERE rs.service_id = s.service_id
)
ORDER BY s.service_id;"},{"question":"Pour chaque organisation, combien de choses lui sont associées, y compris celles qui n'en ont aucune ?","sql":"SELECT o.organization_id, o.organization_details, COUNT(t.thing_id) AS nombre_de_choses
FROM Organizations AS o
LEFT JOIN Things AS t ON t.organization_id = o.organization_id
GROUP BY o.organization_id, o.organization_details
ORDER BY nombre_de_choses DESC, o.organization_id;"},{"question":"Quels événements sont associés à un client, avec les informations du client et l'adresse de la propriété concernée ?","sql":"SELECT e.Customer_Event_ID, c.customer_id, c.customer_details, p.property_id, p.property_address, e.date_moved_in
FROM Customer_Events AS e
JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = e.customer_id
LEFT JOIN Properties AS p ON p.property_id = e.property_id
ORDER BY e.Customer_Event_ID;"},{"question":"Quels résidents ont demandé un service qui n'a pas encore été fourni ?","sql":"SELECT rs.resident_id, rs.property_id, rs.date_moved_in, rs.service_id, rs.date_requested
FROM Residents_Services AS rs
WHERE rs.date_requested IS NOT NULL
  AND rs.date_provided IS NULL
ORDER BY rs.date_requested;"},{"question":"Quelle était la dernière localisation enregistrée pour chaque chose ?","sql":"SELECT t.thing_id, t.Type_of_Thing_Code, l.Date_and_Time, l.Location_Code
FROM Things AS t
JOIN Timed_Locations_of_Things AS l ON l.thing_id = t.thing_id
WHERE l.Date_and_Time = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.Date_and_Time)
    FROM Timed_Locations_of_Things AS l2
    WHERE l2.thing_id = l.thing_id
)
ORDER BY t.thing_id;"},{"question":"Quelles organisations ont une organisation parente, et quels sont les détails de cette organisation parente ?","sql":"SELECT child.organization_id AS organisation_enfant,
       child.organization_details AS details_enfant,
       parent.organization_id AS organisation_parente,
       parent.organization_details AS details_parent
FROM Organizations AS child
JOIN Organizations AS parent
  ON parent.organization_id = child.parent_organization_id
ORDER BY parent.organization_id, child.organization_id;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de choses apparaissent soit dans les localisations horodatées, soit dans les statuts horodatés ?","sql":"SELECT thing_id
FROM Timed_Locations_of_Things
UNION
SELECT thing_id
FROM Timed_Status_of_Things
ORDER BY thing_id;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont enregistré plus d'événements que le nombre moyen d'événements par client ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_details, COUNT(e.Customer_Event_ID) AS nombre_evenements
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Customer_Events AS e ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_details
HAVING COUNT(e.Customer_Event_ID) > (
    SELECT AVG(nombre_evenements)
    FROM (
        SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_evenements
        FROM Customer_Events
        WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY customer_id
    ) AS moyennes
)
ORDER BY nombre_evenements DESC, c.customer_id;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les événements avec leur type de service et leurs détails ?","sql":"SELECT e.Event_ID, s.Service_Type_Code, e.Event_Details
FROM Events AS e
JOIN Services AS s ON s.Service_ID = e.Service_ID;"},{"question":"Quels services n'ont encore aucun événement associé ?","sql":"SELECT s.Service_ID, s.Service_Type_Code
FROM Services AS s
LEFT JOIN Events AS e ON e.Service_ID = s.Service_ID
WHERE e.Event_ID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien d'événements sont associés à chaque service ?","sql":"SELECT s.Service_ID, s.Service_Type_Code, COUNT(e.Event_ID) AS nombre_evenements
FROM Services AS s
LEFT JOIN Events AS e ON e.Service_ID = s.Service_ID
GROUP BY s.Service_ID, s.Service_Type_Code;"},{"question":"Combien de participants sont inscrits à chaque événement, y compris ceux qui n'en ont aucun ?","sql":"SELECT e.Event_ID, e.Event_Details, COUNT(pe.Participant_ID) AS nombre_participants
FROM Events AS e
LEFT JOIN Participants_in_Events AS pe ON pe.Event_ID = e.Event_ID
GROUP BY e.Event_ID, e.Event_Details;"},{"question":"Quels participants ont pris part à au moins deux événements ?","sql":"SELECT p.Participant_ID, p.Participant_Type_Code, COUNT(pe.Event_ID) AS nombre_evenements
FROM Participants AS p
JOIN Participants_in_Events AS pe ON pe.Participant_ID = p.Participant_ID
GROUP BY p.Participant_ID, p.Participant_Type_Code
HAVING COUNT(pe.Event_ID) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels événements n'ont aucun participant ?","sql":"SELECT Event_ID, Event_Details
FROM Events
EXCEPT
SELECT e.Event_ID, e.Event_Details
FROM Events AS e
JOIN Participants_in_Events AS pe ON pe.Event_ID = e.Event_ID;"},{"question":"Quels participants ont participé à un événement relevant du service de type « FIRE » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.Participant_ID, p.Participant_Type_Code, p.Participant_Details
FROM Participants AS p
JOIN Participants_in_Events AS pe ON pe.Participant_ID = p.Participant_ID
JOIN Events AS e ON e.Event_ID = pe.Event_ID
JOIN Services AS s ON s.Service_ID = e.Service_ID
WHERE s.Service_Type_Code = 'FIRE';"},{"question":"Quels types de participants sont représentés dans au moins trois événements distincts ?","sql":"SELECT p.Participant_Type_Code, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.Event_ID) AS nombre_evenements
FROM Participants AS p
JOIN Participants_in_Events AS pe ON pe.Participant_ID = p.Participant_ID
GROUP BY p.Participant_Type_Code
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe.Event_ID) >= 3;"},{"question":"Quels services ont plus d'événements que la moyenne des services ?","sql":"SELECT s.Service_ID, s.Service_Type_Code, COUNT(e.Event_ID) AS nombre_evenements
FROM Services AS s
LEFT JOIN Events AS e ON e.Service_ID = s.Service_ID
GROUP BY s.Service_ID, s.Service_Type_Code
HAVING COUNT(e.Event_ID) > (
    SELECT AVG(nombre_evenements)
    FROM (
        SELECT s2.Service_ID, COUNT(e2.Event_ID) AS nombre_evenements
        FROM Services AS s2
        LEFT JOIN Events AS e2 ON e2.Service_ID = s2.Service_ID
        GROUP BY s2.Service_ID
    ) AS statistiques
);"},{"question":"Quels événements comptent davantage de participants que la moyenne des événements ?","sql":"SELECT e.Event_ID, e.Event_Details, COUNT(pe.Participant_ID) AS nombre_participants
FROM Events AS e
LEFT JOIN Participants_in_Events AS pe ON pe.Event_ID = e.Event_ID
GROUP BY e.Event_ID, e.Event_Details
HAVING COUNT(pe.Participant_ID) > (
    SELECT AVG(nombre_participants)
    FROM (
        SELECT e2.Event_ID, COUNT(pe2.Participant_ID) AS nombre_participants
        FROM Events AS e2
        LEFT JOIN Participants_in_Events AS pe2 ON pe2.Event_ID = e2.Event_ID
        GROUP BY e2.Event_ID
    ) AS moyennes
);"},{"question":"Quel ou quels services organisent le plus grand nombre d'événements ?","sql":"WITH comptage AS (
    SELECT s.Service_ID, s.Service_Type_Code, COUNT(e.Event_ID) AS nombre_evenements
    FROM Services AS s
    LEFT JOIN Events AS e ON e.Service_ID = s.Service_ID
    GROUP BY s.Service_ID, s.Service_Type_Code
)
SELECT Service_ID, Service_Type_Code, nombre_evenements
FROM comptage
WHERE nombre_evenements = (SELECT MAX(nombre_evenements) FROM comptage);"},{"question":"Quels codes de service apparaissent à la fois dans la table des services et pour au moins un événement ?","sql":"SELECT Service_Type_Code
FROM Services
INTERSECT
SELECT s.Service_Type_Code
FROM Services AS s
JOIN Events AS e ON e.Service_ID = s.Service_ID;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels clients possèdent à la fois un dossier de taxe d’habitation et une amende de stationnement, et quels sont les identifiants correspondants ?","sql":"SELECT c.master_customer_id, c.cmi_details, ct.council_tax_id, pf.council_tax_id AS parking_fine_id
FROM Customer_Master_Index AS c
JOIN CMI_Cross_References AS r_ct
  ON r_ct.master_customer_id = c.master_customer_id
JOIN Council_Tax AS ct
  ON ct.cmi_cross_ref_id = r_ct.cmi_cross_ref_id
JOIN CMI_Cross_References AS r_pf
  ON r_pf.master_customer_id = c.master_customer_id
JOIN Parking_Fines AS pf
  ON pf.cmi_cross_ref_id = r_pf.cmi_cross_ref_id;"},{"question":"Combien de dossiers de services municipaux sont associés à chaque client, toutes tables de services confondues ?","sql":"SELECT c.master_customer_id, c.cmi_details, COUNT(s.cmi_cross_ref_id) AS nombre_de_dossiers
FROM Customer_Master_Index AS c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT cmi_cross_ref_id FROM Benefits_Overpayments
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cmi_cross_ref_id FROM Business_Rates
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cmi_cross_ref_id FROM Council_Tax
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cmi_cross_ref_id FROM Electoral_Register
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cmi_cross_ref_id FROM Parking_Fines
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cmi_cross_ref_id FROM Rent_Arrears
) AS s
  ON s.cmi_cross_ref_id IN (
      SELECT r.cmi_cross_ref_id
      FROM CMI_Cross_References AS r
      WHERE r.master_customer_id = c.master_customer_id
  )
GROUP BY c.master_customer_id, c.cmi_details;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de références croisées apparaissent dans les tarifs professionnels mais jamais dans la taxe d’habitation ?","sql":"SELECT cmi_cross_ref_id
FROM Business_Rates
EXCEPT
SELECT cmi_cross_ref_id
FROM Council_Tax;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont des arriérés de loyer mais aucune amende de stationnement ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.master_customer_id, c.cmi_details
FROM Customer_Master_Index AS c
JOIN CMI_Cross_References AS r_rent
  ON r_rent.master_customer_id = c.master_customer_id
JOIN Rent_Arrears AS ra
  ON ra.cmi_cross_ref_id = r_rent.cmi_cross_ref_id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM CMI_Cross_References AS r_fine
    JOIN Parking_Fines AS pf
      ON pf.cmi_cross_ref_id = r_fine.cmi_cross_ref_id
    WHERE r_fine.master_customer_id = c.master_customer_id
);"},{"question":"Pour chaque code du système source, combien de clients distincts et de références croisées sont enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT source_system_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT master_customer_id) AS nombre_de_clients,
       COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_references
FROM CMI_Cross_References
GROUP BY source_system_code
ORDER BY source_system_code;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles machines ont été fabriquées à partir de 2015 inclusivement ?","sql":"SELECT Machine_ID, Making_Year, Class, Machine_series FROM machine WHERE Making_Year >= 2015 ORDER BY Making_Year, Machine_ID;"},{"question":"Quels techniciens ont plus de 40 ans, et dans quelle équipe travaillent-ils ?","sql":"SELECT technician_id, Name, Age, Team FROM technician WHERE Age > 40 ORDER BY Age DESC, Name;"},{"question":"Quelles réparations ont été lancées depuis le 1er janvier 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT repair_ID, name, Launch_Date FROM repair WHERE Launch_Date >= '2020-01-01' ORDER BY Launch_Date;"},{"question":"Affiche les affectations avec le nom du technicien, le nom de la réparation et l'identifiant de la machine.","sql":"SELECT t.Name AS technicien, r.name AS reparation, ra.Machine_ID FROM repair_assignment AS ra JOIN technician AS t ON t.technician_id = ra.technician_id JOIN repair AS r ON r.repair_ID = ra.repair_ID ORDER BY t.Name, r.name, ra.Machine_ID;"},{"question":"Combien de réparations distinctes sont affectées à chaque machine, y compris celles qui n'en ont aucune ?","sql":"SELECT m.Machine_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.repair_ID) AS nombre_reparations FROM machine AS m LEFT JOIN repair_assignment AS ra ON ra.Machine_ID = m.Machine_ID GROUP BY m.Machine_ID ORDER BY nombre_reparations DESC, m.Machine_ID;"},{"question":"Quelle est la valeur moyenne des machines pour chaque classe ?","sql":"SELECT Class, AVG(value_points) AS valeur_moyenne FROM machine GROUP BY Class ORDER BY valeur_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de machines distinctes chaque technicien a-t-il prises en charge ?","sql":"SELECT t.technician_id, t.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.Machine_ID) AS nombre_machines FROM technician AS t LEFT JOIN repair_assignment AS ra ON ra.technician_id = t.technician_id GROUP BY t.technician_id, t.Name ORDER BY nombre_machines DESC, t.Name;"},{"question":"Quelles machines ont une valeur supérieure à la valeur moyenne de toutes les machines ?","sql":"SELECT Machine_ID, Machine_series, value_points FROM machine WHERE value_points > (SELECT AVG(value_points) FROM machine) ORDER BY value_points DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque réparation, combien de techniciens distincts y sont affectés ?","sql":"SELECT r.repair_ID, r.name, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.technician_id) AS nombre_techniciens FROM repair AS r LEFT JOIN repair_assignment AS ra ON ra.repair_ID = r.repair_ID GROUP BY r.repair_ID, r.name ORDER BY nombre_techniciens DESC, r.repair_ID;"},{"question":"Quelles équipes sont présentes à la fois parmi les machines et parmi les techniciens ?","sql":"SELECT Team FROM machine INTERSECT SELECT Team FROM technician ORDER BY Team;"},{"question":"Quelle est la réparation la plus récente selon sa date de lancement ?","sql":"SELECT repair_ID, name, Launch_Date FROM repair WHERE Launch_Date = (SELECT MAX(Launch_Date) FROM repair);"},{"question":"Quelles machines ont le meilleur rang de qualité dans leur classe ?","sql":"SELECT m.Machine_ID, m.Class, m.quality_rank FROM machine AS m WHERE m.quality_rank = (SELECT MAX(m2.quality_rank) FROM machine AS m2 WHERE m2.Class = m.Class) ORDER BY m.Class, m.Machine_ID;"},{"question":"Quelles réparations ne sont affectées à aucune machine ?","sql":"SELECT r.repair_ID, r.name FROM repair AS r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM repair_assignment AS ra WHERE ra.repair_ID = r.repair_ID) ORDER BY r.repair_ID;"},{"question":"Quels techniciens n'ont aucune affectation de réparation ?","sql":"SELECT t.technician_id, t.Name FROM technician AS t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM repair_assignment AS ra WHERE ra.technician_id = t.technician_id) ORDER BY t.Name;"},{"question":"Combien d'affectations chaque réparation possède-t-elle, avec le détail de sa date de lancement ?","sql":"SELECT r.repair_ID, r.name, r.Launch_Date, COUNT(ra.Machine_ID) AS nombre_affectations FROM repair AS r LEFT JOIN repair_assignment AS ra ON ra.repair_ID = r.repair_ID GROUP BY r.repair_ID, r.name, r.Launch_Date ORDER BY nombre_affectations DESC, r.repair_ID;"},{"question":"Quelles machines appartiennent soit à la classe « A », soit ont une valeur d'au moins 80 points ?","sql":"SELECT Machine_ID FROM machine WHERE Class = 'A' UNION SELECT Machine_ID FROM machine WHERE value_points >= 80 ORDER BY Machine_ID;"},{"question":"Quels techniciens travaillent dans une équipe qui possède au moins une machine ?","sql":"SELECT t.technician_id, t.Name, t.Team FROM technician AS t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM machine AS m WHERE m.Team = t.Team) ORDER BY t.Team, t.Name;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les fabricants, classés par nom alphabétique ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Headquarter, Founder, Revenue
FROM Manufacturers
ORDER BY Name ASC;"},{"question":"Quels produits sont plus chers que le prix moyen de tous les produits ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Price, Manufacturer
FROM Products
WHERE Price > (SELECT AVG(Price) FROM Products)
ORDER BY Price DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de produits chaque fabricant propose-t-il, y compris ceux qui n'en proposent aucun ?","sql":"SELECT m.Code, m.Name, COUNT(p.Code) AS ProductCount
FROM Manufacturers AS m
LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code
GROUP BY m.Code, m.Name
ORDER BY ProductCount DESC, m.Name ASC;"},{"question":"Quel est ou quels sont les produits les plus chers ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Price, Manufacturer
FROM Products
WHERE Price = (SELECT MAX(Price) FROM Products);"},{"question":"Quels fabricants ont un revenu supérieur au revenu moyen des fabricants renseignés ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Revenue
FROM Manufacturers
WHERE Revenue > (SELECT AVG(Revenue) FROM Manufacturers WHERE Revenue IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY Revenue DESC;"},{"question":"Quel fabricant possède le plus grand nombre de produits ?","sql":"SELECT m.Code, m.Name, COUNT(p.Code) AS ProductCount
FROM Manufacturers AS m
LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code
GROUP BY m.Code, m.Name
ORDER BY ProductCount DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels sont les produits avec le nom de leur fabricant et leur siège social ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name AS ProductName, p.Price, m.Name AS ManufacturerName, m.Headquarter
FROM Products AS p
JOIN Manufacturers AS m ON m.Code = p.Manufacturer
ORDER BY m.Name ASC, p.Name ASC;"},{"question":"Quels fabricants ne proposent aucun produit ?","sql":"SELECT m.Code, m.Name
FROM Manufacturers AS m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Products AS p
  WHERE p.Manufacturer = m.Code
)
ORDER BY m.Name ASC;"},{"question":"Quel est le prix total des produits de chaque fabricant ?","sql":"SELECT m.Code, m.Name, COALESCE(SUM(p.Price), 0) AS TotalPrice
FROM Manufacturers AS m
LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code
GROUP BY m.Code, m.Name
ORDER BY TotalPrice DESC;"},{"question":"Quels produits coûtent entre 100 et 500 inclus ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Price, Manufacturer
FROM Products
WHERE Price BETWEEN 100 AND 500
ORDER BY Price ASC, Name ASC;"},{"question":"Quels fabricants proposent au moins un produit de plus de 1000 ?","sql":"SELECT m.Code, m.Name
FROM Manufacturers AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Products AS p
  WHERE p.Manufacturer = m.Code
    AND p.Price > 1000
)
ORDER BY m.Name ASC;"},{"question":"Quel est le prix moyen des produits pour chaque fabricant ayant au moins un produit ?","sql":"SELECT m.Code, m.Name, AVG(p.Price) AS AveragePrice
FROM Manufacturers AS m
JOIN Products AS p ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code
GROUP BY m.Code, m.Name
ORDER BY AveragePrice DESC;"},{"question":"Quels fabricants ont un revenu supérieur à celui de tous les autres fabricants dont le revenu est renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT m.Code, m.Name, m.Revenue
FROM Manufacturers AS m
WHERE m.Revenue IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Manufacturers AS other_m
    WHERE other_m.Revenue IS NOT NULL
      AND other_m.Revenue > m.Revenue
  );"},{"question":"Quels sont les produits dont le prix est le plus élevé chez leur fabricant ?","sql":"SELECT p.Code, p.Name, p.Price, p.Manufacturer
FROM Products AS p
WHERE p.Price = (
  SELECT MAX(p2.Price)
  FROM Products AS p2
  WHERE p2.Manufacturer = p.Manufacturer
)
ORDER BY p.Manufacturer ASC, p.Price DESC;"},{"question":"Quels fabricants ont au moins deux produits et quel est le prix moyen de ces produits ?","sql":"SELECT m.Code, m.Name, COUNT(p.Code) AS ProductCount, AVG(p.Price) AS AveragePrice
FROM Manufacturers AS m
JOIN Products AS p ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code
GROUP BY m.Code, m.Name
HAVING COUNT(p.Code) >= 2
ORDER BY ProductCount DESC, AveragePrice DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles valeurs distinctes apparaissent à la fois comme siège social ou comme fondateur ?","sql":"SELECT Headquarter AS Value
FROM Manufacturers
UNION
SELECT Founder AS Value
FROM Manufacturers
ORDER BY Value ASC;"},{"question":"Quels produits sont plus chers que le prix moyen des produits de leur propre fabricant ?","sql":"SELECT p.Code, p.Name, p.Price, p.Manufacturer
FROM Products AS p
WHERE p.Price > (
  SELECT AVG(p2.Price)
  FROM Products AS p2
  WHERE p2.Manufacturer = p.Manufacturer
)
ORDER BY p.Price DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois produits les moins chers ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Price, Manufacturer
FROM Products
ORDER BY Price ASC, Name ASC
LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quels fabricants ont un revenu inférieur à celui d'au moins un autre fabricant renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT m.Code, m.Name, m.Revenue
FROM Manufacturers AS m
WHERE m.Revenue IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Manufacturers AS other_m
    WHERE other_m.Revenue IS NOT NULL
      AND other_m.Revenue > m.Revenue
  )
ORDER BY m.Revenue ASC;"},{"question":"Quels produits appartiennent à des fabricants dont le revenu n'est pas renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT p.Code, p.Name, p.Price, m.Name AS ManufacturerName
FROM Products AS p
JOIN Manufacturers AS m ON m.Code = p.Manufacturer
WHERE m.Revenue IS NULL
ORDER BY m.Name ASC, p.Name ASC;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels meubles ont un tarif de marché supérieur au tarif moyen de tous les meubles ?","sql":"SELECT Furniture_ID, Name, Market_Rate
FROM furniture
WHERE Market_Rate > (SELECT AVG(Market_Rate) FROM furniture)
ORDER BY Market_Rate DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque fabricant, combien de meubles fabrique-t-il, y compris ceux qui n’en fabriquent aucun ?","sql":"SELECT m.Manufacturer_ID, m.Name, COUNT(fm.Furniture_ID) AS Nombre_de_meubles
FROM manufacturer AS m
LEFT JOIN furniture_manufacte AS fm
  ON fm.Manufacturer_ID = m.Manufacturer_ID
GROUP BY m.Manufacturer_ID, m.Name
ORDER BY Nombre_de_meubles DESC, m.Name;"},{"question":"Quels fabricants proposent le meuble le plus cher pour chaque meuble, et quel est son prix ?","sql":"SELECT f.Furniture_ID, f.Name AS Meuble, m.Manufacturer_ID, m.Name AS Fabricant, fm.Price_in_Dollar
FROM furniture AS f
JOIN furniture_manufacte AS fm
  ON fm.Furniture_ID = f.Furniture_ID
JOIN manufacturer AS m
  ON m.Manufacturer_ID = fm.Manufacturer_ID
WHERE fm.Price_in_Dollar = (
    SELECT MAX(fm2.Price_in_Dollar)
    FROM furniture_manufacte AS fm2
    WHERE fm2.Furniture_ID = f.Furniture_ID
)
ORDER BY f.Furniture_ID;"},{"question":"Quels fabricants ont plus de magasins que d’usines ?","sql":"SELECT Manufacturer_ID, Name, Num_of_Factories, Num_of_Shops
FROM manufacturer
WHERE Num_of_Shops > Num_of_Factories
ORDER BY Num_of_Shops - Num_of_Factories DESC;"},{"question":"Quels meubles ont un tarif de marché par composant supérieur à 100 ?","sql":"SELECT Furniture_ID, Name, Market_Rate, Num_of_Component,
       Market_Rate / Num_of_Component AS Tarif_par_composant
FROM furniture
WHERE Num_of_Component > 0
  AND Market_Rate / Num_of_Component > 100
ORDER BY Tarif_par_composant DESC;"},{"question":"Quels fabricants fabriquent tous les meubles présents dans le catalogue ?","sql":"SELECT m.Manufacturer_ID, m.Name
FROM manufacturer AS m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM furniture AS f
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM furniture_manufacte AS fm
        WHERE fm.Manufacturer_ID = m.Manufacturer_ID
          AND fm.Furniture_ID = f.Furniture_ID
    )
)
ORDER BY m.Name;"},{"question":"Quels fabricants ont un prix de fabrication moyen supérieur à 500 dollars pour leurs meubles ?","sql":"SELECT m.Manufacturer_ID, m.Name,
       AVG(fm.Price_in_Dollar) AS Prix_moyen,
       COUNT(fm.Furniture_ID) AS Nombre_de_meubles
FROM manufacturer AS m
JOIN furniture_manufacte AS fm
  ON fm.Manufacturer_ID = m.Manufacturer_ID
GROUP BY m.Manufacturer_ID, m.Name
HAVING AVG(fm.Price_in_Dollar) > 500
ORDER BY Prix_moyen DESC;"},{"question":"Quels meubles ont un tarif de marché au moins égal au tarif de marché maximal ?","sql":"SELECT Furniture_ID, Name, Market_Rate
FROM furniture
WHERE Market_Rate >= (SELECT MAX(Market_Rate) FROM furniture)
ORDER BY Furniture_ID;"},{"question":"Quels meubles ont à la fois un tarif de marché supérieur à la moyenne et au moins une offre de fabrication à moins de 300 dollars ?","sql":"SELECT Furniture_ID
FROM furniture
WHERE Market_Rate > (SELECT AVG(Market_Rate) FROM furniture)
INTERSECT
SELECT Furniture_ID
FROM furniture_manufacte
WHERE Price_in_Dollar < 300
ORDER BY Furniture_ID;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles saisons indiquent le joueur, le nom de son équipe et son pays ?","sql":"SELECT ms.Season, ms.Player, t.Name AS Team_name, c.Country_name
FROM match_season AS ms
LEFT JOIN team AS t ON t.Team_id = ms.Team
LEFT JOIN country AS c ON c.Country_id = ms.Country;"},{"question":"Combien de saisons sont associées à chaque équipe, y compris celles qui n'en ont aucune ?","sql":"SELECT t.Team_id, t.Name, COUNT(ms.Season) AS Season_count
FROM team AS t
LEFT JOIN match_season AS ms ON ms.Team = t.Team_id
GROUP BY t.Team_id, t.Name
ORDER BY Season_count DESC, t.Name;"},{"question":"Pour chaque pays représenté dans les saisons, quel est le nombre de saisons et le choix de draft moyen ?","sql":"SELECT c.Country_name, COUNT(ms.Season) AS Season_count, AVG(ms.Draft_Pick_Number) AS Average_draft_pick
FROM country AS c
JOIN match_season AS ms ON ms.Country = c.Country_id
GROUP BY c.Country_id, c.Country_name
ORDER BY Season_count DESC;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont joué au moins le plus grand nombre d'années indiqué dans la table des joueurs ?","sql":"SELECT Player_ID, Player, Years_Played
FROM player
WHERE CAST(Years_Played AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(CAST(Years_Played AS INTEGER)) FROM player);"},{"question":"Quelles saisons ont un numéro de choix de draft supérieur à la moyenne de toutes les saisons renseignées ?","sql":"SELECT Season, Player, Draft_Pick_Number
FROM match_season
WHERE Draft_Pick_Number > (SELECT AVG(Draft_Pick_Number) FROM match_season)
ORDER BY Draft_Pick_Number DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque équipe, combien de joueurs et de saisons lui sont associés ?","sql":"SELECT t.Team_id, t.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.Player_ID) AS Player_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ms.Season) AS Season_count
FROM team AS t
LEFT JOIN player AS p ON p.Team = t.Team_id
LEFT JOIN match_season AS ms ON ms.Team = t.Team_id
GROUP BY t.Team_id, t.Name
ORDER BY t.Name;"},{"question":"Quels pays et quelles capitales correspondent aux joueurs dont le pays est présent dans les saisons ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.Country_name, c.Capital, c.Official_native_language
FROM country AS c
JOIN match_season AS ms ON ms.Country = c.Country_id
ORDER BY c.Country_name;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont joué plus de cinq années, en affichant leur équipe ?","sql":"SELECT p.Player, p.Years_Played, t.Name AS Team_name
FROM player AS p
LEFT JOIN team AS t ON t.Team_id = p.Team
WHERE CAST(p.Years_Played AS INTEGER) > 5
ORDER BY CAST(p.Years_Played AS INTEGER) DESC, p.Player;"},{"question":"Combien de saisons sont enregistrées pour chaque position ?","sql":"SELECT Position, COUNT(*) AS Season_count
FROM match_season
GROUP BY Position
ORDER BY Season_count DESC, Position;"},{"question":"Quels pays ne sont associés à aucune saison ?","sql":"SELECT c.Country_id, c.Country_name
FROM country AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM match_season AS ms
    WHERE ms.Country = c.Country_id
)
ORDER BY c.Country_name;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants d'équipe apparaissent soit dans les saisons, soit dans les joueurs ?","sql":"SELECT Team
FROM match_season
WHERE Team IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT Team
FROM player
WHERE Team IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY Team;"},{"question":"Quelles informations correspondent à la saison la plus récente ?","sql":"SELECT ms.Season, ms.Player, ms.Position, t.Name AS Team_name, c.Country_name
FROM match_season AS ms
LEFT JOIN team AS t ON t.Team_id = ms.Team
LEFT JOIN country AS c ON c.Country_id = ms.Country
WHERE ms.Season = (SELECT MAX(Season) FROM match_season);"},{"question":"Combien de saisons distinctes sont associées à chaque établissement universitaire ?","sql":"SELECT College, COUNT(DISTINCT Season) AS Season_count
FROM match_season
WHERE College IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY College
ORDER BY Season_count DESC, College;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs de la table des joueurs appartiennent à une équipe qui apparaît également dans les saisons ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.Player, t.Name AS Team_name
FROM player AS p
JOIN team AS t ON t.Team_id = p.Team
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM match_season AS ms
    WHERE ms.Team = p.Team
)
ORDER BY t.Name, p.Player;"},{"question":"Combien de joueurs ont été sélectionnés dans chaque classe de draft ?","sql":"SELECT Draft_Class, COUNT(*) AS Player_count
FROM match_season
GROUP BY Draft_Class
ORDER BY Player_count DESC, Draft_Class;"},{"question":"Quelles saisons mentionnent un joueur absent de la table des joueurs ?","sql":"SELECT ms.Season, ms.Player, ms.Team
FROM match_season AS ms
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM player AS p
    WHERE p.Player = ms.Player
)
ORDER BY ms.Season;"},{"question":"Quels pays ont au moins deux saisons et quel est leur numéro de choix de draft moyen ?","sql":"SELECT c.Country_name, COUNT(ms.Season) AS Season_count, AVG(ms.Draft_Pick_Number) AS Average_draft_pick
FROM country AS c
JOIN match_season AS ms ON ms.Country = c.Country_id
GROUP BY c.Country_id, c.Country_name
HAVING COUNT(ms.Season) >= 2
ORDER BY Average_draft_pick;"},{"question":"Pour chaque équipe ayant au moins un joueur, quels sont les joueurs qui lui sont rattachés ?","sql":"SELECT t.Name AS Team_name, GROUP_CONCAT(p.Player, ', ') AS Players
FROM team AS t
JOIN player AS p ON p.Team = t.Team_id
GROUP BY t.Team_id, t.Name
ORDER BY t.Name;"},{"question":"Quelles saisons ont un numéro de choix de draft inférieur à celui de toutes les saisons dont la classe de draft est la même ?","sql":"SELECT ms.Season, ms.Player, ms.Draft_Class, ms.Draft_Pick_Number
FROM match_season AS ms
WHERE ms.Draft_Pick_Number IS NOT NULL
  AND ms.Draft_Pick_Number < (
      SELECT MAX(ms2.Draft_Pick_Number)
      FROM match_season AS ms2
      WHERE ms2.Draft_Class = ms.Draft_Class
        AND ms2.Draft_Pick_Number IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY ms.Draft_Class, ms.Draft_Pick_Number;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont un bilan de simples renseigné et dans quelle équipe jouent-ils ?","sql":"SELECT p.Player, p.Singles_WL, t.Name AS Team_name
FROM player AS p
LEFT JOIN team AS t ON t.Team_id = p.Team
WHERE p.Singles_WL IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(p.Singles_WL) <> ''
ORDER BY p.Player;"}]}

mei.\"medicine_id\" = m.\"id\" GROUP BY m.\"id\", m.\"name\" ORDER BY enzyme_count DESC, m.\"name\";"},{"question":"Quels sont les différents types d'interaction recensés ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT ?","sql":"SELECT \"name\", \"Chromosome\", \"OMIM\" FROM \"enzyme\" WHERE \"OMIM\" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY \"Chromosome\", \"name\";"},{"question":"Quelles enzymes produisent un produit dont le nom ORDER BY m.\"name\";"},{"question":"Quelles enzymes n'interagissent avec aucun médicament approuvé par la FDA ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"name\" FROM \"enzyme\" AS e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM e.\"name\";"},{"question":"Quels sont les médicaments associés à l'enzyme qui possède le plus grand nombre d'interactions ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"name\" FROM \"medicine\" AS m JOIN \"medicine_enzyme_interaction\" AS mei ON mei.\"medicine_id\" = m.\"id\" WHERE mei.\"enzyme_id\" IN (SELECT \"enzyme_id\" FROM \"medicine_enzyme_interaction\" GROUP BY \"enzyme_id\" HAVING COUNT(*) = FDA et à un médicament non approuvé ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"name\" FROM \"enzyme\" AS e JOIN \"medicine_enzyme_interaction\" AS mei ON mei.\"enzyme_id\" = e.\"id\" JOIN \"medicine\" AS m ON m.\"id\" = \"name\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la liste combinée, sans doublons, des noms d'enzymes et de médicaments ?","sql":"SELECT \"name\" FROM \"enzyme\" UNION SELECT \"name\" FROM \"medicine\" ORDER BY enzyme_count DESC, \"Chromosome\";"},{"question":"Quels médicaments sont associés à au moins trois enzymes distinctes et quel est leur statut d'approbation ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"name\", \"enzyme_id\")) ORDER BY e.\"name\";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les montagnes dont la hauteur est supérieure à la hauteur moyenne de toutes les montagnes ?","sql":"SELECT "name", "Height"
FROM "mountain"
WHERE "Height" > (SELECT AVG("Height") FROM "mountain");"},{"question":"Quelles photos montrent une montagne située en France, avec la marque et le nom de l’objectif utilisé ?","sql":"SELECT p."name" AS photo, m."name" AS mountain, cl."brand", cl."name" AS lens
FROM "photos" AS p
JOIN "mountain" AS m ON m."id" = p."mountain_id"
JOIN "camera_lens" AS cl ON cl."id" = p."camera_lens_id"
WHERE m."Country" = 'France';"},{"question":"Combien de photos sont associées à chaque montagne, y compris celles qui n’en ont aucune ?","sql":"SELECT m."name", COUNT(p."id") AS photo_count
FROM "mountain" AS m
LEFT JOIN "photos" AS p ON p."mountain_id" = m."id"
GROUP BY m."id", m."name"
ORDER BY photo_count DESC, m."name";"},{"question":"Quelles marques d’objectifs ont une longueur focale moyenne supérieure à 100 mm ?","sql":"SELECT "brand", AVG("focal_length_mm") AS average_focal_length
FROM "camera_lens"
GROUP BY "brand"
HAVING AVG("focal_length_mm") > 100
ORDER BY average_focal_length DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque pays, quel est le nombre de montagnes et la hauteur maximale enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT "Country", COUNT(*) AS mountain_count, MAX("Height") AS maximum_height
FROM "mountain"
GROUP BY "Country"
ORDER BY mountain_count DESC, "Country";"},{"question":"Quelles photos ont été prises sur des montagnes plus hautes que la moyenne et avec un objectif dont l’ouverture maximale est inférieure à 2,8 ?","sql":"SELECT p."name" AS photo, m."name" AS mountain, cl."name" AS lens
FROM "photos" AS p
JOIN "mountain" AS m ON m."id" = p."mountain_id"
JOIN "camera_lens" AS cl ON cl."id" = p."camera_lens_id"
WHERE m."Height" > (SELECT AVG("Height") FROM "mountain")
  AND cl."max_aperture" < 2.8;"},{"question":"Quel ou quels objectifs sont utilisés pour le plus grand nombre de photos ?","sql":"WITH lens_counts AS (
    SELECT cl."id", cl."brand", cl."name", COUNT(p."id") AS photo_count
    FROM "camera_lens" AS cl
    LEFT JOIN "photos" AS p ON p."camera_lens_id" = cl."id"
    GROUP BY cl."id", cl."brand", cl."name"
)
SELECT "brand", "name", photo_count
FROM lens_counts
WHERE photo_count = (SELECT MAX(photo_count) FROM lens_counts);"},{"question":"Quels massifs comptent au moins deux montagnes et présentent une proéminence moyenne supérieure à 500 mètres ?","sql":"SELECT "Range", COUNT(*) AS mountain_count, AVG("Prominence") AS average_prominence
FROM "mountain"
GROUP BY "Range"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND AVG("Prominence") > 500
ORDER BY average_prominence DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de photos de chaque couleur ont été prises avec un objectif de marque Canon ?","sql":"SELECT p."color", COUNT(*) AS photo_count
FROM "photos" AS p
JOIN "camera_lens" AS cl ON cl."id" = p."camera_lens_id"
WHERE cl."brand" = 'Canon'
GROUP BY p."color"
ORDER BY photo_count DESC, p."color";"},{"question":"Quels noms de montagnes apparaissent soit dans une photo rouge, soit dans une photo prise avec un objectif de plus de 200 mm de longueur focale ?","sql":"SELECT m."name"
FROM "mountain" AS m
JOIN "photos" AS p ON p."mountain_id" = m."id"
WHERE p."color" = 'red'
UNION
SELECT m."name"
FROM "mountain" AS m
JOIN "photos" AS p ON p."mountain_id" = m."id"
JOIN "camera_lens" AS cl ON cl."id" = p."camera_lens_id"
WHERE cl."focal_length_mm" > 200
ORDER BY "name";"}]}

Performance AS p WHERE p.Bandmate = b.Id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Vocals AS v WHERE v.Bandmate = b.Id) ORDER BY b.Lastname, b.Firstname;"},{"question":"Quels morceaux ont un membre qui joue d’un instrument sans être crédité au chant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.SongId, s.Title FROM Songs AS s JOIN Instruments AS i ON i.SongId = s.SongId WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Vocals AS v WHERE v.SongId = i.SongId AND v.Bandmate = i.BandmateId) ORDER BY s.Title;"},{"question":"Quels albums ont une année de sortie supérieure à la moyenne des années ?","sql":"SELECT AId, Title, Year FROM Albums WHERE Year > (SELECT AVG(Year) FROM Albums) ORDER BY Year, Title;"},{"question":"Quels morceaux ont un titre plus long que la longueur moyenne des titres ?","sql":"SELECT SongId, Title, LENGTH(Title) AS TitleLength FROM Songs WHERE LENGTH(Title) > (SELECT AVG(LENGTH(Title)) FROM Songs) ORDER BY TitleLength DESC, Title;"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne du nombre de chanteurs par morceau chanté ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(SingerCount) AS AverageSingersPerSong FROM (SELECT SongId, COUNT(DISTINCT Bandmate) AS SingerCount FROM Vocals GROUP BY SongId);"},{"question":"Quels membres portent le même prénom qu’au moins un autre membre ?","sql":"SELECT Firstname, COUNT(*) AS MemberCount FROM Band GROUP BY Firstname HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY Firstname;"},{"question":"Quels albums ont plus de morceaux que la moyenne des albums contenant une liste ?","sql":"SELECT a.AId, a.Title, COUNT(t.SongId) AS TrackCount FROM Albums AS a JOIN Tracklists AS t ON t.AlbumId = a.AId GROUP BY a.AId, a.Title HAVING COUNT(t.SongId) > (SELECT AVG(TrackCount) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS TrackCount FROM Tracklists GROUP BY AlbumId)) ORDER BY TrackCount DESC, a.Title;"},{"question":"Quels morceaux sont associés au même nombre d’instruments et de chanteurs ?","sql":"SELECT s.SongId, s.Title FROM Songs AS s WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.Instrument) FROM Instruments AS i WHERE i.SongId = s.SongId) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.Bandmate) FROM Vocals AS v WHERE v.SongId = s.SongId) ORDER BY s.Title;"},{"question":"Quels membres ont joué sur tous les morceaux d’un album donné, l’album 1 ?","sql":"SELECT b.Id, b.Firstname, b.Lastname FROM Band AS b JOIN Performance AS p ON p.Bandmate = b.Id JOIN Tracklists AS t ON t.SongId = p.SongId WHERE t.AlbumId = 1 GROUP BY b.Id, b.Firstname, b.Lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.SongId) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Tracklists WHERE AlbumId = 1) ORDER BY b.Lastname, b.Firstname;"},{"question":"Quels morceaux figurent sur un album mais ne possèdent ni voix ni instrument enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.SongId, s.Title FROM Songs AS s JOIN Tracklists AS t ON t.SongId = s.SongId WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Vocals AS v WHERE v.SongId = s.SongId) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Instruments AS i WHERE i.SongId = s.SongId) ORDER BY s.Title;"},{"question":"Quels labels ont au moins un album avant 1980 et au moins un album après 2000 ?","sql":"SELECT Label FROM Albums GROUP BY Label HAVING MIN(Year) < 1980 AND MAX(Year) > 2000 ORDER BY Label;"},{"question":"Quels morceaux sont classés à une position différente selon les albums ?","sql":"SELECT s.SongId, s.Title, COUNT(DISTINCT t.Position) AS PositionCount FROM Songs AS s JOIN Tracklists AS t ON t.SongId = s.SongId GROUP BY s.SongId, s.Title HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.Position) > 1 ORDER BY s.Title;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de morceaux distincts par label ?","sql":"SELECT a.Label, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SongId) AS SongCount FROM Albums AS a JOIN Tracklists AS t ON t.AlbumId = a.AId GROUP BY a.Label ORDER BY SongCount DESC, a.Label;"},{"question":"Quels membres ont utilisé au moins deux positions de scène différentes ?","sql":"SELECT b.Id, b.Firstname, b.Lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT p.StagePosition) AS PositionCount FROM Band AS b JOIN Performance AS p ON p.Bandmate = b.Id GROUP BY b.Id, b.Firstname, b.Lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.StagePosition) >= 2 ORDER BY PositionCount DESC, b.Lastname;"},{"question":"Quels albums ont au moins un morceau dont le titre est partagé avec un autre morceau ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.AId, a.Title FROM Albums AS a JOIN Tracklists AS t ON t.AlbumId = a.AId JOIN Songs AS s ON s.SongId = t.SongId WHERE s.Title IN (SELECT Title FROM Songs GROUP BY Title HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) ORDER BY a.Title;"},{"question":"Quels instruments sont joués par des membres qui assurent aussi un chant principal ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT i.Instrument FROM Instruments AS i JOIN Vocals AS v ON v.Bandmate = i.BandmateId WHERE v.Type = 'lead' ORDER BY i.Instrument;"},{"question":"Quels albums ont exactement un seul type d’instrument utilisé sur tous leurs morceaux ?","sql":"SELECT a.AId, a.Title FROM Albums AS a JOIN Tracklists AS t ON t.AlbumId = a.AId JOIN Instruments AS i ON i.SongId = t.SongId GROUP BY a.AId, a.Title HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.Instrument) = 1 ORDER BY a.Title;"},{"question":"Quels morceaux ont au moins un membre qui chante et un autre membre qui joue d’un instrument ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.SongId, s.Title FROM Songs AS s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Vocals AS v WHERE v.SongId = s.SongId) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Instruments AS i WHERE i.SongId = s.SongId) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Vocals AS v JOIN Instruments AS i ON i.SongId = v.SongId WHERE v.SongId = s.SongId AND v.Bandmate <> i.BandmateId) ORDER BY s.Title;"},{"question":"Quels albums ont une liste de morceaux dont toutes les positions sont inférieures ou égales à 5 ?","sql":"SELECT a.AId, a.Title, MAX(t.Position) AS LastPosition FROM Albums AS a JOIN Tracklists AS t ON t.AlbumId = a.AId GROUP BY a.AId, a.Title HAVING MAX(t.Position) <= 5 ORDER BY a.Title;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels artistes sont plus âgés que l’âge moyen de tous les artistes ?","sql":"SELECT "Artist_ID", "Artist", "Age"
FROM "artist"
WHERE "Age" > (SELECT AVG("Age") FROM "artist");"},{"question":"Quels festivals ont été associés à un volume sorti après le 1er janvier 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT mf."Music_Festival", mf."Date_of_ceremony", v."Volume_Issue", v."Issue_Date"
FROM "music_festival" AS mf
JOIN "volume" AS v ON mf."Volume" = v."Volume_ID"
WHERE v."Issue_Date" > '2020-01-01';"},{"question":"Combien de volumes sont associés à chaque artiste, y compris ceux qui n’en ont aucun ?","sql":"SELECT a."Artist", COUNT(v."Volume_ID") AS "Nombre_de_volumes"
FROM "artist" AS a
LEFT JOIN "volume" AS v ON a."Artist_ID" = v."Artist_ID"
GROUP BY a."Artist_ID", a."Artist"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_volumes" DESC, a."Artist";"},{"question":"Quel est le volume ayant obtenu le plus grand nombre de semaines au sommet ?","sql":"SELECT "Volume_ID", "Volume_Issue", "Song", "Weeks_on_Top"
FROM "volume"
WHERE "Weeks_on_Top" = (SELECT MAX("Weeks_on_Top") FROM "volume");"},{"question":"Quelles catégories de festival comptent au moins deux cérémonies ?","sql":"SELECT "Category", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_ceremonies"
FROM "music_festival"
GROUP BY "Category"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_ceremonies" DESC, "Category";"},{"question":"Quels artistes n’ont aucun volume associé à un festival ?","sql":"SELECT a."Artist_ID", a."Artist"
FROM "artist" AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "volume" AS v
    JOIN "music_festival" AS mf ON mf."Volume" = v."Volume_ID"
    WHERE v."Artist_ID" = a."Artist_ID"
);"},{"question":"Quels noms apparaissent à la fois parmi les artistes et parmi les festivals de musique ?","sql":"SELECT "Artist" AS "Nom"
FROM "artist"
INTERSECT
SELECT "Music_Festival" AS "Nom"
FROM "music_festival";"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne au sommet des volumes pour chaque catégorie de festival ?","sql":"SELECT mf."Category", AVG(v."Weeks_on_Top") AS "Moyenne_semaines"
FROM "music_festival" AS mf
JOIN "volume" AS v ON mf."Volume" = v."Volume_ID"
GROUP BY mf."Category"
ORDER BY "Moyenne_semaines" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels volumes ont plus de semaines au sommet que tous les volumes associés à l’artiste ayant l’identifiant 1 ?","sql":"SELECT v."Volume_ID", v."Song", v."Weeks_on_Top"
FROM "volume" AS v
WHERE v."Weeks_on_Top" > ALL (
    SELECT v2."Weeks_on_Top"
    FROM "volume" AS v2
    WHERE v2."Artist_ID" = 1
);"},{"question":"Quels festivals, avec leur chanson et leur artiste, ont obtenu un résultat renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT mf."Music_Festival", mf."Result", v."Song", a."Artist"
FROM "music_festival" AS mf
JOIN "volume" AS v ON mf."Volume" = v."Volume_ID"
JOIN "artist" AS a ON v."Artist_ID" = a."Artist_ID"
WHERE mf."Result" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY mf."Music_Festival";"},{"question":"Quels artistes n’ont enregistré aucun volume dans la base ?","sql":"SELECT a."Artist_ID", a."Artist"
FROM "artist" AS a
LEFT JOIN "volume" AS v ON a."Artist_ID" = v."Artist_ID"
WHERE v."Volume_ID" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois volumes ayant le plus grand nombre de semaines au sommet ?","sql":"SELECT "Volume_ID", "Song", "Weeks_on_Top"
FROM "volume"
ORDER BY "Weeks_on_Top" DESC, "Volume_ID"
LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Pour chaque artiste ayant au moins un volume, quel est le nombre maximal de semaines au sommet obtenu par ses volumes ?","sql":"SELECT a."Artist", MAX(v."Weeks_on_Top") AS "Maximum_semaines"
FROM "artist" AS a
JOIN "volume" AS v ON a."Artist_ID" = v."Artist_ID"
GROUP BY a."Artist_ID", a."Artist"
ORDER BY "Maximum_semaines" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels artistes ont un volume sorti à la même date que la date de sortie de leur titre célèbre ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a."Artist_ID", a."Artist", a."Famous_Title", a."Famous_Release_date"
FROM "artist" AS a
JOIN "volume" AS v ON a."Artist_ID" = v."Artist_ID"
WHERE v."Issue_Date" = a."Famous_Release_date";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les musicals sortis après l’an 2000, avec leur année et leur catégorie ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Year", "Category"
FROM "musical"
WHERE "Year" > 2000
ORDER BY "Year", "Name";"},{"question":"Quels acteurs jouent dans chaque musical, et quel personnage interprètent-ils ?","sql":"SELECT m."Name" AS "Musical", a."Name" AS "Acteur", a."Character"
FROM "actor" AS a
JOIN "musical" AS m ON m."Musical_ID" = a."Musical_ID"
ORDER BY m."Name", a."Name";"},{"question":"Combien d’acteurs sont associés à chaque musical, y compris ceux qui n’en ont aucun ?","sql":"SELECT m."Name" AS "Musical", COUNT(a."Actor_ID") AS "Nombre_acteurs"
FROM "musical" AS m
LEFT JOIN "actor" AS a ON a."Musical_ID" = m."Musical_ID"
GROUP BY m."Musical_ID", m."Name"
ORDER BY "Nombre_acteurs" DESC, m."Name";"},{"question":"Quel est l’âge moyen des acteurs pour chaque musical ayant au moins un âge renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT m."Name" AS "Musical", AVG(a."age") AS "Age_moyen"
FROM "musical" AS m
JOIN "actor" AS a ON a."Musical_ID" = m."Musical_ID"
WHERE a."age" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY m."Musical_ID", m."Name"
ORDER BY "Age_moyen" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les acteurs les plus âgés de la base ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Character", "age"
FROM "actor"
WHERE "age" = (SELECT MAX("age") FROM "actor")
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Quels musicals ne sont associés à aucun acteur ?","sql":"SELECT m."Name"
FROM "musical" AS m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "actor" AS a
    WHERE a."Musical_ID" = m."Musical_ID"
)
ORDER BY m."Name";"},{"question":"Combien de musicals appartiennent à chaque catégorie ?","sql":"SELECT "Category", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_musicals"
FROM "musical"
GROUP BY "Category"
ORDER BY "Nombre_musicals" DESC, "Category";"},{"question":"Quels acteurs ont un personnage renseigné et une durée également indiquée ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Character", "Duration"
FROM "actor"
WHERE "Character" IS NOT NULL
  AND "Duration" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Quels musicals ont reçu un résultat contenant le mot « gagnant » ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Award", "Result"
FROM "musical"
WHERE LOWER(COALESCE("Result", '')) LIKE '%gagnant%'
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Quels musicals comptent plus de deux acteurs ?","sql":"SELECT m."Name", COUNT(a."Actor_ID") AS "Nombre_acteurs"
FROM "musical" AS m
JOIN "actor" AS a ON a."Musical_ID" = m."Musical_ID"
GROUP BY m."Musical_ID", m."Name"
HAVING COUNT(a."Actor_ID") > 2
ORDER BY "Nombre_acteurs" DESC, m."Name";"},{"question":"Quels acteurs sont plus âgés que l’âge moyen de tous les acteurs renseignés ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "age"
FROM "actor"
WHERE "age" > (
    SELECT AVG("age")
    FROM "actor"
    WHERE "age" IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY "age" DESC, "Name";"},{"question":"Quels titres apparaissent soit comme nom de musical, soit comme nom d’acteur, sans doublon ?","sql":"SELECT "Name"
FROM "musical"
UNION
SELECT "Name"
FROM "actor"
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Combien d’acteurs sont associés à chaque année de sortie des musicals ?","sql":"SELECT m."Year", COUNT(a."Actor_ID") AS "Nombre_acteurs"
FROM "musical" AS m
LEFT JOIN "actor" AS a ON a."Musical_ID" = m."Musical_ID"
GROUP BY m."Year"
ORDER BY m."Year";"},{"question":"Quels acteurs jouent dans des musicals de la catégorie « Drama » ou « Comedy » ?","sql":"SELECT a."Name" AS "Acteur", m."Name" AS "Musical", m."Category"
FROM "actor" AS a
JOIN "musical" AS m ON m."Musical_ID" = a."Musical_ID"
WHERE m."Category" IN ('Drama', 'Comedy')
ORDER BY m."Category", m."Name", a."Name";"}]}
