AS f JOIN Person AS p ON p.name = f.name JOIN Person AS a ON a.name = f.friend WHERE p.age < 18 OR a.age < 18;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont des amis exerçant au moins deux métiers différents ?","sql":"SELECT f.name FROM PersonFriend AS f JOIN Person AS a ON a.name = f.friend GROUP BY f.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.job) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels couples de personnes ont le même métier et vivent dans la même ville ?","sql":"SELECT p1.name AS personne1, p2.name AS personne2, p1.city, p1.job FROM Person AS p1 JOIN Person AS p2 ON p1.name < p2.name AND p1.city = p2.city AND p1.job = p2.job;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont un ami dont le nom commence par A ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.name FROM Person AS p JOIN PersonFriend AS f ON f.name = p.name WHERE f.friend LIKE 'A%';"},{"question":"Quels liens d'amitié ont été établis entre personnes de genres différents et de villes différentes ?","sql":"SELECT f.name, f.friend, f.year FROM PersonFriend AS f JOIN Person AS p ON p.name = f.name JOIN Person AS a ON a.name = f.friend WHERE p.gender <> a.gender AND p.city <> a.city;"},{"question":"Combien de relations d'amitié chaque personne reçoit-elle ?","sql":"SELECT p.name, COUNT(f.name) AS nombre_amis_entrants FROM Person AS p LEFT JOIN PersonFriend AS f ON f.friend = p.name GROUP BY p.name;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes apparaissent à la fois comme auteur et comme destinataire d'une relation d'amitié ?","sql":"SELECT name FROM PersonFriend INTERSECT SELECT friend FROM PersonFriend;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes déclarent un ami qui n'habite pas dans leur ville ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.name FROM Person AS p JOIN PersonFriend AS f ON f.name = p.name JOIN Person AS a ON a.name = f.friend WHERE p.city <> a.city;"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne d'âge des personnes ayant au moins un ami ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(p.age) AS age_moyen FROM Person AS p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PersonFriend AS f WHERE f.name = p.name);"},{"question":"Quels genres sont associés à des personnes de plus de 50 ans ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT gender FROM Person WHERE age > 50;"},{"question":"Quelles villes ne comptent aucune personne de moins de 18 ans ?","sql":"SELECT city FROM Person GROUP BY city HAVING MIN(age) >= 18;"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms des personnes qui n'ont jamais déclaré d'amitié vers quelqu'un de leur propre ville ?","sql":"SELECT p.name FROM Person AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PersonFriend AS f JOIN Person AS a ON a.name = f.friend WHERE f.name = p.name AND a.city = p.city);"},{"question":"Pour chaque profession, quel est l'âge moyen de ses membres ?","sql":"SELECT job, AVG(age) AS age_moyen FROM Person GROUP BY job ORDER BY age_moyen DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont plus d'amis sortants que d'amis entrants ?","sql":"SELECT p.name FROM Person AS p WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PersonFriend AS o WHERE o.name = p.name) > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PersonFriend AS i WHERE i.friend = p.name);"},{"question":"Quels liens d'amitié concernent deux personnes ayant le même âge ?","sql":"SELECT f.name, f.friend, f.year FROM PersonFriend AS f JOIN Person AS p ON p.name = f.name JOIN Person AS a ON a.name = f.friend WHERE p.age = a.age;"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont au moins une personne qui a déclaré une amitié ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.city FROM Person AS p JOIN PersonFriend AS f ON f.name = p.name;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels événements ont attiré plus de participants que la moyenne de fréquentation de tous les événements ?","sql":"SELECT "Event_ID", "Name", "Event_Attendance"
FROM "event"
WHERE "Event_Attendance" > (SELECT AVG("Event_Attendance") FROM "event");"},{"question":"Quels journalistes n'ont couvert aucun événement ?","sql":"SELECT j."journalist_ID", j."Name"
FROM "journalist" AS j
LEFT JOIN "news_report" AS nr ON nr."journalist_ID" = j."journalist_ID"
WHERE nr."Event_ID" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Pour chaque événement couvert par au moins deux journalistes, combien de journalistes l'ont couvert ?","sql":"SELECT e."Event_ID", e."Name", COUNT(nr."journalist_ID") AS "Nombre_de_journalistes"
FROM "event" AS e
JOIN "news_report" AS nr ON nr."Event_ID" = e."Event_ID"
GROUP BY e."Event_ID", e."Name"
HAVING COUNT(nr."journalist_ID") >= 2;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen d'années d'expérience des journalistes pour chaque nationalité ?","sql":"SELECT "Nationality", AVG("Years_working") AS "Experience_moyenne"
FROM "journalist"
GROUP BY "Nationality";"},{"question":"Quels journalistes ont couvert au moins un événement organisé dans le lieu « Paris » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT j."journalist_ID", j."Name"
FROM "journalist" AS j
JOIN "news_report" AS nr ON nr."journalist_ID" = j."journalist_ID"
JOIN "event" AS e ON e."Event_ID" = nr."Event_ID"
WHERE e."Venue" = 'Paris';"},{"question":"Quels sont les événements ayant enregistré la plus forte affluence ?","sql":"SELECT "Event_ID", "Name", "Event_Attendance"
FROM "event"
WHERE "Event_Attendance" = (SELECT MAX("Event_Attendance") FROM "event");"},{"question":"Combien de reportages chaque journaliste a-t-il réalisés, y compris ceux qui n'en ont réalisé aucun ?","sql":"SELECT j."journalist_ID", j."Name", COUNT(nr."Event_ID") AS "Nombre_de_reportages"
FROM "journalist" AS j
LEFT JOIN "news_report" AS nr ON nr."journalist_ID" = j."journalist_ID"
GROUP BY j."journalist_ID", j."Name";"},{"question":"Quels événements n'ont été couverts par aucun journaliste ?","sql":"SELECT e."Event_ID", e."Name"
FROM "event" AS e
LEFT JOIN "news_report" AS nr ON nr."Event_ID" = e."Event_ID"
WHERE nr."journalist_ID" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels journalistes ont couvert davantage d'événements que le nombre moyen d'événements couverts par journaliste ?","sql":"SELECT j."journalist_ID", j."Name", COUNT(nr."Event_ID") AS "Nombre_evenements"
FROM "journalist" AS j
JOIN "news_report" AS nr ON nr."journalist_ID" = j."journalist_ID"
GROUP BY j."journalist_ID", j."Name"
HAVING COUNT(nr."Event_ID") > (
    SELECT AVG("Nombre_evenements")
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT("Event_ID") AS "Nombre_evenements"
        FROM "news_report"
        GROUP BY "journalist_ID"
    )
);"},{"question":"Quelles nationalités sont représentées à la fois parmi les journalistes ayant au moins cinq ans d'expérience et ceux ayant moins de cinq ans d'expérience ?","sql":"SELECT "Nationality"
FROM "journalist"
WHERE "Years_working" >= 5
INTERSECT
SELECT "Nationality"
FROM "journalist"
WHERE "Years_working" < 5;"},{"question":"Pour chaque journaliste ayant couvert au moins un événement, quelle est l'affluence moyenne des événements couverts ?","sql":"SELECT j."journalist_ID", j."Name", AVG(e."Event_Attendance") AS "Affluence_moyenne"
FROM "journalist" AS j
JOIN "news_report" AS nr ON nr."journalist_ID" = j."journalist_ID"
JOIN "event" AS e ON e."Event_ID" = nr."Event_ID"
GROUP BY j."journalist_ID", j."Name";"},{"question":"Quels journalistes ont couvert tous les événements présents dans la table des événements ?","sql":"SELECT j."journalist_ID", j."Name"
FROM "journalist" AS j
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "event" AS e
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "news_report" AS nr
        WHERE nr."journalist_ID" = j."journalist_ID"
          AND nr."Event_ID" = e."Event_ID"
    )
);"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms, nationalités et âges de tous les hôtes ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Nationality", "Age"
FROM "host";"},{"question":"Quelles sont les fêtes organisées, avec leur lieu et leurs années de début et de fin ?","sql":"SELECT "Party_Theme", "Location", "First_year", "Last_year"
FROM "party";"},{"question":"Quels hôtes sont responsables principaux d'une fête, et de quelle fête s'agit-il ?","sql":"SELECT p."Party_Theme", h."Name"
FROM "party" AS p
JOIN "party_host" AS ph ON ph."Party_ID" = p."Party_ID"
JOIN "host" AS h ON h."Host_ID" = ph."Host_ID"
WHERE ph."Is_Main_in_Charge" = 1;"},{"question":"Combien d'hôtes chaque fête possède-t-elle selon les associations enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT p."Party_ID", p."Party_Theme", COUNT(ph."Host_ID") AS "Nombre_d_hotes"
FROM "party" AS p
LEFT JOIN "party_host" AS ph ON ph."Party_ID" = p."Party_ID"
GROUP BY p."Party_ID", p."Party_Theme";"},{"question":"Combien de fêtes sont associées à chaque hôte ?","sql":"SELECT h."Host_ID", h."Name", COUNT(ph."Party_ID") AS "Nombre_de_fetes"
FROM "host" AS h
LEFT JOIN "party_host" AS ph ON ph."Host_ID" = h."Host_ID"
GROUP BY h."Host_ID", h."Name";"},{"question":"Quelles fêtes n'ont aucun hôte associé ?","sql":"SELECT p."Party_ID", p."Party_Theme"
FROM "party" AS p
LEFT JOIN "party_host" AS ph ON ph."Party_ID" = p."Party_ID"
WHERE ph."Host_ID" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels hôtes ne sont responsables principaux d'aucune fête ?","sql":"SELECT h."Host_ID", h."Name"
FROM "host" AS h
LEFT JOIN "party_host" AS ph
  ON ph."Host_ID" = h."Host_ID" AND ph."Is_Main_in_Charge" = 1
WHERE ph."Party_ID" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles nationalités distinctes sont représentées parmi les hôtes ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT "Nationality"
FROM "host"
WHERE "Nationality" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Nationality";"},{"question":"Quelles fêtes ont au moins un hôte âgé d'au moins 40 ans ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p."Party_ID", p."Party_Theme"
FROM "party" AS p
JOIN "party_host" AS ph ON ph."Party_ID" = p."Party_ID"
JOIN "host" AS h ON h."Host_ID" = ph."Host_ID"
WHERE CAST(h."Age" AS INTEGER) >= 40;"},{"question":"Quels hôtes sont liés à au moins une fête mais jamais comme responsables principaux ?","sql":"SELECT h."Host_ID", h."Name"
FROM "host" AS h
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "party_host" AS ph
    WHERE ph."Host_ID" = h."Host_ID"
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "party_host" AS ph
    WHERE ph."Host_ID" = h."Host_ID"
      AND ph."Is_Main_in_Charge" = 1
);"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total d'associations entre fêtes et hôtes ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_total_d_associations"
FROM "party_host";"},{"question":"Quelles fêtes ont au moins deux hôtes associés ?","sql":"SELECT p."Party_ID", p."Party_Theme", COUNT(ph."Host_ID") AS "Nombre_d_hotes"
FROM "party" AS p
JOIN "party_host" AS ph ON ph."Party_ID" = p."Party_ID"
GROUP BY p."Party_ID", p."Party_Theme"
HAVING COUNT(ph."Host_ID") >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels hôtes sont associés à des fêtes situées dans un lieu renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT h."Host_ID", h."Name"
FROM "host" AS h
JOIN "party_host" AS ph ON ph."Host_ID" = h."Host_ID"
JOIN "party" AS p ON p."Party_ID" = ph."Party_ID"
WHERE p."Location" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Pour chaque nationalité, combien d'hôtes et de fêtes distinctes sont représentés ?","sql":"SELECT h."Nationality",
       COUNT(DISTINCT h."Host_ID") AS "Nombre_d_hotes",
       COUNT(DISTINCT ph."Party_ID") AS "Nombre_de_fetes"
FROM "host" AS h
LEFT JOIN "party_host" AS ph ON ph."Host_ID" = h."Host_ID"
GROUP BY h."Nationality";"},{"question":"Quelles fêtes ont exclusivement des hôtes responsables principaux parmi leurs hôtes associés ?","sql":"SELECT p."Party_ID", p."Party_Theme"
FROM "party" AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "party_host" AS ph
    WHERE ph."Party_ID" = p."Party_ID"
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "party_host" AS ph
    WHERE ph."Party_ID" = p."Party_ID"
      AND ph."Is_Main_in_Charge" <> 1
);"},{"question":"Quels hôtes sont associés à la fois à une fête commencée avant 2000 et à une fête commencée en 2000 ou après ?","sql":"SELECT h."Host_ID", h."Name"
FROM "host" AS h
JOIN "party_host" AS ph ON ph."Host_ID" = h."Host_ID"
JOIN "party" AS p ON p."Party_ID" = ph."Party_ID"
GROUP BY h."Host_ID", h."Name"
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(p."First_year" AS INTEGER) < 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(p."First_year" AS INTEGER) >= 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;"},{"question":"Quels couples d'hôtes ont participé ensemble à au moins une même fête ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT h1."Name" AS "Hote_1", h2."Name" AS "Hote_2"
FROM "party_host" AS ph1
JOIN "party_host" AS ph2
  ON ph1."Party_ID" = ph2."Party_ID"
 AND ph1."Host_ID" < ph2."Host_ID"
JOIN "host" AS h1 ON h1."Host_ID" = ph1."Host_ID"
JOIN "host" AS h2 ON h2."Host_ID" = ph2."Host_ID";"},{"question":"Quelle fête possède le plus grand nombre d'hôtes associés ?","sql":"SELECT p."Party_ID", p."Party_Theme", COUNT(ph."Host_ID") AS "Nombre_d_hotes"
FROM "party" AS p
LEFT JOIN "party_host" AS ph ON ph."Party_ID" = p."Party_ID"
GROUP BY p."Party_ID", p."Party_Theme"
HAVING COUNT(ph."Host_ID") = (
    SELECT MAX("Nombre_d_hotes")
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(ph2."Host_ID") AS "Nombre_d_hotes"
        FROM "party" AS p2
        LEFT JOIN "party_host" AS ph2 ON ph2."Party_ID" = p2."Party_ID"
        GROUP BY p2."Party_ID"
    )
);"},{"question":"Quelles fêtes ont un nombre d'hôtes associé différent du nombre déclaré ?","sql":"SELECT p."Party_ID", p."Party_Theme", p."Number_of_hosts" AS "Nombre_declare", COUNT(ph."Host_ID") AS "Nombre_calcule"
FROM "party" AS p
LEFT JOIN "party_host" AS ph ON ph."Party_ID" = p."Party_ID"
GROUP BY p."Party_ID", p."Party_Theme", p."Number_of_hosts"
HAVING COUNT(ph."Host_ID") <> p."Number_of_hosts";"},{"question":"Combien de fêtes sont organisées dans chaque lieu ?","sql":"SELECT "Location", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_fetes"
FROM "party"
GROUP BY "Location"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_fetes" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels hôtes sont associés à une fête dont la première et la dernière année sont identiques ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT h."Host_ID", h."Name"
FROM "host" AS h
JOIN "party_host" AS ph ON ph."Host_ID" = h."Host_ID"
JOIN "party" AS p ON p."Party_ID" = ph."Party_ID"
WHERE p."First_year" = p."Last_year";"},{"question":"Quels hôtes sont associés à toutes les fêtes auxquelles participe au moins un hôte de leur nationalité ?","sql":"SELECT h."Host_ID", h."Name"
FROM "host" AS h
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "party" AS p
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "party_host" AS phx
        JOIN "host" AS hx ON hx."Host_ID" = phx."Host_ID"
        WHERE phx."Party_ID" = p."Party_ID"
          AND hx."Nationality" = h."Nationality"
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "party_host" AS phy
        WHERE phy."Party_ID" = p."Party_ID"
          AND phy."Host_ID" = h."Host_ID"
    )
);"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne du nombre d'hôtes associés par fête ?","sql":"SELECT AVG("Nombre_d_hotes") AS "Moyenne_des_hotes_par_fete"
FROM (
    SELECT p."Party_ID", COUNT(ph."Host_ID") AS "Nombre_d_hotes"
    FROM "party" AS p
    LEFT JOIN "party_host" AS ph ON ph."Party_ID" = p."Party_ID"
    GROUP BY p."Party_ID"
);"},{"question":"Quelles fêtes ont commencé le plus tôt ?","sql":"SELECT "Party_ID", "Party_Theme", "First_year"
FROM "party"
WHERE CAST("First_year" AS INTEGER) = (
    SELECT MIN(CAST("First_year" AS INTEGER))
    FROM "party"
);"},{"question":"Quels hôtes sont associés à la fête qui se termine le plus tard ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT h."Host_ID", h."Name"
FROM "host" AS h
JOIN "party_host" AS ph ON ph."Host_ID" = h."Host_ID"
JOIN "party" AS p ON p."Party_ID" = ph."Party_ID"
WHERE CAST(p."Last_year" AS INTEGER) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST("Last_year" AS INTEGER))
    FROM "party"
);"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de fêtes apparaissent soit dans la table des fêtes, soit dans les associations, mais pas dans les deux ?","sql":"SELECT "Party_ID"
FROM "party"
EXCEPT
SELECT "Party_ID"
FROM "party_host"
UNION
SELECT "Party_ID"
FROM "party_host"
EXCEPT
SELECT "Party_ID"
FROM "party";"},{"question":"Quels hôtes sont associés à une fête et ont la même nationalité qu'au moins un autre hôte de cette fête ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT h1."Host_ID", h1."Name"
FROM "host" AS h1
JOIN "party_host" AS ph1 ON ph1."Host_ID" = h1."Host_ID"
JOIN "party_host" AS ph2
  ON ph2."Party_ID" = ph1."Party_ID"
 AND ph2."Host_ID" <> ph1."Host_ID"
JOIN "host" AS h2 ON h2."Host_ID" = ph2."Host_ID"
WHERE h1."Nationality" = h2."Nationality";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les membres actuellement en fonction ?","sql":"SELECT "Member_ID", "Member_Name", "Party_ID"
FROM "member"
WHERE "In_office" = 'Yes';"},{"question":"Quels partis sont associés à chaque région ?","sql":"SELECT p."Party_name", r."Region_name"
FROM "party" AS p
JOIN "region" AS r ON r."Region_ID" = p."Region_ID"
ORDER BY r."Region_name", p."Party_name";"},{"question":"Combien de membres chaque parti compte-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT p."Party_name", COUNT(m."Member_ID") AS "nombre_de_membres"
FROM "party" AS p
LEFT JOIN "member" AS m ON m."Party_ID" = CAST(p."Party_ID" AS TEXT)
GROUP BY p."Party_ID", p."Party_name"
ORDER BY "nombre_de_membres" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels événements sont gérés par quel membre ?","sql":"SELECT e."Event_Name", m."Member_Name"
FROM "party_events" AS e
JOIN "member" AS m ON m."Member_ID" = e."Member_in_charge_ID"
ORDER BY e."Event_Name";"},{"question":"Quels partis ont eu un ministre et quand ont-ils pris leurs fonctions ?","sql":"SELECT "Party_name", "Minister", "Took_office"
FROM "party"
WHERE "Minister" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Took_office";"},{"question":"Quelles régions possèdent une étiquette et un format de catalogue renseignés ?","sql":"SELECT "Region_name", "Label", "Format", "Catalogue"
FROM "region"
WHERE "Label" IS NOT NULL
  AND "Format" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le parti qui compte le plus de membres ?","sql":"SELECT p."Party_name", COUNT(m."Member_ID") AS "nombre_de_membres"
FROM "party" AS p
LEFT JOIN "member" AS m ON m."Party_ID" = CAST(p."Party_ID" AS TEXT)
GROUP BY p."Party_ID", p."Party_name"
HAVING COUNT(m."Member_ID") = (
    SELECT MAX("nombre_de_membres")
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(m2."Member_ID") AS "nombre_de_membres"
        FROM "party" AS p2
        LEFT JOIN "member" AS m2 ON m2."Party_ID" = CAST(p2."Party_ID" AS TEXT)
        GROUP BY p2."Party_ID"
    )
);"},{"question":"Quels événements n’ont pas de membre responsable enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT "Event_ID", "Event_Name", "Party_ID"
FROM "party_events"
WHERE "Member_in_charge_ID" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels partis n’ont aucun membre associé ?","sql":"SELECT p."Party_ID", p."Party_name"
FROM "party" AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "member" AS m
    WHERE m."Party_ID" = CAST(p."Party_ID" AS TEXT)
);"},{"question":"Quels membres appartiennent à un parti situé dans la région correspondant à leur parti ?","sql":"SELECT m."Member_Name", p."Party_name", r."Region_name"
FROM "member" AS m
JOIN "party" AS p ON m."Party_ID" = CAST(p."Party_ID" AS TEXT)
JOIN "region" AS r ON r."Region_ID" = p."Region_ID"
ORDER BY r."Region_name", m."Member_Name";"},{"question":"Combien d’événements sont associés à chaque parti, y compris ceux sans événement ?","sql":"SELECT p."Party_name", COUNT(e."Event_ID") AS "nombre_evenements"
FROM "party" AS p
LEFT JOIN "party_events" AS e ON e."Party_ID" = p."Party_ID"
GROUP BY p."Party_ID", p."Party_name"
ORDER BY "nombre_evenements" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la date de prise de fonction la plus ancienne parmi les partis ?","sql":"SELECT MIN("Took_office") AS "premiere_prise_de_fonction"
FROM "party"
WHERE "Took_office" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de partis sont liés soit à un membre, soit à un événement ?","sql":"SELECT CAST("Party_ID" AS TEXT) AS "Party_ID"
FROM "member"
UNION
SELECT CAST("Party_ID" AS TEXT) AS "Party_ID"
FROM "party_events"
ORDER BY "Party_ID";"},{"question":"Quels partis organisent plus d’un événement ?","sql":"SELECT p."Party_name", COUNT(e."Event_ID") AS "nombre_evenements"
FROM "party" AS p
JOIN "party_events" AS e ON e."Party_ID" = p."Party_ID"
GROUP BY p."Party_ID", p."Party_name"
HAVING COUNT(e."Event_ID") > 1;"},{"question":"Combien de partis sont rattachés à chaque région ?","sql":"SELECT r."Region_name", COUNT(p."Party_ID") AS "nombre_de_partis"
FROM "region" AS r
LEFT JOIN "party" AS p ON p."Region_ID" = r."Region_ID"
GROUP BY r."Region_ID", r."Region_name"
ORDER BY "nombre_de_partis" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels membres sont associés à un parti dont le nom est renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT "Member_Name"
FROM "member" AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "party" AS p
    WHERE p."Party_ID" = CAST(m."Party_ID" AS INTEGER)
      AND p."Party_name" IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY "Member_Name";"},{"question":"Quels partis ont au moins un membre actuellement en fonction ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p."Party_name"
FROM "party" AS p
JOIN "member" AS m ON m."Party_ID" = CAST(p."Party_ID" AS TEXT)
WHERE m."In_office" = 'Yes';"},{"question":"Quels partis ont des membres, mais aucun événement enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT p."Party_name"
FROM "party" AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "member" AS m
    WHERE m."Party_ID" = CAST(p."Party_ID" AS TEXT)
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "party_events" AS e
    WHERE e."Party_ID" = p."Party_ID"
);"},{"question":"Quels couples de partis partagent la même région ?","sql":"SELECT p1."Party_name" AS "premier_parti", p2."Party_name" AS "second_parti", r."Region_name"
FROM "party" AS p1
JOIN "party" AS p2
  ON p1."Region_ID" = p2."Region_ID"
 AND p1."Party_ID" < p2."Party_ID"
JOIN "region" AS r ON r."Region_ID" = p1."Region_ID"
ORDER BY r."Region_name", "premier_parti", "second_parti";"},{"question":"Quels événements sont associés à un parti et à sa région ?","sql":"SELECT e."Event_Name", p."Party_name", r."Region_name"
FROM "party_events" AS e
JOIN "party" AS p ON p."Party_ID" = e."Party_ID"
JOIN "region" AS r ON r."Region_ID" = p."Region_ID"
ORDER BY e."Event_Name";"}]}

      "sql": "SELECT "Host",
       COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_performances",
       AVG("Attendance") AS "Affluence_moyenne"

    },
    {

      "sql": "SELECT p."Performance_ID", p."Date", p."Host", p."Location"

    SELECT 1

    WHERE ma."Performance_ID" = p."Performance_ID"
);"
    },
    {

      "sql": "SELECT "Performance_ID", "Date", "Host", "Location", "Attendance"

    SELECT MAX("Attendance")
    FROM "performance"
);"
    },
    {
      "question": "Quels membres n'ont participé à aucune performance ?",
      "sql": "SELECT m."Member_ID", m."Name", m."Nationality", m."Role"
FROM "member" AS m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "member_attendance" AS ma
    WHERE ma."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
);"
    },
    {
      "question": "Quelle est la moyenne du nombre de pièces jouées par participation pour chaque nationalité ?",
      "sql": "SELECT m."Nationality",
       AVG(ma."Num_of_Pieces") AS "Moyenne_de_pieces_par_participation"
FROM "member" AS m

  ON ma."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"

    },
    {
      "question": "Pour chaque performance ayant au moins un participant, quels sont les noms des membres qui y ont participé ?",
      "sql": "SELECT p."Performance_ID", p."Date", p."Host",
       group_concat(m."Name", ', ') AS "Participants"
FROM "performance" AS p
JOIN "member_attendance" AS ma

    {

      "sql": "SELECT m."Member_ID", m."Name"
FROM "member" AS m
JOIN "member_attendance" AS ma

GROUP BY m."Member_ID", m."Name"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ma."Performance_ID") = (

      "question": "Pour chaque lieu, quelle est l'affluence totale, l'affluence moyenne et le nombre de performances organisées ?",

  ]
}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms des personnes impliquées dans un événement survenu en France, avec la date et le lieu correspondants ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", pr."Date", pr."Location"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "perpetrator" AS pr ON pr."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
WHERE pr."Country" = 'France';"},{"question":"Combien d'événements sont recensés dans chaque pays, en ne gardant que les pays comptant au moins deux événements ?","sql":"SELECT "Country", COUNT(*) AS nombre_evenements
FROM "perpetrator"
GROUP BY "Country"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_evenements DESC, "Country";"},{"question":"Quelles personnes sont associées à plus d'un événement ?","sql":"SELECT p."People_ID", p."Name", COUNT(pr."Perpetrator_ID") AS nombre_evenements
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "perpetrator" AS pr ON pr."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
GROUP BY p."People_ID", p."Name"
HAVING COUNT(pr."Perpetrator_ID") > 1
ORDER BY nombre_evenements DESC;"},{"question":"Quels événements ont causé plus de blessés que la moyenne de tous les événements ?","sql":"SELECT "Perpetrator_ID", "Date", "Country", "Injured"
FROM "perpetrator"
WHERE "Injured" > (SELECT AVG("Injured") FROM "perpetrator")
ORDER BY "Injured" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ne sont associées à aucun événement recensé ?","sql":"SELECT p."People_ID", p."Name"
FROM "people" AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "perpetrator" AS pr
    WHERE pr."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
)
ORDER BY p."Name";"},{"question":"Quels sont les pays où le nombre moyen de victimes tuées par événement dépasse deux ?","sql":"SELECT "Country", AVG("Killed") AS moyenne_tues
FROM "perpetrator"
GROUP BY "Country"
HAVING AVG("Killed") > 2
ORDER BY moyenne_tues DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont participé à au moins un événement situé à Londres ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p."Name"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "perpetrator" AS pr ON pr."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
WHERE pr."Location" = 'London'
ORDER BY p."Name";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total de personnes, le nombre de personnes impliquées dans un événement et le nombre d'événements recensés ?","sql":"SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "people") AS total_personnes,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "People_ID") FROM "perpetrator") AS personnes_impliquees,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "perpetrator") AS total_evenements;"},{"question":"Quels sont les lieux ou pays mentionnés dans les données, sans doublon ?","sql":"SELECT "Location" AS valeur
FROM "perpetrator"
WHERE "Location" IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT "Country" AS valeur
FROM "perpetrator"
WHERE "Country" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY valeur;"},{"question":"Pour chaque personne ayant participé à un événement, quel est le nombre total de personnes tuées et blessées dans ses événements ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name",
       SUM(pr."Killed") AS total_tues,
       SUM(pr."Injured") AS total_blesses
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "perpetrator" AS pr ON pr."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
GROUP BY p."People_ID", p."Name"
ORDER BY total_tues DESC, total_blesses DESC;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les modèles de puces et leur année de lancement, classés du plus récent au plus ancien ?","sql":"SELECT "Model_name", "Launch_year"
FROM "chip_model"
ORDER BY "Launch_year" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels téléphones utilisent chaque modèle de puce, avec le nom de l’entreprise ?","sql":"SELECT p."Hardware_Model_name", p."Company_name", c."Model_name"
FROM "phone" AS p
JOIN "chip_model" AS c ON p."chip_model" = c."Model_name"
ORDER BY p."Company_name", p."Hardware_Model_name";"},{"question":"Quels modes graphiques ont un nombre de couleurs matérielles supérieur à la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT "Graphics_mode", "Hardware_colours", "Type"
FROM "screen_mode"
WHERE "Hardware_colours" > (SELECT AVG("Hardware_colours") FROM "screen_mode")
ORDER BY "Hardware_colours" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de téléphones chaque entreprise possède-t-elle ?","sql":"SELECT "Company_name", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_telephones"
FROM "phone"
GROUP BY "Company_name"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_telephones" DESC, "Company_name";"},{"question":"Quelle est la quantité moyenne de mémoire vive par type de Wi-Fi ?","sql":"SELECT "WiFi", AVG("RAM_MiB") AS "RAM_moyenne_MiB"
FROM "chip_model"
GROUP BY "WiFi"
ORDER BY "RAM_moyenne_MiB" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels téléphones utilisent un mode graphique de type couleur, et quel est le nombre de couleurs correspondant ?","sql":"SELECT p."Hardware_Model_name", p."Company_name", s."Graphics_mode", s."Hardware_colours"
FROM "phone" AS p
JOIN "screen_mode" AS s ON p."screen_mode" = s."Graphics_mode"
WHERE LOWER(s."Type") LIKE '%couleur%'
ORDER BY p."Company_name", p."Hardware_Model_name";"},{"question":"Quels modèles de puces ne sont utilisés par aucun téléphone ?","sql":"SELECT c."Model_name"
FROM "chip_model" AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "phone" AS p
    WHERE p."chip_model" = c."Model_name"
)
ORDER BY c."Model_name";"},{"question":"Quels modèles de puces ont la plus grande capacité de mémoire morte ?","sql":"SELECT "Model_name", "ROM_MiB"
FROM "chip_model"
WHERE "ROM_MiB" = (SELECT MAX("ROM_MiB") FROM "chip_model");"},{"question":"Quels modèles de puces offrent le Wi-Fi ou le Bluetooth, sans doublons ?","sql":"SELECT "Model_name"
FROM "chip_model"
WHERE "WiFi" IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT "Model_name"
FROM "chip_model"
WHERE "Bluetooth" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Model_name";"},{"question":"Combien de modes graphiques existe-t-il pour chaque type d’écran ?","sql":"SELECT "Type", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_modes"
FROM "screen_mode"
GROUP BY "Type"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_modes" DESC, "Type";"},{"question":"Pour chaque téléphone, quels sont son modèle de puce et son mode graphique ?","sql":"SELECT p."Hardware_Model_name", c."Model_name" AS "Modele_de_puce", s."Graphics_mode"
FROM "phone" AS p
LEFT JOIN "chip_model" AS c ON p."chip_model" = c."Model_name"
LEFT JOIN "screen_mode" AS s ON p."screen_mode" = s."Graphics_mode"
ORDER BY p."Hardware_Model_name";"},{"question":"Quelle est la date la plus ancienne d’un téléphone pour chaque entreprise ?","sql":"SELECT "Company_name", MIN("Date") AS "Premiere_date"
FROM "phone"
GROUP BY "Company_name"
ORDER BY "Premiere_date";"},{"question":"Quels téléphones utilisent une puce dont la mémoire morte dépasse la moyenne des puces utilisées par des téléphones ?","sql":"SELECT p."Hardware_Model_name", p."Company_name", c."ROM_MiB"
FROM "phone" AS p
JOIN "chip_model" AS c ON p."chip_model" = c."Model_name"
WHERE c."ROM_MiB" > (
    SELECT AVG(c2."ROM_MiB")
    FROM "phone" AS p2
    JOIN "chip_model" AS c2 ON p2."chip_model" = c2."Model_name"
)
ORDER BY c."ROM_MiB" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne du nombre de couleurs matérielles par type de mode graphique ?","sql":"SELECT "Type", AVG("Hardware_colours") AS "Moyenne_des_couleurs"
FROM "screen_mode"
GROUP BY "Type"
ORDER BY "Moyenne_des_couleurs" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de téléphones utilisent chaque mode graphique, y compris les modes qui ne sont associés à aucun téléphone ?","sql":"SELECT s."Graphics_mode", s."Type", COUNT(p."Hardware_Model_name") AS "Nombre_de_telephones"
FROM "screen_mode" AS s
LEFT JOIN "phone" AS p ON p."screen_mode" = s."Graphics_mode"
GROUP BY s."Graphics_mode", s."Type"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_telephones" DESC, s."Graphics_mode";"},{"question":"Combien de téléphones existe-t-il pour chaque niveau d’accréditation ?","sql":"SELECT "Accreditation_level", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_telephones"
FROM "phone"
GROUP BY "Accreditation_level"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_telephones" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels modèles de puces ne sont référencés par aucun téléphone, en utilisant une opération ensembliste ?","sql":"SELECT "Model_name"
FROM "chip_model"
EXCEPT
SELECT "chip_model"
FROM "phone"
WHERE "chip_model" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Model_name";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels pilotes ont enregistré au moins un vol, et combien de vols chacun a-t-il enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT p."Pilot_ID", p."Pilot_name", COUNT(pr."Record_ID") AS nombre_de_vols
FROM "pilot" AS p
LEFT JOIN "pilot_record" AS pr ON pr."Pilot_ID" = p."Pilot_ID"
GROUP BY p."Pilot_ID", p."Pilot_name"
HAVING COUNT(pr."Record_ID") > 0
ORDER BY nombre_de_vols DESC, p."Pilot_name";"},{"question":"Quels constructeurs d’aéronefs sont associés à au moins deux pilotes distincts ?","sql":"SELECT a."Manufacturer", COUNT(DISTINCT pr."Pilot_ID") AS nombre_de_pilotes
FROM "aircraft" AS a
JOIN "pilot_record" AS pr ON pr."Aircraft_ID" = a."Aircraft_ID"
GROUP BY a."Manufacturer"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pr."Pilot_ID") >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_de_pilotes DESC, a."Manufacturer";"},{"question":"Pour chaque pilote ayant un enregistrement, quelle est la date de son dernier vol ?","sql":"SELECT p."Pilot_name", MAX(pr."Date") AS derniere_date
FROM "pilot" AS p
JOIN "pilot_record" AS pr ON pr."Pilot_ID" = p."Pilot_ID"
GROUP BY p."Pilot_ID", p."Pilot_name"
ORDER BY derniere_date DESC;"},{"question":"Quels aéronefs n’ont encore jamais été utilisés dans un enregistrement de vol ?","sql":"SELECT a."Aircraft_ID", a."Manufacturer", a."Model"
FROM "aircraft" AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "pilot_record" AS pr
    WHERE pr."Aircraft_ID" = a."Aircraft_ID"
)
ORDER BY a."Aircraft_ID";"},{"question":"Quelles nationalités ont un âge moyen de pilotes supérieur à 35 ans ?","sql":"SELECT "Nationality", ROUND(AVG("Age"), 2) AS age_moyen
FROM "pilot"
GROUP BY "Nationality"
HAVING AVG("Age") > 35
ORDER BY age_moyen DESC;"},{"question":"Quels pilotes ont utilisé un aéronef à propulsion électrique ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p."Pilot_ID", p."Pilot_name"
FROM "pilot" AS p
JOIN "pilot_record" AS pr ON pr."Pilot_ID" = p."Pilot_ID"
JOIN "aircraft" AS a ON a."Aircraft_ID" = pr."Aircraft_ID"
WHERE LOWER(a."Powertrain") LIKE '%electric%'
ORDER BY p."Pilot_name";"},{"question":"Combien d’enregistrements de vol ont été réalisés chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT SUBSTR("Date", 1, 4) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_d_enregistrements
FROM "pilot_record"
GROUP BY SUBSTR("Date", 1, 4)
ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quels aéronefs ont un nombre d’enregistrements supérieur à la moyenne de tous les aéronefs enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT a."Aircraft_ID", a."Manufacturer", a."Model", COUNT(pr."Record_ID") AS nombre_d_enregistrements
FROM "aircraft" AS a
JOIN "pilot_record" AS pr ON pr."Aircraft_ID" = a."Aircraft_ID"
GROUP BY a."Aircraft_ID", a."Manufacturer", a."Model"
HAVING COUNT(pr."Record_ID") > (
    SELECT AVG(nombre)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre
        FROM "pilot_record"
        GROUP BY "Aircraft_ID"
    )
)
ORDER BY nombre_d_enregistrements DESC;"},{"question":"Quels pilotes de nationalité française ou belge ont au moins un enregistrement de vol ?","sql":"SELECT p."Pilot_ID", p."Pilot_name", p."Nationality"
FROM "pilot" AS p
WHERE p."Nationality" = 'French'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM "pilot_record" AS pr
      WHERE pr."Pilot_ID" = p."Pilot_ID"
  )
UNION
SELECT p."Pilot_ID", p."Pilot_name", p."Nationality"
FROM "pilot" AS p
WHERE p."Nationality" = 'Belgian'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM "pilot_record" AS pr
      WHERE pr."Pilot_ID" = p."Pilot_ID"
  )
ORDER BY "Pilot_name";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les catalogues avec leur éditeur et leur date de dernière révision ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_name, catalog_publisher, date_of_latest_revision
FROM Catalogs;"},{"question":"Combien d’entrées de catalogue chaque catalogue contient-il ?","sql":"SELECT c.catalog_id, c.catalog_name, COUNT(cc.catalog_entry_id) AS nombre_entrees
FROM Catalogs AS c
LEFT JOIN Catalog_Structure AS cs ON cs.catalog_id = c.catalog_id
LEFT JOIN Catalog_Contents AS cc ON cc.catalog_level_number = cs.catalog_level_number
GROUP BY c.catalog_id, c.catalog_name;"},{"question":"Quels sont les niveaux de catalogue dont le prix moyen en dollars dépasse 100 ?","sql":"SELECT cs.catalog_level_number, cs.catalog_level_name, AVG(cc.price_in_dollars) AS prix_moyen_dollars
FROM Catalog_Structure AS cs
JOIN Catalog_Contents AS cc ON cc.catalog_level_number = cs.catalog_level_number
WHERE cc.price_in_dollars IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cs.catalog_level_number, cs.catalog_level_name
HAVING AVG(cc.price_in_dollars) > 100;"},{"question":"Quelles entrées possèdent un prix en dollars mais aucun prix en euros ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_entry_id, catalog_entry_name, product_stock_number, price_in_dollars
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE price_in_dollars IS NOT NULL
  AND price_in_euros IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels attributs supplémentaires sont associés à chaque entrée, avec leur nom et leur type de données ?","sql":"SELECT ca.catalog_entry_id, ad.attribute_name, ad.attribute_data_type, ca.attribute_value
FROM Catalog_Contents_Additional_Attributes AS ca
JOIN Attribute_Definitions AS ad ON ad.attribute_id = ca.attribute_id
ORDER BY ca.catalog_entry_id, ad.attribute_name;"},{"question":"Quelles entrées ont un parent, et quel est le nom de leur entrée parente ?","sql":"SELECT child.catalog_entry_id AS entree_id, child.catalog_entry_name AS nom_entree, parent.catalog_entry_id AS parent_id, parent.catalog_entry_name AS nom_parent
FROM Catalog_Contents AS child
JOIN Catalog_Contents AS parent ON parent.catalog_entry_id = child.parent_entry_id;"},{"question":"Quels catalogues ont été révisés après leur date de publication ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_id, catalog_name, date_of_publication, date_of_latest_revision
FROM Catalogs
WHERE date_of_latest_revision > date_of_publication;"},{"question":"Quels sont les niveaux de catalogue qui ne contiennent aucune entrée ?","sql":"SELECT cs.catalog_level_number, cs.catalog_level_name
FROM Catalog_Structure AS cs
LEFT JOIN Catalog_Contents AS cc ON cc.catalog_level_number = cs.catalog_level_number
WHERE cc.catalog_entry_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Pour chaque catalogue, quelles sont les entrées les plus chères en dollars ?","sql":"SELECT c.catalog_name, cc.catalog_entry_name, cc.price_in_dollars
FROM Catalogs AS c
JOIN Catalog_Structure AS cs ON cs.catalog_id = c.catalog_id
JOIN Catalog_Contents AS cc ON cc.catalog_level_number = cs.catalog_level_number
WHERE cc.price_in_dollars IS NOT NULL
  AND cc.price_in_dollars = (
    SELECT MAX(cc2.price_in_dollars)
    FROM Catalog_Structure AS cs2
    JOIN Catalog_Contents AS cc2 ON cc2.catalog_level_number = cs2.catalog_level_number
    WHERE cs2.catalog_id = c.catalog_id
  );"},{"question":"Quels identifiants d’entrées disposent à la fois d’une largeur et d’une hauteur renseignées, mais pas d’une longueur ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_entry_id, catalog_entry_name, width, height
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE width IS NOT NULL
  AND height IS NOT NULL
  AND length IS NULL;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les clients ayant effectué au moins une réservation, avec le nombre de réservations et le montant total payable ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(b.booking_id) AS nombre_reservations, SUM(b.amount_payable) AS montant_total_payable
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Bookings AS b ON b.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY montant_total_payable DESC;"},{"question":"Quels produits n'ont jamais été réservés ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_type_code
FROM Products_for_Hire AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Products_Booked AS pb
    WHERE pb.product_id = p.product_id
)
ORDER BY p.product_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total payé et dû pour chaque type de paiement ?","sql":"SELECT payment_type_code, SUM(amount_paid) AS montant_total_paye, SUM(amount_due) AS montant_total_du
FROM Payments
GROUP BY payment_type_code
ORDER BY payment_type_code;"},{"question":"Quels produits sont actuellement indiqués comme disponibles selon leur dernier relevé de disponibilité ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, v.status_date
FROM Products_for_Hire AS p
JOIN View_Product_Availability AS v ON v.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE v.status_date = (
    SELECT MAX(v2.status_date)
    FROM View_Product_Availability AS v2
    WHERE v2.product_id = v.product_id
)
AND v.available_yn = 'Y'
ORDER BY p.product_name;"},{"question":"Quelles réservations ont donné lieu à un retour endommagé, avec le nom du client et le montant payable ?","sql":"SELECT b.booking_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, b.booking_start_date, b.booking_end_date, b.amount_payable
FROM Bookings AS b
JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = b.customer_id
WHERE b.returned_damaged_yn = 'Y'
ORDER BY b.booking_start_date;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont reçu un coupon supérieur au montant moyen de tous les coupons ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, d.coupon_amount
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Discount_Coupons AS d ON d.coupon_id = c.coupon_id
WHERE d.coupon_amount > (
    SELECT AVG(coupon_amount)
    FROM Discount_Coupons
)
ORDER BY d.coupon_amount DESC;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont une réservation mais aucun paiement associé ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
FROM Customers AS c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Bookings AS b
    WHERE b.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Payments AS p
    WHERE p.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;"},{"question":"Pour chaque type de produit, combien d'articles ont été réservés et quel est le montant moyen réservé ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_type_code, SUM(pb.booked_count) AS quantite_totale_reservee, AVG(pb.booked_amount) AS montant_moyen_reserve
FROM Products_for_Hire AS p
JOIN Products_Booked AS pb ON pb.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_type_code
ORDER BY p.product_type_code;"},{"question":"Quelles réservations ont un montant payable supérieur à la moyenne des réservations du même client ?","sql":"SELECT b.booking_id, b.customer_id, b.amount_payable
FROM Bookings AS b
WHERE b.amount_payable > (
    SELECT AVG(b2.amount_payable)
    FROM Bookings AS b2
    WHERE b2.customer_id = b.customer_id
)
ORDER BY b.customer_id, b.amount_payable DESC;"}]}

associées au produit dont l'identifiant est 1 ?","sql":"SELECT c.characteristic_name, pc.product_characteristic_value FROM Product_Characteristics AS pc JOIN Characteristics AS c ON t.characteristic_type_description FROM Ref_Characteristic_Types AS t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Characteristics AS c WHERE c.characteristic_type_code = t.characteristic_type_code);"},{"question":"Combien de caractéristiques chaque type décrit-il, y compris les types sans caractéristique ?","sql":"SELECT t.characteristic_type_code, t.characteristic_type_description, COUNT(c.characteristic_id) AS nombre_de_caracteristiques FROM Ref_Characteristic_Types AS t LEFT JOIN Characteristics AS c ON c.characteristic_type_code = t.characteristic_type_code GROUP BY t.characteristic_type_code, t.characteristic_type_description;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont au moins une caractéristique de type numérique ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM Products AS p JOIN Product_Characteristics AS pc ON pc.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Characteristics AS c ON c.characteristic_id = pc.characteristic_id WHERE LOWER(c.characteristic_data_type) IN ('integer', 'real', 'numeric', 'number');"},{"question":"Quelles catégories ont un prix de vente moyen supérieur à la moyenne générale ?","sql":"SELECT r.product_category_code, r.product_category_description, AVG(CAST(p.typical_selling_price AS REAL)) AS prix_moyen FROM Ref_Product_Categories AS r JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_category_code = r.product_category_code WHERE p.typical_selling_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.product_category_code, r.product_category_description HAVING AVG(CAST(p.typical_selling_price AS REAL)) > (SELECT AVG(CAST(typical_selling_price AS REAL)) FROM Products WHERE typical_selling_price IS NOT NULL);"},{"question":"Quels produits appartiennent à une catégorie dont l'unité de mesure est renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, r.unit_of_measure FROM Products AS p JOIN Ref_Product_Categories AS r ON r.product_category_code = p.product_category_code WHERE r.unit_of_measure IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles catégories ne contiennent aucun produit ?","sql":"SELECT r.product_category_code, r.product_category_description FROM Ref_Product_Categories AS r LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_category_code = r.product_category_code WHERE p.product_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles couleurs référencées ne sont utilisées par aucun produit ?","sql":"SELECT c.color_code, c.color_description FROM Ref_Colors AS c LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.color_code = c.color_code WHERE p.product_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont la même couleur qu'au moins un autre produit ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.color_code FROM Products AS p WHERE p.color_code IN (SELECT color_code FROM Products GROUP BY color_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un prix de vente identique à celui d'au moins un autre produit ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.typical_selling_price FROM Products AS p WHERE p.typical_selling_price IS NOT NULL AND p.typical_selling_price IN (SELECT typical_selling_price FROM Products WHERE typical_selling_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY typical_selling_price HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);"},{"question":"Quels noms de produits apparaissent plusieurs fois ?","sql":"SELECT product_name, COUNT(*) AS occurrences FROM Products WHERE product_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un prix d'achat ou de vente non numérique ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, typical_buying_price, typical_selling_price FROM Products WHERE (typical_buying_price IS NOT NULL AND CAST(typical_buying_price AS REAL) = 0 AND typical_buying_price NOT LIKE '0%') OR (typical_selling_price IS NOT NULL AND CAST(typical_selling_price AS REAL) = 0 AND typical_selling_price NOT LIKE '0%');"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un prix de vente au moins deux fois supérieur à leur prix d'achat ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, typical_buying_price, typical_selling_price FROM Products WHERE typical_buying_price IS NOT NULL AND typical_selling_price IS NOT NULL AND CAST(typical_selling_price AS REAL) >= 2 * CAST(typical_buying_price AS REAL);"},{"question":"Quel est l'écart moyen entre prix de vente et prix d'achat ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(CAST(typical_selling_price AS REAL) - CAST(typical_buying_price AS REAL)) AS ecart_moyen FROM Products WHERE typical_buying_price IS NOT NULL AND typical_selling_price IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont le prix de vente le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, typical_selling_price FROM Products WHERE typical_selling_price IS NOT NULL AND CAST(typical_selling_price AS REAL) = (SELECT MAX(CAST(typical_selling_price AS REAL)) FROM Products WHERE typical_selling_price IS NOT NULL);"},{"question":"Quels produits ont le prix d'achat le plus bas ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, typical_buying_price FROM Products WHERE typical_buying_price IS NOT NULL AND CAST(typical_buying_price AS REAL) = (SELECT MIN(CAST(typical_buying_price AS REAL)) FROM Products WHERE typical_buying_price IS NOT NULL);"},{"question":"Quels produits ont à la fois une description et des détails complémentaires ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name FROM Products WHERE product_description IS NOT NULL AND other_product_details IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont une description ou des détails complémentaires renseignés ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name FROM Products WHERE product_description IS NOT NULL OR other_product_details IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels produits n'ont ni description ni détails complémentaires ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name FROM Products WHERE product_description IS NULL AND other_product_details IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelle est la longueur moyenne des noms de produits ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(LENGTH(product_name)) AS longueur_moyenne FROM Products WHERE product_name IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq premiers produits classés par nom ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name FROM Products WHERE product_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY product_name LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Quels produits sont classés par prix de vente décroissant ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, typical_selling_price FROM Products WHERE typical_selling_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(typical_selling_price AS REAL) DESC, product_name;"},{"question":"Quelles catégories sont classées par nombre décroissant de produits ?","sql":"SELECT r.product_category_code, r.product_category_description, COUNT(p.product_id) AS nombre_de_produits FROM Ref_Product_Categories AS r LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_category_code = r.product_category_code GROUP BY r.product_category_code, r.product_category_description ORDER BY nombre_de_produits DESC;"},{"question":"Quels couples de produits et de caractéristiques ont une valeur contenant le mot « oui » ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_name, c.characteristic_name, pc.product_characteristic_value FROM Product_Characteristics AS pc JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = pc.product_id JOIN Characteristics AS c ON c.characteristic_id = pc.characteristic_id WHERE LOWER(pc.product_characteristic_value) LIKE '%oui%';"},{"question":"Quelles valeurs distinctes sont enregistrées pour chaque caractéristique ?","sql":"SELECT characteristic_id, product_characteristic_value FROM Product_Characteristics WHERE product_characteristic_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY characteristic_id, product_characteristic_value ORDER BY characteristic_id, product_characteristic_value;"},{"question":"Combien de valeurs distinctes chaque caractéristique possède-t-elle ?","sql":"SELECT c.characteristic_id, c.characteristic_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.product_characteristic_value) AS nombre_de_valeurs FROM Characteristics AS c LEFT JOIN Product_Characteristics AS pc ON pc.characteristic_id = c.characteristic_id GROUP BY c.characteristic_id, c.characteristic_name;"},{"question":"Quels produits utilisent toutes les caractéristiques qui sont associées au produit 1 ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM Products AS p WHERE p.product_id <> 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Product_Characteristics AS pc1 WHERE pc1.product_id = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Product_Characteristics AS pc2 WHERE pc2.product_id = p.product_id AND pc2.characteristic_id = pc1.characteristic_id));"},{"question":"Quels produits ont au moins une caractéristique mais aucune valeur renseignée pour leurs associations ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM Products AS p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Product_Characteristics AS pc WHERE pc.product_id = p.product_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Product_Characteristics AS pc WHERE pc.product_id = p.product_id AND pc.product_characteristic_value IS NOT NULL);"},{"question":"Quels produits ont une caractéristique dont la valeur est exactement « noir » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM Products AS p JOIN Product_Characteristics AS pc ON pc.product_id = p.product_id WHERE LOWER(pc.product_characteristic_value) = 'noir';"},{"question":"Quels identifiants apparaissent à la fois dans les produits et dans les associations de caractéristiques ?","sql":"SELECT product_id FROM Products INTERSECT SELECT product_id FROM Product_Characteristics;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de caractéristiques ne sont associés à aucun produit ?","sql":"SELECT characteristic_id FROM Characteristics EXCEPT SELECT characteristic_id FROM Product_Characteristics;"},{"question":"Quels codes couleur sont soit référencés, soit utilisés par un produit ?","sql":"SELECT color_code FROM Ref_Colors UNION SELECT color_code FROM Products;"},{"question":"Quels produits appartiennent aux catégories dont l'unité de mesure contient « kg » ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, r.unit_of_measure FROM Products AS p JOIN Ref_Product_Categories AS r ON r.product_category_code = p.product_category_code WHERE LOWER(r.unit_of_measure) LIKE '%kg%';"},{"question":"Quels noms de catégories sont plus longs que la longueur moyenne des noms de catégories ?","sql":"SELECT product_category_code, product_category_description FROM Ref_Product_Categories WHERE product_category_description IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(product_category_description) > (SELECT AVG(LENGTH(product_category_description)) FROM Ref_Product_Categories WHERE product_category_description IS NOT NULL);"},{"question":"Quels types de caractéristiques possèdent le plus grand nombre de caractéristiques ?","sql":"WITH comptes AS (SELECT characteristic_type_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre FROM Characteristics GROUP BY characteristic_type_code) SELECT t.characteristic_type_code, t.characteristic_type_description, comptes.nombre FROM comptes JOIN Ref_Characteristic_Types AS t ON t.characteristic_type_code = comptes.characteristic_type_code WHERE comptes.nombre = (SELECT MAX(nombre) FROM comptes);"},{"question":"Pour chaque catégorie, quel est le prix de vente maximal renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT r.product_category_code, r.product_category_description, MAX(CAST(p.typical_selling_price AS REAL)) AS prix_de_vente_maximal FROM Ref_Product_Categories AS r LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_category_code = r.product_category_code AND p.typical_selling_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.product_category_code, r.product_category_description;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un prix de vente supérieur à tous les prix de vente de la catégorie dont le code est « A » ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, typical_selling_price FROM Products WHERE typical_selling_price IS NOT NULL AND CAST(typical_selling_price AS REAL) > (SELECT MAX(CAST(typical_selling_price AS REAL)) FROM Products WHERE product_category_code = 'A' AND typical_selling_price IS NOT NULL);"}]}

diffusent plus de programmes que la moyenne des chaînes ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Name\", COUNT(b.\"Program_ID\") AS \"Program_Count\" FROM \"channel\" AS c LEFT JOIN \"broadcast\" AS b ON b.\"Channel_ID\" = c.\"Channel_ID\" GROUP BY c.\"Channel_ID\", c.\"Name\" HAVING COUNT(b.\"Program_ID\") > (SELECT AVG(program_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(b2.\"Program_ID\") AS program_count FROM \"channel\" AS c2 LEFT JOIN \"broadcast\" AS b2 ON b2.\"Channel_ID\" = c2.\"Channel_ID\" GROUP BY c2.\"Channel_ID\")) ORDER BY \"Program_Count\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles chaînes ont à la fois au moins une diffusion et une note supérieure à la moyenne des chaînes ?","sql":"SELECT \"Channel_ID\", \"Name\" FROM \"channel\" WHERE \"Channel_ID\" IN (SELECT \"Channel_ID\" FROM \"broadcast\") INTERSECT SELECT \"Channel_ID\", \"Name\" FROM \"channel\" WHERE \"Rating_in_percent\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Rating_in_percent\") FROM \"channel\");"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles sont les institutions situées dans chaque lieu, avec leur nom et leur type ?","sql":"SELECT "Location", "Institution", "Type"
FROM "Institution"
ORDER BY "Location", "Institution";"},{"question":"Combien d'institutions appartiennent à chaque type ?","sql":"SELECT "Type", COUNT(*) AS "nombre_institutions"
FROM "Institution"
GROUP BY "Type"
ORDER BY "nombre_institutions" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles institutions ont une population étudiante supérieure à la moyenne de toutes les institutions ?","sql":"SELECT "Institution", "Enrollment"
FROM "Institution"
WHERE "Enrollment" > (SELECT AVG("Enrollment") FROM "Institution")
ORDER BY "Enrollment" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels bâtiments ont plus de 50 étages, en indiquant leur nom et leur hauteur ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Floors", "Height_feet"
FROM "building"
WHERE "Floors" > 50
ORDER BY "Floors" DESC, "Height_feet" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la hauteur du bâtiment le plus élevé et quels bâtiments l'atteignent ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Height_feet"
FROM "building"
WHERE "Height_feet" = (SELECT MAX("Height_feet") FROM "building");"},{"question":"Pour chaque institution, quel est le nombre de protéines qui lui est associé, y compris celles sans protéine ?","sql":"SELECT i."Institution", COUNT(p."common_name") AS "nombre_proteines"
FROM "Institution" AS i
LEFT JOIN "protein" AS p ON p."Institution_id" = i."Institution_id"
GROUP BY i."Institution_id", i."Institution"
ORDER BY "nombre_proteines" DESC, i."Institution";"},{"question":"Quelles protéines ont une longueur de séquence supérieure à la longueur moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT "common_name", "protein_name", "sequence_length"
FROM "protein"
WHERE "sequence_length" > (SELECT AVG("sequence_length") FROM "protein")
ORDER BY "sequence_length" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la longueur moyenne des séquences de protéines pour chaque institution ?","sql":"SELECT i."Institution", AVG(p."sequence_length") AS "longueur_moyenne"
FROM "Institution" AS i
JOIN "protein" AS p ON p."Institution_id" = i."Institution_id"
GROUP BY i."Institution_id", i."Institution"
ORDER BY "longueur_moyenne" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles institutions n'ont aucune protéine associée ?","sql":"SELECT i."Institution", i."Institution_id"
FROM "Institution" AS i
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "protein" AS p
    WHERE p."Institution_id" = i."Institution_id"
)
ORDER BY i."Institution";"},{"question":"Quelle protéine présente la plus grande divergence par rapport à la lignée humaine ?","sql":"SELECT "common_name", "protein_name", "divergence_from_human_lineage"
FROM "protein"
WHERE "divergence_from_human_lineage" = (
    SELECT MAX("divergence_from_human_lineage")
    FROM "protein"
);"},{"question":"Quelles institutions disposent d'un bâtiment associé, avec l'adresse de ce bâtiment ?","sql":"SELECT i."Institution", b."Name", b."Street_address"
FROM "Institution" AS i
JOIN "building" AS b ON b."building_id" = i."building_id"
ORDER BY i."Institution";"},{"question":"Quels sont les lieux mentionnés pour les institutions ou dans les adresses des bâtiments ?","sql":"SELECT "Location" AS "lieu"
FROM "Institution"
WHERE "Location" IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT "Street_address" AS "lieu"
FROM "building"
WHERE "Street_address" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "lieu";"},{"question":"Quelles conférences principales regroupent au moins deux institutions ?","sql":"SELECT "Primary_Conference", COUNT(*) AS "nombre_institutions"
FROM "Institution"
WHERE "Primary_Conference" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "Primary_Conference"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY "nombre_institutions" DESC, "Primary_Conference";"},{"question":"Quelles protéines ont une divergence supérieure à la divergence moyenne de leur institution ?","sql":"SELECT p."common_name", p."protein_name", i."Institution", p."divergence_from_human_lineage"
FROM "protein" AS p
JOIN "Institution" AS i ON i."Institution_id" = p."Institution_id"
WHERE p."divergence_from_human_lineage" > (
    SELECT AVG(p2."divergence_from_human_lineage")
    FROM "protein" AS p2
    WHERE p2."Institution_id" = p."Institution_id"
)
ORDER BY i."Institution", p."divergence_from_human_lineage" DESC;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles sont les courses avec le nom de leur circuit ?","sql":"SELECT r."Name" AS race_name, t."Name" AS track_name
FROM "race" AS r
JOIN "track" AS t ON t."Track_ID" = r."Track_ID";"},{"question":"Quels circuits n'ont encore accueilli aucune course ?","sql":"SELECT t."Track_ID", t."Name"
FROM "track" AS t
LEFT JOIN "race" AS r ON r."Track_ID" = t."Track_ID"
WHERE r."Race_ID" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien de courses chaque circuit a-t-il accueillies ?","sql":"SELECT t."Track_ID", t."Name", COUNT(r."Race_ID") AS race_count
FROM "track" AS t
LEFT JOIN "race" AS r ON r."Track_ID" = t."Track_ID"
GROUP BY t."Track_ID", t."Name";"},{"question":"Quelle est la capacité moyenne des circuits pour chaque lieu ?","sql":"SELECT "Location", AVG("Seating") AS average_seating
FROM "track"
GROUP BY "Location";"},{"question":"Quelles courses ont eu lieu à partir du 1er janvier 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT "Race_ID", "Name", "Date"
FROM "race"
WHERE "Date" >= '2020-01-01'
ORDER BY "Date";"},{"question":"Quels circuits ont une capacité supérieure à la capacité moyenne de tous les circuits ?","sql":"SELECT "Track_ID", "Name", "Seating"
FROM "track"
WHERE "Seating" > (SELECT AVG("Seating") FROM "track");"},{"question":"Quelle est la première course organisée sur chaque circuit ?","sql":"SELECT r."Race_ID", r."Name", r."Track_ID", r."Date"
FROM "race" AS r
WHERE r."Date" = (
    SELECT MIN(r2."Date")
    FROM "race" AS r2
    WHERE r2."Track_ID" = r."Track_ID"
);"},{"question":"Quelles sont les différentes classes de courses enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT "Class"
FROM "race"
WHERE "Class" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Class";"},{"question":"Combien de courses sont enregistrées dans chaque classe ?","sql":"SELECT "Class", COUNT(*) AS race_count
FROM "race"
GROUP BY "Class"
ORDER BY race_count DESC;"},{"question":"Quels circuits ont accueilli au moins une course en 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT t."Track_ID", t."Name"
FROM "track" AS t
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "race" AS r
    WHERE r."Track_ID" = t."Track_ID"
      AND substr(r."Date", 1, 4) = '2020'
);"},{"question":"Quels noms apparaissent soit parmi les courses, soit parmi les circuits, sans doublon ?","sql":"SELECT "Name" FROM "race"
UNION
SELECT "Name" FROM "track";"},{"question":"Quels circuits ont accueilli plus de deux courses ?","sql":"SELECT t."Track_ID", t."Name", COUNT(r."Race_ID") AS race_count
FROM "track" AS t
JOIN "race" AS r ON r."Track_ID" = t."Track_ID"
GROUP BY t."Track_ID", t."Name"
HAVING COUNT(r."Race_ID") > 2;"},{"question":"Quelle est la course la plus récente enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT "Race_ID", "Name", "Date"
FROM "race"
WHERE "Date" = (SELECT MAX("Date") FROM "race");"},{"question":"Quelles courses se sont déroulées sur des circuits ouverts avant l'an 2000 ?","sql":"SELECT r."Race_ID", r."Name" AS race_name, t."Name" AS track_name, t."Year_Opened"
FROM "race" AS r
JOIN "track" AS t ON t."Track_ID" = r."Track_ID"
WHERE t."Year_Opened" < 2000;"},{"question":"Combien de circuits sont recensés dans chaque lieu, y compris les lieux associés à un seul circuit ?","sql":"SELECT "Location", COUNT(*) AS track_count
FROM "track"
GROUP BY "Location"
ORDER BY track_count DESC, "Location";"},{"question":"Quelles courses ont eu lieu sur le circuit disposant de la plus grande capacité ?","sql":"SELECT r."Race_ID", r."Name", r."Date", t."Name" AS track_name, t."Seating"
FROM "race" AS r
JOIN "track" AS t ON t."Track_ID" = r."Track_ID"
WHERE t."Seating" = (SELECT MAX("Seating") FROM "track");"},{"question":"Quelles classes sont présentes dans les courses d'avant 2020 mais absentes de celles de 2020 et après ?","sql":"SELECT "Class"
FROM "race"
WHERE "Date" < '2020-01-01'
  AND "Class" IS NOT NULL
EXCEPT
SELECT "Class"
FROM "race"
WHERE "Date" >= '2020-01-01'
  AND "Class" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq circuits les plus anciens ?","sql":"SELECT "Track_ID", "Name", "Year_Opened"
FROM "track"
ORDER BY "Year_Opened" ASC
LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Pour chaque circuit, quelle est la date de sa dernière course, ou NULL s'il n'en a jamais accueilli ?","sql":"SELECT t."Track_ID", t."Name", MAX(r."Date") AS latest_race_date
FROM "track" AS t
LEFT JOIN "race" AS r ON r."Track_ID" = t."Track_ID"
GROUP BY t."Track_ID", t."Name";"},{"question":"Quels circuits ont une capacité supérieure à celle de tous les circuits situés à Paris ?","sql":"SELECT t."Track_ID", t."Name", t."Location", t."Seating"
FROM "track" AS t
WHERE t."Seating" > ALL (
    SELECT p."Seating"
    FROM "track" AS p
    WHERE p."Location" = 'Paris'
);"},{"question":"Combien de courses chaque circuit a-t-il accueillies avant et à partir de 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT t."Track_ID", t."Name",
       SUM(CASE WHEN r."Date" < '2020-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS races_before_2020,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r."Date" >= '2020-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS races_from_2020
FROM "track" AS t
LEFT JOIN "race" AS r ON r."Track_ID" = t."Track_ID"
GROUP BY t."Track_ID", t."Name";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les trains avec leur nom, leur gare de départ, leur arrivée et le nom de la voie ferrée qu’ils empruntent ?","sql":"SELECT t."Train_Num", t."Name", t."From", t."Arrival", r."Railway"
FROM "train" AS t
JOIN "railway" AS r ON r."Railway_ID" = t."Railway_ID"
ORDER BY r."Railway", t."Train_Num";"},{"question":"Pour chaque voie ferrée, combien de managers lui sont associés ?","sql":"SELECT r."Railway_ID", r."Railway", COUNT(rm."Manager_ID") AS "Nombre_de_managers"
FROM "railway" AS r
LEFT JOIN "railway_manage" AS rm ON rm."Railway_ID" = r."Railway_ID"
GROUP BY r."Railway_ID", r."Railway"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_managers" DESC, r."Railway";"},{"question":"Quels managers gèrent au moins deux voies ferrées ?","sql":"SELECT m."Manager_ID", m."Name", COUNT(rm."Railway_ID") AS "Nombre_de_voies"
FROM "manager" AS m
JOIN "railway_manage" AS rm ON rm."Manager_ID" = m."Manager_ID"
GROUP BY m."Manager_ID", m."Name"
HAVING COUNT(rm."Railway_ID") >= 2
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_voies" DESC, m."Name";"},{"question":"Quelles sont les voies ferrées qui n’ont aucun train associé ?","sql":"SELECT r."Railway_ID", r."Railway", r."Location"
FROM "railway" AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "train" AS t
    WHERE t."Railway_ID" = r."Railway_ID"
)
ORDER BY r."Railway";"},{"question":"Quels sont les managers les plus âgés de chaque pays ?","sql":"SELECT m."Manager_ID", m."Name", m."Country", m."Age"
FROM "manager" AS m
WHERE m."Age" = (
    SELECT MAX(m2."Age")
    FROM "manager" AS m2
    WHERE m2."Country" = m."Country"
)
ORDER BY m."Country", m."Name";"},{"question":"Quels trains circulent sur une voie ferrée gérée par au moins un manager français ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT t."Train_ID", t."Train_Num", t."Name", r."Railway", m."Name" AS "Manager"
FROM "train" AS t
JOIN "railway" AS r ON r."Railway_ID" = t."Railway_ID"
JOIN "railway_manage" AS rm ON rm."Railway_ID" = r."Railway_ID"
JOIN "manager" AS m ON m."Manager_ID" = rm."Manager_ID"
WHERE m."Country" = 'France'
ORDER BY t."Train_Num", m."Name";"},{"question":"Quelles voies ferrées sont soit sans manager, soit gérées par au moins un manager de niveau 5 ou supérieur ?","sql":"SELECT r."Railway_ID", r."Railway"
FROM "railway" AS r
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "railway_manage" AS rm
    JOIN "manager" AS m ON m."Manager_ID" = rm."Manager_ID"
    WHERE rm."Railway_ID" = r."Railway_ID"
      AND m."Level" >= 5
)
UNION
SELECT r."Railway_ID", r."Railway"
FROM "railway" AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "railway_manage" AS rm
    WHERE rm."Railway_ID" = r."Railway_ID"
)
ORDER BY "Railway";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels restaurants ont une note d’au moins 4, avec leur adresse et leur note ?","sql":"SELECT ResName, Address, Rating
FROM Restaurant
WHERE Rating >= 4
ORDER BY Rating DESC, ResName;"},{"question":"Combien de restaurants appartiennent à chaque type, y compris les types sans restaurant ?","sql":"SELECT rt.ResTypeName, COUNT(tor.ResID) AS nombre_restaurants
FROM Restaurant_Type AS rt
LEFT JOIN Type_Of_Restaurant AS tor ON tor.ResTypeID = rt.ResTypeID
GROUP BY rt.ResTypeID, rt.ResTypeName
ORDER BY nombre_restaurants DESC, rt.ResTypeName;"},{"question":"Pour chaque étudiant ayant effectué au moins une visite, quel est le montant total dépensé et le nombre de visites ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName,
       COUNT(v.ResID) AS nombre_visites,
       SUM(v.Spent) AS depense_totale
FROM Student AS s
JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v ON v.StuID = s.StuID
GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName
ORDER BY depense_totale DESC;"},{"question":"Quel restaurant affiche la dépense moyenne par visite la plus élevée ?","sql":"SELECT r.ResID, r.ResName, AVG(v.Spent) AS depense_moyenne
FROM Restaurant AS r
JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v ON v.ResID = r.ResID
GROUP BY r.ResID, r.ResName
ORDER BY depense_moyenne DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants n’ont jamais visité de restaurant ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName
FROM Student AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Visits_Restaurant AS v
    WHERE v.StuID = s.StuID
)
ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quel type de restaurant a reçu le plus de visites ?","sql":"SELECT rt.ResTypeName, COUNT(*) AS nombre_visites
FROM Restaurant_Type AS rt
JOIN Type_Of_Restaurant AS tor ON tor.ResTypeID = rt.ResTypeID
JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v ON v.ResID = tor.ResID
GROUP BY rt.ResTypeID, rt.ResTypeName
ORDER BY nombre_visites DESC, rt.ResTypeName
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelle est la dépense totale des étudiants de chaque ville ayant effectué des visites ?","sql":"SELECT s.city_code, SUM(v.Spent) AS depense_totale, COUNT(*) AS nombre_visites
FROM Student AS s
JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v ON v.StuID = s.StuID
GROUP BY s.city_code
ORDER BY depense_totale DESC;"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont été visités par au moins un étudiant âgé de 20 ans ou plus ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT r.ResID, r.ResName
FROM Restaurant AS r
JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v ON v.ResID = r.ResID
JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = v.StuID
WHERE s.Age >= 20
ORDER BY r.ResName;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont dépensé davantage que la dépense moyenne de l’ensemble des visites ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, SUM(v.Spent) AS depense_totale
FROM Student AS s
JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v ON v.StuID = s.StuID
GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName
HAVING SUM(v.Spent) > (SELECT AVG(Spent) FROM Visits_Restaurant)
ORDER BY depense_totale DESC;"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont été visités par au moins deux étudiants différents, et combien ont-ils dépensé au total ?","sql":"SELECT r.ResID, r.ResName,
       COUNT(DISTINCT v.StuID) AS nombre_etudiants,
       SUM(v.Spent) AS depense_totale
FROM Restaurant AS r
JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v ON v.ResID = r.ResID
GROUP BY r.ResID, r.ResName
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.StuID) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_etudiants DESC, depense_totale DESC;"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont été visités à la fois par des étudiants de sexe féminin et par des étudiants de sexe masculin ?","sql":"SELECT r.ResID, r.ResName
FROM Restaurant AS r
JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v ON v.ResID = r.ResID
JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = v.StuID
WHERE s.Sex = 'F'
INTERSECT
SELECT r.ResID, r.ResName
FROM Restaurant AS r
JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v ON v.ResID = r.ResID
JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = v.StuID
WHERE s.Sex = 'M'
ORDER BY ResName;"},{"question":"Pour chaque étudiant ayant visité au moins un restaurant, quelle est la date de sa visite la plus récente et quel restaurant a-t-il visité ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, r.ResName, v.Time
FROM Student AS s
JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v ON v.StuID = s.StuID
JOIN Restaurant AS r ON r.ResID = v.ResID
WHERE v.Time = (
    SELECT MAX(v2.Time)
    FROM Visits_Restaurant AS v2
    WHERE v2.StuID = v.StuID
)
ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"}]}
