?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", r.\"RATING\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r WHERE r.\"RATING\" >= (SELECT MIN(r2.\"RATING\") FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r2 WHERE r2.\"RATING\" IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r3 WHERE r3.\"RATING\" > r2.\"RATING\") < (SELECT COUNT(*) * 0.1 FROM \"RESTAURANT\" WHERE \"RATING\" IS NOT NULL));"},{"question":"Quelles villes possèdent au moins un restaurant de chaque type de cuisine présent dans la base ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"CITY_NAME\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r GROUP BY r.\"CITY_NAME\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.\"FOOD_TYPE\") = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT \"FOOD_TYPE\") FROM \"RESTAURANT\");"},{"question":"Quels restaurants sont dans une ville dont toutes les notes sont supérieures à 3 ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", r.\"CITY_NAME\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r WHERE r.\"CITY_NAME\" IN (SELECT \"CITY_NAME\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" GROUP BY \"CITY_NAME\" HAVING MIN(\"RATING\") > 3);"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont au moins une note manquante ?","sql":"SELECT \"CITY_NAME\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" GROUP BY \"CITY_NAME\" HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN \"RATING\" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont une adresse dans une ville géographique dont le comté est renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", l.\"CITY_NAME\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"LOCATION\" AS l ON l.\"RESTAURANT_ID\" = r.\"ID\" JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g ON g.\"CITY_NAME\" = l.\"CITY_NAME\" WHERE g.\"COUNTY\" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles régions possèdent au moins une ville sans restaurant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT g.\"REGION\" FROM \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g LEFT JOIN \"RESTAURANT\" AS r ON r.\"CITY_NAME\" = g.\"CITY_NAME\" WHERE r.\"ID\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels restaurants sont les mieux notés parmi ceux qui ont une adresse ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", r.\"RATING\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"LOCATION\" AS l ON l.\"RESTAURANT_ID\" = r.\"ID\" WHERE r.\"RATING\" = (SELECT MAX(r2.\"RATING\") FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r2 JOIN \"LOCATION\" AS l2 ON l2.\"RESTAURANT_ID\" = r2.\"ID\");"},{"question":"Combien de restaurants sont situés dans chaque région, avec leur note moyenne arrondie ?","sql":"SELECT g.\"REGION\", COUNT(r.\"ID\") AS \"nombre_restaurants\", ROUND(AVG(r.\"RATING\"), 2) AS \"note_moyenne\" FROM \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g LEFT JOIN \"RESTAURANT\" AS r ON r.\"CITY_NAME\" = g.\"CITY_NAME\" GROUP BY g.\"REGION\";"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont plus de restaurants que la moyenne des villes ?","sql":"SELECT \"CITY_NAME\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_restaurants\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" GROUP BY \"CITY_NAME\" HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(\"nombre\") FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS \"nombre\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" GROUP BY \"CITY_NAME\"));"},{"question":"Quels restaurants sont classés par région, puis par note décroissante ?","sql":"SELECT g.\"REGION\", r.\"NAME\", r.\"RATING\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g ON g.\"CITY_NAME\" = r.\"CITY_NAME\" ORDER BY g.\"REGION\", r.\"RATING\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles adresses peuvent être affichées sous forme d'une adresse complète ?","sql":"SELECT \"HOUSE_NUMBER\" || ' ' || \"STREET_NAME\" || ', ' || \"CITY_NAME\" AS \"adresse_complete\" FROM \"LOCATION\";"},{"question":"Quels restaurants et leurs adresses complètes sont disponibles ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", l.\"HOUSE_NUMBER\" || ' ' || l.\"STREET_NAME\" || ', ' || l.\"CITY_NAME\" AS \"adresse_complete\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"LOCATION\" AS l ON l.\"RESTAURANT_ID\" = r.\"ID\";"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont une adresse dont le numéro est compris entre 1 et 50 ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", l.\"HOUSE_NUMBER\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"LOCATION\" AS l ON l.\"RESTAURANT_ID\" = r.\"ID\" WHERE l.\"HOUSE_NUMBER\" BETWEEN 1 AND 50;"},{"question":"Quels restaurants sont dans des villes dont le nom contient la lettre o ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", r.\"CITY_NAME\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r WHERE LOWER(r.\"CITY_NAME\") LIKE '%o%';"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de restaurants par première lettre du nom ?","sql":"SELECT UPPER(SUBSTR(\"NAME\", 1, 1)) AS \"initiale\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" GROUP BY UPPER(SUBSTR(\"NAME\", 1, 1)) ORDER BY \"initiale\";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de villes par initiale ?","sql":"SELECT UPPER(SUBSTR(\"CITY_NAME\", 1, 1)) AS \"initiale\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_villes\" FROM \"GEOGRAPHIC\" GROUP BY UPPER(SUBSTR(\"CITY_NAME\", 1, 1));"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont une note textuellement comprise entre 4 et 5 ?","sql":"SELECT \"NAME\", \"RATING\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" WHERE \"RATING\" >= 4 AND \"RATING\" <= 5 ORDER BY \"RATING\" DESC, \"NAME\";"},{"question":"Quelles cuisines sont représentées dans des régions différentes ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"FOOD_TYPE\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g ON g.\"CITY_NAME\" = r.\"CITY_NAME\" GROUP BY r.\"FOOD_TYPE\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.\"REGION\") > 1;"},{"question":"Quels restaurants sont dans des comtés contenant au moins deux villes ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", g.\"COUNTY\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g ON g.\"CITY_NAME\" = r.\"CITY_NAME\" WHERE g.\"COUNTY\" IN (SELECT \"COUNTY\" FROM \"GEOGRAPHIC\" GROUP BY \"COUNTY\" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2);"},{"question":"Quelle est la note moyenne par comté, uniquement pour les comtés ayant des restaurants ?","sql":"SELECT g.\"COUNTY\", AVG(r.\"RATING\") AS \"note_moyenne\" FROM \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g JOIN \"RESTAURANT\" AS r ON r.\"CITY_NAME\" = g.\"CITY_NAME\" GROUP BY g.\"COUNTY\";"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont une note supérieure à la note moyenne de leur région ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", g.\"REGION\", r.\"RATING\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g ON g.\"CITY_NAME\" = r.\"CITY_NAME\" WHERE r.\"RATING\" > (SELECT AVG(r2.\"RATING\") FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r2 JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g2 ON g2.\"CITY_NAME\" = r2.\"CITY_NAME\" WHERE g2.\"REGION\" = g.\"REGION\");"},{"question":"Quelles villes possèdent des restaurants de plusieurs types et au moins une adresse ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"CITY_NAME\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r WHERE r.\"CITY_NAME\" IN (SELECT \"CITY_NAME\" FROM \"LOCATION\") GROUP BY r.\"CITY_NAME\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.\"FOOD_TYPE\") > 1;"},{"question":"Quels restaurants n'ont aucune autre cuisine identique dans leur ville ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", r.\"CITY_NAME\", r.\"FOOD_TYPE\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r2 WHERE r2.\"CITY_NAME\" = r.\"CITY_NAME\" AND r2.\"FOOD_TYPE\" = r.\"FOOD_TYPE\" AND r2.\"ID\" <> r.\"ID\");"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont la note maximale parmi ceux de leur comté ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", g.\"COUNTY\", r.\"RATING\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g ON g.\"CITY_NAME\" = r.\"CITY_NAME\" WHERE r.\"RATING\" = (SELECT MAX(r2.\"RATING\") FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r2 JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g2 ON g2.\"CITY_NAME\" = r2.\"CITY_NAME\" WHERE g2.\"COUNTY\" = g.\"COUNTY\");"},{"question":"Combien de restaurants sont associés à une ville dont la région est renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS \"nombre\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g ON g.\"CITY_NAME\" = r.\"CITY_NAME\" WHERE g.\"REGION\" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont un identifiant inférieur à la moyenne des identifiants ?","sql":"SELECT \"NAME\", \"ID\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" WHERE \"ID\" < (SELECT AVG(\"ID\") FROM \"RESTAURANT\");"},{"question":"Quel est l'identifiant maximal des restaurants ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(\"ID\") AS \"identifiant_maximal\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\";"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de restaurant sont absents des adresses ?","sql":"SELECT \"ID\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" EXCEPT SELECT \"RESTAURANT_ID\" FROM \"LOCATION\";"},{"question":"Quels identifiants d'adresse ne correspondent à aucun restaurant ?","sql":"SELECT \"RESTAURANT_ID\" FROM \"LOCATION\" EXCEPT SELECT \"ID\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\";"},{"question":"Combien d'identifiants de restaurants sont communs aux deux tables ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS \"nombre\" FROM (SELECT \"ID\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" INTERSECT SELECT \"RESTAURANT_ID\" FROM \"LOCATION\");"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont une note supérieure à 4 et appartiennent à un comté commençant par K ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", g.\"COUNTY\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g ON g.\"CITY_NAME\" = r.\"CITY_NAME\" WHERE r.\"RATING\" > 4 AND g.\"COUNTY\" LIKE 'K%';"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont une cuisine différente de celle du restaurant le mieux noté ?","sql":"SELECT \"NAME\", \"FOOD_TYPE\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" WHERE \"FOOD_TYPE\" <> (SELECT \"FOOD_TYPE\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" ORDER BY \"RATING\" DESC LIMIT 1);"},{"question":"Quels restaurants se trouvent dans la région qui compte le plus de villes ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", g.\"REGION\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g ON g.\"CITY_NAME\" = r.\"CITY_NAME\" WHERE g.\"REGION\" = (SELECT \"REGION\" FROM \"GEOGRAPHIC\" GROUP BY \"REGION\" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1);"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont une note supérieure ou égale à 4, avec leur région ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", r.\"RATING\", g.\"REGION\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r LEFT JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g ON g.\"CITY_NAME\" = r.\"CITY_NAME\" WHERE r.\"RATING\" >= 4;"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont exactement un restaurant ?","sql":"SELECT \"CITY_NAME\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" GROUP BY \"CITY_NAME\" HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;"},{"question":"Quels types de cuisine sont représentés par exactement un restaurant noté ?","sql":"SELECT \"FOOD_TYPE\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" WHERE \"RATING\" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY \"FOOD_TYPE\" HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne des notes des restaurants de chaque type, avec le nombre d'avis ?","sql":"SELECT \"FOOD_TYPE\", AVG(\"RATING\") AS \"note_moyenne\", COUNT(\"RATING\") AS \"nombre_notes\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" GROUP BY \"FOOD_TYPE\";"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont une adresse moyenne supérieure à 50 ?","sql":"SELECT \"CITY_NAME\", AVG(\"HOUSE_NUMBER\") AS \"numero_moyen\" FROM \"LOCATION\" GROUP BY \"CITY_NAME\" HAVING AVG(\"HOUSE_NUMBER\") > 50;"},{"question":"Quels restaurants sont sur la rue la plus représentée ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", l.\"STREET_NAME\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"LOCATION\" AS l ON l.\"RESTAURANT_ID\" = r.\"ID\" WHERE l.\"STREET_NAME\" = (SELECT \"STREET_NAME\" FROM \"LOCATION\" GROUP BY \"STREET_NAME\" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1);"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont le plus grand nombre d'adresses ?","sql":"SELECT \"CITY_NAME\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_adresses\" FROM \"LOCATION\" GROUP BY \"CITY_NAME\" HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(\"nombre\") FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS \"nombre\" FROM \"LOCATION\" GROUP BY \"CITY_NAME\"));"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont un nom et un type de cuisine commençant par la même lettre ?","sql":"SELECT \"NAME\", \"FOOD_TYPE\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" WHERE LOWER(SUBSTR(\"NAME\", 1, 1)) = LOWER(SUBSTR(\"FOOD_TYPE\", 1, 1));"},{"question":"Quels restaurants sont situés dans une ville dont le comté est différent de sa région ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", g.\"COUNTY\", g.\"REGION\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g ON g.\"CITY_NAME\" = r.\"CITY_NAME\" WHERE g.\"COUNTY\" <> g.\"REGION\";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de restaurants par couple région-comté ?","sql":"SELECT g.\"REGION\", g.\"COUNTY\", COUNT(r.\"ID\") AS \"nombre_restaurants\" FROM \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g LEFT JOIN \"RESTAURANT\" AS r ON r.\"CITY_NAME\" = g.\"CITY_NAME\" GROUP BY g.\"REGION\", g.\"COUNTY\";"},{"question":"Quels comtés ont une note moyenne supérieure à 4 ?","sql":"SELECT g.\"COUNTY\" FROM \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g JOIN \"RESTAURANT\" AS r ON r.\"CITY_NAME\" = g.\"CITY_NAME\" GROUP BY g.\"COUNTY\" HAVING AVG(r.\"RATING\") > 4;"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont une note non nulle et une ville géographique existante ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", r.\"RATING\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r WHERE r.\"RATING\" IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g WHERE g.\"CITY_NAME\" = r.\"CITY_NAME\");"},{"question":"Combien de restaurants ont un type de cuisine distinct de celui du restaurant précédent par identifiant ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS \"nombre\" FROM (SELECT \"ID\", \"FOOD_TYPE\", LAG(\"FOOD_TYPE\") OVER (ORDER BY \"ID\") AS \"type_precedent\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\") WHERE \"type_precedent\" IS NOT NULL AND \"FOOD_TYPE\" <> \"type_precedent\";"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont une note supérieure à celle du restaurant précédent par identifiant ?","sql":"SELECT \"NAME\", \"RATING\" FROM (SELECT \"NAME\", \"RATING\", LAG(\"RATING\") OVER (ORDER BY \"ID\") AS \"note_precedente\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\") WHERE \"RATING\" > \"note_precedente\";"},{"question":"Classez les villes selon leur nombre de restaurants.","sql":"SELECT \"CITY_NAME\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_restaurants\", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS \"rang\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" GROUP BY \"CITY_NAME\";"},{"question":"Donnez le restaurant le mieux noté de chaque ville avec son rang.","sql":"SELECT \"CITY_NAME\", \"NAME\", \"RATING\" FROM (SELECT \"CITY_NAME\", \"NAME\", \"RATING\", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY \"CITY_NAME\" ORDER BY \"RATING\" DESC) AS \"rang\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\") WHERE \"rang\" = 1;"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois restaurants ayant les meilleures notes ?","sql":"SELECT \"NAME\", \"RATING\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" ORDER BY \"RATING\" DESC LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois restaurants ayant les plus mauvaises notes ?","sql":"SELECT \"NAME\", \"RATING\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" WHERE \"RATING\" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY \"RATING\" ASC LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre cumulé de restaurants par ville dans l'ordre alphabétique ?","sql":"SELECT \"CITY_NAME\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_restaurants\", SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY \"CITY_NAME\") AS \"cumul\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" GROUP BY \"CITY_NAME\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne mobile des notes dans l'ordre des identifiants ?","sql":"SELECT \"ID\", \"NAME\", AVG(\"RATING\") OVER (ORDER BY \"ID\" ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS \"moyenne_mobile\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\";"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont une note supérieure à la moyenne de leur région et une adresse connue ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", r.\"RATING\", g.\"REGION\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g ON g.\"CITY_NAME\" = r.\"CITY_NAME\" JOIN \"LOCATION\" AS l ON l.\"RESTAURANT_ID\" = r.\"ID\" WHERE r.\"RATING\" > (SELECT AVG(r2.\"RATING\") FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r2 JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g2 ON g2.\"CITY_NAME\" = r2.\"CITY_NAME\" WHERE g2.\"REGION\" = g.\"REGION\");"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont au moins autant de voisins dans leur ville que la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", r.\"CITY_NAME\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r2 WHERE r2.\"CITY_NAME\" = r.\"CITY_NAME\") >= (SELECT AVG(\"nombre\") FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS \"nombre\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" GROUP BY \"CITY_NAME\"));"},{"question":"Quels restaurants sont dans des villes représentées par plusieurs comtés ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"NAME\", r.\"CITY_NAME\" FROM \"RESTAURANT\" AS r JOIN \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g ON g.\"CITY_NAME\" = r.\"CITY_NAME\" WHERE g.\"COUNTY\" IN (SELECT \"COUNTY\" FROM \"GEOGRAPHIC\" GROUP BY \"COUNTY\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT \"CITY_NAME\") > 1);"},{"question":"Quelle région a la note moyenne la plus élevée ?","sql":"SELECT g.\"REGION\", AVG(r.\"RATING\") AS \"note_moyenne\" FROM \"GEOGRAPHIC\" AS g JOIN \"RESTAURANT\" AS r ON r.\"CITY_NAME\" = g.\"CITY_NAME\" GROUP BY g.\"REGION\" ORDER BY \"note_moyenne\" DESC LIMIT 1;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les clubs de la région « Île-de-France », classés par année de création croissante ?","sql":"SELECT "Club_ID", "Club_name", "Start_year"
FROM "club"
WHERE "Region" = 'Île-de-France'
ORDER BY "Start_year" ASC;"},{"question":"Quels entraîneurs travaillent dans chaque club, avec le nom du club affiché ?","sql":"SELECT c."Coach_name", c."Gender", c."Rank", cl."Club_name"
FROM "coach" AS c
JOIN "club" AS cl ON cl."Club_ID" = c."Club_ID"
ORDER BY cl."Club_name", c."Coach_name";"},{"question":"Quels clubs ont obtenu plus de 100 points au total dans les résultats de matchs ?","sql":"SELECT cl."Club_name", SUM(m."Points") AS total_points
FROM "match_result" AS m
JOIN "club" AS cl ON cl."Club_ID" = m."Club_ID"
GROUP BY cl."Club_ID", cl."Club_name"
HAVING SUM(m."Points") > 100
ORDER BY total_points DESC;"},{"question":"Quels clubs ne figurent dans aucun résultat de match ?","sql":"SELECT cl."Club_ID", cl."Club_name"
FROM "club" AS cl
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "match_result" AS m
    WHERE m."Club_ID" = cl."Club_ID"
)
ORDER BY cl."Club_name";"},{"question":"Quels joueurs sont suivis par quels entraîneurs, avec leur année de début de collaboration ?","sql":"SELECT p."Player_name", c."Coach_name", pc."Starting_year"
FROM "player_coach" AS pc
JOIN "player" AS p ON p."Player_ID" = pc."Player_ID"
JOIN "coach" AS c ON c."Coach_ID" = pc."Coach_ID"
ORDER BY p."Player_name", pc."Starting_year";"},{"question":"Combien d'entraîneurs chaque club possède-t-il, y compris les clubs sans entraîneur ?","sql":"SELECT cl."Club_name", COUNT(c."Coach_ID") AS nombre_entraineurs
FROM "club" AS cl
LEFT JOIN "coach" AS c ON c."Club_ID" = cl."Club_ID"
GROUP BY cl."Club_ID", cl."Club_name"
ORDER BY nombre_entraineurs DESC, cl."Club_name";"},{"question":"Quel club a obtenu le plus grand nombre total de médailles d'or ?","sql":"SELECT cl."Club_name", SUM(m."Gold") AS total_or
FROM "match_result" AS m
JOIN "club" AS cl ON cl."Club_ID" = m."Club_ID"
GROUP BY cl."Club_ID", cl."Club_name"
ORDER BY total_or DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs sont associés à au moins deux entraîneurs différents ?","sql":"SELECT p."Player_ID", p."Player_name", COUNT(DISTINCT pc."Coach_ID") AS nombre_entraineurs
FROM "player" AS p
JOIN "player_coach" AS pc ON pc."Player_ID" = p."Player_ID"
GROUP BY p."Player_ID", p."Player_name"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc."Coach_ID") >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_entraineurs DESC, p."Player_name";"},{"question":"Quels clubs ont au moins un entraîneur mais aucun résultat de match ?","sql":"SELECT "Club_ID", "Club_name"
FROM "club"
WHERE "Club_ID" IN (SELECT "Club_ID" FROM "coach")
EXCEPT
SELECT cl."Club_ID", cl."Club_name"
FROM "club" AS cl
JOIN "match_result" AS m ON m."Club_ID" = cl."Club_ID"
ORDER BY "Club_name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque entraîneur ayant au moins un joueur, quelle est l'année moyenne de début de ses collaborations ?","sql":"SELECT c."Coach_name", AVG(pc."Starting_year") AS annee_moyenne_debut
FROM "coach" AS c
JOIN "player_coach" AS pc ON pc."Coach_ID" = c."Coach_ID"
GROUP BY c."Coach_ID", c."Coach_name"
ORDER BY annee_moyenne_debut ASC;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont reçu plus de votes que la moyenne de l'ensemble des joueurs ?","sql":"SELECT "Player_name", "Votes"
FROM "player"
WHERE "Votes" > (SELECT AVG("Votes") FROM "player")
ORDER BY "Votes" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois clubs ayant le plus grand nombre total de médailles, toutes catégories confondues ?","sql":"WITH medailles AS (
    SELECT "Club_ID", SUM("Gold" + "Big_Silver" + "Small_Silver" + "Bronze") AS total_medailles
    FROM "match_result"
    GROUP BY "Club_ID"
)
SELECT cl."Club_name", m.total_medailles
FROM medailles AS m
JOIN "club" AS cl ON cl."Club_ID" = m."Club_ID"
ORDER BY m.total_medailles DESC
LIMIT 3;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Combien de montagnes russes sont recensées dans chaque pays, y compris les pays qui n'en possèdent aucune ?","sql":"SELECT c."Name" AS "Pays", COUNT(r."Roller_Coaster_ID") AS "Nombre_de_montagnes_russes"
FROM "country" AS c
LEFT JOIN "roller_coaster" AS r
  ON r."Country_ID" = c."Country_ID"
GROUP BY c."Country_ID", c."Name"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_montagnes_russes" DESC, "Pays";"},{"question":"Quelles montagnes russes sont plus hautes que la hauteur moyenne de toutes les montagnes russes ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Park", "Height"
FROM "roller_coaster"
WHERE "Height" > (
  SELECT AVG("Height")
  FROM "roller_coaster"
  WHERE "Height" IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY "Height" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels parcs possèdent au moins deux montagnes russes ?","sql":"SELECT "Park", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_montagnes_russes"
FROM "roller_coaster"
GROUP BY "Park"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_montagnes_russes" DESC, "Park";"},{"question":"Quels pays ont une population supérieure à la population moyenne des pays et accueillent au moins une montagne russe ?","sql":"SELECT c."Name", c."Population"
FROM "country" AS c
WHERE c."Population" > (
  SELECT AVG("Population")
  FROM "country"
  WHERE "Population" IS NOT NULL
)
AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM "roller_coaster" AS r
  WHERE r."Country_ID" = c."Country_ID"
)
ORDER BY c."Population" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque pays, quelles sont les montagnes russes les plus longues ?","sql":"SELECT r."Name", r."Park", r."Length", c."Name" AS "Pays"
FROM "roller_coaster" AS r
JOIN "country" AS c
  ON c."Country_ID" = r."Country_ID"
WHERE r."Length" = (
  SELECT MAX(r2."Length")
  FROM "roller_coaster" AS r2
  WHERE r2."Country_ID" = r."Country_ID"
)
ORDER BY c."Name", r."Length" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles montagnes russes ont été ouvertes après l'année 2000 ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Park", "Opened"
FROM "roller_coaster"
WHERE CAST("Opened" AS INTEGER) > 2000
ORDER BY CAST("Opened" AS INTEGER), "Name";"},{"question":"Quels pays possèdent au moins une montagne russe de plus de 100 mètres de hauteur ou de plus de 1 000 mètres de longueur ?","sql":"SELECT c."Name" AS "Pays"
FROM "country" AS c
JOIN "roller_coaster" AS r
  ON r."Country_ID" = c."Country_ID"
WHERE r."Height" > 100
UNION
SELECT c."Name" AS "Pays"
FROM "country" AS c
JOIN "roller_coaster" AS r
  ON r."Country_ID" = c."Country_ID"
WHERE r."Length" > 1000
ORDER BY "Pays";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les acteurs classés par nom de famille puis par prénom ?","sql":"SELECT actor_id, first_name, last_name FROM actor ORDER BY last_name, first_name;"},{"question":"Combien d’acteurs sont enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_acteurs FROM actor;"},{"question":"Quels films sont classés « PG-13 » ?","sql":"SELECT film_id, title, l.language_id GROUP BY l.language_id, l.name ORDER BY nombre_films DESC, l.name;"},{"question":"Combien de villes chaque pays possède-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT co.country, COUNT(ci.city_id) AS nombre_villes FROM country AS co LEFT JOIN city AS ci ON ci.country_id = co.country_id GROUP BY co.country_id, co.country ORDER BY nombre_villes DESC, co.country;"},{"question":"Quelles adresses indiquent leur ville et leur pays ?","sql":"SELECT a.address_id, a.address, a.district, ci.city, co.country FROM address AS a JOIN city AS ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country AS co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id ORDER BY co.country, ci.city, a.address;"},{"question":"Quels clients sont actuellement actifs ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, email FROM customer WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY last_name, first_name;"},{"question":"Dans quelle ville habite chaque client ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, ci.city, co.country FROM customer AS c JOIN address AS a ON a.address_id = c.address_id JOIN city AS ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country AS co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les adresses des magasins avec leur ville ?","sql":"SELECT s.store_id, a.address, ci.city, co.country FROM store AS s JOIN address AS a ON a.address_id = s.address_id JOIN city AS ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country AS co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id ORDER BY s.store_id;"},{"question":"Quels employés sont actifs, avec leur identifiant et leur nom d’utilisateur ?","sql":"SELECT staff_id, first_name, last_name, username FROM staff WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY last_name, first_name;"},{"question":"Combien d’exemplaires sont disponibles dans chaque magasin ?","sql":"SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_exemplaires FROM inventory GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id;"},{"question":"Quels films appartiennent à chaque catégorie ?","sql":"SELECT ca.name AS categorie, f.title FROM category AS ca JOIN film_category AS fc ON fc.category_id = ca.category_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = fc.film_id ORDER BY ca.name, f.title;"},{"question":"Combien de films chaque acteur a-t-il dans le catalogue, y compris ceux qui n’en ont aucun ?","sql":"SELECT a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS nombre_films FROM actor AS a LEFT JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY nombre_films DESC, a.last_name, a.first_name;"},{"question":"Quelles catégories contiennent le plus de films ?","sql":"SELECT ca.name, COUNT(fc.film_id) AS nombre_films FROM category AS ca LEFT JOIN film_category AS fc ON fc.category_id = ca.category_id GROUP BY ca.category_id, ca.name ORDER BY nombre_films DESC, ca.name;"},{"question":"Combien d’acteurs jouent dans chaque film ?","sql":"SELECT f.film_id, f.title, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS nombre_acteurs FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY nombre_acteurs DESC, f.title;"},{"question":"Quels films n’ont encore jamais été loués ?","sql":"SELECT f.film_id, f.title FROM film AS f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory AS i JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id) ORDER BY f.title;"},{"question":"Quelles locations sont encore en cours, sans date de retour ?","sql":"SELECT rental_id, rental_date, inventory_id, customer_id FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NULL ORDER BY rental_date;"},{"question":"Quelles locations ont été rendues en moins de deux jours ?","sql":"SELECT rental_id, rental_date, return_date, ROUND((julianday(return_date) - julianday(rental_date)), 2) AS duree_jours FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NOT NULL AND julianday(return_date) - julianday(rental_date) < 2 ORDER BY duree_jours;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont effectué au moins une location ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS nombre_locations FROM customer AS c JOIN rental AS r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY nombre_locations DESC, c.last_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total payé par chaque client ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_paye FROM customer AS c LEFT JOIN payment AS p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_paye DESC, c.last_name;"},{"question":"Quel montant chaque employé a-t-il encaissé ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_encaisse FROM staff AS s LEFT JOIN payment AS p ON p.staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name ORDER BY total_encaisse DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq clients ayant dépensé le plus ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_paye FROM customer AS c JOIN payment AS p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_paye DESC LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Quels clients n’ont effectué aucune location ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental AS r WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id) ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;"},{"question":"Quels films sont associés à plusieurs catégories ?","sql":"SELECT f.film_id, f.title, COUNT(fc.category_id) AS nombre_categories FROM film AS f JOIN film_category AS fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title HAVING COUNT(fc.category_id) > 1 ORDER BY nombre_categories DESC, f.title;"},{"question":"Quels acteurs jouent dans plus de dix films ?","sql":"SELECT a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS nombre_films FROM actor AS a JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name HAVING COUNT(fa.film_id) > 10 ORDER BY nombre_films DESC, a.last_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le tarif de location moyen par catégorie ?","sql":"SELECT ca.name AS categorie, AVG(f.rental_rate) AS tarif_moyen FROM category AS ca JOIN film_category AS fc ON fc.category_id = ca.category_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = fc.film_id GROUP BY ca.category_id, ca.name ORDER BY tarif_moyen DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de clients résident dans chaque ville ?","sql":"SELECT ci.city, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS nombre_clients FROM city AS ci JOIN address AS a ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN customer AS c ON c.address_id = a.address_id GROUP BY ci.city_id, ci.city ORDER BY nombre_clients DESC, ci.city;"},{"question":"Combien de clients résident dans chaque pays ?","sql":"SELECT co.country, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS nombre_clients FROM country AS co JOIN city AS ci ON ci.country_id = co.country_id JOIN address AS a ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN customer AS c ON c.address_id = a.address_id GROUP BY co.country_id, co.country ORDER BY nombre_clients DESC, co.country;"},{"question":"Quels sont les montants encaissés par mois ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS mois, SUM(amount) AS total_mensuel FROM payment GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) ORDER BY mois;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne de location selon la langue du film ?","sql":"SELECT l.name AS langue, AVG(f.rental_duration) AS duree_moyenne FROM language AS l JOIN film AS f ON f.language_id = l.language_id GROUP BY l.language_id, l.name ORDER BY duree_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quels titres contiennent le mot « love » sans tenir compte de la casse ?","sql":"SELECT film_id, title FROM film WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%love%' ORDER BY title;"},{"question":"Quels films ont une description non renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT film_id, title FROM film WHERE description IS NULL ORDER BY title;"},{"question":"Quels titres apparaissent à la fois dans film et dans film_text ?","sql":"SELECT f.film_id, f.title FROM film AS f INNER JOIN film_text AS ft ON ft.film_id = f.film_id ORDER BY f.title;"},{"question":"Quels acteurs n’apparaissent dans aucun film ?","sql":"SELECT actor_id, first_name, last_name FROM actor EXCEPT SELECT a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor AS a JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id ORDER BY last_name, first_name;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont à la fois effectué une location et effectué un paiement ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental AS r WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment AS p WHERE p.customer_id = c.customer_id) ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;"},{"question":"Quels films ont un coût de remplacement supérieur à la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT film_id, title, replacement_cost FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > (SELECT AVG(replacement_cost) FROM film) ORDER BY replacement_cost DESC, title;"},{"question":"Quels films ont le tarif de location le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT film_id, title, rental_rate FROM film WHERE rental_rate = (SELECT MAX(rental_rate) FROM film) ORDER BY title;"},{"question":"Combien d’exemplaires de chaque film sont présents dans l’inventaire ?","sql":"SELECT f.film_id, f.title, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS nombre_exemplaires FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY nombre_exemplaires DESC, f.title;"},{"question":"Quel est le taux de locations retournées ?","sql":"SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN return_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS taux_retour_pourcent FROM rental;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne des locations retournées ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(julianday(return_date) - julianday(rental_date)) AS duree_moyenne_jours FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Combien de locations chaque employé a-t-il traitées ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS nombre_locations FROM staff AS s LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name ORDER BY nombre_locations DESC, s.last_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le chiffre d’affaires de chaque magasin ?","sql":"SELECT s.store_id, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS chiffre_affaires FROM store AS s JOIN staff AS st ON st.store_id = s.store_id LEFT JOIN payment AS p ON p.staff_id = st.staff_id GROUP BY s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le dernier paiement de chaque client ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, MAX(p.payment_date) AS dernier_paiement FROM customer AS c LEFT JOIN payment AS p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY dernier_paiement DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films possèdent au moins un acteur et au moins une catégorie ?","sql":"SELECT f.film_id, f.title FROM film AS f WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM film_actor AS fa WHERE fa.film_id = f.film_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM film_category AS fc WHERE fc.film_id = f.film_id) ORDER BY f.title;"},{"question":"Quelle catégorie contient le plus grand nombre de films ?","sql":"SELECT ca.name, COUNT(fc.film_id) AS nombre_films FROM category AS ca JOIN film_category AS fc ON fc.category_id = ca.category_id GROUP BY ca.category_id, ca.name HAVING COUNT(fc.film_id) = (SELECT MAX(nombre) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre FROM film_category GROUP BY category_id)) ORDER BY ca.name;"},{"question":"Dans quel pays trouve-t-on le plus grand nombre de villes ?","sql":"SELECT co.country, COUNT(ci.city_id) AS nombre_villes FROM country AS co JOIN city AS ci ON ci.country_id = co.country_id GROUP BY co.country_id, co.country HAVING COUNT(ci.city_id) = (SELECT MAX(nombre) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre FROM city GROUP BY country_id)) ORDER BY co.country;"},{"question":"Quels clients habitent dans la même ville qu’au moins un employé ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer AS c JOIN address AS ca ON ca.address_id = c.address_id JOIN city AS ci ON ci.city_id = ca.city_id JOIN staff AS st ON st.address_id IN (SELECT a.address_id FROM address AS a WHERE a.city_id = ci.city_id) ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;"},{"question":"Quelles langues ne sont utilisées par aucun film ?","sql":"SELECT l.language_id, l.name FROM language AS l LEFT JOIN film AS f ON f.language_id = l.language_id WHERE f.film_id IS NULL ORDER BY l.name;"},{"question":"Quels couples d’acteurs ont joué ensemble dans au moins un film ?","sql":"SELECT a1.first_name || ' ' || a1.last_name AS acteur_1, a2.first_name || ' ' || a2.last_name AS acteur_2, COUNT(*) AS films_communs FROM film_actor AS fa1 JOIN film_actor AS fa2 ON fa2.film_id = fa1.film_id AND fa2.actor_id > fa1.actor_id JOIN actor AS a1 ON a1.actor_id = fa1.actor_id JOIN actor AS a2 ON a2.actor_id = fa2.actor_id GROUP BY fa1.actor_id, fa2.actor_id, a1.first_name, a1.last_name, a2.first_name, a2.last_name ORDER BY films_communs DESC, acteur_1, acteur_2;"},{"question":"Quels films appartiennent à la catégorie « Action » ?","sql":"SELECT f.film_id, f.title FROM film AS f JOIN film_category AS fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category AS ca ON ca.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE ca.name = 'Action' ORDER BY f.title;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont dépensé plus que la moyenne des clients payeurs ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_paye FROM customer AS c JOIN payment AS p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING SUM(p.amount) > (SELECT AVG(total_client) FROM (SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_client FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id)) ORDER BY total_paye DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de films distincts chaque magasin possède-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS nombre_films FROM inventory GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id;"},{"question":"Quelles adresses ne sont associées à aucun client ?","sql":"SELECT a.address_id, a.address, a.district FROM address AS a LEFT JOIN customer AS c ON c.address_id = a.address_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL ORDER BY a.address_id;"},{"question":"Combien de films sont sortis chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT release_year, COUNT(*) AS nombre_films FROM film WHERE release_year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY release_year ORDER BY release_year;"},{"question":"Quels films ont un tarif supérieur au tarif moyen de leur catégorie ?","sql":"SELECT f.film_id, f.title, ca.name AS categorie, f.rental_rate FROM film AS f JOIN film_category AS fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category AS ca ON ca.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE f.rental_rate > (SELECT AVG(f2.rental_rate) FROM film AS f2 JOIN film_category AS fc2 ON fc2.film_id = f2.film_id WHERE fc2.category_id = fc.category_id) ORDER BY ca.name, f.rental_rate DESC;"},{"question":"Quels paiements ne sont associés à aucune location ?","sql":"SELECT payment_id, customer_id, amount, payment_date FROM payment WHERE rental_id IS NULL ORDER BY payment_date;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les dix locations les plus récentes ?","sql":"SELECT rental_id, rental_date, customer_id, inventory_id FROM rental ORDER BY rental_date DESC LIMIT 10;"},{"question":"Quels films sont présents dans tous les magasins ?","sql":"SELECT f.film_id, f.title FROM film AS f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory AS i WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id AND i.store_id = s.store_id)) ORDER BY f.title;"},{"question":"Pour chaque pays, combien y a-t-il de villes et d’adresses ?","sql":"SELECT co.country, COUNT(DISTINCT ci.city_id) AS nombre_villes, COUNT(a.address_id) AS nombre_adresses FROM country AS co LEFT JOIN city AS ci ON ci.country_id = co.country_id LEFT JOIN address AS a ON a.city_id = ci.city_id GROUP BY co.country_id, co.country ORDER BY co.country;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les auteurs ?","sql":"SELECT authorId,authorName FROM author;"},{"question":"Quels sont les articles ?","sql":"SELECT paperId,title FROM paper;"},{"question":"Quels journaux existent ?","sql":"SELECT journalId,journalName FROM journal;"},{"question":"Quels lieux de publication sont recensés ?","sql":"SELECT venueId,venueName FROM venue;"},{"question":"Quels jeux de données sont connus ?","sql":"SELECT datasetId,datasetName FROM dataset;"},{"question":"Quels mots-clés sont utilisés ?","sql":"SELECT keyphraseId,keyphraseName FROM keyphrase;"},{"question":"Combien d'articles chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT year,COUNT(*) FROM paper GROUP BY year;"},{"question":"Combien d'articles chaque auteur a-t-il écrits ?","sql":"SELECT authorId,COUNT(*) FROM writes GROUP BY authorId;"},{"question":"Quels articles citent d'autres articles ?","sql":"SELECT citingPaperId,citedPaperId FROM cite;"},{"question":"Quels articles utilisent des jeux de données ?","sql":"SELECT paperId,datasetId FROM paperDataset;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont chaque mot-clé ?","sql":"SELECT paperId,keyphraseId FROM paperKeyphrase;"},{"question":"Quels articles appartiennent à un journal ?","sql":"SELECT p.paperId,p.title,j.journalName FROM paper p JOIN journal j ON j.journalId=p.journalId;"}]}

moyen ?","sql":"SELECT \"Party\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_de_chauffeurs\", AVG(\"Age\") AS \"Age_moyen\" FROM \"driver\" GROUP BY \"Party\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_de_chauffeurs\" DESC, \"Party\";"}]}

e ON e.\"School_id\" = s.\"School_id\" GROUP BY s.\"School_id\", s.\"School_name\" ORDER BY total_endowment DESC, s.\"School_name\";"},{"question":"Combien d'écoles disposent d'un budget enregistré une dotation mais aucun budget n'est enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"School_id\", s.\"School_name\" FROM \"School\" AS s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"endowment\" AS e WHERE e.\"School_id\" = ?","sql":"SELECT \"County\", SUM(\"Enrollment\") AS enrollment_total FROM \"School\" GROUP BY \"County\" ORDER BY enrollment_total DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelles écoles ont investi davantage que {"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les joueurs âgés de 18 ans ou plus, avec leur équipe et leur position ?","sql":"SELECT "Player", "Team", "Age", "Position"
FROM "player"
WHERE "Age" >= 18
ORDER BY "Age" DESC, "Player";"},{"question":"Quelles écoles ont un effectif supérieur à la moyenne de toutes les écoles ?","sql":"SELECT "School", "Enrollment"
FROM "school"
WHERE "Enrollment" > (SELECT AVG("Enrollment") FROM "school")
ORDER BY "Enrollment" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de joueurs sont associés à chaque école, y compris les écoles sans joueur ?","sql":"SELECT s."School", COUNT(p."Player_ID") AS "Nombre_de_joueurs"
FROM "school" AS s
LEFT JOIN "player" AS p ON p."School_ID" = s."School_ID"
GROUP BY s."School_ID", s."School"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_joueurs" DESC, s."School";"},{"question":"Quelles écoles appartiennent à chaque ligue et quelle est leur division ?","sql":"SELECT s."School", d."League", d."Division", d."Class"
FROM "school" AS s
JOIN "school_details" AS d ON d."School_ID" = s."School_ID"
ORDER BY d."League", s."School";"},{"question":"Quels joueurs fréquentent une école fondée avant 1900 ?","sql":"SELECT p."Player", p."Team", s."School", s."Founded"
FROM "player" AS p
JOIN "school" AS s ON s."School_ID" = p."School_ID"
WHERE s."Founded" < 1900
ORDER BY s."Founded", p."Player";"},{"question":"Quelles écoles ont une performance renseignée en classe A ou en classe AA pour au moins une année ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s."School", sp."School_Year", sp."Class_A", sp."Class_AA"
FROM "school" AS s
JOIN "school_performance" AS sp ON sp."School_Id" = s."School_ID"
WHERE sp."Class_A" IS NOT NULL OR sp."Class_AA" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s."School", sp."School_Year";"},{"question":"Quel est l’âge moyen des joueurs par position ?","sql":"SELECT "Position", ROUND(AVG("Age"), 2) AS "Age_moyen", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_joueurs"
FROM "player"
GROUP BY "Position"
ORDER BY "Age_moyen" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles écoles ont des joueurs mais aucune performance enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT s."School"
FROM "school" AS s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "player" AS p
    WHERE p."School_ID" = s."School_ID"
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "school_performance" AS sp
    WHERE sp."School_Id" = s."School_ID"
)
ORDER BY s."School";"},{"question":"Pour chaque dénomination, quel est le nombre d’écoles et leur effectif moyen ?","sql":"SELECT "Denomination", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_ecoles", ROUND(AVG("Enrollment"), 2) AS "Effectif_moyen"
FROM "school"
GROUP BY "Denomination"
ORDER BY "Nombre_ecoles" DESC, "Denomination";"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont le même âge que l’âge moyen de l’ensemble des joueurs ?","sql":"SELECT "Player", "Age", "Team"
FROM "player"
WHERE "Age" = (SELECT AVG("Age") FROM "player")
ORDER BY "Player";"},{"question":"Quelles écoles ont une couleur scolaire renseignée ainsi qu’un surnom dans les détails ?","sql":"SELECT s."School", s."School_Colors", d."Nickname", d."Colors"
FROM "school" AS s
JOIN "school_details" AS d ON d."School_ID" = s."School_ID"
WHERE s."School_Colors" IS NOT NULL
  AND d."Nickname" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s."School";"},{"question":"Quelles sont les années de compétition distinctes associées aux écoles situées dans chaque lieu ?","sql":"SELECT "Location", "Year_Entered_Competition", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_ecoles"
FROM "school"
GROUP BY "Location", "Year_Entered_Competition"
ORDER BY "Location", "Year_Entered_Competition";"},{"question":"Quelles écoles ont au moins un joueur en position de gardien ou de défenseur ?","sql":"SELECT s."School"
FROM "school" AS s
JOIN "player" AS p ON p."School_ID" = s."School_ID"
WHERE p."Position" IN ('Gardien', 'Défenseur')
GROUP BY s."School_ID", s."School"
ORDER BY s."School";"},{"question":"Quelles écoles sont à la fois entrées en compétition avant 2000 et fondées après 1950 ?","sql":"SELECT "School", "Founded", "Year_Entered_Competition"
FROM "school"
WHERE "School_ID" IN (
    SELECT "School_ID"
    FROM "school"
    WHERE "Year_Entered_Competition" < 2000
    INTERSECT
    SELECT "School_ID"
    FROM "school"
    WHERE "Founded" > 1950
)
ORDER BY "Founded", "School";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et les heures prévues pour tous les projets ?","sql":"SELECT Name, Hours FROM Projects;"},{"question":"Quels sont les scientifiques enregistrés, avec leur numéro SSN ?","sql":"SELECT SSN, Name FROM Scientists;"},{"question":"Quels projets nécessitent au moins 100 heures ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Hours FROM Projects WHERE Hours >= 100;"},{"question":"Quels scientifiques portent un nom commençant par la lettre A ?","sql":"SELECT SSN, Name FROM Scientists WHERE Name LIKE 'A%';"},{"question":"Quels projets sont classés par nombre Scientists AS s LEFT JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Scientist = s.SSN GROUP BY s.SSN, s.Name;"},{"question":"Quels projets comptent plus de deux scientifiques affectés ?","sql":"SELECT p.Code, p.Name, COUNT(a.Scientist) AS ScientistCount FROM Projects AS p JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Project = p.Code GROUP BY p.Code, p.Name HAVING COUNT(a.Scientist) > 2;"},{"question":"Quels scientifiques travaillent sur plus d'un projet ?","sql":"SELECT s.SSN, s.Name, COUNT(a.Project) AS ProjectCount FROM Scientists AS s JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Scientist = s.SSN GROUP BY s.SSN, s.Name HAVING COUNT(a.Project) > 1;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total d'affectations ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS AssignmentCount FROM AssignedTo;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de projets distincts ayant des affectations ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Project) AS AssignedProjectCount FROM AssignedTo;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen d'heures prévues par projet ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(Hours) AS AverageHours FROM Projects;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les heures minimale et maximale prévues pour un projet ?","sql":"SELECT MIN(Hours) AS MinimumHours, MAX(Hours) AS MaximumHours FROM Projects;"},{"question":"Quel est le total des heures prévues pour tous les projets ?","sql":"SELECT SUM(Hours) AS TotalHours FROM Projects;"},{"question":"Quels projets ont une durée supérieure à la durée moyenne des projets ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Hours FROM Projects WHERE Hours > (SELECT AVG(Hours) FROM Projects);"},{"question":"Quels projets ont le plus grand nombre d'heures prévues ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Hours FROM Projects WHERE Hours = (SELECT MAX(Hours) FROM Projects);"},{"question":"Quels projets ont le moins d'heures prévues ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Hours FROM Projects WHERE Hours = (SELECT MIN(Hours) FROM Projects);"},{"question":"Quels scientifiques ne sont affectés à aucun projet ?","sql":"SELECT s.SSN, s.Name FROM Scientists AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AssignedTo AS a WHERE a.Scientist = s.SSN);"},{"question":"Quels projets ne possèdent encore aucune affectation ?","sql":"SELECT p.Code, p.Name FROM Projects AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AssignedTo AS a WHERE a.Project = p.Code);"},{"question":"Quels scientifiques travaillent sur le projet nommé « Alpha » ?","sql":"SELECT s.SSN, s.Name FROM Scientists AS s JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Scientist = s.SSN JOIN Projects AS p ON p.Code = a.Project WHERE p.Name = 'Alpha';"},{"question":"Quels projets sont suivis par le scientifique dont le SSN vaut 1001 ?","sql":"SELECT p.Code, p.Name FROM Projects AS p JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Project = p.Code WHERE a.Scientist = 1001;"},{"question":"Quels scientifiques sont affectés à un projet nécessitant au moins 200 heures ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.SSN, s.Name FROM Scientists AS s JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Scientist = s.SSN JOIN Projects AS p ON p.Code = a.Project WHERE p.Hours >= 200;"},{"question":"Quels projets ont au moins un scientifique dont le nom contient « Martin » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.Code, p.Name FROM Projects AS p JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Project = p.Code JOIN Scientists AS s ON s.SSN = a.Scientist WHERE s.Name LIKE '%Martin%';"},{"question":"Quels scientifiques travaillent à la fois sur un projet de moins de 100 heures et sur un projet d'au moins 100 heures ?","sql":"SELECT s.SSN, s.Name FROM Scientists AS s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AssignedTo AS a JOIN Projects AS p ON p.Code = a.Project WHERE a.Scientist = s.SSN AND p.Hours < 100) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AssignedTo AS a JOIN Projects AS p ON p.Code = a.Project WHERE a.Scientist = s.SSN AND p.Hours >= 100);"},{"question":"Quels projets ont un nombre de scientifiques affectés supérieur à la moyenne des affectations par projet ?","sql":"SELECT p.Code, p.Name, COUNT(a.Scientist) AS ScientistCount FROM Projects AS p LEFT JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Project = p.Code GROUP BY p.Code, p.Name HAVING COUNT(a.Scientist) > (SELECT AVG(ScientistCount) FROM (SELECT COUNT(a2.Scientist) AS ScientistCount FROM Projects AS p2 LEFT JOIN AssignedTo AS a2 ON a2.Project = p2.Code GROUP BY p2.Code));"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de projets par scientifique, en ne comptant que les scientifiques affectés ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(ProjectCount) AS AverageProjectsPerScientist FROM (SELECT Scientist, COUNT(Project) AS ProjectCount FROM AssignedTo GROUP BY Scientist);"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms réunis des scientifiques et des projets ?","sql":"SELECT Name FROM Scientists UNION SELECT Name FROM Projects;"},{"question":"Quels noms apparaissent à la fois parmi les scientifiques et parmi les projets ?","sql":"SELECT Name FROM Scientists INTERSECT SELECT Name FROM Projects;"},{"question":"Quels noms de scientifiques n'apparaissent pas comme noms de projets ?","sql":"SELECT Name FROM Scientists EXCEPT SELECT Name FROM Projects;"},{"question":"Quelles paires scientifique-projet sont enregistrées, avec les identifiants correspondants ?","sql":"SELECT a.Scientist, s.Name AS ScientistName, a.Project, p.Name AS ProjectName FROM AssignedTo AS a JOIN Scientists AS s ON s.SSN = a.Scientist JOIN Projects AS p ON p.Code = a.Project ORDER BY s.Name, p.Name;"},{"question":"Quels projets sont affectés à exactement un scientifique ?","sql":"SELECT p.Code, p.Name FROM Projects AS p JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Project = p.Code GROUP BY p.Code, p.Name HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;"},{"question":"Quels scientifiques sont affectés à exactement un projet ?","sql":"SELECT s.SSN, s.Name FROM Scientists AS s JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Scientist = s.SSN GROUP BY s.SSN, s.Name HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;"},{"question":"Pour chaque projet, quelles sont les heures prévues et le nombre d'affectations ?","sql":"SELECT p.Code, p.Name, p.Hours, COUNT(a.Scientist) AS AssignmentCount FROM Projects AS p LEFT JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Project = p.Code GROUP BY p.Code, p.Name, p.Hours;"},{"question":"Quels projets ont des heures renseignées et aucun scientifique affecté ?","sql":"SELECT p.Code, p.Name, p.Hours FROM Projects AS p LEFT JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Project = p.Code WHERE p.Hours IS NOT NULL AND a.Project IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels projets ont un nombre d'heures supérieur à celui de tous les projets de code inférieur à « M » ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Hours FROM Projects WHERE Hours > ALL (SELECT Hours FROM Projects WHERE Code < 'M');"},{"question":"Quels scientifiques sont affectés à tous les projets ?","sql":"SELECT s.SSN, s.Name FROM Scientists AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Projects AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AssignedTo AS a WHERE a.Scientist = s.SSN AND a.Project = p.Code));"},{"question":"Quels projets sont suivis par tous les scientifiques ?","sql":"SELECT p.Code, p.Name FROM Projects AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Scientists AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AssignedTo AS a WHERE a.Project = p.Code AND a.Scientist = s.SSN));"},{"question":"Quel projet compte le plus de scientifiques affectés ?","sql":"SELECT p.Code, p.Name, COUNT(a.Scientist) AS ScientistCount FROM Projects AS p LEFT JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Project = p.Code GROUP BY p.Code, p.Name HAVING COUNT(a.Scientist) = (SELECT MAX(ScientistCount) FROM (SELECT COUNT(a2.Scientist) AS ScientistCount FROM Projects AS p2 LEFT JOIN AssignedTo AS a2 ON a2.Project = p2.Code GROUP BY p2.Code));"},{"question":"Quel scientifique est affecté au plus grand nombre de projets ?","sql":"SELECT s.SSN, s.Name, COUNT(a.Project) AS ProjectCount FROM Scientists AS s LEFT JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Scientist = s.SSN GROUP BY s.SSN, s.Name HAVING COUNT(a.Project) = (SELECT MAX(ProjectCount) FROM (SELECT COUNT(a2.Project) AS ProjectCount FROM Scientists AS s2 LEFT JOIN AssignedTo AS a2 ON a2.Scientist = s2.SSN GROUP BY s2.SSN));"},{"question":"Quels projets ont un nom contenant le mot « recherche » sans tenir compte de la casse ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Hours FROM Projects WHERE Name LIKE '%recherche%' COLLATE NOCASE;"},{"question":"Combien d'heures sont prévues pour les projets ayant au moins un scientifique affecté ?","sql":"SELECT SUM(p.Hours) AS AssignedProjectHours FROM Projects AS p WHERE p.Code IN (SELECT a.Project FROM AssignedTo AS a);"},{"question":"Quels scientifiques sont affectés à des projets dont le total d'heures dépasse 300 ?","sql":"SELECT s.SSN, s.Name FROM Scientists AS s JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Scientist = s.SSN JOIN Projects AS p ON p.Code = a.Project WHERE p.Hours > 300;"},{"question":"Quelle est la répartition du nombre de projets selon le nombre de scientifiques affectés ?","sql":"SELECT ScientistCount, COUNT(*) AS ProjectCount FROM (SELECT p.Code, COUNT(a.Scientist) AS ScientistCount FROM Projects AS p LEFT JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Project = p.Code GROUP BY p.Code) GROUP BY ScientistCount ORDER BY ScientistCount;"},{"question":"Quels scientifiques sont affectés à des projets dont le nom est différent de leur propre nom ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.SSN, s.Name AS ScientistName, p.Name AS ProjectName FROM Scientists AS s JOIN AssignedTo AS a ON a.Scientist = s.SSN JOIN Projects AS p ON p.Code = a.Project WHERE s.Name <> p.Name;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms, types et années de construction de tous les navires ?","sql":"SELECT \"Name\", \"Type\", \"Built_Year\" FROM \"Ship\";"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms d’un capitaine enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Name\", COUNT(c.\"Captain_ID\") AS \"Nombre_de_capitaines\" FROM \"Ship\" AS s JOIN \"captain\" AS c ON c.\"Ship_ID\" = s.\"Ship_ID\" GROUP BY s.\"Ship_ID\", s.\"Name\" HAVING COUNT(c.\"Captain_ID\") > 1;"},{"question":"Quel est le capitaine le plus âgé ?","sql":"SELECT \"Name\", \"age\" FROM \"captain\" WHERE CAST(\"age\" AS INTEGER) = s.\"Name\", MAX(CAST(c.\"age\" AS INTEGER)) AS \"Age_maximal\" FROM \"Ship\" AS s JOIN \"captain\" AS c ON c.\"Ship_ID\" = s.\"Ship_ID\" GROUP BY s.\"Ship_ID\", s.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Quel navire possède le plus grand nombre de capitaines ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Name\", COUNT(c.\"Captain_ID\") AS \"Nombre_de_capitaines\" FROM \"Ship\" AS s JOIN \"captain\" AS c ON c.\"Ship_ID\" = s.\"Ship_ID\" GROUP BY s.\"Ship_ID\", s.\"Name\" HAVING COUNT(c.\"Captain_ID\") = (SELECT MAX(\"Nombre\") FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre\" FROM \"captain\" GROUP BY \"Ship_ID\"));"},{"question":"Quels capitaines ont une classe différente de celle de leur navire ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Name\" AS \"Capitaine\", s.\"Name\" AS \"Navire\", c.\"Class\" AS \"Classe_capitaine\", s.\"Class\" AS \"Classe_navire\" FROM ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Name\", s.\"Built_Year\" FROM \"Ship\" AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"captain\" AS c WHERE c.\"Ship_ID\" = s.\"Ship_ID\") AND s.\"Built_Year\" < (SELECT {"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms des navires et les lieux où leurs missions ont été menées ?","sql":"SELECT s."Name", m."Location"
FROM "ship" AS s
JOIN "mission" AS m ON m."Ship_ID" = s."Ship_ID";"},{"question":"Pour chaque nationalité, quel est le tonnage moyen de ses navires ?","sql":"SELECT "Nationality", AVG("Tonnage") AS tonnage_moyen
FROM "ship"
GROUP BY "Nationality";"},{"question":"Quelle mission a atteint la vitesse maximale, et à quel navire appartenait-elle ?","sql":"SELECT m."Mission_ID", s."Name", m."Speed_knots"
FROM "mission" AS m
JOIN "ship" AS s ON s."Ship_ID" = m."Ship_ID"
WHERE m."Speed_knots" = (SELECT MAX("Speed_knots") FROM "mission");"},{"question":"Combien de missions correspondent à chaque issue ?","sql":"SELECT "Fate", COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_missions
FROM "mission"
GROUP BY "Fate"
ORDER BY nombre_de_missions DESC;"},{"question":"Quels navires n'ont participé à aucune mission ?","sql":"SELECT s."Name"
FROM "ship" AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "mission" AS m
    WHERE m."Ship_ID" = s."Ship_ID"
);"},{"question":"Pour chaque lieu, combien de missions ont été lancées depuis 1950 ?","sql":"SELECT "Location", COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_missions
FROM "mission"
WHERE "Launched_Year" >= 1950
GROUP BY "Location"
ORDER BY nombre_de_missions DESC, "Location";"},{"question":"Quels navires sont soit de nationalité française, soit associés à au moins une mission ?","sql":"SELECT "Name"
FROM "ship"
WHERE "Nationality" = 'France'
UNION
SELECT s."Name"
FROM "ship" AS s
JOIN "mission" AS m ON m."Ship_ID" = s."Ship_ID";"},{"question":"Quels navires ont un tonnage supérieur au tonnage moyen de tous les navires ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Tonnage"
FROM "ship"
WHERE "Tonnage" > (SELECT AVG("Tonnage") FROM "ship")
ORDER BY "Tonnage" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels navires ont effectué au moins deux missions, avec leur nombre de missions et leur vitesse moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT s."Name", COUNT(m."Mission_ID") AS nombre_de_missions, AVG(m."Speed_knots") AS vitesse_moyenne
FROM "ship" AS s
JOIN "mission" AS m ON m."Ship_ID" = s."Ship_ID"
GROUP BY s."Ship_ID", s."Name"
HAVING COUNT(m."Mission_ID") >= 2;"},{"question":"Pour chaque navire ayant une mission, quelles sont son nom et l'année de sa mission la plus récente ?","sql":"SELECT s."Name", MAX(m."Launched_Year") AS derniere_annee_de_mission
FROM "ship" AS s
JOIN "mission" AS m ON m."Ship_ID" = s."Ship_ID"
GROUP BY s."Ship_ID", s."Name"
ORDER BY derniere_annee_de_mission DESC;"}]}
