\"membership_register_branch\" r JOIN \"member\" m ON m.\"Member_ID\" = r.\"Member_ID\" JOIN \"branch\" b ON b.\"Branch_ID\" = r.\"Branch_ID\";"},{"question":"Quelles transactions ont dépassé 100 livres ?","sql":"SELECT \"Member_ID\", \"Branch_ID\", \"Year\", \"Total_pounds\" FROM \"purchase\" WHERE \"Total_pounds\" > 100 ORDER BY \"Total_pounds\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total dépensé par chaque membre ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\", COALESCE(SUM(p.\"Total_pounds\"), 0) AS \"Total_spent\" FROM \"member\" m LEFT JOIN \"purchase\" p ON p.\"Member_ID\" = m.\"Member_ID\" GROUP BY m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\" ORDER BY \"Total_spent\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant moyen des cotisations par agence ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(CAST(\"membership_amount\" AS REAL)) AS \"Average_membership_amount\" FROM \"branch\";"},{"question":"Combien de membres sont inscrits dans chaque agence ?","sql":"SELECT b.\"Branch_ID\", b.\"Name\", COUNT(r.\"Member_ID\") AS \"Member_count\" FROM \"branch\" b LEFT JOIN \"membership_register_branch\" r ON r.\"Branch_ID\" = CAST(b.\"Branch_ID\" AS TEXT) GROUP BY b.\"Branch_ID\", b.\"Name\" ORDER BY \"Member_count\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles agences n'ont encore aucun membre inscrit ?","sql":"SELECT b.\"Branch_ID\", b.\"Name\" FROM \"branch\" b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"membership_register_branch\" r WHERE r.\"Branch_ID\" = CAST(b.\"Branch_ID\" AS TEXT));"},{"question":"Quels membres n'ont effectué aucun achat ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\" FROM \"member\" m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"purchase\" p WHERE p.\"Member_ID\" = m.\"Member_ID\") ORDER BY m.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Quel est le total des achats pour chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT \"Year\", SUM(\"Total_pounds\") AS \"Yearly_total\" FROM \"purchase\" GROUP BY \"Year\" ORDER BY CAST(\"Year\" AS INTEGER);"},{"question":"Quel membre a dépensé le plus au total ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\", SUM(p.\"Total_pounds\") AS \"Total_spent\" FROM \"member\" m JOIN \"purchase\" p ON p.\"Member_ID\" = m.\"Member_ID\" GROUP BY m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\" HAVING SUM(p.\"Total_pounds\") = (SELECT MAX(\"Member_total\") FROM (SELECT SUM(\"Total_pounds\") AS \"Member_total\" FROM \"purchase\" GROUP BY \"Member_ID\"));"},{"question":"Quel est le montant moyen des achats dans chaque agence ?","sql":"SELECT b.\"Branch_ID\", b.\"Name\", AVG(p.\"Total_pounds\") AS \"Average_purchase\" FROM \"branch\" b JOIN \"purchase\" p ON p.\"Branch_ID\" = CAST(b.\"Branch_ID\" AS TEXT) GROUP BY b.\"Branch_ID\", b.\"Name\" ORDER BY \"Average_purchase\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels achats ont été réalisés dans la ville d'origine du membre ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\", b.\"Name\" AS \"Branch_Name\", p.\"Year\", p.\"Total_pounds\" FROM \"purchase\" p JOIN \"member\" m ON m.\"Member_ID\" = p.\"Member_ID\" JOIN \"branch\" b ON b.\"Branch_ID\" = CAST(p.\"Branch_ID\" AS INTEGER) WHERE m.\"Hometown\" = b.\"City\";"},{"question":"Quelle est l'agence ouverte le plus anciennement ?","sql":"SELECT \"Branch_ID\", \"Name\", \"Open_year\" FROM \"branch\" WHERE CAST(\"Open_year\" AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MIN(CAST(\"Open_year\" AS INTEGER)) FROM \"branch\");"},{"question":"Combien de membres y a-t-il pour chaque niveau ?","sql":"SELECT \"Level\", COUNT(*) AS \"Member_count\" FROM \"member\" GROUP BY \"Level\" ORDER BY \"Level\";"},{"question":"Quels membres ont acheté dans l'agence où ils sont inscrits ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\", b.\"Name\" AS \"Branch_Name\" FROM \"member\" m JOIN \"membership_register_branch\" r ON r.\"Member_ID\" = m.\"Member_ID\" JOIN \"branch\" b ON b.\"Branch_ID\" = CAST(r.\"Branch_ID\" AS INTEGER) JOIN \"purchase\" p ON p.\"Member_ID\" = m.\"Member_ID\" AND p.\"Branch_ID\" = r.\"Branch_ID\";"},{"question":"Quelles agences ont un total d'achats supérieur au total moyen des agences ?","sql":"SELECT b.\"Branch_ID\", b.\"Name\", SUM(p.\"Total_pounds\") AS \"Branch_total\" FROM \"branch\" b JOIN \"purchase\" p ON p.\"Branch_ID\" = CAST(b.\"Branch_ID\" AS TEXT) GROUP BY b.\"Branch_ID\", b.\"Name\" HAVING SUM(p.\"Total_pounds\") > (SELECT AVG(\"Branch_total\") FROM (SELECT SUM(\"Total_pounds\") AS \"Branch_total\" FROM \"purchase\" GROUP BY \"Branch_ID\"));"},{"question":"Quelle est l'année du dernier achat de chaque membre ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\", MAX(CAST(p.\"Year\" AS INTEGER)) AS \"Last_purchase_year\" FROM \"member\" m LEFT JOIN \"purchase\" p ON p.\"Member_ID\" = m.\"Member_ID\" GROUP BY m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Quels membres ont acheté dans plusieurs agences différentes ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\", COUNT(DISTINCT p.\"Branch_ID\") AS \"Branch_count\" FROM \"member\" m JOIN \"purchase\" p ON p.\"Member_ID\" = m.\"Member_ID\" GROUP BY m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.\"Branch_ID\") > 1;"},{"question":"Quelles agences ont des membres inscrits mais aucun achat ?","sql":"SELECT b.\"Branch_ID\", b.\"Name\" FROM \"branch\" b WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"membership_register_branch\" r WHERE r.\"Branch_ID\" = CAST(b.\"Branch_ID\" AS TEXT)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"purchase\" p WHERE p.\"Branch_ID\" = CAST(b.\"Branch_ID\" AS TEXT));"},{"question":"Quelles villes apparaissent comme ville d'origine d'un membre ou comme ville d'une agence ?","sql":"SELECT \"Hometown\" AS \"City\" FROM \"member\" UNION SELECT \"City\" AS \"City\" FROM \"branch\" ORDER BY \"City\";"},{"question":"Quels membres sont inscrits mais n'ont effectué aucun achat ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\" FROM \"member\" m JOIN \"membership_register_branch\" r ON r.\"Member_ID\" = m.\"Member_ID\" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"purchase\" p WHERE p.\"Member_ID\" = m.\"Member_ID\");"},{"question":"Quels achats sont supérieurs à la moyenne des achats du même membre ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\", p.\"Branch_ID\", p.\"Year\", p.\"Total_pounds\" FROM \"purchase\" p JOIN \"member\" m ON m.\"Member_ID\" = p.\"Member_ID\" WHERE p.\"Total_pounds\" > (SELECT AVG(p2.\"Total_pounds\") FROM \"purchase\" p2 WHERE p2.\"Member_ID\" = p.\"Member_ID\");"},{"question":"Pour chaque agence, quel est l'achat le plus élevé et quel membre l'a réalisé ?","sql":"SELECT b.\"Branch_ID\", b.\"Name\" AS \"Branch_Name\", m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\" AS \"Member_Name\", p.\"Total_pounds\" FROM \"purchase\" p JOIN \"branch\" b ON b.\"Branch_ID\" = CAST(p.\"Branch_ID\" AS INTEGER) JOIN \"member\" m ON m.\"Member_ID\" = p.\"Member_ID\" WHERE p.\"Total_pounds\" = (SELECT MAX(p2.\"Total_pounds\") FROM \"purchase\" p2 WHERE p2.\"Branch_ID\" = p.\"Branch_ID\");"},{"question":"Quelles sont les informations des membres portant la carte numéro 12345 ?","sql":"SELECT \"Member_ID\", \"Name\", \"Hometown\", \"Level\" FROM \"member\" WHERE \"Card_Number\" = '12345';"},{"question":"Quels membres se sont inscrits après l'ouverture de leur agence ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\", b.\"Name\" AS \"Branch_Name\", r.\"Register_Year\", b.\"Open_year\" FROM \"membership_register_branch\" r JOIN \"member\" m ON m.\"Member_ID\" = r.\"Member_ID\" JOIN \"branch\" b ON b.\"Branch_ID\" = CAST(r.\"Branch_ID\" AS INTEGER) WHERE CAST(r.\"Register_Year\" AS INTEGER) > CAST(b.\"Open_year\" AS INTEGER);"},{"question":"Pour chaque agence, quels sont le montant de cotisation et le total des achats ?","sql":"SELECT b.\"Branch_ID\", b.\"Name\", b.\"membership_amount\", COALESCE(SUM(p.\"Total_pounds\"), 0) AS \"Purchase_total\" FROM \"branch\" b LEFT JOIN \"purchase\" p ON p.\"Branch_ID\" = CAST(b.\"Branch_ID\" AS TEXT) GROUP BY b.\"Branch_ID\", b.\"Name\", b.\"membership_amount\";"},{"question":"Quels membres ont le niveau le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT \"Member_ID\", \"Name\", \"Level\" FROM \"member\" WHERE \"Level\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Level\") FROM \"member\");"},{"question":"Combien de transactions chaque agence a-t-elle enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT b.\"Branch_ID\", b.\"Name\", COUNT(p.\"Member_ID\") AS \"Purchase_count\" FROM \"branch\" b LEFT JOIN \"purchase\" p ON p.\"Branch_ID\" = CAST(b.\"Branch_ID\" AS TEXT) GROUP BY b.\"Branch_ID\", b.\"Name\" ORDER BY \"Purchase_count\" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de membres distincts ont acheté au cours de chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT \"Year\", COUNT(DISTINCT \"Member_ID\") AS \"Distinct_members\" FROM \"purchase\" GROUP BY \"Year\" ORDER BY CAST(\"Year\" AS INTEGER);"},{"question":"Quelles agences ont reçu des achats de tous leurs membres inscrits ?","sql":"SELECT b.\"Branch_ID\", b.\"Name\" FROM \"branch\" b WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"membership_register_branch\" r WHERE r.\"Branch_ID\" = CAST(b.\"Branch_ID\" AS TEXT)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"membership_register_branch\" r WHERE r.\"Branch_ID\" = CAST(b.\"Branch_ID\" AS TEXT) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"purchase\" p WHERE p.\"Member_ID\" = r.\"Member_ID\" AND p.\"Branch_ID\" = r.\"Branch_ID\"));"},{"question":"Combien d'agences se trouvent dans chaque ville ?","sql":"SELECT \"City\", COUNT(*) AS \"Branch_count\" FROM \"branch\" GROUP BY \"City\" ORDER BY \"Branch_count\" DESC, \"City\";"},{"question":"Quels membres ont dépensé davantage que la moyenne des dépenses totales par membre ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\", SUM(p.\"Total_pounds\") AS \"Total_spent\" FROM \"member\" m JOIN \"purchase\" p ON p.\"Member_ID\" = m.\"Member_ID\" GROUP BY m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\" HAVING SUM(p.\"Total_pounds\") > (SELECT AVG(\"Member_total\") FROM (SELECT SUM(\"Total_pounds\") AS \"Member_total\" FROM \"purchase\" GROUP BY \"Member_ID\"));"},{"question":"Quelles agences ont une cotisation supérieure à 50 ?","sql":"SELECT \"Branch_ID\", \"Name\", \"membership_amount\" FROM \"branch\" WHERE CAST(\"membership_amount\" AS REAL) > 50 ORDER BY CAST(\"membership_amount\" AS REAL) DESC;"},{"question":"Quels membres ont effectué un achat dans une agence différente de celle où ils sont inscrits ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"Member_ID\", m.\"Name\", r.\"Branch_ID\" AS \"Registered_branch\", p.\"Branch_ID\" AS \"Purchase_branch\" FROM \"member\" m JOIN \"membership_register_branch\" r ON r.\"Member_ID\" = m.\"Member_ID\" JOIN \"purchase\" p ON p.\"Member_ID\" = m.\"Member_ID\" WHERE r.\"Branch_ID\" <> p.\"Branch_ID\";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont tous les comptes clients ?","sql":"SELECT custid, name FROM ACCOUNTS;"},{"question":"Quels clients possèdent un compte courant ?","sql":"SELECT custid, balance FROM CHECKING;"},{"question":"Quels sont les soldes des comptes d’épargne ?","sql":"SELECT custid, balance FROM SAVINGS;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont à la fois un compte courant et un compte d’épargne ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un compte courant mais pas de compte d’épargne ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid LEFT JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid WHERE s.custid IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un compte d’épargne mais pas de compte courant ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid LEFT JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid WHERE c.custid IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total détenu sur les comptes courants et d’épargne ?","sql":"SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) FROM CHECKING) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) FROM SAVINGS) AS total_balance;"},{"question":"Quels sont les comptes courants classés du plus grand au plus petit solde ?","sql":"SELECT custid, balance FROM CHECKING ORDER BY balance DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le solde moyen des comptes d’épargne ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(balance) AS average_savings_balance FROM SAVINGS;"},{"question":"Quel est le solde courant le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(balance) AS maximum_checking_balance FROM CHECKING;"},{"question":"Quel est le solde d’épargne le plus faible ?","sql":"SELECT MIN(balance) AS minimum_savings_balance FROM SAVINGS;"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms et soldes courants des clients concernés ?","sql":"SELECT a.name, c.balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid;"},{"question":"Pour chaque client ayant les deux types de comptes, quels sont ses soldes et son total ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, c.balance AS checking_balance, s.balance AS savings_balance, c.balance + s.balance AS total_balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un solde courant supérieur à leur solde d’épargne ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid WHERE c.balance > s.balance;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont exactement le même solde courant et d’épargne ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid WHERE c.balance = s.balance;"},{"question":"Quels clients possèdent uniquement un compte courant ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name FROM ACCOUNTS AS a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CHECKING AS c WHERE c.custid = a.custid) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAVINGS AS s WHERE s.custid = a.custid);"},{"question":"Quels clients ont plus de 1 000 sur l’ensemble de leurs deux comptes ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, c.balance + s.balance AS total_balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid WHERE c.balance + s.balance > 1000;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont au moins un solde strictement positif ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name FROM ACCOUNTS AS a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CHECKING AS c WHERE c.custid = a.custid AND c.balance > 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAVINGS AS s WHERE s.custid = a.custid AND s.balance > 0);"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un solde nul sur leurs deux comptes ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid WHERE c.balance = 0 AND s.balance = 0;"},{"question":"Combien de clients sont enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM ACCOUNTS;"},{"question":"Combien de comptes courants existent-ils ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS checking_account_count FROM CHECKING;"},{"question":"Combien de comptes d’épargne sont ouverts ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS savings_account_count FROM SAVINGS;"},{"question":"Quel est le solde total moyen des clients possédant les deux types de comptes ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(c.balance + s.balance) AS average_total_balance FROM CHECKING AS c JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = c.custid;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq plus grands soldes courants ?","sql":"SELECT custid, balance FROM CHECKING ORDER BY balance DESC LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Quels clients présentent un écart d’au moins 500 entre leurs deux comptes ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, ABS(c.balance - s.balance) AS balance_difference FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid WHERE ABS(c.balance - s.balance) >= 500;"},{"question":"Quels clients portent un nom commençant par la lettre A ?","sql":"SELECT custid, name FROM ACCOUNTS WHERE name LIKE 'A%';"},{"question":"Quels comptes courants ont un solde inférieur à la moyenne des comptes courants ?","sql":"SELECT custid, balance FROM CHECKING WHERE balance < (SELECT AVG(balance) FROM CHECKING);"},{"question":"Quels comptes d’épargne ont un solde supérieur à la moyenne de cette table ?","sql":"SELECT custid, balance FROM SAVINGS WHERE balance > (SELECT AVG(balance) FROM SAVINGS);"},{"question":"Quels clients n’ont ni compte courant ni compte d’épargne ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name FROM ACCOUNTS AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CHECKING AS c WHERE c.custid = a.custid) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAVINGS AS s WHERE s.custid = a.custid);"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de clients ont un solde positif sur au moins un type de compte ?","sql":"SELECT custid FROM CHECKING WHERE balance > 0 UNION SELECT custid FROM SAVINGS WHERE balance > 0;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont simultanément un solde courant positif et un solde d’épargne positif ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name FROM ACCOUNTS AS a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CHECKING AS c WHERE c.custid = a.custid AND c.balance > 0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAVINGS AS s WHERE s.custid = a.custid AND s.balance > 0);"},{"question":"Le solde courant de quels clients est-il supérieur à tous les soldes d’épargne ?","sql":"SELECT c.custid, c.balance FROM CHECKING AS c WHERE c.balance > (SELECT MAX(balance) FROM SAVINGS);"},{"question":"Quel client possède le total courant et épargne le plus élevé ?","sql":"WITH totals AS (SELECT c.custid, c.balance + s.balance AS total_balance FROM CHECKING AS c JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = c.custid) SELECT a.custid, a.name, t.total_balance FROM totals AS t JOIN ACCOUNTS AS a ON a.custid = t.custid WHERE t.total_balance = (SELECT MAX(total_balance) FROM totals);"},{"question":"Combien de comptes courants ont un solde positif, nul ou négatif ?","sql":"SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_count, SUM(CASE WHEN balance = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_count, SUM(CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_count FROM CHECKING;"},{"question":"Quels sont les soldes minimal et maximal en considérant les deux types de comptes ?","sql":"SELECT MIN(balance) AS minimum_balance, MAX(balance) AS maximum_balance FROM (SELECT balance FROM CHECKING UNION ALL SELECT balance FROM SAVINGS);"},{"question":"Pour chaque client, indiquez s’il possède un compte courant, un compte d’épargne ou les deux.","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, CASE WHEN c.custid IS NOT NULL AND s.custid IS NOT NULL THEN 'les deux' WHEN c.custid IS NOT NULL THEN 'courant uniquement' WHEN s.custid IS NOT NULL THEN 'épargne uniquement' ELSE 'aucun' END AS account_status FROM ACCOUNTS AS a LEFT JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid LEFT JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid;"},{"question":"Quel est le total de tous les soldes, sans dédupliquer les clients ?","sql":"SELECT SUM(balance) AS total_balance FROM (SELECT balance FROM CHECKING UNION ALL SELECT balance FROM SAVINGS);"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un compte courant mais aucun compte d’épargne, par opération ensembliste ?","sql":"SELECT custid FROM CHECKING EXCEPT SELECT custid FROM SAVINGS;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants apparaissent dans les deux tables de comptes ?","sql":"SELECT custid FROM CHECKING INTERSECT SELECT custid FROM SAVINGS;"},{"question":"Quels comptes courants ont un solde compris entre 100 et 500 inclus ?","sql":"SELECT custid, balance FROM CHECKING WHERE balance BETWEEN 100 AND 500;"},{"question":"Quels comptes d’épargne ont un solde strictement négatif ?","sql":"SELECT custid, balance FROM SAVINGS WHERE balance < 0;"},{"question":"Quel est le nom du client portant l’identifiant 10 ?","sql":"SELECT name FROM ACCOUNTS WHERE custid = 10;"},{"question":"Combien de clients ont un solde courant supérieur à leur solde d’épargne ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM CHECKING AS c JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = c.custid WHERE c.balance > s.balance;"},{"question":"Quelle part des comptes courants a un solde positif ?","sql":"SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS positive_percentage FROM CHECKING;"},{"question":"Quel est le plus grand écart absolu entre les soldes courant et épargne d’un même client ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(ABS(c.balance - s.balance)) AS maximum_difference FROM CHECKING AS c JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = c.custid;"},{"question":"Affichez tous les clients avec leur solde courant lorsqu’ils en ont un, y compris ceux qui n’en ont pas.","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, c.balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a LEFT JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid ORDER BY a.name;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un compte d’épargne sans compte courant, avec leur solde d’épargne ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, s.balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid LEFT JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid WHERE c.custid IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels clients ayant les deux comptes ont un total supérieur au total moyen des clients ayant les deux comptes ?","sql":"WITH totals AS (SELECT custid, SUM(balance) AS total_balance FROM (SELECT custid, balance FROM CHECKING UNION ALL SELECT custid, balance FROM SAVINGS) GROUP BY custid HAVING COUNT(*) = 2) SELECT a.custid, a.name, t.total_balance FROM totals AS t JOIN ACCOUNTS AS a ON a.custid = t.custid WHERE t.total_balance > (SELECT AVG(total_balance) FROM totals);"},{"question":"Quels clients ont le même solde sur leur compte courant et leur compte d’épargne ?","sql":"SELECT c.custid, c.balance FROM CHECKING AS c JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = c.custid WHERE c.balance = s.balance;"},{"question":"Pour chaque client, quel est le total de ses soldes disponibles ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, COALESCE((SELECT c.balance FROM CHECKING AS c WHERE c.custid = a.custid), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT s.balance FROM SAVINGS AS s WHERE s.custid = a.custid), 0) AS total_balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a;"},{"question":"Combien de clients ont au moins un compte dont le solde est nul ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM ACCOUNTS AS a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CHECKING AS c WHERE c.custid = a.custid AND c.balance = 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAVINGS AS s WHERE s.custid = a.custid AND s.balance = 0);"},{"question":"Quels clients n’ont aucun solde positif ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name FROM ACCOUNTS AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CHECKING AS c WHERE c.custid = a.custid AND c.balance > 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAVINGS AS s WHERE s.custid = a.custid AND s.balance > 0);"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total de comptes en additionnant comptes courants et comptes d’épargne ?","sql":"SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHECKING) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SAVINGS) AS total_account_count;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Combien de ligues sont associées à chaque pays, y compris les pays sans ligue ?","sql":"SELECT c.name AS pays, COUNT(l.id) AS nombre_de_ligues
FROM Country AS c
LEFT JOIN League AS l ON l.country_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY nombre_de_ligues DESC, pays;"},{"question":"Quels sont les dix joueurs dont la note globale moyenne est la plus élevée ?","sql":"SELECT p.player_name, ROUND(AVG(pa.overall_rating), 2) AS note_globale_moyenne
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
GROUP BY p.id, p.player_name
ORDER BY note_globale_moyenne DESC
LIMIT 10;"},{"question":"Quel ou quels pays possèdent le plus grand nombre de ligues ?","sql":"WITH nombre_par_pays AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(l.id) AS nombre_de_ligues
    FROM Country AS c
    LEFT JOIN League AS l ON l.country_id = c.id
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
SELECT name AS pays, nombre_de_ligues
FROM nombre_par_pays
WHERE nombre_de_ligues = (SELECT MAX(nombre_de_ligues) FROM nombre_par_pays);"},{"question":"Quels joueurs avaient une note globale supérieure ou égale à 80 dans leur évaluation la plus récente ?","sql":"SELECT p.player_name, pa.overall_rating, pa.potential, pa.date
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.date = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.date)
    FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
    WHERE pa2.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
)
AND pa.overall_rating >= 80
ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC, p.player_name;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs sont à la fois plus lourds et plus grands que les moyennes de tous les joueurs ?","sql":"SELECT player_name, height, weight
FROM Player
WHERE height > (SELECT AVG(height) FROM Player WHERE height IS NOT NULL)
  AND weight > (SELECT AVG(weight) FROM Player WHERE weight IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY weight DESC, height DESC, player_name;"},{"question":"Quelle est la note globale moyenne selon le pied préféré, en ne gardant que les pieds représentés par au moins 100 joueurs évalués ?","sql":"SELECT pa.preferred_foot, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_api_id) AS nombre_de_joueurs, ROUND(AVG(pa.overall_rating), 2) AS note_moyenne
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
WHERE pa.preferred_foot IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY pa.preferred_foot
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_api_id) >= 100
ORDER BY note_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque équipe, quelles sont la date de sa dernière évaluation et sa valeur de construction par la passe ?","sql":"SELECT t.team_long_name, ta.date, ta.buildUpPlayPassing
FROM Team AS t
JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE ta.date = (
    SELECT MAX(ta2.date)
    FROM Team_Attributes AS ta2
    WHERE ta2.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
)
ORDER BY t.team_long_name;"},{"question":"Quelles équipes ont, dans leur dernière évaluation, une valeur de construction par la passe supérieure à la moyenne des dernières évaluations de toutes les équipes ?","sql":"WITH dernieres_evaluations AS (
    SELECT ta.team_api_id, ta.buildUpPlayPassing
    FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
    WHERE ta.date = (
        SELECT MAX(ta2.date)
        FROM Team_Attributes AS ta2
        WHERE ta2.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
    )
)
SELECT t.team_long_name, d.buildUpPlayPassing
FROM dernieres_evaluations AS d
JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = d.team_api_id
WHERE d.buildUpPlayPassing > (SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) FROM dernieres_evaluations)
ORDER BY d.buildUpPlayPassing DESC, t.team_long_name;"},{"question":"Quelles ligues appartiennent à des pays dont le nom contient « England » ou « France » ?","sql":"SELECT l.name AS ligue, c.name AS pays
FROM League AS l
JOIN Country AS c ON c.id = l.country_id
WHERE c.name LIKE '%England%'
UNION
SELECT l.name AS ligue, c.name AS pays
FROM League AS l
JOIN Country AS c ON c.id = l.country_id
WHERE c.name LIKE '%France%'
ORDER BY pays, ligue;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont soit une note globale récente d'au moins 85, soit un potentiel récent d'au moins 90 ?","sql":"SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.date = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.date)
    FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
    WHERE pa2.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
)
AND pa.overall_rating >= 85
UNION
SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.date = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.date)
    FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
    WHERE pa2.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
)
AND pa.potential >= 90
ORDER BY player_name;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les événements avec leur type, les détails de leur adresse et les détails de leur canal ?","sql":"SELECT e.Event_ID, e.Event_Type_Code, a.address_details, c.Other_Details AS channel_details
FROM Events AS e
LEFT JOIN Addresses AS a ON a.Address_ID = e.Address_ID
JOIN Channels AS c ON c.Channel_ID = e.Channel_ID;"},{"question":"Combien d'événements existe-t-il pour chaque type d'événement ?","sql":"SELECT Event_Type_Code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_evenements
FROM Events
GROUP BY Event_Type_Code
ORDER BY nombre_evenements DESC, Event_Type_Code;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un prix supérieur au prix moyen de tous les produits ?","sql":"SELECT Product_ID, Product_Name, Product_Type_Code, Product_Price
FROM Products
WHERE Product_Price > (SELECT AVG(Product_Price) FROM Products)
ORDER BY Product_Price DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque partie, combien d'événements lui sont associés et quels rôles y exerce-t-elle ?","sql":"SELECT p.Party_ID, p.Party_Details, COUNT(DISTINCT pie.Event_ID) AS nombre_evenements, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pie.Role_Code) AS roles
FROM Parties AS p
JOIN Parties_in_Events AS pie ON pie.Party_ID = p.Party_ID
GROUP BY p.Party_ID, p.Party_Details
ORDER BY nombre_evenements DESC, p.Party_ID;"},{"question":"Quels actifs sont associés à au moins un événement, avec le nombre d'événements correspondants ?","sql":"SELECT a.Asset_ID, a.Other_Details, COUNT(DISTINCT aie.Event_ID) AS nombre_evenements
FROM Assets AS a
JOIN Assets_in_Events AS aie ON aie.Asset_ID = a.Asset_ID
GROUP BY a.Asset_ID, a.Other_Details
ORDER BY nombre_evenements DESC, a.Asset_ID;"},{"question":"Quels accords sont liés à un événement et à quels détails financiers cet événement correspond-il ?","sql":"SELECT ag.Document_ID, ag.Event_ID, f.Finance_ID, f.Other_Details AS finance_details
FROM Agreements AS ag
JOIN Events AS e ON e.Event_ID = ag.Event_ID
JOIN Finances AS f ON f.Finance_ID = e.Finance_ID
ORDER BY ag.Document_ID;"},{"question":"Quels événements ne possèdent aucun produit associé ?","sql":"SELECT e.Event_ID, e.Event_Type_Code
FROM Events AS e
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Products_in_Events AS pie
    WHERE pie.Event_ID = e.Event_ID
)
ORDER BY e.Event_ID;"},{"question":"Quelles parties sont associées à des événements ayant le rôle « assureur » ou le rôle « courtier » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.Party_ID, p.Party_Details
FROM Parties AS p
JOIN Parties_in_Events AS pie ON pie.Party_ID = p.Party_ID
WHERE pie.Role_Code = 'assureur'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT p.Party_ID, p.Party_Details
FROM Parties AS p
JOIN Parties_in_Events AS pie ON pie.Party_ID = p.Party_ID
WHERE pie.Role_Code = 'courtier'
ORDER BY Party_ID;"},{"question":"Quelles adresses sont utilisées par plusieurs événements, et combien d'événements utilisent chacune d'elles ?","sql":"SELECT a.Address_ID, a.address_details, COUNT(e.Event_ID) AS nombre_evenements
FROM Addresses AS a
JOIN Events AS e ON e.Address_ID = a.Address_ID
GROUP BY a.Address_ID, a.address_details
HAVING COUNT(e.Event_ID) > 1
ORDER BY nombre_evenements DESC, a.Address_ID;"}]}

\"Competition_type\";"},{"question":"Quels clubs ont remporté davantage de médailles d'or que de médailles d'argent ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"name\", cr.\"Gold\", cr.\"Silver\" FROM \"club_rank\" cr JOIN \"club\" c ON c.\"Club_ID\" = cr.\"Club_ID\" WHERE cr.\"Gold\" > cr.\"Silver\" ORDER BY cr.\"Gold\" DESC;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Combien de trains desservent chaque station, y compris les stations sans train ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.network_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.train_id) AS nombre_de_trains
FROM station AS s
LEFT JOIN route AS r ON r.station_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.network_name
ORDER BY nombre_de_trains DESC, s.id;"},{"question":"Quels trains desservent au moins deux stations, et combien de stations desservent-ils ?","sql":"SELECT t.id, t.train_number, t.name, COUNT(r.station_id) AS nombre_de_stations
FROM train AS t
JOIN route AS r ON r.train_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.id, t.train_number, t.name
HAVING COUNT(r.station_id) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_de_stations DESC, t.train_number;"},{"question":"Quelle est la température maximale prévue et la précipitation moyenne pour chaque station disposant de données météorologiques ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.network_name, MAX(w.high_temperature) AS temperature_maximale, AVG(w.precipitation) AS precipitation_moyenne
FROM station AS s
JOIN weekly_weather AS w ON w.station_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.network_name
ORDER BY temperature_maximale DESC, s.id;"},{"question":"Quelles stations ont une température maximale moyenne supérieure à la moyenne de toutes les températures maximales ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.network_name, AVG(w.high_temperature) AS temperature_maximale_moyenne
FROM station AS s
JOIN weekly_weather AS w ON w.station_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.network_name
HAVING AVG(w.high_temperature) > (SELECT AVG(high_temperature) FROM weekly_weather)
ORDER BY temperature_maximale_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quels trains desservent au moins une station où les précipitations d'un jour dépassent la moyenne de toutes les observations ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT t.id, t.train_number, t.name
FROM train AS t
JOIN route AS r ON r.train_id = t.id
JOIN weekly_weather AS w ON w.station_id = r.station_id
WHERE w.precipitation > (SELECT AVG(precipitation) FROM weekly_weather)
ORDER BY t.train_number, t.id;"},{"question":"Quelles stations sont desservies par un train mais ne possèdent aucune donnée météorologique hebdomadaire ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.network_name
FROM station AS s
JOIN route AS r ON r.station_id = s.id
EXCEPT
SELECT s.id, s.network_name
FROM station AS s
JOIN weekly_weather AS w ON w.station_id = s.id
ORDER BY id;"},{"question":"Pour chaque station, quel jour présente la vitesse du vent maximale, avec la valeur correspondante ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.network_name, w.day_of_week, w.wind_speed_mph
FROM station AS s
JOIN weekly_weather AS w ON w.station_id = s.id
WHERE w.wind_speed_mph = (
    SELECT MAX(w2.wind_speed_mph)
    FROM weekly_weather AS w2
    WHERE w2.station_id = w.station_id
)
ORDER BY s.id, w.day_of_week;"}]}

?","sql":"SELECT p.name, COUNT(pt.track_id) AS nombre_morceaux FROM playlists p JOIN playlist_tracks pt ON pt.playlist_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY nombre_morceaux DESC LIMIT customers GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(nombre_clients) FROM (SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS nombre_clients FROM customers GROUP BY country) AS statistiques) ORDER BY nombre_clients vendus par le magasin appelé « Central » ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"product_id\", p.\"product\" FROM \"product\" AS p JOIN \"store_product\" AS sp ON sp.\"Product_ID\" = p.\"product_id\" JOIN \"store\" AS s ON s.\"Store_ID\" = sp.\"Store_ID\" WHERE s.\"Store_Name\" = 'Central' ORDER BY p.\"product\";"},{"question":"Quels magasins ne proposent encore aucun produit ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Store_ID\", s.\"Store_Name\" FROM \"store\" AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"store_product\" AS sp WHERE sp.\"Store_ID\" = s.\"Store_ID\") ORDER BY s.\"Store_Name\";"},{"question":"Quels produits sont disponibles dans au moins deux magasins ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"product_id\", p.\"product\", COUNT(sp.\"Store_ID\") AS \"store_count\" FROM \"product\" AS p JOIN \"store_product\" AS sp ON sp.\"Product_ID\" = p.\"product_id\" GROUP BY p.\"product_id\", p.\"product\" HAVING COUNT(sp.\"Store_ID\") >= 2 ORDER BY \"store_count\" DESC, p.\"product\";"},{"question":"Quels produits ont la vitesse d'impression couleur maximale ?","sql":"SELECT \"product_id\", \"product\", \"pages_per_minute_color\" FROM \"product\" WHERE \"pages_per_minute_color\" = (SELECT MAX(\"pages_per_minute_color\") FROM \"product\");"},{"question":"Quelle est la résolution moyenne des produits pour chaque interface ?","sql":"SELECT \"interface\", AVG(\"dpi\") AS \"average_dpi\" FROM \"product\" GROUP BY \"interface\" ORDER BY \"average_dpi\" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de magasins chaque district contient-il ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"District_ID\", d.\"District_name\", COUNT(sd.\"Store_ID\") AS \"store_count\" FROM \"district\" AS d LEFT JOIN \"store_district\" AS sd ON sd.\"District_ID\" = d.\"District_ID\" GROUP BY d.\"District_ID\", d.\"District_name\" ORDER BY \"store_count\" DESC, d.\"District_name\";"},{"question":"Combien de magasins y a-t-il pour chaque type ?","sql":"SELECT \"Type\", COUNT(*) AS \"store_count\" FROM \"store\" GROUP BY \"Type\" ORDER BY \"store_count\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels produits sont vendus dans des districts dont la population dépasse 100000 habitants ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.\"product_id\", p.\"product\" FROM \"product\" AS p JOIN \"store_product\" AS sp ON sp.\"Product_ID\" = p.\"product_id\" JOIN \"store_district\" AS sd ON sd.\"Store_ID\" = sp.\"Store_ID\" JOIN \"district\" AS d ON d.\"District_ID\" = sd.\"District_ID\" WHERE d.\"City_Population\" > 100000 ORDER BY p.\"product\";"},{"question":"Quels magasins ont une superficie supérieure à la superficie moyenne de tous les magasins ?","sql":"SELECT \"Store_ID\", \"Store_Name\", \"Area_size\" FROM \"store\" WHERE \"Area_size\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Area_size\") FROM \"store\") ORDER BY \"Area_size\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels produits ne sont proposés par aucun magasin ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"product_id\", p.\"product\" FROM \"product\" AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"store_product\" AS sp WHERE sp.\"Product_ID\" = p.\"product_id\") ORDER BY p.\"product\";"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois magasins les mieux classés ?","sql":"SELECT \"Store_ID\", \"Store_Name\", \"Ranking\" FROM \"store\" ORDER BY \"Ranking\" ASC LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quel district a la plus grande superficie urbaine ?","sql":"SELECT \"District_ID\", \"District_name\", \"City_Area\" FROM \"district\" WHERE \"City_Area\" = (SELECT MAX(\"City_Area\") FROM \"district\");"},{"question":"Quels magasins ont plus de catégories de produits que la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT \"Store_ID\", \"Store_Name\", \"Number_of_product_category\" FROM \"store\" WHERE \"Number_of_product_category\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Number_of_product_category\") FROM \"store\") ORDER BY \"Number_of_product_category\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels produits utilisent la même interface que le produit nommé « Alpha » ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"product_id\", p.\"product\", p.\"interface\" FROM \"product\" AS p WHERE p.\"interface\" IN (SELECT \"interface\" FROM \"product\" WHERE \"product\" = 'Alpha') AND p.\"product\" <> 'Alpha' ORDER BY p.\"product\";"},{"question":"Combien de produits correspondent à chaque format maximal de page ?","sql":"SELECT \"max_page_size\", COUNT(*) AS \"product_count\" FROM \"product\" GROUP BY \"max_page_size\" ORDER BY \"product_count\" DESC, \"max_page_size\";"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de magasins sont situés dans un district ou proposent le produit numéro 1 ?","sql":"SELECT \"Store_ID\" FROM \"store_district\" WHERE \"District_ID\" IN (SELECT \"District_ID\" FROM \"district\" WHERE \"City_Population\" > 100000) UNION SELECT \"Store_ID\" FROM \"store_product\" WHERE \"Product_ID\" = 1 ORDER BY \"Store_ID\";"},{"question":"Quels produits sont vendus dans le district nommé « Nord » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.\"product_id\", p.\"product\" FROM \"product\" AS p JOIN \"store_product\" AS sp ON sp.\"Product_ID\" = p.\"product_id\" JOIN \"store_district\" AS sd ON sd.\"Store_ID\" = sp.\"Store_ID\" JOIN \"district\" AS d ON d.\"District_ID\" = sd.\"District_ID\" WHERE d.\"District_name\" = 'Nord' ORDER BY p.\"product\";"},{"question":"Quels districts ne possèdent aucun magasin ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"District_ID\", d.\"District_name\" FROM \"district\" AS d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"store_district\" AS sd WHERE sd.\"District_ID\" = d.\"District_ID\") ORDER BY d.\"District_name\";"},{"question":"Quels couples de magasins partagent le même district ?","sql":"SELECT s1.\"Store_Name\" AS \"store_1\", s2.\"Store_Name\" AS \"store_2\", d.\"District_name\" FROM \"store_district\" AS sd1 JOIN \"store_district\" AS sd2 ON sd1.\"District_ID\" = sd2.\"District_ID\" AND sd1.\"Store_ID\" < sd2.\"Store_ID\" JOIN \"store\" AS s1 ON s1.\"Store_ID\" = sd1.\"Store_ID\" JOIN \"store\" AS s2 ON s2.\"Store_ID\" = sd2.\"Store_ID\" JOIN \"district\" AS d ON d.\"District_ID\" = sd1.\"District_ID\" ORDER BY d.\"District_name\", s1.\"Store_Name\", s2.\"Store_Name\";"},{"question":"Quel produit est disponible dans le plus grand nombre de magasins ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"product_id\", p.\"product\", COUNT(sp.\"Store_ID\") AS \"store_count\" FROM \"product\" AS p JOIN \"store_product\" AS sp ON sp.\"Product_ID\" = p.\"product_id\" GROUP BY p.\"product_id\", p.\"product\" HAVING COUNT(sp.\"Store_ID\") = (SELECT MAX(\"store_count\") FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS \"store_count\" FROM \"store_product\" GROUP BY \"Product_ID\")) ORDER BY p.\"product\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la superficie moyenne des magasins pour chaque type ?","sql":"SELECT \"Type\", AVG(\"Area_size\") AS \"average_area\" FROM \"store\" GROUP BY \"Type\" ORDER BY \"average_area\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont une résolution supérieure à la résolution moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT \"product_id\", \"product\", \"dpi\" FROM \"product\" WHERE \"dpi\" > (SELECT AVG(\"dpi\") FROM \"product\") ORDER BY \"dpi\" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque district, quel est le ratio entre la superficie urbaine et la population ?","sql":"SELECT \"District_name\", \"City_Area\" / NULLIF(\"City_Population\", 0) AS \"area_per_person\" FROM \"district\" ORDER BY \"area_per_person\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels magasins proposent tous les produits présents dans le catalogue ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Store_ID\", s.\"Store_Name\" FROM \"store\" AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"product\" AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"store_product\" AS sp WHERE sp.\"Store_ID\" = s.\"Store_ID\" AND sp.\"Product_ID\" = p.\"product_id\")) ORDER BY s.\"Store_Name\";"},{"question":"Combien de produits différents chaque district propose-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT d.\"District_ID\", d.\"District_name\", COUNT(DISTINCT sp.\"Product_ID\") AS \"product_count\" FROM \"district\" AS d LEFT JOIN \"store_district\" AS sd ON sd.\"District_ID\" = d.\"District_ID\" LEFT JOIN \"store_product\" AS sp ON sp.\"Store_ID\" = sd.\"Store_ID\" GROUP BY d.\"District_ID\", d.\"District_name\" ORDER BY \"product_count\" DESC, d.\"District_name\";"},{"question":"Quels magasins ont le meilleur classement dans leur type respectif ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Store_ID\", s.\"Store_Name\", s.\"Type\", s.\"Ranking\" FROM \"store\" AS s WHERE s.\"Ranking\" = (SELECT MIN(s2.\"Ranking\") FROM \"store\" AS s2 WHERE s2.\"Type\" = s.\"Type\") ORDER BY s.\"Type\", s.\"Ranking\";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms, dates d’activité et vitesses maximales de toutes les tempêtes ?","sql":"SELECT \"Name\", \"Dates_active\", \"Max_speed\" FROM storm ORDER BY \"Name\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la tempête ayant enregistré la vitesse maximale la plus élevée ?","sql":"SELECT \"Storm_ID\", \"Name\", \"Max_speed\" FROM storm WHERE \"Max_speed\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Max_speed\") FROM storm);"},{"question":"Quel est le montant moyen des dégâts en millions de dollars ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(\"Damage_millions_USD\") AS average_damage_millions_usd FROM storm;"},{"question":"Combien de décès ont été enregistrés au total pour toutes les tempêtes ?","sql":"SELECT SUM(\"Number_Deaths\") AS total_deaths FROM storm;"},{"question":"Quelles régions ont été touchées par au moins une tempête ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT r.\"Region_id\", r.\"Region_code\", r.\"Region_name\" FROM region AS r JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.\"Region_id\" = r.\"Region_id\" ORDER BY r.\"Region_name\";"},{"question":"Combien de régions chaque tempête a-t-elle affectées ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Storm_ID\", s.\"Name\", COUNT(ar.\"Region_id\") AS affected_region_count FROM storm villes affectées par chaque tempête ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Storm_ID\", s.\"Name\", COALESCE(SUM(ar.\"Number_city_affected\"), 0) AS total_cities_affected FROM storm AS s LEFT JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.\"Storm_ID\" = s.\"Storm_ID\" GROUP BY s.\"Storm_ID\", s.\"Name\" ORDER BY total_cities_affected DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles tempêtes ont causé des dégâts supérieurs à la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT \"Storm_ID\", \"Name\", \"Damage_millions_USD\" FROM storm WHERE \"Damage_millions_USD\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Damage_millions_USD\") FROM storm) ORDER BY \"Damage_millions_USD\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la valeur maximale du nombre de décès enregistrés pour une tempête ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(\"Number_Deaths\") AS maximum_deaths FROM storm;"},{"question":"Quelles régions n’ont jamais été affectées par une tempête ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"Region_id\", r.\"Region_code\", r.\"Region_name\" FROM region AS r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM affected_region AS ar WHERE ar.\"Region_id\" = r.\"Region_id\") ORDER BY r.\"Region_name\";"},{"question":"Quelles tempêtes n’ont affecté aucune région ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Storm_ID\", s.\"Name\" FROM storm AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM affected_region AS ar WHERE ar.\"Storm_ID\" = s.\"Storm_ID\") ORDER BY s.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Pour chaque association, quelles sont la région et la tempête concernées ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"Region_name\", s.\"Name\" AS storm_name, ar.\"Number_city_affected\" FROM affected_region AS ar JOIN region AS r ON r.\"Region_id\" = ar.\"Region_id\" JOIN storm AS s ON s.\"Storm_ID\" = ar.\"Storm_ID\" ORDER BY r.\"Region_name\", s.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Quelle région présente le plus grand nombre total de villes affectées ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"Region_id\", r.\"Region_name\", SUM(ar.\"Number_city_affected\") AS total_cities_affected FROM region AS r JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.\"Region_id\" = r.\"Region_id\" GROUP BY r.\"Region_id\", r.\"Region_name\" ORDER BY total_cities_affected DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les tempêtes classées par nombre de décès décroissant ?","sql":"SELECT \"Storm_ID\", \"Name\", \"Number_Deaths\" FROM storm ORDER BY \"Number_Deaths\" DESC, \"Name\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la vitesse maximale moyenne des tempêtes ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(\"Max_speed\") AS average_max_speed FROM storm;"},{"question":"Combien de tempêtes appartiennent à chaque catégorie de dégâts : faibles, moyens ou élevés ?","sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN \"Damage_millions_USD\" < 100 THEN 'faibles' WHEN \"Damage_millions_USD\" < 500 THEN 'moyens' ELSE 'élevés' END AS damage_category, COUNT(*) AS storm_count FROM storm GROUP BY damage_category ORDER BY damage_category;"},{"question":"Quelles tempêtes ont causé plus de décès que la moyenne de toutes les tempêtes ?","sql":"SELECT \"Storm_ID\", \"Name\", \"Number_Deaths\" FROM storm WHERE \"Number_Deaths\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Number_Deaths\") FROM storm) ORDER BY \"Number_Deaths\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles régions ont été touchées par plus d’une tempête distincte ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"Region_id\", r.\"Region_name\", COUNT(DISTINCT ar.\"Storm_ID\") AS storm_count FROM region AS r JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.\"Region_id\" = r.\"Region_id\" GROUP BY r.\"Region_id\", r.\"Region_name\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ar.\"Storm_ID\") > 1 ORDER BY storm_count DESC, r.\"Region_name\";"},{"question":"Pour chaque tempête, quelles régions et combien de villes y ont été affectées ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Name\" AS storm_name, r.\"Region_name\", ar.\"Number_city_affected\" FROM storm AS s JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.\"Storm_ID\" = s.\"Storm_ID\" JOIN region AS r ON r.\"Region_id\" = ar.\"Region_id\" ORDER BY s.\"Name\", r.\"Region_name\";"},{"question":"Quels noms apparaissent soit comme nom de tempête, soit comme nom de région ?","sql":"SELECT \"Name\" AS name FROM storm UNION SELECT \"Region_name\" AS name FROM region ORDER BY name;"},{"question":"Quelles tempêtes ont subi le montant de dégâts maximal ?","sql":"SELECT \"Storm_ID\", \"Name\", \"Damage_millions_USD\" FROM storm WHERE \"Damage_millions_USD\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Damage_millions_USD\") FROM storm);"},{"question":"Quelles tempêtes n’ont causé aucun décès ?","sql":"SELECT \"Storm_ID\", \"Name\", \"Number_Deaths\" FROM storm WHERE \"Number_Deaths\" = 0 ORDER BY \"Name\";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de villes affectées par association région-tempête ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(\"Number_city_affected\") AS average_cities_affected FROM affected_region;"},{"question":"Quelle association région-tempête concerne le plus grand nombre de villes ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"Region_name\", s.\"Name\" AS storm_name, ar.\"Number_city_affected\" FROM affected_region AS ar JOIN region AS r ON r.\"Region_id\" = ar.\"Region_id\" JOIN storm AS s ON s.\"Storm_ID\" = ar.\"Storm_ID\" WHERE ar.\"Number_city_affected\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Number_city_affected\") FROM affected_region);"},{"question":"Pour chaque région, combien de villes ont été affectées au total et par combien de tempêtes ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"Region_id\", r.\"Region_name\", SUM(ar.\"Number_city_affected\") AS total_cities_affected, COUNT(DISTINCT ar.\"Storm_ID\") AS storm_count FROM region AS r JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.\"Region_id\" = r.\"Region_id\" GROUP BY r.\"Region_id\", r.\"Region_name\" ORDER BY total_cities_affected DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles associations ont un nombre de villes affectées supérieur à la moyenne de toutes les associations ?","sql":"SELECT ar.\"Region_id\", ar.\"Storm_ID\", ar.\"Number_city_affected\" FROM affected_region AS ar WHERE ar.\"Number_city_affected\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Number_city_affected\") FROM affected_region) ORDER BY ar.\"Number_city_affected\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des dégâts et le nombre total de décès pour l’ensemble des tempêtes ?","sql":"SELECT SUM(\"Damage_millions_USD\") AS total_damage_millions_usd, SUM(\"Number_Deaths\") AS total_deaths FROM storm;"},{"question":"Quelles tempêtes ont une vitesse maximale supérieure à celle de toutes les autres tempêtes ?","sql":"SELECT \"Storm_ID\", \"Name\", \"Max_speed\" FROM storm WHERE \"Max_speed\" > ALL (SELECT \"Max_speed\" FROM storm AS other_storm WHERE other_storm.\"Storm_ID\" <> storm.\"Storm_ID\");"},{"question":"Quels codes de région sont associés à au moins une tempête ayant causé des décès ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT r.\"Region_code\" FROM region AS r JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.\"Region_id\" = r.\"Region_id\" JOIN storm AS s ON s.\"Storm_ID\" = ar.\"Storm_ID\" WHERE s.\"Number_Deaths\" > 0 ORDER BY r.\"Region_code\";"},{"question":"Combien de tempêtes sont associées à chaque région, y compris celles sans association ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"Region_id\", r.\"Region_name\", COUNT(DISTINCT ar.\"Storm_ID\") AS storm_count FROM region AS r LEFT JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.\"Region_id\" = r.\"Region_id\" GROUP BY r.\"Region_id\", r.\"Region_name\" ORDER BY storm_count DESC, r.\"Region_name\";"},{"question":"Quel est le ratio de dégâts en millions de dollars par décès pour chaque tempête ?","sql":"SELECT \"Storm_ID\", \"Name\", CASE WHEN \"Number_Deaths\" = 0 THEN NULL ELSE \"Damage_millions_USD\" * 1.0 / \"Number_Deaths\" END AS damage_per_death FROM storm ORDER BY damage_per_death DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles régions ont une moyenne de villes affectées supérieure à la moyenne globale des associations ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"Region_id\", r.\"Region_name\", AVG(ar.\"Number_city_affected\") AS average_cities_affected FROM region AS r JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.\"Region_id\" = r.\"Region_id\" GROUP BY r.\"Region_id\", r.\"Region_name\" HAVING AVG(ar.\"Number_city_affected\") > (SELECT AVG(\"Number_city_affected\") FROM affected_region) ORDER BY average_cities_affected DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles tempêtes ont affecté exactement une seule région ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Storm_ID\", s.\"Name\" FROM storm AS s JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.\"Storm_ID\" = s.\"Storm_ID\" GROUP BY s.\"Storm_ID\", s.\"Name\" HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 ORDER BY s.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Quelles tempêtes ont affecté au moins une région où plus de 100 villes ont été touchées ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.\"Storm_ID\", s.\"Name\" FROM storm AS s JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.\"Storm_ID\" = s.\"Storm_ID\" WHERE ar.\"Number_city_affected\" > 100 ORDER BY s.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Quelles tempêtes ont affecté toutes les régions connues ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Storm_ID\", s.\"Name\" FROM storm AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM region AS r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM affected_region AS ar WHERE ar.\"Storm_ID\" = s.\"Storm_ID\" AND ar.\"Region_id\" = r.\"Region_id\")) ORDER BY s.\"Name\";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Combien d'élèves sont inscrits dans chaque classe ?","sql":"SELECT "Classroom", COUNT(*) AS nombre_eleves
FROM "list"
GROUP BY "Classroom"
ORDER BY "Classroom";"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne des notes par classe ?","sql":"SELECT "Classroom", AVG("Grade") AS moyenne_note
FROM "list"
GROUP BY "Classroom"
ORDER BY "Classroom";"},{"question":"Quel élève a obtenu la meilleure note ?","sql":"SELECT "LastName", "FirstName", "Grade", "Classroom"
FROM "list"
WHERE "Grade" = (SELECT MAX("Grade") FROM "list")
ORDER BY "LastName", "FirstName";"},{"question":"Quels enseignants travaillent dans une classe sans aucun élève ?","sql":"SELECT t."LastName", t."FirstName", t."Classroom"
FROM "teachers" AS t
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "list" AS l
    WHERE l."Classroom" = t."Classroom"
)
ORDER BY t."LastName", t."FirstName";"},{"question":"Quels élèves sont dans une classe où enseigne au moins un professeur ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT l."LastName", l."FirstName", l."Classroom"
FROM "list" AS l
JOIN "teachers" AS t ON t."Classroom" = l."Classroom"
ORDER BY l."LastName", l."FirstName";"},{"question":"Quelles classes ont une moyenne supérieure à la moyenne générale ?","sql":"SELECT "Classroom", AVG("Grade") AS moyenne_note
FROM "list"
GROUP BY "Classroom"
HAVING AVG("Grade") > (SELECT AVG("Grade") FROM "list")
ORDER BY moyenne_note DESC;"},{"question":"Quels élèves ont une note supérieure à la moyenne de leur classe ?","sql":"SELECT l."LastName", l."FirstName", l."Grade", l."Classroom"
FROM "list" AS l
WHERE l."Grade" > (
    SELECT AVG(l2."Grade")
    FROM "list" AS l2
    WHERE l2."Classroom" = l."Classroom"
)
ORDER BY l."Classroom", l."Grade" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles classes figurent dans la liste des élèves mais ne sont associées à aucun enseignant ?","sql":"SELECT "Classroom" FROM "list"
EXCEPT
SELECT "Classroom" FROM "teachers"
ORDER BY "Classroom";"},{"question":"Combien d'élèves chaque enseignant a-t-il dans sa classe ?","sql":"SELECT t."LastName", t."FirstName", t."Classroom", COUNT(l."FirstName") AS nombre_eleves
FROM "teachers" AS t
LEFT JOIN "list" AS l ON l."Classroom" = t."Classroom"
GROUP BY t."LastName", t."FirstName", t."Classroom"
ORDER BY t."LastName", t."FirstName";"},{"question":"Quelles sont les notes minimale et maximale de chaque classe ?","sql":"SELECT "Classroom", MIN("Grade") AS note_minimale, MAX("Grade") AS note_maximale
FROM "list"
GROUP BY "Classroom"
ORDER BY "Classroom";"},{"question":"Quels élèves ont obtenu la note maximale de leur classe ?","sql":"SELECT l."LastName", l."FirstName", l."Grade", l."Classroom"
FROM "list" AS l
WHERE l."Grade" = (
    SELECT MAX(l2."Grade")
    FROM "list" AS l2
    WHERE l2."Classroom" = l."Classroom"
)
ORDER BY l."Classroom", l."LastName", l."FirstName";"},{"question":"Quelles classes comptent au moins trois élèves et quelle est leur moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT "Classroom", COUNT(*) AS nombre_eleves, AVG("Grade") AS moyenne_note
FROM "list"
GROUP BY "Classroom"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY nombre_eleves DESC, "Classroom";"},{"question":"Quels enseignants partagent exactement leur nom et prénom avec un élève ?","sql":"SELECT t."LastName", t."FirstName", t."Classroom"
FROM "teachers" AS t
JOIN "list" AS l
  ON l."LastName" = t."LastName"
 AND l."FirstName" = t."FirstName"
ORDER BY t."LastName", t."FirstName";"},{"question":"Quelles classes ont à la fois des élèves et des enseignants ?","sql":"SELECT "Classroom" FROM "list"
INTERSECT
SELECT "Classroom" FROM "teachers"
ORDER BY "Classroom";"},{"question":"Quels élèves ont une note comprise entre la moyenne générale et la note maximale, bornes incluses ?","sql":"SELECT "LastName", "FirstName", "Grade", "Classroom"
FROM "list"
WHERE "Grade" BETWEEN (SELECT AVG("Grade") FROM "list")
                  AND (SELECT MAX("Grade") FROM "list")
ORDER BY "Grade" DESC, "LastName", "FirstName";"},{"question":"Pour chaque classe, combien d'enseignants et d'élèves sont recensés ?","sql":"SELECT c."Classroom",
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "teachers" AS t WHERE t."Classroom" = c."Classroom") AS nombre_enseignants,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "list" AS l WHERE l."Classroom" = c."Classroom") AS nombre_eleves
FROM (
    SELECT "Classroom" FROM "list"
    UNION
    SELECT "Classroom" FROM "teachers"
) AS c
ORDER BY c."Classroom";"},{"question":"Quels élèves ont une note strictement supérieure à toutes les notes de la classe 1 ?","sql":"SELECT "LastName", "FirstName", "Grade", "Classroom"
FROM "list"
WHERE "Grade" > ALL (SELECT "Grade" FROM "list" WHERE "Classroom" = 1)
ORDER BY "Grade" DESC, "LastName", "FirstName";"},{"question":"Quelles classes sont uniquement représentées chez les enseignants et pas chez les élèves ?","sql":"SELECT "Classroom" FROM "teachers"
EXCEPT
SELECT "Classroom" FROM "list"
ORDER BY "Classroom";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total d'élèves et quelle est leur note moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_total_eleves, AVG("Grade") AS moyenne_generale
FROM "list";"},{"question":"Dans quelle classe y a-t-il le plus grand nombre d'élèves ?","sql":"SELECT "Classroom", COUNT(*) AS nombre_eleves
FROM "list"
GROUP BY "Classroom"
ORDER BY nombre_eleves DESC, "Classroom"
LIMIT 1;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les prénoms, noms et adresses e-mail de toutes les personnes ?","sql":"SELECT first_name, last_name, email_address FROM People;"},{"question":"Quels sont les candidats avec leur prénom, leur nom et leurs détails ?","sql":"SELECT c.candidate_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, c.candidate_details FROM Candidates AS c JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id = ?","sql":"SELECT ca.candidate_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, ca.qualification, ca.assessment_date, ca.asessment_outcome_code FROM Candidate_Assessments AS ca JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id =
