ca.asessment_outcome_code FROM Candidate_Assessments AS ca WHERE ca.assessment_date = (SELECT MAX(ca2.assessment_date) FROM Candidate_Assessments AS ca2 WHERE ca2.candidate_id = ca.candidate_id);"},{"question":"Combien d’évaluations correspondent à chaque qualification ?","sql":"SELECT qualification, COUNT(*) AS nombre_evaluations FROM Candidate_Assessments GROUP BY qualification ORDER BY nombre_evaluations DESC, qualification;"},{"question":"Quelles évaluations ont eu lieu depuis le 1er janvier 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT candidate_id, qualification, assessment_date, asessment_outcome_code FROM Candidate_Assessments WHERE assessment_date >= '2023-01-01' ORDER BY assessment_date;"},{"question":"Quels cours sont proposés, avec leur nom et leur description ?","sql":"SELECT course_id, course_name, course_description FROM Courses ORDER BY course_name;"},{"question":"Quelles inscriptions associent des étudiants à des cours ?","sql":"SELECT scr.student_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, scr.course_id, c.course_name, scr.registration_date FROM Student_Course_Registrations AS scr JOIN Students AS s ON s.student_id = scr.student_id JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id = s.student_id JOIN Courses AS c ON c.course_id = scr.course_id ORDER BY scr.registration_date;"},{"question":"Quelles présences aux cours ont été enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT sca.student_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, sca.course_id, c.course_name, sca.date_of_attendance FROM Student_Course_Attendance AS sca JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id = sca.student_id JOIN Courses AS c ON c.course_id = sca.course_id ORDER BY sca.date_of_attendance;"},{"question":"Quelles présences ont été enregistrées depuis le 1er septembre 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT student_id, course_id, date_of_attendance FROM Student_Course_Attendance WHERE date_of_attendance >= '2023-09-01' ORDER BY date_of_attendance;"},{"question":"Combien de cours chaque étudiant suit-il ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(scr.course_id) AS nombre_cours FROM Students AS s JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Registrations AS scr ON scr.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, p.first_name, p.last_name ORDER BY nombre_cours DESC;"},{"question":"Combien d’étudiants sont inscrits à chaque cours ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(scr.student_id) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Courses AS c LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Registrations AS scr ON scr.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY nombre_etudiants DESC, c.course_name;"},{"question":"Quels cours ne comptent encore aucune inscription ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name FROM Courses AS c LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Registrations AS scr ON scr.course_id = c.course_id WHERE scr.student_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont inscrits à un cours mais n’ont aucune présence enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, p.first_name, p.last_name FROM Students AS s JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id = s.student_id JOIN Student_Course_Registrations AS scr ON scr.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Attendance AS sca ON sca.student_id = scr.student_id AND sca.course_id = scr.course_id WHERE sca.student_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels candidats ont obtenu le résultat « réussi » ?","sql":"SELECT ca.candidate_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, ca.qualification, ca.assessment_date FROM Candidate_Assessments AS ca JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id = ca.candidate_id WHERE LOWER(ca.asessment_outcome_code) = 'réussi';"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont une adresse e-mail renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT person_id, first_name, last_name, email_address FROM People WHERE email_address IS NOT NULL AND email_address <> '' ORDER BY last_name, first_name;"},{"question":"Quels pays apparaissent dans les adresses, sans doublon ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT country FROM Addresses WHERE country IS NOT NULL ORDER BY country;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes possèdent plusieurs associations d’adresses ?","sql":"SELECT p.person_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(pa.person_address_id) AS nombre_adresses FROM People AS p JOIN People_Addresses AS pa ON pa.person_id = p.person_id GROUP BY p.person_id, p.first_name, p.last_name HAVING COUNT(pa.person_address_id) > 1;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les inscriptions effectuées en 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT student_id, course_id, registration_date FROM Student_Course_Registrations WHERE registration_date >= '2024-01-01' AND registration_date < '2025-01-01' ORDER BY registration_date;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont des inscriptions mais aucune présence ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name FROM Courses AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Student_Course_Registrations AS scr WHERE scr.course_id = c.course_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Student_Course_Attendance AS sca WHERE sca.course_id = c.course_id);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont inscrits à tous les cours disponibles ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, p.first_name, p.last_name FROM Students AS s JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id = s.student_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Courses AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Student_Course_Registrations AS scr WHERE scr.student_id = s.student_id AND scr.course_id = c.course_id));"},{"question":"Quels candidats ont au moins une évaluation dont le résultat est renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.candidate_id, p.first_name, p.last_name FROM Candidates AS c JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id = c.candidate_id JOIN Candidate_Assessments AS ca ON ca.candidate_id = c.candidate_id WHERE ca.asessment_outcome_code IS NOT NULL AND ca.asessment_outcome_code <> '';"},{"question":"Pour quelles inscriptions la date de présence est-elle postérieure à la date d’inscription ?","sql":"SELECT scr.student_id, scr.course_id, scr.registration_date, sca.date_of_attendance FROM Student_Course_Registrations AS scr JOIN Student_Course_Attendance AS sca ON sca.student_id = scr.student_id AND sca.course_id = scr.course_id WHERE sca.date_of_attendance > scr.registration_date;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes sont à la fois candidates et étudiantes ?","sql":"SELECT p.person_id, p.first_name, p.last_name FROM People AS p JOIN Candidates AS c ON c.candidate_id = p.person_id JOIN Students AS s ON s.student_id = p.person_id ORDER BY p.last_name, p.first_name;"},{"question":"Combien d’inscriptions ont été faites chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', registration_date) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_inscriptions FROM Student_Course_Registrations GROUP BY strftime('%Y', registration_date) ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre d’évaluations pour chaque résultat ?","sql":"SELECT asessment_outcome_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_evaluations FROM Candidate_Assessments GROUP BY asessment_outcome_code ORDER BY nombre_evaluations DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont une adresse actuellement active dans chaque ville ?","sql":"SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.person_id) AS nombre_de_personnes FROM People_Addresses AS pa JOIN Addresses AS a ON a.address_id = pa.address_id WHERE pa.date_to IS NULL GROUP BY a.city ORDER BY nombre_de_personnes DESC, a.city;"},{"question":"Quels cours contiennent le mot « informatique » dans leur nom ou leur description ?","sql":"SELECT course_id, course_name, course_description FROM Courses WHERE course_name LIKE '%informatique%' OR course_description LIKE '%informatique%';"},{"question":"Quels étudiants résident dans une ville donnée par leur adresse associée ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, a.city FROM Students AS s JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id = s.student_id JOIN People_Addresses AS pa ON pa.person_id = s.student_id JOIN Addresses AS a ON a.address_id = pa.address_id WHERE a.city IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.city, p.last_name, p.first_name;"},{"question":"Quels candidats n’ont encore aucune évaluation ?","sql":"SELECT c.candidate_id, p.first_name, p.last_name FROM Candidates AS c JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id = c.candidate_id LEFT JOIN Candidate_Assessments AS ca ON ca.candidate_id = c.candidate_id WHERE ca.candidate_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien de personnes ont une adresse dans chaque pays ?","sql":"SELECT a.country, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.person_id) AS nombre_de_personnes FROM People_Addresses AS pa JOIN Addresses AS a ON a.address_id = pa.address_id GROUP BY a.country ORDER BY nombre_de_personnes DESC, a.country;"},{"question":"Quel est le cours ayant le plus grand nombre d’inscriptions ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(scr.student_id) AS nombre_inscriptions FROM Courses AS c LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Registrations AS scr ON scr.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY nombre_inscriptions DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont inscrits à au moins deux cours ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(scr.course_id) AS nombre_cours FROM Students AS s JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id = s.student_id JOIN Student_Course_Registrations AS scr ON scr.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, p.first_name, p.last_name HAVING COUNT(scr.course_id) >= 2 ORDER BY nombre_cours DESC;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants correspondent à au moins un candidat ou un étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT candidate_id AS person_id FROM Candidates UNION SELECT student_id AS person_id FROM Students ORDER BY person_id;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants correspondent à la fois à un candidat et à un étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT candidate_id AS person_id FROM Candidates INTERSECT SELECT student_id AS person_id FROM Students ORDER BY person_id;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ne sont ni candidates ni étudiantes ?","sql":"SELECT p.person_id, p.first_name, p.last_name FROM People AS p WHERE p.person_id NOT IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM Candidates) AND p.person_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM Students) ORDER BY p.last_name, p.first_name;"},{"question":"Quelle est la première évaluation enregistrée pour chaque candidat ?","sql":"SELECT ca.candidate_id, ca.qualification, ca.assessment_date, ca.asessment_outcome_code FROM Candidate_Assessments AS ca WHERE ca.assessment_date = (SELECT MIN(ca2.assessment_date) FROM Candidate_Assessments AS ca2 WHERE ca2.candidate_id = ca.candidate_id);"},{"question":"Quel est le taux de présence par cours, calculé sur les inscriptions ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sca.student_id) AS etudiants_presents, COUNT(DISTINCT scr.student_id) AS etudiants_inscrits, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT sca.student_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT scr.student_id), 0), 2) AS taux_presence FROM Courses AS c LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Registrations AS scr ON scr.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Attendance AS sca ON sca.course_id = scr.course_id AND sca.student_id = scr.student_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY taux_presence DESC;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels stades ont une capacité supérieure à la capacité moyenne de tous les stades ?","sql":"SELECT "name", "City", "Capacity"
FROM "stadium"
WHERE "Capacity" > (SELECT AVG("Capacity") FROM "stadium");"},{"question":"Quels événements ont eu lieu en indiquant le nom et la ville du stade correspondant ?","sql":"SELECT e."Name" AS event_name, e."Year", s."name" AS stadium_name, s."City"
FROM "event" AS e
JOIN "stadium" AS s ON s."ID" = e."Stadium_ID";"},{"question":"Combien de nageurs sont recensés pour chaque nationalité ?","sql":"SELECT "Nationality", COUNT(*) AS swimmer_count
FROM "swimmer"
GROUP BY "Nationality"
ORDER BY swimmer_count DESC, "Nationality";"},{"question":"Combien de records sont associés à chaque événement, y compris ceux qui n'en ont aucun ?","sql":"SELECT e."ID", e."Name", COUNT(r."Swimmer_ID") AS record_count
FROM "event" AS e
LEFT JOIN "record" AS r ON r."Event_ID" = e."ID"
GROUP BY e."ID", e."Name"
ORDER BY record_count DESC, e."Name";"},{"question":"Quels événements ne possèdent encore aucun record ?","sql":"SELECT e."ID", e."Name", e."Year"
FROM "event" AS e
LEFT JOIN "record" AS r ON r."Event_ID" = e."ID"
WHERE r."Event_ID" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels nageurs ont participé à au moins deux événements ?","sql":"SELECT s."ID", s."name", COUNT(r."Event_ID") AS event_count
FROM "swimmer" AS s
JOIN "record" AS r ON r."Swimmer_ID" = s."ID"
GROUP BY s."ID", s."name"
HAVING COUNT(r."Event_ID") >= 2
ORDER BY event_count DESC, s."name";"},{"question":"Quel est le stade ou quels sont les stades ayant la plus grande capacité ?","sql":"SELECT "name", "City", "Country", "Capacity"
FROM "stadium"
WHERE "Capacity" = (SELECT MAX("Capacity") FROM "stadium");"},{"question":"Quels nageurs ont un temps sur 100 mètres renseigné et inférieur à la moyenne des temps renseignés ?","sql":"SELECT "name", "Nationality", "meter_100"
FROM "swimmer"
WHERE "meter_100" IS NOT NULL
  AND "meter_100" < (SELECT AVG("meter_100") FROM "swimmer" WHERE "meter_100" IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY "meter_100";"},{"question":"Pour quelles années le nombre d'événements est-il supérieur à un événement ?","sql":"SELECT "Year", COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM "event"
GROUP BY "Year"
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY "Year";"},{"question":"Quels stades n'accueillent aucun événement ?","sql":"SELECT s."ID", s."name", s."City"
FROM "stadium" AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "event" AS e
    WHERE e."Stadium_ID" = s."ID"
);"},{"question":"Quels nageurs ont obtenu un record lors d'un événement organisé en France ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s."ID", s."name", s."Nationality"
FROM "swimmer" AS s
JOIN "record" AS r ON r."Swimmer_ID" = s."ID"
JOIN "event" AS e ON e."ID" = r."Event_ID"
JOIN "stadium" AS st ON st."ID" = e."Stadium_ID"
WHERE st."Country" = 'France';"},{"question":"Quels pays possèdent au moins un stade dont la capacité dépasse 50 000 places ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT "Country"
FROM "stadium"
WHERE "Capacity" > 50000
ORDER BY "Country";"},{"question":"Quels événements ont accueilli plus de nageurs distincts que la moyenne des événements ?","sql":"SELECT e."ID", e."Name", COUNT(DISTINCT r."Swimmer_ID") AS swimmer_count
FROM "event" AS e
JOIN "record" AS r ON r."Event_ID" = e."ID"
GROUP BY e."ID", e."Name"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r."Swimmer_ID") > (
    SELECT AVG(swimmer_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Swimmer_ID") AS swimmer_count
        FROM "record"
        GROUP BY "Event_ID"
    )
)
ORDER BY swimmer_count DESC;"},{"question":"Quels nageurs apparaissent dans les records des événements de 2020 ou de 2021 ?","sql":"SELECT s."ID", s."name"
FROM "swimmer" AS s
JOIN "record" AS r ON r."Swimmer_ID" = s."ID"
JOIN "event" AS e ON e."ID" = r."Event_ID"
WHERE e."Year" = '2020'
UNION
SELECT s."ID", s."name"
FROM "swimmer" AS s
JOIN "record" AS r ON r."Swimmer_ID" = s."ID"
JOIN "event" AS e ON e."ID" = r."Event_ID"
WHERE e."Year" = '2021'
ORDER BY "name";"},{"question":"Quels nageurs ont à la fois un temps sur 100 mètres et un temps sur 200 mètres renseignés ?","sql":"SELECT "ID", "name", "meter_100", "meter_200"
FROM "swimmer"
WHERE "meter_100" IS NOT NULL
  AND "meter_200" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quelle est la capacité moyenne des stades par pays ?","sql":"SELECT "Country", ROUND(AVG("Capacity"), 2) AS average_capacity, COUNT(*) AS stadium_count
FROM "stadium"
GROUP BY "Country"
ORDER BY average_capacity DESC;"},{"question":"Quels événements ont lieu dans un stade situé dans la même ville qu'un autre stade ?","sql":"SELECT e."ID", e."Name", s."City", s."name" AS stadium_name
FROM "event" AS e
JOIN "stadium" AS s ON s."ID" = e."Stadium_ID"
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "stadium" AS s2
    WHERE s2."City" = s."City"
      AND s2."ID" <> s."ID"
);"},{"question":"Quels nageurs ont plus de records que la moyenne du nombre de records par nageur ?","sql":"SELECT s."ID", s."name", COUNT(r."Event_ID") AS record_count
FROM "swimmer" AS s
JOIN "record" AS r ON r."Swimmer_ID" = s."ID"
GROUP BY s."ID", s."name"
HAVING COUNT(r."Event_ID") > (
    SELECT AVG(record_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count
        FROM "record"
        GROUP BY "Swimmer_ID"
    )
)
ORDER BY record_count DESC;"},{"question":"Quels couples de nageur et d'événement ont un résultat renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT s."name" AS swimmer_name, e."Name" AS event_name, r."Result"
FROM "record" AS r
JOIN "swimmer" AS s ON s."ID" = r."Swimmer_ID"
JOIN "event" AS e ON e."ID" = r."Event_ID"
WHERE r."Result" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s."name", e."Name";"},{"question":"Quelles villes accueillent au moins un événement et possèdent aussi un stade ouvert avant 1950 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s."City"
FROM "stadium" AS s
JOIN "event" AS e ON e."Stadium_ID" = s."ID"
WHERE s."Opening_year" < 1950
ORDER BY s."City";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les artistes français âgés de plus de 40 ans ?","sql":"SELECT \"Name\", \"Age\" FROM \"artist\" WHERE \"Country\" = 'France' AND \"Age\" > 40;"},{"question":"Quelles expositions ont eu lieu après 2020, avec leur thème et leur prix d’entrée ?","sql":"SELECT \"Exhibition_ID\", \"Year\", \"Theme\", \"Ticket_Price\" FROM \"exhibition\" WHERE \"Year\" > 2020;"},{"question":"Quels sont les enregistrements de fréquentation associés à l’exposition 3 ?","sql":"SELECT \"Date\", \"Attendance\" FROM \"exhibition_record\" WHERE \"Exhibition_ID\" = 3 ORDER BY \"Date\";"},{"question":"Quels artistes ont organisé au moins une exposition, avec le nombre d’expositions correspondantes ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"Artist_ID\", a.\"Name\", COUNT(e.\"Exhibition_ID\") AS \"Nombre_expositions\" FROM \"artist\" AS a JOIN \"exhibition\" AS e ON e.\"Artist_ID\" = a.\"Artist_ID\" GROUP BY a.\"Artist_ID\", a.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la fréquentation moyenne de chaque exposition ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\", AVG(r.\"Attendance\") AS \"Frequentation_moyenne\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" GROUP BY e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\";"},{"question":"Combien de visiteurs chaque artiste a-t-il attirés au total dans ses expositions enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"Artist_ID\", a.\"Name\", COALESCE(SUM(r.\"Attendance\"), 0) AS \"Visiteurs_total\" FROM \"artist\" AS a LEFT JOIN \"exhibition\" AS e ON e.\"Artist_ID\" = a.\"Artist_ID\" LEFT JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" GROUP BY a.\"Artist_ID\", a.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Combien d’artistes viennent de chaque pays ?","sql":"SELECT \"Country\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_artistes\" FROM \"artist\" GROUP BY \"Country\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_artistes\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles expositions ont un prix d’entrée supérieur au prix moyen de toutes les expositions ?","sql":"SELECT \"Exhibition_ID\", \"Theme\", \"Ticket_Price\" FROM \"exhibition\" WHERE \"Ticket_Price\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Ticket_Price\") FROM \"exhibition\");"},{"question":"Quel est l’artiste le plus âgé et quel est son âge ?","sql":"SELECT \"Name\", \"Age\" FROM \"artist\" WHERE \"Age\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Age\") FROM \"artist\");"},{"question":"Quelles expositions ne possèdent aucun relevé de fréquentation ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"exhibition_record\" AS r WHERE r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\");"},{"question":"Quel est le relevé correspondant à la plus forte fréquentation ?","sql":"SELECT \"Exhibition_ID\", \"Date\", \"Attendance\" FROM \"exhibition_record\" WHERE \"Attendance\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Attendance\") FROM \"exhibition_record\");"},{"question":"Quelle est la fréquentation totale par année d’exposition ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Year\", SUM(r.\"Attendance\") AS \"Frequentation_totale\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" GROUP BY e.\"Year\" ORDER BY e.\"Year\";"},{"question":"Quels artistes ont présenté au moins deux expositions ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"Name\", COUNT(e.\"Exhibition_ID\") AS \"Nombre_expositions\" FROM \"artist\" AS a JOIN \"exhibition\" AS e ON e.\"Artist_ID\" = a.\"Artist_ID\" GROUP BY a.\"Artist_ID\", a.\"Name\" HAVING COUNT(e.\"Exhibition_ID\") >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels pays sont représentés à la fois par des artistes ayant rejoint la galerie avant 2015 et après 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT \"Country\" FROM \"artist\" WHERE \"Year_Join\" < 2015 INTERSECT SELECT \"Country\" FROM \"artist\" WHERE \"Year_Join\" > 2020;"},{"question":"Quels artistes ont une exposition mais aucun relevé de fréquentation pour leurs expositions ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"Artist_ID\", a.\"Name\" FROM \"artist\" AS a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"exhibition\" AS e WHERE e.\"Artist_ID\" = a.\"Artist_ID\") AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"exhibition\" AS e JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" WHERE e.\"Artist_ID\" = a.\"Artist_ID\");"},{"question":"Quelles expositions ont une fréquentation moyenne supérieure à la moyenne de fréquentation de toutes les journées enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\", AVG(r.\"Attendance\") AS \"Moyenne_exposition\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" GROUP BY e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\" HAVING AVG(r.\"Attendance\") > (SELECT AVG(\"Attendance\") FROM \"exhibition_record\");"},{"question":"Pour chaque exposition enregistrée, quelle est sa fréquentation minimale et maximale ?","sql":"SELECT \"Exhibition_ID\", MIN(\"Attendance\") AS \"Frequentation_minimale\", MAX(\"Attendance\") AS \"Frequentation_maximale\" FROM \"exhibition_record\" GROUP BY \"Exhibition_ID\";"},{"question":"Quels artistes ont rejoint la galerie avant leur première exposition ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"Name\", a.\"Year_Join\", MIN(e.\"Year\") AS \"Premiere_annee_exposition\" FROM \"artist\" AS a JOIN \"exhibition\" AS e ON e.\"Artist_ID\" = a.\"Artist_ID\" GROUP BY a.\"Artist_ID\", a.\"Name\", a.\"Year_Join\" HAVING a.\"Year_Join\" < MIN(e.\"Year\");"},{"question":"Quelles dates ont enregistré une fréquentation supérieure à 500 visiteurs ?","sql":"SELECT \"Exhibition_ID\", \"Date\", \"Attendance\" FROM \"exhibition_record\" WHERE \"Attendance\" > 500 ORDER BY \"Attendance\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le prix moyen des expositions par pays d’origine des artistes ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"Country\", AVG(e.\"Ticket_Price\") AS \"Prix_moyen\" FROM \"artist\" AS a JOIN \"exhibition\" AS e ON e.\"Artist_ID\" = a.\"Artist_ID\" GROUP BY a.\"Country\";"},{"question":"Quelles expositions ont cumulé plus de 1 000 visiteurs ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\", SUM(r.\"Attendance\") AS \"Visiteurs_total\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" GROUP BY e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\" HAVING SUM(r.\"Attendance\") > 1000;"},{"question":"Quels artistes ont le même âge qu’au moins un artiste français ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.\"Name\", a.\"Country\", a.\"Age\" FROM \"artist\" AS a WHERE a.\"Age\" IN (SELECT \"Age\" FROM \"artist\" WHERE \"Country\" = 'France');"},{"question":"Quelles expositions ont été organisées par des artistes ayant rejoint la galerie en 2018 ou 2019 ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\", a.\"Name\", a.\"Year_Join\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e JOIN \"artist\" AS a ON a.\"Artist_ID\" = e.\"Artist_ID\" WHERE a.\"Year_Join\" IN (2018, 2019);"},{"question":"Quels identifiants apparaissent à la fois dans les expositions et dans les relevés de fréquentation ?","sql":"SELECT \"Exhibition_ID\" FROM \"exhibition\" INTERSECT SELECT \"Exhibition_ID\" FROM \"exhibition_record\";"},{"question":"Donnez le détail des expositions avec le nom de l’artiste, le pays, le thème et le prix d’entrée.","sql":"SELECT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", a.\"Name\", a.\"Country\", e.\"Theme\", e.\"Ticket_Price\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e JOIN \"artist\" AS a ON a.\"Artist_ID\" = e.\"Artist_ID\" ORDER BY e.\"Year\", e.\"Exhibition_ID\";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les codes et descriptions de tous les types de documents ?","sql":"SELECT document_type_code, document_description FROM Document_Types;"},{"question":"Quelles organisations sont enregistrées, avec leurs détails ?","sql":"SELECT organisation_id, organisation_details FROM Organisations;"},{"question":"Quels sont les types d'organisations et leur description ?","sql":"SELECT organisation_type, organisation_type_description FROM Organisation_Types;"},{"question":"Quels projets sont associés à chaque organisation ?","sql":"SELECT p.project_id, o.customer_id FROM Orders AS o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Order_Items AS oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Order_Items AS oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Shipment_Items AS si WHERE si.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id));"},{"question":"Quelle est la date de la dernière expédition pour chaque commande ?","sql":"SELECT o.order_id, (SELECT MAX(s.shipment_date) FROM Shipments AS s WHERE s.order_id = o.order_id) AS derniere_expedition FROM Orders AS o;"},{"question":"Quels produits apparaissent dans des commandes distinctes ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS nombre_commandes FROM Products AS p JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) > 1;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont toutes leurs commandes associées à une expédition ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name FROM Customers AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Shipments AS s WHERE s.order_id = o.order_id));"},{"question":"Quels noms de produits et de clients peuvent être réunis dans une même liste ?","sql":"SELECT product_name AS nom FROM Products WHERE product_name IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT customer_name AS nom FROM Customers WHERE customer_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY nom;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de produits ont été commandés et apparaissent dans des articles expédiés ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT oi.product_id FROM Order_Items AS oi JOIN Shipment_Items AS si ON si.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id;"},{"question":"Quelles factures ne sont liées à aucune expédition ?","sql":"SELECT i.invoice_number, i.invoice_date FROM Invoices AS i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Shipments AS s WHERE s.invoice_number = i.invoice_number);"},{"question":"Quelle commande contient le plus grand nombre d'articles ?","sql":"SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_articles FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(nombre_articles) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_articles FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id));"},{"question":"Combien de commandes ont été passées chaque année et chaque mois ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', date_order_placed) AS annee, strftime('%m', date_order_placed) AS mois, COUNT(*) AS nombre_commandes FROM Orders GROUP BY strftime('%Y', date_order_placed), strftime('%m', date_order_placed) ORDER BY annee, mois;"},{"question":"Pour chaque commande, combien d'articles sont dans chaque statut ?","sql":"SELECT order_id, order_item_status, COUNT(*) AS nombre_articles FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id, order_item_status ORDER BY order_id, order_item_status;"},{"question":"Quelles expéditions n'ont pas de numéro de suivi ?","sql":"SELECT shipment_id, order_id, shipment_date FROM Shipments WHERE shipment_tracking_number IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont passé leur dernière commande à la date la plus récente parmi toutes les commandes ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, o.order_id, o.date_order_placed FROM Customers AS c JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed = (SELECT MAX(date_order_placed) FROM Orders);"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Combien de lots chaque investisseur possède-t-il, y compris ceux qui n’en possèdent aucun ?","sql":"SELECT i.investor_id, i.Investor_details, COUNT(l.lot_id) AS nombre_de_lots
FROM Investors AS i
LEFT JOIN Lots AS l ON l.investor_id = i.investor_id
GROUP BY i.investor_id, i.Investor_details;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les transactions avec le code et la description de leur type, ainsi que les détails de l’investisseur ?","sql":"SELECT t.transaction_id, t.date_of_transaction, t.amount_of_transaction, t.transaction_type_code, r.transaction_type_description, i.Investor_details
FROM Transactions AS t
JOIN Ref_Transaction_Types AS r ON r.transaction_type_code = t.transaction_type_code
JOIN Investors AS i ON i.investor_id = t.investor_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des transactions pour chaque investisseur ?","sql":"SELECT i.investor_id, i.Investor_details, SUM(t.amount_of_transaction) AS montant_total
FROM Investors AS i
JOIN Transactions AS t ON t.investor_id = i.investor_id
GROUP BY i.investor_id, i.Investor_details;"},{"question":"Quelles transactions ont un montant supérieur au montant moyen de toutes les transactions ?","sql":"SELECT transaction_id, investor_id, date_of_transaction, amount_of_transaction
FROM Transactions
WHERE amount_of_transaction > (SELECT AVG(amount_of_transaction) FROM Transactions);"},{"question":"Quels achats sont enregistrés avec la date, le montant et les détails de l’achat ?","sql":"SELECT p.purchase_transaction_id, p.purchase_details, t.date_of_transaction, t.amount_of_transaction, t.investor_id
FROM Purchases AS p
JOIN Transactions AS t ON t.transaction_id = p.purchase_transaction_id;"},{"question":"Affiche les ventes avec les informations de l’investisseur concerné.","sql":"SELECT s.sales_transaction_id, s.sales_details, t.date_of_transaction, t.amount_of_transaction, i.investor_id, i.Investor_details
FROM Sales AS s
JOIN Transactions AS t ON t.transaction_id = s.sales_transaction_id
JOIN Investors AS i ON i.investor_id = t.investor_id;"},{"question":"Quels lots ne sont associés à aucune transaction ?","sql":"SELECT l.lot_id, l.investor_id, l.lot_details
FROM Lots AS l
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Transactions_Lots AS tl
    WHERE tl.lot_id = l.lot_id
);"},{"question":"Combien de transactions relèvent de chaque type, y compris les types jamais utilisés ?","sql":"SELECT r.transaction_type_code, r.transaction_type_description, COUNT(t.transaction_id) AS nombre_de_transactions
FROM Ref_Transaction_Types AS r
LEFT JOIN Transactions AS t ON t.transaction_type_code = r.transaction_type_code
GROUP BY r.transaction_type_code, r.transaction_type_description;"},{"question":"Quels investisseurs ont un montant total de transactions supérieur à la moyenne des totaux par investisseur ?","sql":"SELECT i.investor_id, i.Investor_details, SUM(t.amount_of_transaction) AS montant_total
FROM Investors AS i
JOIN Transactions AS t ON t.investor_id = i.investor_id
GROUP BY i.investor_id, i.Investor_details
HAVING SUM(t.amount_of_transaction) > (
    SELECT AVG(total_amount)
    FROM (
        SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount_of_transaction) AS total_amount
        FROM Transactions
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ) AS totaux
);"},{"question":"Quelles transactions sont liées à un lot appartenant au même investisseur ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT t.transaction_id, t.investor_id, tl.lot_id, t.date_of_transaction
FROM Transactions AS t
JOIN Transactions_Lots AS tl ON tl.transaction_id = t.transaction_id
JOIN Lots AS l ON l.lot_id = tl.lot_id AND l.investor_id = t.investor_id;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de transactions apparaissent dans les achats ou dans les ventes ?","sql":"SELECT purchase_transaction_id AS transaction_id
FROM Purchases
UNION
SELECT sales_transaction_id AS transaction_id
FROM Sales;"},{"question":"Quelle est la transaction la plus récente de chaque investisseur ?","sql":"SELECT t.transaction_id, t.investor_id, t.date_of_transaction, t.amount_of_transaction
FROM Transactions AS t
WHERE t.date_of_transaction = (
    SELECT MAX(t2.date_of_transaction)
    FROM Transactions AS t2
    WHERE t2.investor_id = t.investor_id
);"},{"question":"Combien de transactions ont une valeur de nombre de parts renseignée pour chaque investisseur ?","sql":"SELECT i.investor_id, i.Investor_details, COUNT(t.transaction_id) AS transactions_avec_parts
FROM Investors AS i
LEFT JOIN Transactions AS t ON t.investor_id = i.investor_id AND t.share_count IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.investor_id, i.Investor_details;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant moyen des transactions pour chaque type de transaction ?","sql":"SELECT r.transaction_type_code, r.transaction_type_description, AVG(t.amount_of_transaction) AS montant_moyen
FROM Ref_Transaction_Types AS r
JOIN Transactions AS t ON t.transaction_type_code = r.transaction_type_code
GROUP BY r.transaction_type_code, r.transaction_type_description;"},{"question":"Quels investisseurs ont réalisé au moins un achat et au moins une vente ?","sql":"SELECT i.investor_id, i.Investor_details
FROM Investors AS i
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Purchases AS p
    JOIN Transactions AS tp ON tp.transaction_id = p.purchase_transaction_id
    WHERE tp.investor_id = i.investor_id
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Sales AS s
    JOIN Transactions AS ts ON ts.transaction_id = s.sales_transaction_id
    WHERE ts.investor_id = i.investor_id
);"},{"question":"Quels codes de type ne sont associés à aucune transaction ?","sql":"SELECT r.transaction_type_code, r.transaction_type_description
FROM Ref_Transaction_Types AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Transactions AS t
    WHERE t.transaction_type_code = r.transaction_type_code
);"},{"question":"Pour chaque investisseur, combien de lots sont liés à au moins une transaction ?","sql":"SELECT i.investor_id, i.Investor_details, COUNT(DISTINCT tl.lot_id) AS lots_lies
FROM Investors AS i
LEFT JOIN Lots AS l ON l.investor_id = i.investor_id
LEFT JOIN Transactions_Lots AS tl ON tl.lot_id = l.lot_id
GROUP BY i.investor_id, i.Investor_details;"},{"question":"Quels investisseurs possèdent plus de lots que la moyenne du nombre de lots par investisseur ?","sql":"SELECT l.investor_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_lots
FROM Lots AS l
GROUP BY l.investor_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > (
    SELECT AVG(nombre_de_lots)
    FROM (
        SELECT i.investor_id, COUNT(l2.lot_id) AS nombre_de_lots
        FROM Investors AS i
        LEFT JOIN Lots AS l2 ON l2.investor_id = i.investor_id
        GROUP BY i.investor_id
    ) AS moyennes
);"},{"question":"Quelle transaction possède le montant le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT t.transaction_id, t.investor_id, t.date_of_transaction, t.amount_of_transaction, r.transaction_type_description
FROM Transactions AS t
JOIN Ref_Transaction_Types AS r ON r.transaction_type_code = t.transaction_type_code
WHERE t.amount_of_transaction = (SELECT MAX(amount_of_transaction) FROM Transactions);"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des transactions pour chaque mois de leur date d’enregistrement ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date_of_transaction) AS mois, SUM(amount_of_transaction) AS montant_total
FROM Transactions
WHERE date_of_transaction IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date_of_transaction)
ORDER BY mois;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les problèmes encore ouverts, avec leur produit et leur date de signalement ?","sql":"SELECT p.problem_id, pr.product_name, p.date_problem_reported
FROM Problems AS p
JOIN Product AS pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.date_problem_closed IS NULL
ORDER BY p.date_problem_reported;"},{"question":"Combien de journaux existent pour chaque statut de problème ?","sql":"SELECT s.problem_status_code, s.problem_status_description, COUNT(l.problem_log_id) AS nombre_journaux
FROM Problem_Status_Codes AS s
LEFT JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.problem_status_code = s.problem_status_code
GROUP BY s.problem_status_code, s.problem_status_description
ORDER BY nombre_journaux DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles catégories n'apparaissent dans aucun journal de problème ?","sql":"SELECT c.problem_category_code, c.problem_category_description
FROM Problem_Category_Codes AS c
LEFT JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.problem_category_code = c.problem_category_code
WHERE l.problem_log_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.problem_category_code;"},{"question":"Combien de journaux chaque membre du personnel s'est-il vu attribuer ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name, COUNT(l.problem_log_id) AS nombre_journaux
FROM Staff AS s
LEFT JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.assigned_to_staff_id = s.staff_id
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name
ORDER BY nombre_journaux DESC, s.staff_last_name;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne, en jours, entre le signalement et la clôture des problèmes pour chaque produit ?","sql":"SELECT pr.product_id, pr.product_name, AVG(julianday(p.date_problem_closed) - julianday(p.date_problem_reported)) AS duree_moyenne_jours
FROM Product AS pr
JOIN Problems AS p ON p.product_id = pr.product_id
WHERE p.date_problem_closed IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY pr.product_id, pr.product_name
ORDER BY duree_moyenne_jours DESC;"},{"question":"Quels problèmes n'ont encore aucun journal associé ?","sql":"SELECT p.problem_id, p.problem_description
FROM Problems AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Problem_Log AS l
    WHERE l.problem_id = p.problem_id
)
ORDER BY p.problem_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le dernier journal enregistré pour chaque problème qui possède au moins un journal ?","sql":"SELECT l.problem_id, l.problem_log_id, l.log_entry_date, l.log_entry_description
FROM Problem_Log AS l
WHERE l.log_entry_date = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.log_entry_date)
    FROM Problem_Log AS l2
    WHERE l2.problem_id = l.problem_id
)
ORDER BY l.problem_id;"},{"question":"Combien de problèmes chaque membre du personnel a-t-il signalés ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name, COUNT(p.problem_id) AS nombre_problemes_signales
FROM Staff AS s
LEFT JOIN Problems AS p ON p.reported_by_staff_id = s.staff_id
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name
ORDER BY nombre_problemes_signales DESC, s.staff_last_name;"},{"question":"Pour chaque catégorie utilisée, quel est le nombre de journaux et le nombre de problèmes distincts concernés ?","sql":"SELECT c.problem_category_code, c.problem_category_description, COUNT(l.problem_log_id) AS nombre_journaux, COUNT(DISTINCT l.problem_id) AS nombre_problemes
FROM Problem_Category_Codes AS c
JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.problem_category_code = c.problem_category_code
GROUP BY c.problem_category_code, c.problem_category_description
ORDER BY nombre_problemes DESC, c.problem_category_code;"},{"question":"Affichez chaque journal avec la description de son statut et le nom de la personne à qui il est attribué.","sql":"SELECT l.problem_log_id, l.problem_id, s.problem_status_description, st.staff_first_name, st.staff_last_name, l.log_entry_date
FROM Problem_Log AS l
JOIN Problem_Status_Codes AS s ON s.problem_status_code = l.problem_status_code
JOIN Staff AS st ON st.staff_id = l.assigned_to_staff_id
ORDER BY l.log_entry_date;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont au moins un problème et combien en ont-ils ?","sql":"SELECT pr.product_id, pr.product_name, COUNT(p.problem_id) AS nombre_problemes
FROM Product AS pr
JOIN Problems AS p ON p.product_id = pr.product_id
GROUP BY pr.product_id, pr.product_name
ORDER BY nombre_problemes DESC, pr.product_name;"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel ont signalé au moins un problème encore ouvert ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name
FROM Staff AS s
JOIN Problems AS p ON p.reported_by_staff_id = s.staff_id
WHERE p.date_problem_closed IS NULL
ORDER BY s.staff_last_name, s.staff_first_name;"},{"question":"Quels problèmes sont associés à plusieurs catégories distinctes dans leurs journaux ?","sql":"SELECT p.problem_id, p.problem_description, COUNT(DISTINCT l.problem_category_code) AS nombre_categories
FROM Problems AS p
JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.problem_id = p.problem_id
GROUP BY p.problem_id, p.problem_description
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.problem_category_code) > 1
ORDER BY nombre_categories DESC, p.problem_id;"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel sont intervenus soit comme déclarants, soit comme responsables de journaux ?","sql":"SELECT staff_id, staff_first_name, staff_last_name
FROM Staff
WHERE staff_id IN (
    SELECT reported_by_staff_id FROM Problems
    UNION
    SELECT assigned_to_staff_id FROM Problem_Log
)
ORDER BY staff_last_name, staff_first_name;"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel ont à la fois signalé un problème et autorisé une clôture ?","sql":"SELECT staff_id, staff_first_name, staff_last_name
FROM Staff
WHERE staff_id IN (SELECT reported_by_staff_id FROM Problems)
  AND staff_id IN (SELECT closure_authorised_by_staff_id FROM Problems)
ORDER BY staff_last_name, staff_first_name;"},{"question":"Quel problème possède le plus grand nombre de journaux ?","sql":"SELECT p.problem_id, p.problem_description, COUNT(l.problem_log_id) AS nombre_journaux
FROM Problems AS p
JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.problem_id = p.problem_id
GROUP BY p.problem_id, p.problem_description
ORDER BY nombre_journaux DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Combien de problèmes ont été signalés au cours de chaque mois ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date_problem_reported) AS mois, COUNT(*) AS nombre_problemes
FROM Problems
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date_problem_reported)
ORDER BY mois;"},{"question":"Quels problèmes ont été clôturés après leur date de signalement ?","sql":"SELECT problem_id, problem_description, date_problem_reported, date_problem_closed
FROM Problems
WHERE date_problem_closed IS NOT NULL
  AND date_problem_closed > date_problem_reported
ORDER BY date_problem_closed;"},{"question":"Quels journaux ne contiennent aucune information de correction ?","sql":"SELECT problem_log_id, problem_id, log_entry_date, log_entry_description
FROM Problem_Log
WHERE log_entry_fix IS NULL OR TRIM(log_entry_fix) = ''
ORDER BY log_entry_date;"},{"question":"Pour chaque catégorie, combien de journaux concernent des problèmes clôturés ?","sql":"SELECT c.problem_category_code, c.problem_category_description, COUNT(l.problem_log_id) AS journaux_de_problemes_clotures
FROM Problem_Category_Codes AS c
LEFT JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.problem_category_code = c.problem_category_code
LEFT JOIN Problems AS p ON p.problem_id = l.problem_id
WHERE p.date_problem_closed IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.problem_category_code, c.problem_category_description
ORDER BY journaux_de_problemes_clotures DESC;"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel n'ont jamais été responsables d'un journal ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name
FROM Staff AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Problem_Log AS l
    WHERE l.assigned_to_staff_id = s.staff_id
)
ORDER BY s.staff_last_name, s.staff_first_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le problème le plus récemment signalé pour chaque produit qui possède au moins un problème ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, pr.product_name, p.problem_id, p.date_problem_reported
FROM Problems AS p
JOIN Product AS pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.date_problem_reported = (
    SELECT MAX(p2.date_problem_reported)
    FROM Problems AS p2
    WHERE p2.product_id = p.product_id
)
ORDER BY pr.product_name;"},{"question":"Quels problèmes clôturés ont duré plus longtemps que la durée moyenne de tous les problèmes clôturés ?","sql":"SELECT problem_id, problem_description, date_problem_reported, date_problem_closed,
       julianday(date_problem_closed) - julianday(date_problem_reported) AS duree_jours
FROM Problems
WHERE date_problem_closed IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday(date_problem_closed) - julianday(date_problem_reported) > (
      SELECT AVG(julianday(date_problem_closed) - julianday(date_problem_reported))
      FROM Problems
      WHERE date_problem_closed IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY duree_jours DESC;"},{"question":"Quels statuts ne sont utilisés par aucun journal ?","sql":"SELECT s.problem_status_code, s.problem_status_description
FROM Problem_Status_Codes AS s
LEFT JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.problem_status_code = s.problem_status_code
WHERE l.problem_log_id IS NULL
ORDER BY s.problem_status_code;"},{"question":"Quelle est la catégorie qui apparaît le plus souvent dans les journaux ?","sql":"SELECT c.problem_category_code, c.problem_category_description, COUNT(l.problem_log_id) AS nombre_journaux
FROM Problem_Category_Codes AS c
JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.problem_category_code = c.problem_category_code
GROUP BY c.problem_category_code, c.problem_category_description
ORDER BY nombre_journaux DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels problèmes ont été signalés en 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT problem_id, product_id, date_problem_reported, problem_description
FROM Problems
WHERE date_problem_reported >= '2024-01-01'
  AND date_problem_reported < '2025-01-01'
ORDER BY date_problem_reported;"},{"question":"Pour quels problèmes la personne ayant autorisé la clôture est-elle différente de la personne ayant signalé le problème ?","sql":"SELECT p.problem_id, p.reported_by_staff_id, p.closure_authorised_by_staff_id
FROM Problems AS p
WHERE p.reported_by_staff_id <> p.closure_authorised_by_staff_id
ORDER BY p.problem_id;"},{"question":"Quelles descriptions de problèmes apparaissent plusieurs fois ?","sql":"SELECT problem_description, COUNT(*) AS nombre_occurrences
FROM Problems
WHERE problem_description IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY problem_description
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY nombre_occurrences DESC, problem_description;"},{"question":"Pour chaque membre du personnel ayant au moins un journal attribué, indiquez son nombre de journaux et la date de son dernier journal.","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name, COUNT(l.problem_log_id) AS nombre_journaux, MAX(l.log_entry_date) AS dernier_journal
FROM Staff AS s
JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.assigned_to_staff_id = s.staff_id
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name
ORDER BY nombre_journaux DESC, dernier_journal DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles catégories sont utilisées dans les journaux de problèmes encore ouverts ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.problem_category_code, c.problem_category_description
FROM Problem_Category_Codes AS c
JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.problem_category_code = c.problem_category_code
JOIN Problems AS p ON p.problem_id = l.problem_id
WHERE p.date_problem_closed IS NULL
ORDER BY c.problem_category_code;"},{"question":"Combien de journaux y a-t-il en moyenne par problème parmi les problèmes possédant au moins un journal ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(nombre_journaux) AS moyenne_journaux_par_probleme
FROM (
    SELECT problem_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_journaux
    FROM Problem_Log
    GROUP BY problem_id
) AS statistiques;"},{"question":"Quels produits n'ont aucun problème encore ouvert ?","sql":"SELECT pr.product_id, pr.product_name
FROM Product AS pr
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Problems AS p
    WHERE p.product_id = pr.product_id
      AND p.date_problem_closed IS NULL
)
ORDER BY pr.product_name;"},{"question":"Quels problèmes possèdent au moins un journal avec une correction et aucun journal sans correction ?","sql":"SELECT p.problem_id, p.problem_description
FROM Problems AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Problem_Log AS l
    WHERE l.problem_id = p.problem_id
      AND l.log_entry_fix IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(l.log_entry_fix) <> ''
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Problem_Log AS l
    WHERE l.problem_id = p.problem_id
      AND (l.log_entry_fix IS NULL OR TRIM(l.log_entry_fix) = '')
)
ORDER BY p.problem_id;"},{"question":"Affichez les problèmes avec leur produit, leur déclarant et la personne ayant autorisé leur clôture.","sql":"SELECT p.problem_id, pr.product_name,
       reporter.staff_first_name AS declarant_prenom,
       reporter.staff_last_name AS declarant_nom,
       authoriser.staff_first_name AS autorisateur_prenom,
       authoriser.staff_last_name AS autorisateur_nom
FROM Problems AS p
JOIN Product AS pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Staff AS reporter ON reporter.staff_id = p.reported_by_staff_id
JOIN Staff AS authoriser ON authoriser.staff_id = p.closure_authorised_by_staff_id
ORDER BY p.problem_id;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles sont les stations, avec leur localisation et leur nombre total de voyageurs, classées par fréquentation décroissante ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Location", "Total_Passengers"
FROM "station"
ORDER BY "Total_Passengers" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels trains desservent chaque station ?","sql":"SELECT s."Name" AS station, t."Name" AS train
FROM "station" AS s
JOIN "train_station" AS ts ON ts."Station_ID" = s."Station_ID"
JOIN "train" AS t ON t."Train_ID" = ts."Train_ID"
ORDER BY s."Name", t."Name";"},{"question":"Combien de trains desservent chaque station, y compris celles qui ne sont desservies par aucun train ?","sql":"SELECT s."Name" AS station, COUNT(ts."Train_ID") AS nombre_de_trains
FROM "station" AS s
LEFT JOIN "train_station" AS ts ON ts."Station_ID" = s."Station_ID"
GROUP BY s."Station_ID", s."Name"
ORDER BY nombre_de_trains DESC, station;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de quais par localisation ?","sql":"SELECT "Location", AVG("Number_of_Platforms") AS moyenne_de_quais
FROM "station"
GROUP BY "Location"
ORDER BY "Location";"},{"question":"Quelles stations ont un nombre total de voyageurs supérieur à la moyenne de toutes les stations ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Total_Passengers"
FROM "station"
WHERE "Total_Passengers" > (SELECT AVG("Total_Passengers") FROM "station")
ORDER BY "Total_Passengers" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de trains existe-t-il pour chaque type de service ?","sql":"SELECT "Service", COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_trains
FROM "train"
GROUP BY "Service"
ORDER BY nombre_de_trains DESC, "Service";"},{"question":"Quelles stations ne sont desservies par aucun train ?","sql":"SELECT s."Name"
FROM "station" AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "train_station" AS ts
    WHERE ts."Station_ID" = s."Station_ID"
)
ORDER BY s."Name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque localisation, quelles sont les stations ayant le plus grand nombre d'interchanges ?","sql":"SELECT s."Location", s."Name", s."Annual_interchanges"
FROM "station" AS s
WHERE s."Annual_interchanges" = (
    SELECT MAX(s2."Annual_interchanges")
    FROM "station" AS s2
    WHERE s2."Location" = s."Location"
)
ORDER BY s."Location", s."Name";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total de voyageurs par type de services principaux des stations ?","sql":"SELECT "Main_Services", SUM("Total_Passengers") AS total_de_voyageurs
FROM "station"
GROUP BY "Main_Services"
ORDER BY total_de_voyageurs DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles stations desservies par au moins un train ont une fréquentation supérieure à la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s."Name", s."Total_Passengers"
FROM "station" AS s
JOIN "train_station" AS ts ON ts."Station_ID" = s."Station_ID"
WHERE s."Total_Passengers" > (SELECT AVG("Total_Passengers") FROM "station")
ORDER BY s."Total_Passengers" DESC, s."Name";"},{"question":"Quelles stations ont soit un nombre d'entrées et sorties supérieur à la moyenne, soit un nombre d'interchanges supérieur à la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT "Name"
FROM "station"
WHERE "Annual_entry_exit" > (SELECT AVG("Annual_entry_exit") FROM "station")
UNION
SELECT "Name"
FROM "station"
WHERE "Annual_interchanges" > (SELECT AVG("Annual_interchanges") FROM "station")
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque train, combien de stations dessert-il ?","sql":"SELECT t."Name" AS train, COUNT(ts."Station_ID") AS nombre_de_stations
FROM "train" AS t
JOIN "train_station" AS ts ON ts."Train_ID" = t."Train_ID"
GROUP BY t."Train_ID", t."Name"
ORDER BY nombre_de_stations DESC, train;"},{"question":"Quels trains desservent au moins deux stations ?","sql":"SELECT t."Name", COUNT(ts."Station_ID") AS nombre_de_stations
FROM "train" AS t
JOIN "train_station" AS ts ON ts."Train_ID" = t."Train_ID"
GROUP BY t."Train_ID", t."Name"
HAVING COUNT(ts."Station_ID") >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_de_stations DESC, t."Name";"},{"question":"Quelle ou quelles stations ont le plus grand nombre total de voyageurs ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Total_Passengers"
FROM "station"
WHERE "Total_Passengers" = (SELECT MAX("Total_Passengers") FROM "station")
ORDER BY "Name";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels utilisateurs ont un nombre d’abonnés supérieur à la moyenne de tous les utilisateurs ?","sql":"SELECT uid, name, followers
FROM user_profiles
WHERE followers > (SELECT AVG(followers) FROM user_profiles)
ORDER BY followers DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de tweets chaque utilisateur a-t-il publiés, y compris ceux qui n’en ont publié aucun ?","sql":"SELECT u.uid, u.name, COUNT(t.id) AS nombre_tweets
FROM user_profiles AS u
LEFT JOIN tweets AS t ON t.uid = u.uid
GROUP BY u.uid, u.name
ORDER BY nombre_tweets DESC, u.uid;"},{"question":"Quelles paires d’utilisateurs se suivent-elles mutuellement ?","sql":"SELECT u1.uid AS uid_1, u1.name AS nom_1, u2.uid AS uid_2, u2.name AS nom_2
FROM follows AS f1
JOIN follows AS f2 ON f1.f1 = f2.f2 AND f1.f2 = f2.f1
JOIN user_profiles AS u1 ON u1.uid = f1.f1
JOIN user_profiles AS u2 ON u2.uid = f1.f2
WHERE f1.f1 < f1.f2
ORDER BY u1.uid, u2.uid;"},{"question":"Quels sont les tweets les plus récents de chaque utilisateur, avec leur date de publication ?","sql":"SELECT t.uid, u.name, t.id, t.text, t.createdate
FROM tweets AS t
JOIN user_profiles AS u ON u.uid = t.uid
WHERE t.createdate = (
    SELECT MAX(t2.createdate)
    FROM tweets AS t2
    WHERE t2.uid = t.uid
)
ORDER BY t.createdate DESC;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs sont suivis par au moins trois personnes ?","sql":"SELECT u.uid, u.name, COUNT(f.f1) AS nombre_abonnes
FROM user_profiles AS u
JOIN follows AS f ON f.f2 = u.uid
GROUP BY u.uid, u.name
HAVING COUNT(f.f1) >= 3
ORDER BY nombre_abonnes DESC, u.uid;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs suivent au moins une personne mais n’ont encore publié aucun tweet ?","sql":"SELECT u.uid, u.name
FROM user_profiles AS u
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM follows AS f
    WHERE f.f1 = u.uid
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM tweets AS t
    WHERE t.uid = u.uid
)
ORDER BY u.uid;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs n’ont jamais publié de tweet ou n’ont pas d’adresse e-mail renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT uid, name, email
FROM user_profiles
WHERE email IS NULL
UNION
SELECT u.uid, u.name, u.email
FROM user_profiles AS u
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM tweets AS t
    WHERE t.uid = u.uid
)
ORDER BY uid;"},{"question":"Combien de tweets ont été publiés chaque jour ?","sql":"SELECT DATE(createdate) AS jour, COUNT(*) AS nombre_tweets
FROM tweets
GROUP BY DATE(createdate)
ORDER BY jour;"},{"question":"Quelles paires d’utilisateurs suivent-elles au moins une même personne ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT
       u1.uid AS uid_1, u1.name AS nom_1,
       u2.uid AS uid_2, u2.name AS nom_2
FROM follows AS f1
JOIN follows AS f2 ON f1.f2 = f2.f2 AND f1.f1 < f2.f1
JOIN user_profiles AS u1 ON u1.uid = f1.f1
JOIN user_profiles AS u2 ON u2.uid = f2.f1
ORDER BY u1.uid, u2.uid;"},{"question":"Quel ou quels utilisateurs ont publié le plus grand nombre de tweets ?","sql":"WITH compteurs AS (
    SELECT u.uid, u.name, COUNT(t.id) AS nombre_tweets
    FROM user_profiles AS u
    LEFT JOIN tweets AS t ON t.uid = u.uid
    GROUP BY u.uid, u.name
)
SELECT uid, name, nombre_tweets
FROM compteurs
WHERE nombre_tweets = (SELECT MAX(nombre_tweets) FROM compteurs)
ORDER BY uid;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les étudiants âgés de plus de 21 ans, classés par âge décroissant puis par nom ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, LName, Fname, Age
FROM Student
WHERE Age > 21
ORDER BY Age DESC, LName, Fname;"},{"question":"Combien d’étudiants y a-t-il dans chaque ville ?","sql":"SELECT city_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_etudiants
FROM Student
GROUP BY city_code
ORDER BY nombre_etudiants DESC, city_code;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont enregistré au moins un vote ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname
FROM Student AS s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Voting_record AS v
    WHERE v.StuID = s.StuID
)
ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Combien de votes pour la présidence chaque étudiant candidat a-t-il reçus ?","sql":"SELECT c.StuID, c.LName, c.Fname, COUNT(v.StuID) AS nombre_de_votes
FROM Student AS c
JOIN Voting_record AS v ON v.President_Vote = c.StuID
GROUP BY c.StuID, c.LName, c.Fname
ORDER BY nombre_de_votes DESC, c.LName, c.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants n’ont encore enregistré aucun vote ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname
FROM Student AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Voting_record AS v
    WHERE v.StuID = s.StuID
)
ORDER BY s.StuID;"},{"question":"Quel est l’âge moyen des étudiants pour chaque spécialité ?","sql":"SELECT Major, AVG(Age) AS age_moyen, COUNT(*) AS nombre_etudiants
FROM Student
GROUP BY Major
ORDER BY Major;"},{"question":"Quels cycles électoraux comptent plus de cinq enregistrements de vote ?","sql":"SELECT Election_Cycle, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_votants
FROM Voting_record
GROUP BY Election_Cycle
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY nombre_de_votants DESC, Election_Cycle;"},{"question":"Quels enregistrements indiquent que le même étudiant a été choisi pour la présidence et la vice-présidence ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Election_Cycle, President_Vote, Vice_President_Vote
FROM Voting_record
WHERE President_Vote = Vice_President_Vote;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont été choisis comme président mais jamais comme vice-président ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname
FROM Student AS s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Voting_record AS v WHERE v.President_Vote = s.StuID
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Voting_record AS v WHERE v.Vice_President_Vote = s.StuID
)
ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels votes ont été enregistrés avant le 1er janvier 2022 ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Registration_Date, Election_Cycle
FROM Voting_record
WHERE Registration_Date < '2022-01-01'
ORDER BY Registration_Date, StuID;"},{"question":"Pour chaque étudiant ayant un conseiller, quel est le nom de son conseiller ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname, a.StuID AS AdvisorID, a.LName AS AdvisorLName, a.Fname AS AdvisorFname
FROM Student AS s
JOIN Student AS a ON a.StuID = s.Advisor
ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne d’âge des étudiants selon leur sexe ?","sql":"SELECT Sex, AVG(Age) AS age_moyen, COUNT(*) AS effectif
FROM Student
GROUP BY Sex
ORDER BY Sex;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont voté pour un candidat à la présidence appartenant à la même spécialité qu’eux ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT v.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname
FROM Voting_record AS v
JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = v.StuID
JOIN Student AS c ON c.StuID = v.President_Vote
WHERE s.Major = c.Major
ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quel candidat a reçu le plus grand nombre de votes pour la vice-présidence ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_votes
FROM Voting_record AS v
JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = v.Vice_President_Vote
GROUP BY s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname
ORDER BY nombre_de_votes DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont voté pour au moins un candidat qui habite dans la même ville qu’eux ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname
FROM Student AS s
JOIN Voting_record AS v ON v.StuID = s.StuID
JOIN Student AS c ON c.StuID IN (v.President_Vote, v.Vice_President_Vote, v.Secretary_Vote, v.Treasurer_Vote, v.Class_President_Vote, v.Class_Senator_Vote)
WHERE c.city_code = s.city_code
ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels sont les étudiants les plus jeunes de chaque spécialité ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname, s.Major, s.Age
FROM Student AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Student AS s2
    WHERE s2.Major = s.Major
      AND s2.Age < s.Age
)
ORDER BY s.Major, s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Combien de votes pour la présidence ont été exprimés lors de chaque cycle électoral ?","sql":"SELECT Election_Cycle, COUNT(President_Vote) AS votes_presidentiels
FROM Voting_record
GROUP BY Election_Cycle
ORDER BY Election_Cycle;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont enregistré un vote lors de chacun des cycles électoraux présents dans les données ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname
FROM Student AS s
JOIN Voting_record AS v ON v.StuID = s.StuID
GROUP BY s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.Election_Cycle) = (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Election_Cycle)
    FROM Voting_record
)
ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont été candidats dans au moins une fonction élective ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, LName, Fname
FROM Student
WHERE StuID IN (
    SELECT President_Vote FROM Voting_record WHERE President_Vote IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT Vice_President_Vote FROM Voting_record WHERE Vice_President_Vote IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT Secretary_Vote FROM Voting_record WHERE Secretary_Vote IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT Treasurer_Vote FROM Voting_record WHERE Treasurer_Vote IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT Class_President_Vote FROM Voting_record WHERE Class_President_Vote IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT Class_Senator_Vote FROM Voting_record WHERE Class_Senator_Vote IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY LName, Fname;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont reçu des votes dans toutes les fonctions électives ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname
FROM Student AS s
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Voting_record WHERE President_Vote = s.StuID)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Voting_record WHERE Vice_President_Vote = s.StuID)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Voting_record WHERE Secretary_Vote = s.StuID)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Voting_record WHERE Treasurer_Vote = s.StuID)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Voting_record WHERE Class_President_Vote = s.StuID)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Voting_record WHERE Class_Senator_Vote = s.StuID)
ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Combien de mariages ont été célébrés dans chaque église, y compris celles sans mariage enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT c."Church_ID", c."Name", COUNT(w."Year") AS "Nombre_de_mariages"
FROM "church" AS c
LEFT JOIN "wedding" AS w ON w."Church_ID" = c."Church_ID"
GROUP BY c."Church_ID", c."Name"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_mariages" DESC, c."Name";"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms des hommes ayant été mariés au moins deux fois selon les données ?","sql":"SELECT p."People_ID", p."Name", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_mariages"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "wedding" AS w ON w."Male_ID" = p."People_ID"
GROUP BY p."People_ID", p."Name"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_mariages" DESC, p."Name";"},{"question":"Quel est l’âge moyen des femmes mariées pour chaque pays, en ne conservant que les pays ayant au moins un mariage ?","sql":"SELECT p."Country", AVG(p."Age") AS "Age_moyen_des_femmes_mariees"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "wedding" AS w ON w."Female_ID" = p."People_ID"
GROUP BY p."Country"
ORDER BY "Age_moyen_des_femmes_mariees" DESC, p."Country";"},{"question":"Quelles églises ont été ouvertes avant la date du plus ancien mariage enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT c."Church_ID", c."Name", c."Open_Date"
FROM "church" AS c
WHERE c."Open_Date" < (SELECT MIN("Year") FROM "wedding")
ORDER BY c."Open_Date", c."Name";"},{"question":"Quels mariages concernent un homme plus âgé que la femme ?","sql":"SELECT w."Year", c."Name" AS "Eglise", m."Name" AS "Homme", m."Age" AS "Age_de_l_homme", f."Name" AS "Femme", f."Age" AS "Age_de_la_femme"
FROM "wedding" AS w
JOIN "church" AS c ON c."Church_ID" = w."Church_ID"
JOIN "people" AS m ON m."People_ID" = w."Male_ID"
JOIN "people" AS f ON f."People_ID" = w."Female_ID"
WHERE m."Age" > f."Age"
ORDER BY w."Year", c."Name";"},{"question":"Pour quelles années le nombre de mariages enregistrés dépasse-t-il la moyenne annuelle des mariages ?","sql":"SELECT "Year", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_mariages"
FROM "wedding"
GROUP BY "Year"
HAVING COUNT(*) > (
    SELECT AVG("Nombre_annuel")
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_annuel"
        FROM "wedding"
        GROUP BY "Year"
    )
)
ORDER BY "Year";"},{"question":"Quelles églises sont une continuation d’une autre église connue dans la base ?","sql":"SELECT c."Church_ID", c."Name", c."Continuation_of"
FROM "church" AS c
WHERE c."Continuation_of" IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM "church" AS ancienne
      WHERE ancienne."Name" = c."Continuation_of"
  )
ORDER BY c."Name";"},{"question":"Quels habitants n’apparaissent dans aucun mariage, ni comme homme ni comme femme ?","sql":"SELECT p."People_ID", p."Name", p."Country", p."Age"
FROM "people" AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "wedding" AS w
    WHERE w."Male_ID" = p."People_ID"
       OR w."Female_ID" = p."People_ID"
)
ORDER BY p."Name";"},{"question":"Quels pays sont représentés à la fois parmi les hommes mariés et parmi les femmes mariées ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT hommes."Country"
FROM "people" AS hommes
JOIN "wedding" AS w_hommes ON w_hommes."Male_ID" = hommes."People_ID"
WHERE hommes."Country" IS NOT NULL
INTERSECT
SELECT DISTINCT femmes."Country"
FROM "people" AS femmes

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles soumissions ont obtenu un score supérieur au score moyen de toutes les soumissions ?","sql":"SELECT "Submission_ID", "Author", "Scores"
FROM "submission"
WHERE "Scores" > (SELECT AVG("Scores") FROM "submission");"},{"question":"Combien de soumissions chaque atelier a-t-il reçu, y compris les ateliers sans soumission ?","sql":"SELECT w."Workshop_ID", w."Name", COUNT(a."Submission_ID") AS "Nombre_de_soumissions"
FROM "workshop" AS w
LEFT JOIN "Acceptance" AS a ON a."Workshop_ID" = w."Workshop_ID"
GROUP BY w."Workshop_ID", w."Name";"},{"question":"Quel est le score moyen des soumissions pour chaque établissement ?","sql":"SELECT "College", AVG("Scores") AS "Score_moyen"
FROM "submission"
GROUP BY "College";"},{"question":"Combien de soumissions correspondent à chaque résultat dans chaque atelier ?","sql":"SELECT w."Name", a."Result", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_soumissions"
FROM "Acceptance" AS a
JOIN "workshop" AS w ON w."Workshop_ID" = a."Workshop_ID"
GROUP BY w."Workshop_ID", w."Name", a."Result";"},{"question":"Quelles sont les soumissions ayant obtenu le score le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT "Submission_ID", "Author", "Scores"
FROM "submission"
WHERE "Scores" = (SELECT MAX("Scores") FROM "submission");"},{"question":"Quelles soumissions ne sont associées à aucun atelier ?","sql":"SELECT s."Submission_ID", s."Author"
FROM "submission" AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "Acceptance" AS a
    WHERE a."Submission_ID" = s."Submission_ID"
);"},{"question":"Quels ateliers comptent le plus grand nombre de soumissions ?","sql":"SELECT w."Workshop_ID", w."Name", COUNT(a."Submission_ID") AS "Nombre_de_soumissions"
FROM "workshop" AS w
LEFT JOIN "Acceptance" AS a ON a."Workshop_ID" = w."Workshop_ID"
GROUP BY w."Workshop_ID", w."Name"
HAVING COUNT(a."Submission_ID") = (
    SELECT MAX("Nombre_de_soumissions")
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(a2."Submission_ID") AS "Nombre_de_soumissions"
        FROM "workshop" AS w2
        LEFT JOIN "Acceptance" AS a2 ON a2."Workshop_ID" = w2."Workshop_ID"
        GROUP BY w2."Workshop_ID"
    )
);"},{"question":"Quels lieux accueillent plusieurs ateliers différents ?","sql":"SELECT w1."Venue", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_paires_d_ateliers"
FROM "workshop" AS w1
JOIN "workshop" AS w2
  ON w1."Venue" = w2."Venue"
 AND w1."Workshop_ID" < w2."Workshop_ID"
GROUP BY w1."Venue";"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont soumis plusieurs articles ?","sql":"SELECT "Author", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_soumissions"
FROM "submission"
GROUP BY "Author"
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;"},{"question":"Quelles soumissions ont un score supérieur à la moyenne des soumissions de leur établissement ?","sql":"SELECT s."Submission_ID", s."Author", s."College", s."Scores"
FROM "submission" AS s
WHERE s."Scores" > (
    SELECT AVG(s2."Scores")
    FROM "submission" AS s2
    WHERE s2."College" = s."College"
);"},{"question":"Pour chaque soumission, combien d'ateliers lui sont associés ?","sql":"SELECT s."Submission_ID", s."Author", COUNT(a."Workshop_ID") AS "Nombre_d_ateliers"
FROM "submission" AS s
LEFT JOIN "Acceptance" AS a ON a."Submission_ID" = s."Submission_ID"
GROUP BY s."Submission_ID", s."Author";"},{"question":"Quels ateliers ne sont associés à aucune soumission ?","sql":"SELECT w."Workshop_ID", w."Name", w."Date", w."Venue"
FROM "workshop" AS w
LEFT JOIN "Acceptance" AS a ON a."Workshop_ID" = w."Workshop_ID"
WHERE a."Submission_ID" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel ou quels ateliers ont la date la plus ancienne ?","sql":"SELECT "Workshop_ID", "Name", "Date", "Venue"
FROM "workshop"
WHERE "Date" = (SELECT MIN("Date") FROM "workshop");"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont à la fois une soumission associée à un atelier et une autre qui n'est associée à aucun atelier ?","sql":"SELECT "Author"
FROM "submission" AS s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "Acceptance" AS a
    WHERE a."Submission_ID" = s."Submission_ID"
)
INTERSECT
SELECT "Author"
FROM "submission" AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "Acceptance" AS a
    WHERE a."Submission_ID" = s."Submission_ID"
);"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms des catcheurs associés à un lieu renseigné, avec leur lieu, classés par nom ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Location"

WHERE "Location" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Combien de catcheurs sont associés à chaque événement renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT "Event", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_catcheurs"

ORDER BY "Nombre_de_catcheurs" DESC, "Event";"},{"question":"Pour chaque élimination, quel catcheur a été éliminé, par qui, avec quel mouvement et à quel moment ?","sql":"SELECT w."Name" AS "Catcheur_elimine", e."Eliminated_By", e."Elimination_Move", e."Time"

JOIN "wrestler" AS w ON w."Wrestler_ID" = e."Wrestler_ID"
ORDER BY e."Time", w."Name";"},{"question":"Combien d'éliminations sont enregistrées pour chaque catcheur, y compris ceux qui n'en ont aucune ?","sql":"SELECT w."Name", COUNT(e."Elimination_ID") AS "Nombre_d_eliminations"
FROM "wrestler" AS w
LEFT JOIN "Elimination" AS e ON e."Wrestler_ID" = w."Wrestler_ID"
GROUP BY w."Wrestler_ID", w."Name"
ORDER BY "Nombre_d_eliminations" DESC, w."Name";"},{"question":"Quels catcheurs détiennent le nombre maximal de jours de règne ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Days_held"
FROM "wrestler"
WHERE CAST("Days_held" AS INTEGER) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST("Days_held" AS INTEGER))
    FROM "wrestler"
)
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Quels catcheurs ont détenu leur titre plus longtemps que la moyenne des jours renseignés ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Days_held"
FROM "wrestler"
WHERE CAST("Days_held" AS INTEGER) > (
    SELECT AVG(CAST("Days_held" AS INTEGER))
    FROM "wrestler"
    WHERE "Days_held" IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY CAST("Days_held" AS INTEGER) DESC;"},{"question":"Quels catcheurs ont été éliminés au moins deux fois ?","sql":"SELECT w."Name", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_d_eliminations"
FROM "Elimination" AS e

GROUP BY w."Wrestler_ID", w."Name"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

FROM "Elimination"
WHERE "Elimination_Move" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "Elimination_Move"
ORDER BY "Nombre_d_eliminations" DESC, "Elimination_Move";"},{"question":"Pour chaque événement renseigné, quel est le nombre de catcheurs et la moyenne de leurs jours de règne ?","sql":"SELECT "Event", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_catcheurs", AVG(CAST("Days_held" AS REAL)) AS "Moyenne_des_jours"
FROM "wrestler"
WHERE "Event" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "Event"
ORDER BY "Event";"},{"question":"Quels catcheurs n'apparaissent dans aucune élimination ?","sql":"SELECT w."Name"
FROM "wrestler" AS w
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "Elimination" AS e
    WHERE e."Wrestler_ID" = w."Wrestler_ID"
)
ORDER BY w."Name";"},{"question":"Quels lieux sont à la fois associés à des catcheurs ayant un règne renseigné et à des catcheurs ayant un événement renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT "Location"
FROM "wrestler"
WHERE "Location" IS NOT NULL
  AND "Reign" IS NOT NULL
INTERSECT
SELECT "Location"
FROM "wrestler"
WHERE "Location" IS NOT NULL
  AND "Event" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Location";"},{"question":"Quelles équipes comptent le plus d'éliminations enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT "Team", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_d_eliminations"
FROM "Elimination"
WHERE "Team" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "Team"
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX("Nombre_d_eliminations")
    FROM (
        SELECT "Team", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_d_eliminations"
        FROM "Elimination"
        WHERE "Team" IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY "Team"
    )
)
ORDER BY "Team";"},{"question":"Quels événements regroupent plus de catcheurs que le nombre moyen de catcheurs par événement ?","sql":"SELECT "Event", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_catcheurs"
FROM "wrestler"
WHERE "Event" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "Event"
HAVING COUNT(*) > (
    SELECT AVG("Nombre_de_catcheurs")
    FROM (
        SELECT "Event", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_catcheurs"
        FROM "wrestler"
        WHERE "Event" IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY "Event"
    )
)
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_catcheurs" DESC, "Event";"},{"question":"Quels noms apparaissent soit parmi les catcheurs associés à un événement, soit parmi ceux associés à un lieu ?","sql":"SELECT "Name"
FROM "wrestler"
WHERE "Event" IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT "Name"
FROM "wrestler"
WHERE "Location" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Name";"}]}
